text.body:
<1> śrīḥ alaṃkāramaṇihāre caturthabhāgaḥ rasavadalaṅkārādinirūpaṇam itthaṃ yathāmati prācāmarvācāṃ ca matānyalam | pravicārya śataṃ sāgramalaṃkārā nirūpitāḥ || rasabhāvatadābhāsabhāvaśāntinibandhanāḥ | rasavatpreyaūrjasvisamāhitamiti śrutāḥ || aparāṅgavyaṅgyabhedā ye proktāḥ prāktanairbudhaiḥ | alaṃkāratvamāpannāścatvāraste'tisundarāḥ || bhāvasya codayassaṃdhiśśabalatvamiti trayaḥ | evaṃ saptāpyalaṃkārā nirūpyante'pare'dhunā || atreyaṃ rasasiddhāntapaddhatirbālabodhakṛte diṅmātraṃ pradarśyate | ratihāsaśokakrodhotsāhabhayajugupsāvismayanirvedākhyāḥ nava cetovṛttiviśeṣā vāsanātmatayā sadā'vasthāyinaḥ ānandāṅkurapūrvāvasthārūpāḥ viruddhā aviruddhā vā yāṃ tirodhātumakṣamāḥ | ānandāṅkurakando'sau bhāvassthāyipadāspadam || iti bharatamuninā viruddhāviruddhasajātīyavijātīyabhāvāntarātiraskṛtānandasūkṣmāvasthātvena lakṣitāḥ sthāyino nāma bhāvāḥ | teṣāṃ cetovṛttiviśeṣāṇāṃ kāraṇakāryasahakāriṇaḥ vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicāribhāvaśabdaiḥ kāvye nāṭye ca pratipādyante | tadyathāratirnāma sthāyī bhāvaḥ tasyāḥ rateḥ kāraṇāni lokasiddhāni taruṇanāyakarahodeśāvasthānakokilālāpamākandamandamārutacandrodayamadhukaralatāgṛhavāpījaladastanitādīni | tatkāryāṇi darśanasparśanopagūhanacumbanabhujavellanādīni | sahakāriṇo nirvedādibhedena trayastriṃśat | yathā nirvedaglāniśaṅkākhyāstathā'sūyāmadaśramāḥ | ālasyaṃ caiva dainyaṃ ca cintā mohassmṛtirdhṛtiḥ || vrīḍā capalatā harṣa āvego jaḍatā tathā | garvo viṣāda autsukyaṃ nidrā'pasmāra eva ca || suptirvibodho harṣaścāpyavahitthamathogratā | matirvyādhistathonmādastathā maraṇameva ca || trāsaścaiva vikalpaśca vijñeyā vyabhicāriṇaḥ | trayastriṃśadamī bhāvāssamākhyātāstu nāmataḥ || iti muninā lakṣitāḥ | ete ca yathāsaṃbhavaṃ navānāmapi sthāyināṃ sahakāriṇaḥ | prakṛte ratirūpaśṛṅgārasthāyinaḥ autsukyavismayāvegaharṣacapalatādayassahakāriṇaḥ | hāsarūpasthāyino vikṛtavastudarśanādayo vibhāvāḥ | vadanavikāsanaradanaprakāśanaprabhṛtayo'nubhāvāḥ cāpalatrāsādayo vyabhicāriṇa iti | anayaiva diśā rasāntarāṇāmapi vibhāvādayo rasārṇavasudhākarādiprabandhadarśibhirunneyāḥ | evamamībhirvibhāvānubhāvavyabhicāribhiḥ kāvye ślokānusaṃdhānapratītaiḥ nāṭye abhyāsapāṭavanirvartitavācikāṅgikādyabhinayaiścābhivyañjito ratyādissāmājikaniṣṭhaḥ sthāyībhāvo rasaḥ | taduktaṃ muninā ‘vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogādrasaniṣpattiḥ' iti | iti saṃkṣepaḥ || atha rasavadalaṃkārasaraḥ rase rasāṅge bhāvāṅge'pyeṣvāhū rasavadbudhāḥ | raso yatra rasasya bhāvasya vā aṅgaṃ bhavati tatra rasavannāmā'laṃkāraḥ | rasasya bhāvasya vā prādhānye tu dhvanitvameva | ataeva dhvanikāraḥ pradhāne'nyatra vākyārthe yatrāṅgaṃ tu rasādayaḥ | kāvye tasminnalaṃkāro rasādiriti me matiḥ || iti | bhāvo nāma vibhāvānubhāvābhivyañjito nirvedādistrayastriṃśadbhedaḥ devatāguruśiṣyadvijaputranṛpādāvabhivyajyamānā ratiśca | taduktaṃ darpaṇe ratirdevādiviṣayā vyañjitā bhāva ucyate | evaṃ bhāvatayā vedyā vyañjitā vyabhicāriṇaḥ || iti | yathā sajyadhanurguṇanirgataśaradhārāpātadhūtayātudavam | raghutanayamupajugūhe pulakitatanuravanijā janasthāne || 2001 || atra sītāyāḥ śrīraghunandanaviṣayakasaṃbhogaśṛṅgārasya tadgatavīraraso'ṅgam || yathāvā itaradurānamapuraharakodaṇḍoddalanaśauṇḍadordaṇḍam | aikṣata sītā raghusutamavanatavadanā vilolataranayanā || 2002 || atretarasurāsuradhanurdharadurāsadapurāhitaśarāsanoddalanena vismayasya sthāyinaḥ paripoṣādadbhutarasaḥ | sa ca śrīraghunandanaviṣayakajānakīgataśṛṅgārarasasyāṅgam || yathāvā yuddhoddhatena hariṇā nirdhūtaṃ vepamānamuptakacam | avalokya bhīṣmakasutaṃ bhavati smerānanassma balabhadraḥ || 2003 || atra yuddhauddhatyābhivyajyamānabhagavadgatavīrarasasya vepamānamityādyabhivyaṅgyarukmigatabhayānakarasāṅgatā | tasya ca balabhadragatahāsyarasāṅgateti vicchittiviśeṣaḥ pūrvasmāt || rasasya bhāvāṅgatve yathā anyonyāśliṣṭāṅgakamanyonyavilāsavivaśitānyonyam | vṛṣagirikuṭumbi mithunaṃ viharatu nassvāntanāmni śuddhānte || 2004 || atra kavigatadivyadampativiṣayakaratibhāvasya tadgataśṛṅgāraraso'ṅgam | yadyapi rasabhāvamāpannasyākhaṇḍabrahmanandasabrahmacāriṇo vibhāvādiparāmarśajīvitāvadheraṅgatā na saṃbhavati | tathā'pi rasasthāyibhāvasyāṅgatayā rasāṅgatvopacāra ityāhuḥ || yathāvā parasumahājyākarṣaṇarabhasonnaddhāni raghukulavivasvan | loṣṭānīva mahānti kṣapācaraśirāṃsi koṭiśo'bhaitsīḥ || 2005 || he raghukulavivasvan ! pareṣāṃ dviṣatāṃ sumahatī yā ājiḥ yuddhaṃ tasyāḥ ākarṣaṇe samīpānayane viṣaye rabhasena vegena harṣeṇa vā unnaddhāni garvitāni utkṣiptāni vā pakṣe sumahatyāḥ ativipulāyāḥ jyāyāḥ kṣiteḥ karṣaṇarabhasena halamukhavilekhanavegena unnaddhāni udastāni mahānti bṛhanti koṭiśaḥ asaṅkhyākānīti yāvat | ‘bahvalpārthāt' iti śas | kṣapācarāṇāṃ daśānanādiniśācarāṇāṃ śirāṃsi koṭiśaḥ loṣṭabhedanalaguḍaviśeṣaḥ ‘koṭiśo loṣṭabhedanaḥ' ityamaraḥ | koṭirasyāstīti koṭiśaḥ | lomāditvānmatvarthīyaśśapratyayaḥ | loṣṭānīva mṛtkhaṇḍānīva abhaitsīḥ vyadīdaraḥ | atra bhagavadgatavīrarasaḥ kavigatatadviṣayakaratibhāvasyāṅgam || yathāvā bhavatā śamite samitau daśavadane deva kṛtajagatkadane | dundubhirativelādbhutakolāhalaśabalito'nadanmarutām || 2006 || deveti saṃbuddhiḥ | atra śrīraghunandanaviṣayakatridaśagataratibhāvasya tadgatavīraraso'ṅgam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre rasavadalaṃkāraḥ pañcādhikaśatatamaḥ atha preyolaṃkārasaraḥ yadi bhāvarasāṅgatvaṃ bhāvasya preya iṣyate | bhāvasya bhāvāṅgatve ca preyo'laṃkāro dviprakāraḥ | ayameva bhāvālaṃkāra iti kaiścidvyavahriyate || tatra bhāvasya bhāvāṅgatve yathā sā manasi saṃnidhattāṃ tāmarasaniketanā rucāṃ vitatiḥ | pratyaṣṭhāpi yayaiva hi nityaṃ śrīveṃkaṭeśvaraiśvaryam || 2007 || atra śrīviṣayakaratibhāvasya śrīnivāsaviṣayakaratibhāvo'ṅgam || bhāvasya rasāṅgatve yathā vāṇīpatisanakādimavāṅmanasāviṣayabhūmni śubhadhāmni | vyomni parame rameśvara vataṃsayiṣye kadā tava padābjam || 2008 || atra kavigataśāntarasasya kadeti sūcitaścintākhyo vyabhicāribhāvo'ṅgam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre preyassaraṣṣaḍuttaraśatatamaḥ athorjasvisaraḥ bhāvāṅgatāṃ rasābhāso bhāvābhāso'thavā'śnute | yadā tadeyamūrjasvināmālaṃkṛtirucyate || yatra rasābhāso bhāvābhāso vā bhāvāṅgatāṃ pratipadyate tatrobhayatrāpyūrjasvināmālaṃkāraḥ | rasābhāso nāma ratyāderanaucityena pravṛttiḥ ‘rasābhāsastu ratyāderanaucityapravartanam' ityuktalakṣaṇāt || yathāvā nārāyaṇadharaṇīdharanātha tvayyeva līyatāṃ mama dhīḥ | na pṛthagjanamatiriva bahuvallabhatā dūṣitā bhavatāt || atra samāsoktibalena pṛthagjanamatau svairiṇītvapratītyā tadgataśṛṅgārarasābhāsasya kavigatabhagavadviṣayakabhāvāṅgatvam | atra śṛṅgārarasasya bahuṣu vallabheṣvanaucityena pravṛttatvādābhāsatvam | yathā''huḥ ekatraivānurāgaścettiryaṅmlecchagato'pi vā | yoṣito bahusaktiścedrasābhāsastridhā mataḥ || iti || yathāvā tvaccakravilūnānyudhi vīrāndivi nātha labdhadivyatanūn | ekaikaiva bahūn suralalanā'vṛṇutaivamapyaśiṣyata taiḥ || 2010 || atrāpi pūrvavat yoṣito bahusaktirūparasābhāsasya kavigatabhagavadviṣayakabhāvāṅgatvam || yathāvā vindatu cirāya vijayaṃ saundaryaṃ kosaleśvarakulendoḥ | yadavekṣya madanakaluṣāsstriya iva munayo'pi daṇḍakāraṇye || 2011 || atra munīnāṃ śrīraghunandanaviṣayakaśṛṅgārarasasyānaucityena pravṛtterābhāsatvaṃ, tasya ca kavigatabhagavatsaundaryaviṣayakabhāvāṅgatvam || yathāvā kva vaśī tvaṃ sukumāraḥ kva nu śūrpaṇakhā'tikāmukī raudrī | rūpyaṃ tvāṃ dāśarathe prāpyānicchantamāpa vairūpyam || 2012 || praśastaṃ rūpamasya rūpyaḥ ‘rūpādāhatapraśaṃsayoryap' iti yappratyayaḥ | ‘rūpyaṃ praśastarūpe'pi' ityamaraḥ | atra śūrpaṇakhāyāmekatraivānurāgādvā anaucityena pravṛttervā śṛṅgārarasasyābhāsatvam | sa ca kavigatatadviṣayakaratibhāvāṅgam | viṣamālaṅkārasaṃkīrṇatvarūpavicchittiviśeṣo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ || sarvamidaṃ rasābhāsasya bhāvāṅgatve udāharaṇam | bhāvābhāsasya bhāvāṅgatve yathā sarvo mamāvanabharo darvīkaragiripate tvayi nyastaḥ | rakṣasi cedrakṣāmuṃ tyakṣasi cettyaja na jātu nirvidye || 2013 || na nirvidye nirvedaṃ na prāpnomi | atra garvarūpabhāvasyānaucityena pravṛtterābhāsatā | sa cābhāsaḥ bhagavadviṣayakabhāvaṃ pratyaṅgabhūtaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre ūrjasvisarassaptottaraśatatamaḥ atha samāhitasaraḥ samāhitaṃ bhāvaśānterbhāvāṅgatve tvalaṃkṛtiḥ || yatra ‘bhāvaśāntistvabhivyakte praśame vyabhicāriṇām' ityuktalakṣaṇabhāvaśānterbhāvāṅgatvam tatra samāhitam || yathāvā kuṭilabhrukuṭivibhīṣaṇaniṭilo duhiṇādiduṣprasādo'pi | prahlādaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva prāsīdastava kiyannu vātsalyam || 2014 || he bhagavannityadhyāhāraḥ | atra ‘apakāriṣu pāruṣyamugratātarjanādikṛt' iti lakṣitabhagavadgatogratākhyabhāvaśāntiḥ kavigatatadviṣayakaratibhāvasyāṅgam | kecittu bhāvābhāsasya bhāvāṅgatve samāhitaṃ, bhāvaśānterbhāvāṅgatve bhāvaśāntirityāhuḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre samāhitasaro'ṣṭottaraśatatamaḥ atha bhāvodayasaraḥ bhāvodayasya bhāvāṅgabhāve bhāvodayo mataḥ | ‘bhāvodayassyādutpattau vyaṅgyāyāṃ vyabhicāriṇām' ityuktalakṣaṇasya bhāvodayasya bhāvāṅgatāyāṃ bhāvodayo nāmālaṃkāraḥ || yathā ambhodharagambhīre vijṛmbhite śauriśārṅgavi ṣphāre | api vijvalati bhujoṣmaṇi vepathumabhajanta hanta daityendrāḥ || 2015 || atra daityendragatatrāsarūpabhāvodayaḥ kavigatabhagavadviṣayakaratibhāvasyāṅgam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre bhavodayasaro navottaraśatatamaḥ atha bhāvasaṃdhisaraḥ bhāvāṅgatve bhāvasaṃdherbhāvasaṃdhiralaṃkṛtiḥ || 'bhāvasaṃdhistu bhāvānāṃ tulyānāṃ vyaṅgyatā yadi' ityuktalakṣaṇabhāvasaṃdherbhāvāṅgatve bhāvasaṃdhiralaṃkāraḥ || yathā bhujabalahṛtabhaiṣmīmukhavilokanotphullalocanadvaṃdvaḥ | caidyādyabhiyogavaśādgṛhṇañ śārṅgaṃ ca jayati yaduvīraḥ || 2016 || atra bhujabalahṛtetyādinā śṛṅgārarasavyabhicāriṇo harṣasya caidyādyabhiyogavaśataśśārṅgagrahaṇenānubhāvena vīrarasavyabhicāriṇa āvegāmarṣādeśca saṃbhūyavṛtteḥ bhāvasaṃdhiḥ | sa ca bhagavadviṣayaḥ kavigataratibhāvasyāṅgam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre bhāvasaṃdhisaro daśottaraśatatamaḥ | atha bhāvaśabalatālaṃkārasaraḥ bhāvāṅge bhāvaśābalye bhāvaśābalyamucyate | yatra bhāvaśabalatāyā bhāvaṅgitvaṃ tatra bhāvaśabalatvaṃ nāmālaṃkāraḥ | bhāvānāṃ śabalatā nāma pūrvapūrvopamardena pravṛttiḥ | yathoktaṃ ‘pūrvapūrvopamardena teṣāṃ śabalatā matā' | iti | teṣāṃ bhāvānāmityarthaḥ || yathā yāsyāmyeva janaḥ kiṃ paśyenmāṃ tamasi kiṃnu vidyātsaḥ | yadi paśyedbrūyānmāṃ kṛṣṇe raktāṃ tadā'smi dhanyaiva || 2017 || iti mandamandamandhe tamasi calantīṃ vrajāsitābjākṣīm | sarabhasamabhimukhamupayan sugāḍhamupagūḍhavān jayatu kṛṣṇaḥ || 2018 || atra yāsyāmyevetyautsukyaṃ, janaḥ kiṃ māṃ paśyediti śaṅkā, tamasi kiṃnu vidyātsa iti dhṛtiḥ, yadi paśyediti vitarkaḥ, brūyānmāṃ kṛṣṇe raktāmiti matiḥ, tadā'smi dhanyaiveti harṣaḥ ityeteṣāṃ pūrvapūrvopamardenottarottarottaravṛtterbhāvaśabalatā | sā ca kavigatabhagavadviṣayakaratibhāvasyāṅgam || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre bhāvaśabalatāsara ekādaśottaraśatatamaḥ <2> atha pramāṇālaṃkārāḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇānāṃ syāccamatkāritā yadi | tadā pramāṇālaṃkārānaṣṭau prāhuḥ pare budhāḥ || tatra pratyakṣaṃ yathā arthānāmindriyāṇāṃ ca saṃnikarṣeṇa yadbhavet | jñānaṃ tadāhuḥ pratyakṣaṃ cāru cettadalaṃkṛtiḥ || indriyārthasannikarṣajanyaṃ jñānaṃ cārutayā varṇitaṃ cetpratyakṣaṃ nāmālaṅkāraḥ || yathā tvayi nātha ruciravacane sudhādhare sundare'tisukumāre | sarvāṇi sarvagandhe vrajasudṛśāmindriyāṇi sukhitāni || 2019 || atra prāthimikena viśeṣaṇena śrotraviṣayasya, dvitīyena rasanendriyaviṣayasya, tṛtīyena cakṣurviṣayasya, turīyeṇa tvagindriyaviṣayasya, pañcamena ghrāṇendriyaviṣayasya, sukhitānītyanena sarvendriyaviṣayānubhavajanyasukhasya ca pratipādanena sarvendriyajanyapratyakṣapratīteścamatkāritayā pratyakṣanāmālaṅkāraḥ || atra 'sarvagandhassarvarasaḥ' iti śrutiranusandheyā || yathāvā tvattanumatidivyatamāṃ tvattīrthaṃ svādu tava sura bhitulasīm | tava padamatimṛdu caritaṃ cāsevya kṛtārtha indriyagaṇo naḥ || 2020 || atrāsevanakarmabhūtaiḥ tvattanumityādibhiḥ cakṣūrasanaghrāṇatvakśrotrarūpendriyaviṣayāṇāṃ pañcānāṃ rūparasagandhasparśaśabdānāṃ āsevyetyanena tadanubhavasya ca pratipādanādayamapi pūrvavatpratyakṣālaṅkāraḥ || yathāvā imamadhunā''lokapathaṃ samanaiṣaṃ phaṇidhare'tra mama nātham | gamito yaśśrutipadavīmamitojjvalabhāḥ purā śriyaḥ kamitā || 2021 || atra phaṇidhare adhunā imaṃ mama nāthaṃ ālokapathaṃ samanaiṣaṃ adrākṣamityarthaḥ | pakṣe lokapathaṃ smṛtipadavīṃ samanaiṣamiti | lokaśabdaḥ smṛtivācī | ‘ato'smi loke vede ca' ityatra ato'smi vede ityatra loke smṛtāvityarthasya bhāṣitatvāt | amitojjvalabhāḥ yaḥ śriyaḥ kamitā purā śrutipadavīṃ śravaṇasaraṇiṃ vedavartanīṃ gamitaḥ yaśśrāvaṇapratyakṣaviṣayatāṃ pūrvaṃ prāpitasso'dhunā cākṣuṣapratyakṣagocarīkṛto'smābhiriti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe śrutiṣu yaḥ śriyaḥpatitvenāmitatejastvena prathitassa eva manvādismṛtiṣvapi tathātvenocyata ityavidamiti bhāvaḥ | atra bhagavataśśrāvaṇacākṣuṣapratyakṣaviṣayatayā varṇanam || yathāvā cintāmaṇigiriśikhare kiṃ tāvadiyaṃ taṭillatā'mbudhare | saṃdihyetthaṃ sthemnā mandaṃ niracaiṣamacyute lakṣmīm || 2022 || sthemnā sthairyeṇa hetunā acyute lakṣmīṃ niracaiṣaṃ neyaṃ jaladhare vidyut kiṃtu śrīnivāse śrīriti niraṇaiṣamityarthaḥ | pūrvatra pratyakṣamātraṃ, iha tu viśeṣadarśanajanyasaṃśayottarapratyakṣamiti viśeṣaḥ || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre pratyakṣālaṃkārasaro dvādaśottaraśatatamaḥ <3> athānumānālaṅkārasaraḥ anumānaṃ liṅgajanyaliṅgijñānamudāhṛtam || liṅgaṃ hetuḥ dhūmādiḥ, liṅgi sādhyaṃ vahnyādiḥ | tathāca hetujanyasādhyajñānamanumitirityarthaḥ | etacca sādhāraṇamanumānam | asya ca kavipratibhonmiṣitatvena sundaratāyāṃ kāvyālaṃkāratā || yathā bhuvanatalaṃ śītalayañ śiśiramayūkhassvakāraṇaṃ bhagavan | śrīnilaya mānasaṃ tava karuṇāśiśiraṃ paraṃ prakāśayati || 2023 || prakāśanaṃ sphuṭabodhanaṃ taccānumityātmakam | atra ca bhagavanmānasaśiśiratārūpaliṅginaḥ śiśiramayūkhakartṛkabhuvanatalaśītalīkaraṇalakṣaṇaliṅgajanyatvenānumānālaṃṅkāraḥ | bhagavanmānasaṃ karuṇāśiśiraṃ bhuvanatalaśītalīkaraṇanipuṇaśiśiramayūkhajanisthānatvāditi prayogaḥ | yathāvā iti chedaḥ padeṣu suptiṅantātmakeṣu ruciḥ abhilāṣaḥ yasyāḥ tathoktāyāḥ padaparivṛttivaicitryādikutūhalinyā iti yāvat | tava bhavatyāḥ taskaraḥ taskara ityeva śabdo bhavati | kiṃca yat yasmāt ayaṃ taskaraśabdatāmāpanno bhāskaraśabdaḥ aparāṅge uttarabhāge guṇena ‘divāvibhāniśā' ityādisūtravihitārdhadhātukaṭapratyayanimittakena laghūpadhaguṇena saṃdānitaḥ yuktaḥ karaḥ kuñdhātuprakṛtikākareti śabdaḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | antaresatāmiti samastaṃ padam | antare ityetadedantamavyayaṃ madhye ityarthakam | ‘athāntare'ntarāḥ antareṇa ca madhye syuḥ' ityavyayeṣvamaraḥ | antare madhye saḥ 'kaskādiṣu ca' iti vihitassakāraḥ ‘tadbṛhatoḥ' iti vihitassuṭsaṃbandhisakāraśca yasya sa tathoktaḥ | tasya bhāvaḥ antaresatā tāṃ gamitaḥ prāpita ityarthaḥ | idamapyākṣiptamevānumānam || yathāvā tvatkīrtisudhāmbhodhaśśītakaro'yaṃ kaṇaḥ phaṇigirīndo | yata eṣa śīkara iti svata eva manīṣibhirvyavahriyate || 2037 || he phaṇigirīndo! śītakaraḥ tvatkīrtisudhāmbhodheḥ kaṇaḥ | idaṃ sādhyaṃ | tatra hetuḥ yata iti | yataḥ yasmāt eṣaḥ śītakaraḥ svata eva śīkara iti manīṣibhirvyavahriyate | vastutastu ataḥ avidyamānatakāraḥ suṣṭhu ataḥ svataḥ vigalitatakāro'yaṃ śītakaraśabdaḥ śīkara iti vyavahriyata ityarthaḥ || yathāvā lopamupayānti tāpāstamāṃsi sakalāni yadgalantitamām | tadamīṣāṃ lasati satāṃ hṛdayākāśe vidhussadā vimale || 2038 || atra sādhye vidhuvilasanenānumiterākṣepātpratīyamānatvam | santo hṛdayākāśavilasadvidhutvavantaḥ luptatāpatvāt galitatamaskatvācceti prayogaḥ | śleṣarūpakasaṃkīrṇamidam | yatra sādhyasyāpyanupāttatve liṅgamātrasyopāttatvenāgūryamāṇaṃ sādhyaṃ tatra dhvanyanumānam || yathāvā bṛṃhanti dantinivahā hreṣante hanta santataṃ vāhāḥ | gṛhacatvareṣu mahatāṃ bahusatvaragā rathāśca viharante || 2039 || atra mahatāṃ lakṣmīkaṭākṣapātratvarūpasādhyasthānumānaṃ dhvanyate || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre anumānasarastrayodaśottaraśatatamaḥ <4> athopamānasaraḥ saṃjñāyāssaṃjñinaścāpi saṃbandhapratyayo hi yaḥ | sādṛśyajñānakaraṇa upamānaṃ taducyate || sādṛśyajñānakaraṇakassaṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhapratyaya upamānam | tadeva camatkāri upamānālaṃkāraḥ || yathā taṃ viddhi kaustubhamaṇiṃ veṃkaṭagirinātha hṛdayamaṇinivahe | yo'tra sakhe gaganāntaratārakanikarasthahimakarākāraḥ || 2040 || sumaśaramiva sukumāraṃ suratarumiva santataṃ mahodāram | jalanidhimiva gambhīraṃ vidāma devaṃ vṛṣācalavihāram || 2041 || atra prathamodāharaṇe gaganāntaratārakanikarasthahimakarasadṛśākāratāśāliveṃkaṭagirināthahṛdayagatamaṇinivahamadhyasthitaṃ vastu kaustubhamaṇipadavācyamityupamānamūlabhūtātideśavākyopanyāsena tadvākyārthajñānādidaṃ vastu kaustubhamaṇipadavācyamityupamitipratīterayamupamānālaṃkāraḥ | dvitīyodāharaṇe tu sumaśaramivetyādivākyaiḥ kandarpasadṛśasaundaryaśālitvasuratarusadṛśaudāryavattvajalanidhisamagāmbhīryavattvānāmatideśavākyārthabhūtasāddaśyātmakānāṃ vṛṣācalavihāradevaśabdavācyaṃ vidāmeti tatpadaśaktigrahalakṣaṇopamitiphalasya pratipādanādatideśavākyārthasādṛśyapratyakṣarūpamupamānaṃ phalena saha darśitamiti viśeṣaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre upamānasaraścaturdaśottaraśatatamaḥ <5> atha śabdapramāṇasaraḥ sa śabdo yattu śabdasya pramāṇatvena kīrtanam | śrutismṛtītihāsādirūpaśśabda itīryate || svoktārthe śrutyādīnāṃ pramāṇatayopanyāsaśśabdapramāṇālaṃkāraḥ | śabdapadārthamāha śrutīti | ādiśabdena purāṇābhāṇakalaukikavākyādīnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ || tatra śrutirūpaśabdo yathā nāvātaraḥ phaṇigirau nātha yadi tvāṃ kathaṃ nu paśyema | vinuyāma vā śrutiryaṃ durgrahamavadanna cakṣuṣetyādiḥ || 2042 || atra bhagavataḥ parasya brahmaṇaḥ cakṣurādīndriyāgrāhyatve 'na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā' ityādiśrutiḥ pramāṇatvenopanyastā | ādiśabdena ‘yattadadreśyamagrāhyam' ityādergrahaṇam || yathāvā vetsi mama bhaktimavane śaknoṣi tathā'pyupekṣase kasmāt | sarveśvara śrutistvāṃ sarvajñaṃ hyāha sarvaśaktiṃ ca || 2043 || atra bhavataḥ mamopekṣāyāṃ madbhaktyajñānaṃ vā rakṣaṇāśaktatvaṃ veti vikalpya tadubhayamapi na saṃbhavatīti jñāpayituṃ ‘yassarvajñassarvavit | parā'sya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate' iti śrutirūpaṃ pramāṇamupanyastam || yathāvā tvāmadvitīya iti yo nārāyaṇa veda sa bhavati bhaviṣṇuḥ | tvannibhamātanuṣe taṃ tannigamāntassa viṣṇuriti vadati || 2044 || he nārāyaṇa! anena vakṣyamāṇārthasya nārāyaṇopaniṣadgatatvaṃ sūcitam | yaḥ pumān tvāṃ advitīya iti apratidvaṃdva iti veda vetti saḥ bhaviṣṇuḥ vardhiṣṇuḥ uttarottaraśreyaśśālī bhavatītyarthaḥ | taṃ evaṃ vettāraṃ bhaviṣṇuṃ pumāṃsaṃ tvannibhaṃ tvatsadṛśaṃ ātanuṣe | tasya sāyujyaṃ dadāsītyarthaḥ | pakṣe taṃ bhaviṣṇuśabdaṃ tvannibhamityatra tvaṃ nibhamiti chedaḥ ‘vā padantasya' iti vaikalpiko'nusvārasya parasavarṇaḥ | tvaṃ nibhaṃ bhakāraśūnyamityarthaḥ | nītyupasargapūrvako bahuvrīhiḥ | ātanuṣe | tat tasmāt nigamāntaḥ nārāyaṇopaniṣadrūpaḥ | sa pumān viṣṇuriti vadati | yathā''mnāyate tatra ‘atha nityo nārāyaṇaḥ' ityupakramya ‘niṣkalaṅko nirañjano nirvikalpo nirākhyātaśśuddho deva eko nārāyaṇaḥ | na dvitīyo'sti kaścit | ya evaṃ veda | sa viṣṇureva bhavati' iti | pakṣe bhaviṣṇuśabdo bhakāracyāvane viṣṇurityeva bhavatītyarthaḥ | atra svoktārthacamatkāre upaniṣat pramāṇatāṃ prāpitā | atra nārāyaṇavedādvitīyo bhavatīti śabdairuktopaniṣatpratyabhijñāpyate || kvacicchruterarthāntaraparikalpanena pramāṇatayopanyāse cārutātiśayaḥ | yathā brahma tvāṃ gamayati māṃ yo gururenaṃ na mānavaṃ manye | tatpuruṣo'mānava ityupaniṣaduktiḥ pramāṇamiha bhagavan || 2045 || atra brahmagamayitṛtvena hetunā ācāryasyāmānavatvasaṃbhāvanarūpasvābhimatārthe ‘tatpuruṣo'mānavassa enān brahma gamayati' iti śruteḥ pramāṇatayopanyāsa iti vaicitryaviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā yadbrahma vṛṣagirigataṃ tajjagatāṃ sukṛtameva jāne'ham| tatsukṛtamucyata iti śrutirāhaitaddhi taittirīyāṇām || 2046 || atra ‘tadātmānagm̐ svayamakuruta | tasmāttatsukṛtamucyate' iti svātmana evopādānatayā svīkāreṇa suṣṭhu sṛjyaprapañcakaraṇarūpapravṛttinimittena sukṛtaśabdavācyatāṃ brahmaṇaḥ pratipādayantī taittirīyaśrutiḥ bhagavati svābhimatajagatsukṛtarūpalakṣaṇe arthe pramāṇatāṃ nītā || yathāvā sarvāntarātmani tvayi yo'nyaṃ yajate phaṇābhṛdacalamaṇe | yajamānaḥ paśuriti yā tāṃ śrutimetatparāṃ vijānīmaḥ || 2047 || yathāvā yajate yastvāmavidanyadunandana sarvayajñabhoktāram | yajamānaḥ prastara iti yā śrutireṣā hi tatparā manye || 2048 || sarvāntarātmani tvayītyanādarādhikye bhāvalakṣaṇasaptamī | prastaro darbhamuṣṭiḥ pāṣāṇaśca | sarvayajñabhoktāraṃ ‘ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca' iti gānāditi bhāvaḥ | ata eva yadunandaneti sābhiprāyaṃ saṃbodhanam | atrādye padye śrutyā anyārthatayā rūpitasya yajamāne paśutvasya ajñatvena hetunā rūpaṇaṃ parikalpitam | dvitīye tu prastarakāryakaratvena rūpitasya yajamāne prastaratvasya pāṣāṇarūpārthāntarakalpanaṃ veditavyam || yathāvā mā bhūvaṃ pratyakṣastava deva parokṣa eva bhūyāsam | tarhi priyo bhaveyaṃ śrutiḥ parokṣapriyān vadati devān || 2049 || atra 'ididragm̐ santamindra ityācakṣate parokṣeṇa | parokṣa priyā hi vai devāḥ' iti parokṣanāmagrahaṇe devānāṃ prītiṃ pratipādayitrī śrutiḥ svasya parokṣatāhetukapriyatvāśaṃsanarūpārthe pramāṇabhāvaṃ gamitā || yathāvā veṃkaṭagirimātrapatiṃ tvāṃ kathayanto janāḥ paraṃ mugdhāḥ | viṣṇurhi parvatānāmadhipatiriti gaurjaratyapi prāha || 2050 || jaratī gaurapi jīrṇaḥ kaścit paśurapi viṣṇuḥ parvatānāṃ sarveṣāmadhīśvara iti vadati | vastutastu jaratī gauḥ 'viṣṇuḥ parvatānāmadhipatissa mā'vatu' iti śrutirityarthaḥ | hiśabdaḥ prasiddhau, atra pūrvārdhoktasvābhimatabhagavato veṃkaṭagirimātramatitvaṃ vadatāṃ janānāṃ mugdhatvopapādane'rthe udāhṛtaśrutirupodbalakatayā pramāṇatāmanāyi | yathāvā jānāsi naiva dīnānasmān kasmāditīha vi śayo naḥ | vṛkṣa iva stabdha iti tvāṃ śrutirāhātha kiṃ vitarkeṇa || 2051 || yathāvā yadamī krandanti hare tvāmavalambyāpi bhavapathe manujāḥ | tadacakṣuśśrotraṃ tvāṃ śrutyantāssāṃprataṃ vadantīti || 2052 || pūrvodāharaṇeṣu śrutirabhimatārthe pramāṇatayopanyastā | anayorudāharaṇayostu ‘vṛkṣa iva stabdho divi tiṣṭhatyekaḥ | acakṣuśśrotraṃ tadapāṇipādam' iti śrutī anabhimatārthe bhagavadupālambhanapareṇa bhavapathanirviṇṇena pramāṇatāṃ prāpite iti bhidā | stabdhaḥ jaḍaḥ | vāstavārthastu nantavyavastuvirahādvṛkṣa ivāpraṇatasvabhāva iti || yathāvā vidadhānassaśrīkānviprānkamalāpate kucelamukhān | na śrī ramate brāhmaṇa iti śrutiṃ vitathavādinīṃ vyadadhāḥ || 2053 || atra viprāṇāṃ niśrīkatāpramāṇabhūtā ‘na vai brāhmaṇe śrī ramate' iti śrutiḥ teṣāṃ saśrīkatānirvartanena vitathārthavāditāprakāśanāyopātteti pūrvāpekṣayā viśeṣaḥ || smṛtirūpaśabdapramāṇaṃ yathā hṛtkamalaṃ mama vimalaṃ śraya mṛdulaṃ śrīśa bhujagarāḍacalam | vijahīhi ciraṃ na vasetparvata iti varvṛtīti hi smaraṇam || 2054 || smaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ varvṛtīti kriyāsamabhihāreṇa vartate | atra bhagavataśrīnivāsasyātimṛdulasvahṛdayāśrayaṇāyātiniṣṭhurabhujagarāḍacalaparityajanaprārthanarūpasvābhīpsitārthe ‘na ciraṃ parvate vaset' iti mānavī smṛtiḥ pramāṇabhāvamanīyata || yathāvā namatāṃ jetuṃ vargaṃ dviṣatāṃ śrayase mṛgendragiridurgam | sarveṣāṃ durgāṇāṃ smaranti giridurgameva hi jyāyaḥ || 2055 || namatāṃ śaraṇāgatānāṃ sambandhinaṃ dviṣatāṃ vargaṃ kāmādyariṣaḍvargaṃ jetuṃ mṛgendragiridurgaṃ śeṣādridurgaṃ siṃhādikrūrasatvādhiṣṭhitaṃ durgamityapi gamyate | atra śrīnivāsasya bhagavataḥ śaraṇāgatasaṃbandhidviṣadvargavijayaphalakatvena saṃbhāvyamānamṛgendragiridurgāśrayaṇarūpe'rthe sarveṇāpi prayatnena giridurgaṃ samāśrayet | eṣāṃ hi bāhuguṇyena giridurgaṃ viśiṣyate || iti mānavī smṛtireva pramāṇatvena pradarśitā || yathāvā durgamacākṣuṣamamatiḥ prapadyatāṃ nācyutaṃ yadāha manuḥ | durgamacakṣurviṣayaṃ na hi prapadyeta karhicidapīti || 1056 || durgaṃ durgamaṃ 'kṣurasya dhārā niśitā duratyayā durgaṃ pathastatkavayo vadanti' iti śruteḥ ‘durlabho durgamo durgaḥ' iti nāmasahasrapāṭhācca | acākṣuṣaṃ cākṣuragocaraṃ ‘na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate' iti śruteḥ | īdṛśaṃ acyutaṃ ‘yasmātprāptā na cyavante so'cyutaḥ' iti niruktiviṣayaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ paraṃ brahma amatiḥ na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ | māyayā'pahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ || ityuktarītyā mūḍhaḥ māyayā apahṛtajñānaśca janaḥ na prapadyatāṃ prapanno mā bhūdityarthaḥ | uktārthe 'acakṣurviṣayaṃ durgaṃ na prapadyeta karhicit |' iti snātakadharmoktaṃ cakṣuragocaraṃ kāntāraṃ kadācidapi na praviśedityarthakaṃ manuvacanaṃ śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyena pramāṇatāmanīyata | pūrvaṃ smṛterabhimatārthe pramāṇatayopanyāsaḥ | iha tu bhagavadaprapannopālambhapareṇānabhimatārthe iti viśeṣaḥ || itihāsarūpaśabdapramāṇaṃ yathā viṣayaviṣābdhāvindriyamakaraiḥ kuṣṭo'pi dhārayan prāṇān | adhunā''paṃ tvāṃ dvīpaṃ jīvan bhadrāṇi paśyatīti nayāt || 2057 || he bhagavanniti prakaraṇāllabhyate | adhunā yādṛcchikādisukṛtaparipākāvasare idānīṃ tvāmeva dvīpaṃ āpaṃ prāptavānasmi | atra bahūni kṛcchrāṇi soḍhvā prāṇān dhārayitussvasya bahoḥ kālādbhagavaccaraṇāvalambanabhāgyalābharūpe'rthe 'vināśe bahavo doṣā jīvan bhadrāṇi paśyati' iti śrīrāmāyaṇaṃ pramāṇatayopāttam | yathāvā etadalaṃkaraṇagaṇaṃ nātha mamādāstvamahamapi tavādām | rāmāyaṇamāha kṛte pratikartavyaṃ sanātanaṃ dharmam || 2058 || he nātha! etat karaṇagaṇaṃ indriyavargaṃ tvadārādhanaupayikamiti bhāvaḥ | mama tvaṃ alaṃ paryāptaṃ adāḥ dattavānasi ahamapi tava adāṃ adadām | asmin pakṣe alaṃkaraṇamiti samastaṃ padam | alaṃkaraṇagaṇaṃ alaṅkārapratipādakamamuṃ prabandhamityarthaḥ | atra svābhimate'rthe ‘kṛte ca pratikartavyameṣa dharmassanātanaḥ |' iti śrīrāmāyaṇasya pramāṇatvavarṇanam | śleṣojjīvitamidam | pūrvaṃ tu rūpakasaṃkīrṇam || yathāvā yadyapi sarvajñastvaṃ na bhaktadoṣāṃstathā'pi jānāsi | tadavijñāteti tvāṃ nāmasahasre paṭhanti munivaryāḥ || 2059 || atra sarvajñasyāpi śrīnivāsasya bhaktadoṣādarśananirdhāraṇe'rthe ‘avijñātā sahasrāṃśuḥ' iti śrībhāratāntargatasahasranāmastutivacanaṃ pramāṇamupanibaddham || purāṇarūpaśabdapramāṇaṃ yathā hānissamajani māpa tvaddhyānabhṛto'pi vāsudeva katham | prāha purāṇaṃ hānissā yat kṣaṇamapi na cintyase tvamiti || 2060 || he māpa! mādhava he vāsudeva! tvaddhyānaṃ bibhartīti tvaddhyānabhṛt tasyāpi nirantaraṃ tvāṃ cintayato'pīti bhāvaḥ | hāniḥ iṣṭahāniḥ kathaṃ samajani ajāyata | āścaryametaditi bhāvaḥ | hāniḥ kuto na saṃbhavedityata āha prāheti | purāṇaṃ yanmuhūrtaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vā'pi vāsudevo na cintyate | sā hānistanmahacchidraṃ sā bhrāntissā ca vikriyā | iti purāṇaṃ, tvaṃ bhavān kṣaṇamapi atyalpakālamapi vā na cintyasa iti yat sā hāniriti prāha | parihārastu pūrvārdhe hā nissamajaniṃ āpa iti chedaḥ | tvaddhyānena bhṛtaḥ janaḥ bhṛñaḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ | nissamāṃ asadṛśīṃ janiṃ janma ‘sa hi vidyātastaṃ janayati tacchreṣṭhaṃ janma' ityuktaprakāraṃ brahmavidyāvettṛtvarūpaṃ janmeti bhāvaḥ | yadvā ‘varṇāśramācāraparaḥ' ityupakramya mahatā tena puṇyena vaiṣṇavatvaṃ labheta saḥ | viṣṇubhaktiparastadvatsapta janmāni mānavaḥ || ekāntabhagavadyājī vipro bhāgavatānvaye | tatassa labhate janma devairatyantadurlabham || iti vārāhoktaṃ lokottaraṃ prapannajanmeti bhāvaḥ | āpa prāptavān | nissaṃdehaiva tatprāptiriti dyotanāya ‘kṛtaṃ kāryamiti śrīmān vyājahāra pitāmahaḥ' ityuktarītyā siddhavatkāreṇa bhūtanirdeśaḥ | hā ityāścarye | atra upapāditaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyanirvyūḍhasvavivakṣitabhagavaddhyātṛhānyasaṃbhāvitatvanirdhāraṇāya upadarśitapurāṇarūpaśabdapramāṇodāharaṇam || vyākaraṇarūpaśabdapramāṇaṃ yathā mahataḥ paramasya sato bhavatā puruṣeṇa pūjyamānena | sāmastye'gryatvaṃ syāddevaitatprāha sanmahatsūtram || 2061 || he deva ! mahataḥ pūjyasya ata eva paramasya utkṛṣṭasya sataḥ brahmavidaḥ kasyacit pūjyena puruṣeṇa bhagavatā nārāyaṇena bhavatā tvayā sāmastye sāmagrye sati saṃbandhe satītyarthaḥ | agryatvaṃ sakalalokāgragaṇyatā syāt | etat, idaṃ karma | sanmahatsūtraṃ kartṛ | prāha vadati | imamarthamuktasūtraṃ kathayatītyarthaḥ | sūtrapakṣe mahataḥ paramasya sata iti ca śabdasya pūjyamānena puruṣeṇa puruṣaśabdena sāmastye samastatāyāṃ satyāṃ samāse satītyarthaḥ | agryatvaṃ pūrvaprayojyatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ | ‘sanmahatparamottamotkṛṣṭāḥ pūjyamānaiḥ' iti sūtreṇa sadādiśabdānāṃ pūjyamānavācakaissaha samāsavidhānātteṣāṃ ‘prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam' ityupasarjanasaṃjñāyāṃ ‘upasarjanaṃ pūrvam' iti pūrvaprayojyatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ | atra vivakṣitasya brahmavido bhagaṃvatsaṃbandhena sarvalokāgragaṇanīyatvasya nirdhāraṇe upapāditaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyena pāṇinīyasūtrarūpaśabdaḥ pramāṇapadavīmanāyi || yathāvā vijitassa pārijātāharaṇaraṇāgre tvayā hare maghavā | bahulaṃ tānto'dyāpica maghavā bahulamiti sūtramiha mānam || 1062 || he hare! maghavā indraḥ pārijātāharaṇaraṇāgre tvayā vijitaḥ | ataeva adyāpi ca bahulaṃ ativelaṃ tāntaḥ glānaḥ | iha asminnarthe 'maghavā bahulam' iti sūtraṃ mānam | maghavato'dyāpi bahulaṃ tāntatve uktasūtraṃ pramāṇamityarthaḥ | maghavaśabdasya uktasūtreṇa tṛ ityantādeśasya bahulaṃ vidhānāttasya bahulaṃ tāntatve tatpramāṇamiti bhāvaḥ | atropapāditārthasthāpanāya śabdārthatādātmyamūlakaśleṣopaṣṭambhena uktasūtrasya pramāṇatāpradarśanam || yathāvā nirmitsā cettava jagadāsīdevātra neṣyate'bhyāsaḥ | ata evācyuta pāṇiniratrābhyāsasya lopamevāha || 2063 || he acyuta! tava jagadekakāraṇasyeti bhāvaḥ | nirmitsā nirmātumicchā cet jagat idaṃ bhuvanaṃ āsīdeva niṣpannameva | na tu tanniṣpattau mātrayā'pi vilambaḥ 'icchāmātraṃ prabhossṛṣṭiḥ' iti śruteriti bhāvaḥ | atra nirmitsāyāṃ abhyāsaḥ paunaḥpunyaṃ neṣyate | sakṛdicchonmeṣamātrādeva saṃbhavantyāṃ jagatsṛṣṭau tatpaunaḥpunyaṃ nāpekṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | ataeva nirmitsāyāmabhyāsānapekṣaṇādeva pāṇiniḥ atra nirbhitsārūpe'rthe, pakṣe nirmitsāśabde abhyāsasya paunaḥpunyasya, anyatra dvirvacanasya lopameva adarśanameva āha kathayati | nirityupasargapūrvakāt mādhātossani ‘sani mī mā' ityārabhya yaduktaṃ tatrābhyāsalopasya ‘atra lopo'bhyāsasya' iti sūtreṇa tena vihitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra bhagavato jagannirmāṇaviṣayakecchābhyāsānapekṣaṇe'rthe pūrvavadeva śleṣamūlātiśayoktyavalambanena upadarśitaṃ pāṇinisūtraṃ pramāṇīkṛtam || yathāvā sama eva bhavati samrāṭ puruṣatvaṃ cāpi bhavati tasyaiva | yanmo rāji samaḥ kvau vraścabhrasjeti sūtritaṃ muninā || 2064 || mayā śriyā saha vartata iti samaḥ | sa eva salakṣmīka eva samrāṭ jagadīśvaro bhavati 'eṣa brahmalokassamrāṭ | rājā dhirājassarveṣāṃ viṣṇurbrahmamayo mahān' ityādiśrutismṛtibhyaḥ | 'salakṣmīkasya sāmrājyaṃ sarvadhā supratiṣṭhitam' ityācāryaśrīsūkteśca | na hyalakṣmīkānāṃ sāmrājyaṃ kadā'pi bhavediti bhāvaḥ | tasyaiva salakṣmīkasyaiva puruṣatvaṃ cāpi ‘pūrvamevāhamihāsamiti tatpuruṣasya puruṣatvam' iti niruktasarvakāraṇatvasarvāntaryāmitvādiprakāśakapuruṣaśabdavācyatvaṃ ca bhavati ‘hrī śca te lakṣmīśca patnyau' iti lakṣmījānerevaṃ ‘vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam' iti puruṣatvaśravaṇāt | evaṃ śrutisiddhe svābhimatārthe pāṇinīyasūtralakṣaṇasmṛtimapi śleṣeṇa pramāṇīkaroti yaditi | tadā pūrvārdhasyaivamartho yat yasmāt samrāḍiti śabdaḥ sama eva makārasahita eva bhavet ‘mo rāji samaḥ kvau' iti kvibante rājatau pare samo makārasya makāravidhānāt | na tu 'mo'nusvāraḥ' iti vihitānusvārasahitaḥ | tasyaiva samrāṭchabdasyaiva puru bhūyiṣṭhaṃ yathātathā ‘purubhūḥ puru bhūyiṣṭham' ityamaraḥ | ṣatvaṃ 'vraścabhrasjasṛjamṛjayajarājabhrājacchaśāṃ ṣaḥ' iti jaśtvasthānibhūtaṃ ṣatvaṃ bhavati | samrāḍiti śabda uktaprakriyayā niṣpadyata iti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā vṛddhācchapratyaya iha bhavettvadīyo na cātra saṃdehaḥ | smarati hi bhagavān pāṇiniramumarthaṃ śeṣaśailamaulimaṇe || 2065 || he śeṣaśailamaulimaṇe! vṛddhaḥ abhivṛddhaḥ tailadhārāvadavicchinna iti yāvat | acchaḥ vijātīyapratyayānantaritatayā nirmalaśca pratyayaḥ tvadviṣayakadhyānaṃ yasya sa tathābhūtaḥ tvadīyo bhavati ‘priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ' ityukta rītyā tava niratiśayaprītipātratāmāpadyeteti bhāvaḥ | atra na sandehaḥ | yadvā vṛddhaḥ pravṛddhaḥ acchaḥ devatāntarasaṃbandhagandhadavīyastayā vimalaḥ pratyayo viśvāso yasya sa tathābhūtaḥ mahāviśvāsaśālītyarthaḥ | tvadīyaḥ tvadekaśaraṇaḥ pumān vṛddhācchapratyaya ityāvṛttyā yojyam | abhivṛddhanirmalajñānaḥ 'sarvaṃ ha paśyaḥ paśyati | sa cānantyāya kalpate' ityuktarītyā nityāsaṃkucitajñāno bhavedityarthaḥ | tvayi mahāviśvāsopalakṣitātmarakṣābharasamarpaṇaṃ vidadhāno mukto bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | atra prāthamike'rthe upāsanā dvitīyasminnyāsa iti vailakṣaṇyam || anyatra vṛddhācchapratyaya iti saptamyantatayā chedaḥ | vṛddhācchapratyaye ‘vṛddhācchaḥ' iti sūtravihitachapratyaye kṛte sati tvadīya iti rūpaṃ bhavatītyāvṛttyā yojanīyam | ‘tyadādīni ca' iti yuṣmacchabdasya vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ ‘vṛddhācchaḥ' iti chapratyaye vihite tvadīya iti rūpaṃ siddhyatītyarthaḥ | uttarārdhaṃ sugamam | atra svābhimate upapādite'rthe pāṇinismṛteḥ prāmāṇatayā'vatāraṇam || yathāvā iyamādeśamajādye dhatte suppratyaye pare'pi śrīḥ | bhavatīlopagatā'sminnarthe śābdikamunervaco mānam || 2066 || he śrīḥ! ilopagatā ilayā bhūdevyā upagatā samīpāśritā 'lakṣmīpriyasakhīm' iti bhūdevyāḥ śrīsakhītvaśravaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | iyaṃ bhavatī suprasiddhā tvaṃ ajādye brahmādau caturmukhasyāpi kāraṇabhūte iti paramātmana eva viśeṣaṇaṃ vā | suppratyaye śobhanajñāne, pratyaya ityupalakṣaṇaṃ śaktibalādīnāmapi paripūrṇajñānādiṣāḍguṇye ityarthaḥ | pare'pi bhagavatyapi ‘paro'riparamātmanoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | ādeśaṃ śāsana dhatte puṣṇāti | ‘yadapāṅgāśritaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | yadbhrubhaṅgāḥ praṇāṇaṃ sthiracararacanātāratamye murāreḥ' ityādyukteḥ || pakṣe śrīḥ śrīśabdaḥ ajādye ac ādyo yasya tasmin suppratyaye suppratyāhāraghaṭaka aujas ityādau pratyaye pare sati | apiśabdo bhinnakrama uttaratrānveti | iyaṃ iy ityākārakaṃ ādeśaṃ dhatte | bhavati īlopagatā iti chedaḥ | īlopaṃ īkārādarśanaṃ gatā'pi prāptā'pi, apissamuccaye | bhavati bhūdhātorlaṭ | asminnarthe śābdikamuneḥ pāṇineḥ vacaḥ pramāṇam | śrīśabdasyājādau vibhaktau parataḥ ‘aci ‘śnudhātubhruvāṃ yvoriyaṅuvaṅau' iti vihitasya iyaṅo ṅittvāt ‘ṅicca' ityanena antyavarṇasya īkārasyādeśavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | īkārasya iyaṅā'pahṛtatvādadarśanam | atrāpi svavivakṣite śrutyādisiddhe śrīparatvarūpe'rthe upapāditaśleṣamūlābhedādhyavasāyena pāṇinīyavacasaḥ pramāṇatayopanyāsaḥ || yathāvā āste viṣṇurnityaṃ pade parasmiñ śriyā trilokatanuḥ | nityasamāsavacastatpuruṣasyottarapade tadatyucitam || 2067 || trilokatanuḥ sakalajagaccharīrakaḥ ‘jagatsarvaṃ śarīraṃ te' ityādipramāṇāt | triloketyatra 'diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām' iti niyamena samāsaprāptau ‘taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' ityanena samāsaḥ | trayo lokāḥ tanuḥ yasyeti tripade bahuvrīhau kṛte tanuśabde uttarapade pūrvayostatpuruṣaḥ | atrāvāntaratatpuruṣasya vikalpe prāpte ‘dvaṃdvatatpuruṣayoruttarapade nityasamāsavacanam' iti nityasamāsaḥ | viṣṇuḥ bhagavān śriyā lakṣmyā saha ‘vṛddho yūnā' iti nirdeśādvinā'pi sahaśabdayogaṃ tṛtīyā | parasmin pade śrīmati vaikuṇṭhe āste upaviśati | tat tasmāt sa cāsau puruṣaśca tatpuruṣaḥ tasya pūrvoktasya paramapuruṣasyetyarthaḥ | uttare śreṣṭhe pade sthāne nityaṃ mayā śriyā saha vartata iti samaḥ āsaḥ upaveśaḥ āserghañ | nityasamaṃ yathātathā āsa iti vā | lakṣmyā sahāvasthānaṃ tasya vacaḥ vacanaṃ atyucitam | pakṣe upapāditarītyā uttarapade parataḥ tatpuruṣasya nityasamāsavacanaṃ atyucitamityarthaḥ | atra ‘vaikuṇṭhe tu pare loke śriyā sārdhaṃ jagatpatiḥ | āste viṣṇuracintyātmā' iti vacanarītyā svopapādite'rthe upadarśitaśleṣamūlātiśayoktyā ‘dvaṃdvatatpuruṣayoḥ' ityuktavyākaraṇavārtikasya pramāṇatayopanyāsena aucityaṃ samarthitam || yathāvā yā madayati svasevinamacireṇa janaṃ haripriyā saiṣā | suvacā halipriyetyapi ralayorabhidā hi sammatā viduṣām || 2068 || yā haripriyā svasevinaṃ ātmānaṃ bhajamānaṃ āsvādayamānaṃ ca madayati harṣavantaṃ madavantaṃ ca karoti 'harṣe'pyāmodavanmadaḥ' ityamaraḥ | sā haripriyā halipriyetyapi suvacā harihalinorabhedāditi bhāvaḥ | halī balabhadraḥ | pakṣe upapāditena hetunaiva halipriyā kādambarītyapi suvacā | ‘surā halipriyā' ityamaraḥ | samarthitamapyarthaṃ sthūṇānikhananyāyena punassamarthayate ralayoriti | hi yasmāt ralayorvarṇayoḥ abhidā abhedaḥ viduṣāṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ sammatā | ato haripriyāśabdaḥ haliṃpriyetyapi suvaceti bhāvaḥ | śabdārthatādāmyaṃ na vismartavyam | atra svavivakṣite haripriyāyāḥ halipriyātvanirdhāraṇe vaiyākaraṇokteḥ pramāṇatā || yathāvā ajaraṃ brahma tadekaṃ daivatamanyattu nājaraṃ vidmaḥ | jarasā vikṛtimajādau munirāha hi nirjare samaste'pi || 2069 || tadbrahma ekameva ajaraṃ jaropalakṣitasarvavikāravidhuraṃ ‘vijaro vimṛtyuḥ, yattacchāntamajaraṃ paraṃ brahma' ityādiśruteḥ | anyaddaivataṃ tu ajaraṃ na vidmaḥ | daivatāntarasya sarvasyāpi jarāmaraṇādyanatītatvāt | hi yasmāt muniḥ pāṇiniḥ | ajādau caturmukhādau samaste nirjare daivate'pi jarasā vikṛtiṃ āha | yadvā hīti prasiddhau | pakṣe nirjare nirjaraśabde samaste'pi samastatāṃ prāpte'pi ajādau ajādivibhaktau parataḥ jarasā 'jarāyā jarasanyatarasyām' iti vihitajarasādeśena vikṛtiṃ āha | samaste'pītyuktiḥ 'padāṅgādhikāre tasya ca tadantasya ca' iti jñāpanāya | atra bhagavadatiriktadaivatajarākrāntatvanirdhāraṇāya śābdikokteḥ pramāṇatā || yathāvā prāptānāṃ tvāṃ cihnaṃ prāyeṇa taveva bhavati paramātman | tatpuruṣasya hi paravalliṅgaṃ śābdikamunīśitā'vādīt || 2070 || he paramātman! tvāṃ prāptānāṃ muktānāmityarthaḥ | te tava cihnaṃ caturbhujatvādi liṅgaṃ prāyeṇa bhavati | prāyeṇetyanena jagatkāraṇatva śrīpatitvādivyāvṛttissūcitā | hi yasmāt śābdikamunīśitā pāṇiniḥ tatpuruṣasya tādṛśatvadīyapuruṣasya muktasya paravat paramātmanastaveva liṅgaṃ cihnaṃ bhavatītyavādīt | vastutastu ‘paravalliṅgaṃ dvaṃdvatatpuruṣayoḥ' iti tatpuruṣasya uttarapadaliṅgamevāvādīditi | atra svābhimate bhāgavatānāṃ muktānāṃ bhagavaccihnalābhe śleṣāvalambanena pāṇinisūtraṃ pramāṇatāṃ nītam || yathāvā nanu viśvamekanīḍaṃ yatra sa puruṣottamātkimanyatsyāt | viśvaṃbhare mumāgamamāha ṛṣiśśabdavit sphuṭaṃ saktam || 2071 || viśvaṃ idaṃ sarvaṃ jagat yatra nanu yatraiva puruṣe | nanu ravadhāraṇe | ekanīḍaṃ abhinnasthānakaṃ aikādhikaraṇyabhāgityarthaḥ | saḥ puruṣottamāt puruṣaśabdābhilapanīyabaddhamuktobhayāvasthapratyagātmavilakṣaṇānnārāyaṇāt anyaḥ kiṃ itarassyātkim | kimityadhikṣepe | kadā'pi na syādeveti bhāvaḥ | yatra viśvamekanīḍamiti padasaṃdarbheṇa ‘yatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekanīḍam' iti śrutiḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | amuṃ buddhisthaṃ āgamaṃ ‘yatra viśvam' ityādyudāhṛtaśrutiṃ viśvaṃbhare nārāyaṇe svasmin saktaṃ tatparaṃ, śabdavit śabdaśabdo'tra ‘śabdaścāto'kāmakāre' ityādāviva vedaparaḥ | vedavidityarthaḥ | ‘vedāntavidvedavideva cāham' iti gānāt | ṛṣiḥ vāsudevatayā'vatīrṇo badarikāśramatāpaso nārāyaṇa ityarthaḥ | śrūyate ca bhagavadvācakaṛṣiśabdaḥ ‘svayaṃ juhvata ekaṛṣiṃ śraddhayantaḥ' iti muṇḍake | ‘ekaṛṣiṃ mukhyaṛṣiṃ paramātmānamityarthaḥ' ityupaniṣadbhāṣye vyākhyātam | ‘ke te ṛṣayaḥ prāṇā vāva ṛṣayaḥ' iti śrutirapya trānukūlā | ṛṣaya iti bahuvacanānta ṛṣiśabdaḥ paramātmaparatayā tathā prāṇāḥ' ityadhikaraṇe abhāṣi | āha vadati || dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca | kṣarassarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate || uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ | yo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ || yasmātkṣaramatīto'hamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ | ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || iti gāyan bhagavān bibhartītyanena ‘yatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekanīḍam' iti śrutiṃ nārāyaṇaparāmevāhetyarthaḥ | tathāhyatropabṛṃhaṇe 'paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ' ityanena 'tasyāśśikhāyā madhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ' iti śrutiḥ smāryate | ‘yo lokatrayamāviśya' ityanena 'yacca kiṃcit' ityādikaṃ vyākhyātam | "lokyata iti lokaḥ tattrayaṃ lokatrayaṃ acetanaṃ tatsaṃsṛṣṭaścetanaḥ muktaśceti pramāṇāvagamyametattrayaṃ ya ātmatayā''viśya bibharti tasmādvyāpyādbhartavyāccārthāntarabhūtaḥ" iti śrīmadgītābhāṣyam | bibhartītyādhāratvoktyā ‘yatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekanīḍaṃ, tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ, dhruvamacalamamṛtaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ sarvādhāraṃ dhāma' ityāderartha uktaḥ | avyayaśabdoktyā ‘śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam' ityādyuktasaṃgrahaḥ | īśvaraśabda iha ‘vyāpya nārāyaṇassthitaḥ' ityuktavyāpteḥ ‘antaḥ praviṣṭaśśāstā' ityādyanusārātsamastaniyamanaviśiṣṭatvaṃ ‘atmeśvaram' ityuktānanyaniyāmyatvaṃ cābhipraitīti ‘puruṣottamaḥ kaḥ' | ityatra śrīmat stotrabhāṣyam | tasmāt ‘yatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekanīḍam' iti śrutiṃ nārāyaṇe svasminneva tatparāmāha gītācārya iti suṣṭhūktam || arthāntaraṃ tu śabdavit vyākaraṇavettā ṛṣiḥ pāṇiniḥ viśvaṃbhare viśvaṃbharaśabde mumāgamaṃ mumityākārakamāgamaṃ saktaṃ saṃbandhaṃ sphuṭamāha ‘saṃjñāyāṃ bhṛtṛvṛji' ityādinā viśvaśabdopapadakāt bhṛñaḥ khaci 'arurdviṣadajantasya' iti mumāgamaṃ vyadhatteti | atra ‘yatra viśvam' ityādiśrutipratipāditāyāssakalajagadādhāratāyāḥ puruṣottamaikaniṣṭhatvanirdhāraṇe svābhimate ‘yo lokatrayamāviśya' ityādismṛtiḥ śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyena udāhṛtavyākaraṇasmṛtiśca pramāṇatayopadarśite iti pūrvodāharaṇebhyo viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā yo veda brahmāsaddurmedhāstaṃ hyasantamevāhuḥ | āstāṃ śrutiriha mānaṃ nālaṃ kiṃ nityamasijiti hi sūtram || 2072 || yaḥ durmedhāḥ brahma asaditi veda sat astīti na vedetyarthaḥ | a ityetannañsamānārthakamavyayaṃ 'abhāve nahyano nāpi' ityavyayeṣvamarānuśāsanāt | yadvā asaditi samastaṃ padaṃ yathāśrutameva yojyam | brahma nāstīti yovedeti tadarthaḥ | anyattulyam | atrādyayojanā "brahmaviṣayakajñānāsadbhāvasadbhāvābhyāmātmanāśamātmasattāṃ ca vadati" iti 'asanneva sa bhavati' iti śrutyarthavarṇanaparamahāsiddhāntasthaśrībhāṣyatātparyānurodhena | dvitīyā tu ‘ānandamayasadasattvajñānānmokṣasaṃsārau bhavataḥ' iti prakṛtaśrutyarthavarṇanaparopaniṣadbhāṣyānurodhena | taṃ durmedhasaṃ durbuddhiṃ durmedhaśśabdaṃ ca asantaṃ asādhumeva anyatra as iti varṇāntameva āhuḥ | iha asminnarthe śrutiḥ ‘asanneva sa bhavati asadbrahmeti veda cet' iti śrutiḥ mānaṃ pramāṇaṃ āsmāṃ tiṣṭhatu nāma | nityamasijiti hi sūtraṃ, hiśabdo'vadhāraṇe | ‘nityamasic prajāmedhayoḥ' iti sūtramevetyarthaḥ | nālaṃ kiṃ na paryāptaṃ kim | anenaiva nirvāhe kiṃ śrutiparyantānudhāvaneneti bhāvaḥ | uktasūtreṇa durityupasargapūrvakasya medhāśabdasya bahuvrīhau asiti samāsāntapratyayasya vihitatvāditi vastusthitiḥ | atrāpi asantamiti śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyānuprāṇitaṃ śabdasmṛtirūpapramāṇaṃ śrutipramāṇena saha uktārthasthāpanāyopāttam || yathāvā yena tvaṃ sarvavidasi tasmin bodhe'sti sumahatī śaktiḥ | mā'stu guṇe'nyatra guṇo bhagavan bodhe tu so'sti śabdanayāt || 2073 || bhagavān jñānaśaktyādiparipūrṇaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he bhagavan yena bodhaguṇena ṣāḍguṇyaprathamabhūtena tvaṃ sarvavit ‘yassarvajñassarvavit' ityuktarītyā sarvajñaḥ asi nityāsaṃkucitabodhavattvādeva hi tava sarvajñatvamiti bhāvaḥ | tasmin bodhe jñāne sarvasākṣātkārarūpe sumahatī śaktiḥ ṣāḍguṇyāntaḥpātiguṇaviśeṣaḥ | sā ca yadanyairaśakyatvādaghaṭitamiva bhāti taddhaṭanasāmarthyarūpā | sarvajñatvanirvahaṇasāmarthyamiti tu tattvam | asti vidyate | ‘parā'sya śaktiḥ' ityuktarītyā sarvaśaktestavāpi sarvavittvasyānena niṣpāditatvādasmin bodhe tvatto'pi mahatī śaktirastīti bhāvaḥ | nanviyamuktiḥ kathaṃ ghaṭatāṃ guṇe guṇasyānaṅgīkārāt | guṇau hi bodhaśaktī ubhe apītyata āha mā'stviti | anyatra bodhādanyasmin guṇe guṇāntaraṃ māstu astu vā mā veti bhāvaḥ | bodhe tu bodharūpe guṇe tu sa guṇaḥ uktaśaktirūpaḥ asti | evaṃ nirdhāraṇe kiṃ pramāṇamityatrāha śabdanayāditi | vyākaraṇanayāt bodhe guṇāstitvamuktamiti bhāvaḥ | tatpakṣe budhadhātorghañā niṣpanne bodhaśabdhe ‘pugantalaghūpadhasya ca' iti guṇavidhānādguṇo'stīti bhāvaḥ | atra svavivakṣitasya bodharūpaguṇe sumahāśaktirūpaguṇasadbhāvasya upapāditaśaktiguṇaśabdagataśleṣamūlābhedādhyavasāyena śabdāśāstrīyaprakriyāyāḥ pramāṇatā || yathāvā padme tavāṅgarociḥ paribhavati svarṇavarṇasaubhāgyam | varṇayati śābdikaugho vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya iti tasmāt || 2074 || atra varṇakāryādaṅgādhikārakāryasya balīyastvamabhidadhānā ‘vārṇādāṅgam' iti paribhāṣā aṅgavarṇaśabdapratipādyārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyabalena svābhimatārthe pramāṇatvenopanyasteti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā svārthe vibādhate paramacyuta nityaṃ ca me'ntaraṅgaṃ tvām | śābdikamunirāha parānnityādapyantaraṅgamadhikabalam || 2075 || he acyuta! nitya ‘nityo nityānām' iti śruteḥ | paraṃ ca ‘paraḥ parāṇām' iti śruteḥ | tvāṃ me antaraṅgaṃ manaḥ kartṛ svārthe svābhīpsitaprayojane viṣaye bādhate pīḍayatīti yāvat | ‘nūnaṃ svārthaparo loko na veda parasaṃkaṭam' iti bhāvaḥ | anyatra paraṃ nityaṃ ca śāstraṃ karma antaraṅgaṃ antaraṅgaśātraṃ kartṛ svārthe viṣaye bādhate tatpravṛttivighātakaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | atra svoktārthe śābdikaparibhāṣāṃ pramāṇayati śābdiketi | śābdikamuniḥ patañjaliḥ parānnityādapyantaraṅgamadhikabalamāha | ‘paranityāntaraṅgāpavādānāmuttarottaraṃ balīyaḥ' iti paribhāṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ || yathāvā kṛpayā tavācyutākhilakarma vināśonmukhaṃ tato'hamagham | tadvaśago'pi na kuryāmakṛtavyūhā hi pāṇinīyāssyuḥ || 2076 || he acyuta! tava kṛpayā mama akhilaṃ karma vināśonmukhaṃ, tataḥ kāraṇāt tadvaśago'pi karmavaśyo'pi ahaṃ aghaṃ uttarāghaṃ na kuryām | hi yasmāt pāṇinīyāḥ akṛtavyūhāḥ 'akṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' iti paribhāṣitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ‘nimittaṃ vināśonmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ na kurvanti' iti paribhāṣārthaḥ | atra vināśonmukhakarmānurodhena tatprayuktottarāghasyākaraṇe pāṇinīyaparibhāṣāyāḥ pramāṇīkaraṇātkaveḥ pāṇinīyatā'pi prakaṭitā || yathāvā yeṣāṃ tvayā'nubandhasteṣāṃ bhagavan kathaṃ svasārūpyaṃ syāt | yadiha vadanti padajñā na hyanubandhena kṛtamasārūpyamiti || 2077 || he bhagavan! yeṣāṃ janānāṃ tvayā saha anubandhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ bhavati bhāgavatatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadvā niravaśeṣāvidyānivṛttipūrvakaṃ parame vyomni saṃśleṣaḥ bhavatītyarthaḥ | teṣāṃ janānāṃ asārūpyaṃ tvadasarūpatā kathaṃnu syāt śeṣatvena tvayā parigṛhītānāṃ tvāmeva dhyāyatāṃ tvatsārūpyaṃ caturbhujatvādikaṃ syādeva | yathā kratunayāditi bhāvaḥ | ‘nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti' iti śrutiratrānusaṃdheyā | yat yasmātkāraṇāt padajñāḥ vyākaraṇavidaḥ anubandhena 'ṛhalorṇyat' ityādau kṛtena itsaṃjñārthakaṇakārādyanubandhena kṛtaṃ asārūpyaṃ ‘poradupadhāt' ityādivihitasya yataḥ asarūpatvaṃ na bhavatīti vadanti ‘nānubandhakṛtamasārūpyam' iti paribhāṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | tathāca śapyaṃ labhyamityādau śapilabhyādeḥ ‘poradupadhāt' ityanena vihito yatpratyayaḥ ‘ṛhalorṇyat' iti vihitasya ṇyataḥ bādhaka eva bhavati | na tu 'vā sarūpo'striyām' ityanena asārūpyanibandhanavaikalpikabādhakatvaṃ prāpnotītyavadheyam | atra śrutismṛtiśatapramāṇasadbhāve'pi camatkārātiśayāya ‘nānubandhakṛtamasārūpyam' iti śābdikaparibhāṣāyāḥ śleṣeṇārthāntaraṃ parikalpya pramāṇīkaraṇam || yathāvā tvāṃ paramavaraṃ cānyaṃ samau vadannāparādhyati murāre | pūrvaparāvarasūtre parāvarau pāṇiniryadāha samau || 2078 || utkṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ tvatto'pakaṣṭena devatāntareṇa tulyaṃ vadato janasyāparādhābhāvarūpe'rthe ‘pūrvāparāvaradakṣiṇottara' ityādipāṇinīyasmṛteḥ pramāṇatayopanyāsaḥ | pūrvodāharaṇeṣu pāṇinismṛtirabhimatārthe pramāṇīkṛtā | iha tu yastu nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sāmānyenābhimanyate | sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvaccandradivākarau || yastu nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ brahmarudrādidaivataiḥ | samatvena vijānāti sa pāṣaṇḍīti kathyate || ityādyuktārītyā bhagavato nārāyaṇasya devatāntaratulyakakṣyatāvarṇanaparajananindāpareṇa anabhimatārthe pramāṇīkṛteti vailakṣaṇyam || yathāvā tadviṣṇoḥ padamavyayamāmnātamanavyayaṃ svarādyaṃ tu | evaṃ sati pāṇininā svarādipadamavyayaṃ kathamabhāṇi || 2079 || tat viṣṇoḥ padaṃ 'tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam' ityāmnātaṃ sthānaṃ avyayaṃ anaśvaraṃ āmnātaṃ ‘tadakṣare parame vyoman' ityādiśrutyā pratipāditam | svarādyaṃ svargādikaṃ padaṃ sthānaṃ tu avyayaṃ na bhavatītyanavyayaṃ naśvaraṃ āmnātam | evaṃ sati evaṃ sthite pāṇininā svarādi svargādikaṃ padaṃ sthānaṃ, pakṣe svarādigaṇapaṭhitaṃ padaṃ avyayaṃ anaśvaraṃ avyayasaṃjñakaṃ ca kathamabhāṇi ‘svarādi nipātamavyayam' iti sūtreṇeti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā svāminnaiśvarye tava kena nipātaḥ kvavā'pi kiṃ dṛṣṭaḥ | evaṃ sthite'sya pāṇinirāha nipātaṃ kathaṃ nviti vicintā || 2080 || he svāmin he sarveśvara! aiśvarye jagadīśvaratve viṣaye tava ‘eṣa sarveśvara eṣa bhūtādhipatiḥ' iti śrutapāramaiśvaryasya tava nipātaḥ bhraṃśaḥ kena puruṣeṇa kva vā'pi kiṃ dṛṣṭaḥ na dṛṣṭa evetyarthaḥ | evaṃ sthite vastusvarūpe evamavasthite pāṇiniḥ asya evaṃvidhaiśvaryavatastavetyarthaḥ | pakṣe asya svāminniti śabdasyetyarthaḥ | nipātaṃ bhraṃśaṃ, anyatra aiśvaryarūpe'rthe lakṣaṇābhāve śabdasādhutvāya svarūpeṇoccāraṇarūpaṃ nipātaṃ kathaṃnu āha | ‘svāminaiśvarye' iti sūtreṇa aiśvaryarūpārthe svāminniti nipātitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ityasmākaṃ vicintā || yathāvā prathamaḥ pumān samantādacīkaśatsarvanāmarūpamiti | śrutirāha pāṇinimunistasya kvacideva tadidamāha katham || 2081 || śrutiḥ ‘anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi' iti śrutiḥ prathamaḥ pumān parabrahmabhūtaḥ puruṣottamaḥ samantāt sarvataḥ sarvanāmarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ nāma ca rūpaṃ ca anayossamāhāraṃ, anyatra pumān puṃliṅgaḥ prathamaḥ prathama iti śabdaḥ samantāt sarvanāmatāprayuktakaryāspadabhūtāsu sarvāsu vibhaktiṣu sarvanāmarūpaṃ sarvanāmaśabdarūpaṃ acīkaśat prakāśitavān ityāha | pāṇinimunistu tasya prathamasya puṃsaḥ tadidaṃ sarvanāmarūpaprakāśanaṃ kvacideva ekadeśa eveti kathamāhetyāścaryam | pulliṅgasya prathamaśabdasya jasyeva sarvanāmatāṃ ‘prathamacaramatayālpārdhakatipayanemāśca' iti sūtreṇāvādīdityākṣepaparihāraḥ || atra padyatraye'pi sakalanayaviṣayanigamoddharaṇādarajuṣi phaṇīndragirinetaḥ | kathamiva mātsye rūpe nayalopaṃ te vadanti śabdavidaḥ || 2082 || he phaṇīndragirinetaḥ ! sakalānāṃ nayānāṃ mīmāṃsānyāyānāṃ viṣayaḥ yo nigamaḥ vedaḥ tasya uddharaṇe uddhāre ādarajuṣi te tava mātsye matsyasaṃbandhini rūpe avatāre śabdavidaḥ vaiyākaraṇāḥ nayalopaṃ kathaṃ vadānti | sakalanayaviṣayabhūtavedoddharaṇālaṃkarmīṇe avatāre nayalopokterasaṃgatatvāditi bhāvaḥ | mātsye rūpe mātsya ityākārake aṇṇante śabdarūpe nayalopaṃ yalopābhāvaṃ ‘sūryatiṣyāgatsyamatsyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ' iti vihitayakāralopasya ‘matsyasya ṅyām' iti niyamitatvena yalopāprasakteriti parihāraḥ | yadvā phaṇīndragirīti bhinnaṃ padam | he netaḥ svāmin! phaṇīndragiri patañjalibhāṣya ityarthopyupaskāryaḥ | tadā sakalanayaviṣayanigamoddharaṇādarajuṣītyasya ukta evārthaḥ | vyākaraṇabhāṣyasya vedaśabdānuśāsanārthaṃ pravṛttatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra svavivakṣitārthapratyanīkatvaṃ śabdavidvākyasya śleṣeṇa parikalpya tadadhikṣepāya tadukteḥ pramāṇatayā upanyāsaḥ | evamagre'pyūhyam || yathāvā viśvaṃbharāsahoktau viśvaṃbhara eva śeṣatāṃ dhatte | saivāsya śeṣabhūtetyuktau saṃdegdhi kevalapadajñaḥ || 2083 viśvaṃbharāyāḥ bhūdevyāḥ sahoktau sahasaṃlāpāvasare viśvaṃbharaḥ bhagavāneva śeṣatāṃ tatpārārthyaṃ dhatte | pakṣe viśvaṃbharāśabdena sahoktau sahavacane viśvaṃbhara eva śeṣatāṃ dhatte viśvaṃbharaśabda eka evāvaśiṣyate | strīpuṃsalakṣaṇamātraviśeṣasadbhāvena ‘pumān striyā' ityanena puṃsa ekasyaiva śeṣatāvidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | saiva viśvaṃbharā bhūreva asya śeṣabhūtetyukau ‘tathā bhūmiśca nīlā ca śeṣabhūte mate mama' iti bhagavaduktau, pakṣe viśvaṃbharāśabda eva asya viśvaṃbharaśabdasya śeṣabhūtā avaśiṣṭā ityuktau keva lapadajñaḥ natu paramapadajñaḥ anāghrātabhagavacchāstrasatsaṃpradāyagandhaśśuṣkavaiyākaraṇaḥ svādhītavyākaraṇamātradattadṛṣṭirityarthaḥ | saṃdegdhi 'pumān striyā' ityanena tallakṣaṇamātraviśeṣasadbhāve puṃsa evāvaśeṣasya vihitatvāt kathaṃ strīliṅgasya viśvaṃbharāśabdasyāvaśeṣassyāditi saṃśete iti bhāvaḥ | atra kevalavaiyākaraṇena kenacidupapāditārthasya vyākaraṇavirodhaṃ pradarśayituṃ bhagavacchāstravacanārthopanibandha iti viśeṣaḥ | śleṣottambhitatvaṃ tu pūrvavadeva || yathāvā ekamanekānugataṃ nityaṃ sāmānyamiti vaco vitatham | ekamanekānugataṃ nityamasāmānyameva yadbrahma || 2084 || yadvastu ekaṃ anekeṣu gavādivyaktiṣu anugataṃ anusyūtaṃ nityaṃ nāśāpratiyogi ca | tat sāmānyaṃ jātirityarthaḥ | 'jātirjātaṃ ca sāmānyam' ityamaraḥ | iti vacaḥ ‘nityamekamanekānugataṃ sāmānyam' iti naiyāyikavacanaṃ vitatham | kuta ityata āha yat yasmātkāraṇāt brahma ekaṃ anekānugataṃ nityamapi asāmānyaṃ ajātireva | paramārthatastu ekaṃ asadṛśaṃ anekeṣu cetanācetaneṣu anugataṃ anupraviṣṭaṃ ‘yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tiṣṭhan, ya ātmani tiṣṭhan, ‘sāmānyāstu parārthamudyamaparāssvārthāvirodhena ye' ityādau sāmānyaśabda utkarṣāpakarṣahīne hi prayuktaḥ | atra svavivakṣitārthapratyanīkatāṃ nyāyavidvākyasya śleṣeṇa parikalpya tadadhikṣepāya tadvākyasya pramāṇatayopanyāsa iti pūrvebhyo vailakṣaṇyam || yathāvā asati virodhe smṛtyā śrutyā upabṛṃhaṇaṃ kila nyāyyam | śrutireva tava guṇānāṃ smṛtimupabṛṃhayati hanta naśśaure || 2085 || he śaure! virodhe asati pratyakṣaśrutivirodhe avidyamāne sati smṛtyā manvādipraṇītadharmasaṃhitayā śrutyāḥ vedasya upabṛṃhaṇaṃ aspaṣṭārthaviśadīkaraṇaṃ nyāyyaṃ mīmāṃsānyāyādanapetam | kileti śāstrīyavārtāyām | sati tu śrutivirodhe smṛteranādaraṇīyataiva | ‘audumbarīṃ spṛṣṭvodgāyet' iti sparśanaśrutivirodhe ‘audumbarī sarvā veṣṭayitavyā' iti sarvaveṣṭanasmṛteriveti bhāvaḥ | tadetatsūtritaṃ maharṣiṇā‘virodhe tvanapekṣyaṃ syādasati hyanumānam' iti | evaṃ sati śāstrīyaprasthāne viparītametadityāha śrutiriti | tava guṇānāṃ satyatvajñānatvādikalyāṇaguṇānāṃ śrutireva ‘satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma, yassarvajñassarvavit' ityādiguṇapratipādikā śrutireva | pakṣe niśamanameva naḥ asmākaṃ smṛtiṃ tvatkalyāṇaguṇādiviṣayakāṃ smṛtiṃ ‘sarvajñassarvadṛksarvaśaktirjñānabalarddhimān' ityādiparāśarādismṛtimityarthaḥ | anyatra tava smaraṇaṃ smṛtisaṃtānamiti yāvat | upabṛṃhayati abhivardhayati | hanteti vaiparītyacintanajanitāścarye | atra śleṣagarbhasvoktārthavaicitryaparipoṣāya bhagavan! te tava pādānte caraṇāgre | anyatra padyacaturthāṃśacaramabhāge saktāḥ saṃbaddhāḥ laghavo vā jātiguṇādiprayuktamahattvahīnā api | pakṣe te ityasya laghava ityetadviśeṣaṇatā | te laghavaḥ | vā pādāntastu' iti | atra svoktacamatkṛtisthāpanāya udāhṛtacchandaśśāstrajñavacanaṃ pramāṇatayopāttamiti viśeṣaḥ | chandobhijñāḥ vedajñā ityapyarthaḥ pratīyate | tena prāmāṇyātiśayapratītiḥ || ‘evamaṣṭavidhā bhaktiryasmin mlecche'pi vartate' | ‘sa ca pūjyo yathā hyaham' ityukteḥ | ṛjavaḥ karaṇatrayasārūpyaśālinaḥ | anye tvadabhaktāḥ laghavaḥ alpāḥ vakrāḥ kuṭilasvabhāvāḥ syuḥ | evaṃ sthite chāndasāḥ chandaśśāstravettāraḥ vaidikāścetyapyupaskāryam | chāndasā ityetat ‘śrotriyasyeva te rājan mandakasyāvipaścitaḥ | anuvākahatā buddhiḥ' ityuktarītyā mandabuddhitādyotanāya | guruṃ vakraṃ pūrvasmādvicchittiviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā tvayi vidadhāno maitrīṃ dvijarājo budhasuhṛdbhavatyanariḥ | jagati hare'śeṣasamo dhāmanidhe jyautiṣaṃ pramāṇamiha || 2088 || dhāmanidhe he tejonidhe he hare bhagavan! pakṣe he bhāsvannityarthaḥ | tvayi bhagavati bhānau ca maitrīṃ śaraṇāgatiṃ ‘viditassa hi dharmajñaśśaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ | tena maitrī bhavatu te' ityatra maitrīśabdasya śaraṇāgatyarthakatayā vyākhyānāt | anyatra suhṛttvaṃ vidadhānaḥ dvijarājaḥ brāhmaṇamūrdhanyaḥ candramāśca | candramaso bhānumanmitratvāditi bhāvaḥ | budhasuhṛt brahmavitsauhārdavān saumyagrahasya mitraṃ ca, candramasastanmitratvāt | anariḥ kāmādivairivargavidhuraḥ | candrapakṣe śatrurahitaḥ tasya śatrugrahavirahāditi bhāvaḥ | jagati aśeṣeṣu samaḥ 'tulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ' ityuktakrameṇa sarvatra samadarśī anyatra śeṣasama iti chedaḥ | śeṣeṣu uktagrahātiriktagraheṣu samaḥ bhavati | anyeṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ tatsamatvāditi bhāvaḥ | iha asminnarthe jyautiṣaṃ jyotiśśāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ ‘tīkṣṇāṃśurhimaraśmijaśca suhṛdau śeṣāssamāśśītagoḥ' iti varāhamihirādyuktiḥ pramāṇamiti bhāvaḥ | atra śleṣamahimnā svoktārthasthāpanāya jyautiṣarūpasmṛteḥ pramāṇatāprāpaṇamiti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā haridṛṣṭiryo haṃsassa mahārcissatkriyāñcitaḥ kramataḥ | uccapadastho bhavitā śrutivajjyautiṣamiha pramāṇaṃ cet || 2089 || yaḥ haṃsaḥ yativiśeṣaḥ bhānuśca | harau bhagavati viṣaye dṛṣṭiḥ upāsanātmakajñānaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | pakṣe harau siṃharāśau dṛṣṭiryasya tathoktaḥ kumbharāśisthassanniti bhāvaḥ | tatrāvasthitasyaiva tasmātsaptame siṃhe dṛṣṭisaṃbhavāt ‘paśyanti saptamān sarve' iti hi jyotirvidaḥ | saḥ yativiśeṣaḥ mahārcissatkriyāñcitaḥ mahatyā arciṣaḥ ātivāhikādyabhūtasyāgneḥ satkriyayā satkāreṇa añcitaḥ yuktaḥ kramataḥ arciṣo'harahna āpūryamāṇapakṣam' ityādyuktadinapūrvapakṣādikrameṇa uccapadasthaḥ parasmin pade sthitaḥ bhavitā | pakṣe saḥ kumbharāśigato bhānuḥ kramataḥ mīnarāśiprāptipūrvakaṃ satkriyāñcitaḥ saṃścāsau kriyaḥ meṣarāśiḥ ‘kriyatāburujatumakulīyaleyapāthonajūkakaurpyākhyāḥ' iti jyotirvidbhiḥ meṣādīnāṃ krameṇa kriyādisaṃjñāyā uktatvāt | tasmin añcitaḥ gatassan uccapadasthaḥ uccasthānasthitaḥ ‘ajavṛṣabha' ityādinā meṣasya taduccasthānatoktiḥ | ataeva mahārciḥ mahādīptiḥ ‘svocce pradīptaḥ' iti vidyāmādhavokteḥ | bhavitā | spaṣṭamanyat | atrāpyabhimate'rthe jyautiṣasya pramāṇatā || yathāvā kavayastavopamānaṃ kathayanti harinmaṇiṃ harimaṇiṃ ca | anayorna varṇabhedo yaducyate kṛṣṇa tanna khalu mithyā || 2090 || he kṛṣṇa! nīlanīradaśyāmaleti bhāvaḥ | kavayaḥ harinmaṇiṃ marakataṃ harimaṇiṃ indranīlaṃ ca tava uktavarṇasya bhavataḥ upamānaṃ kathayanti kathaṃ harinnīlavarṇayoruktaratnayośśyāmalavarṇasya tava copamānopameyabhāva ityāśaṅkya samādhatte’nayoriti | anayoḥ harinmaṇiharimaṇyoḥ varṇabhedaḥ neti yaducyate kavibhiriti śeṣaḥ | tat na mithyā khalu anayoruktaśabdayoḥ navarṇenaiva bhedo nānyavarṇairityarthāntaramapi camatkāri | atra bhagavato nīlatoyadanīlasya harinmaṇiharimaṇyubhayasādṛśyavarṇanāya tayorvarṇabhedābhāvavarṇanarūpe'bhimate'rthe ‘kamalāsaṃpadoḥ kṛṣṇaharitornāgasarpayoḥ' ityārabhya ‘dānavāsuradaityānāmaikyamevābhisaṃhitam' ityālaṃkārikoktiḥ pramāṇabhāvaṃ prāpitā || evaṃ śāstrāntaralaukikavākyarūpāṇyapi śabdapramāṇānyudāhāryāṇi | ‘ācāraścaiva sādhūnāmātmanastuṣṭireva ca' iti pramāṇapratipāditācārātmatuṣṭyorapi mīmāṃsakoktadharmapramāṇayorvedaśabdānumāpakatayā śabdapramāṇa evāntarbhāvaḥ || tatrācārapramāṇaṃ yathā saurissa kathaṃ pāpo vāre yasyācaranti tava tuṣṭyai | vratamamitamahigirīśvara sadasacca vibhāvyamiha sadācārāt || 2091 || he ahigirīśvara! saḥ sauriḥ śaniḥ kathaṃ pāpaḥ | tasya jyautiṣoktaṃ pāpatvaṃ na ghaṭata iti bhavaḥ | tatra hetumabhiprayannāha yasyeti | yasya śaneḥ vāre tava tuṣṭhyai amitaṃ vrataṃ upavāsādiniyamaṃ ācaranti santa iti śeṣaḥ | kathamācārādeva tasyāpāpatvaṃ nirṇeyamityata āha sadati | iha loke sat sādhu asacca asādhu vā satāṃ ācārādeva vibhāvyaṃ nirṇeyaṃ hi | svavāre satāṃ śrīnivāsaprīṇanavratādyācāradarśanātsaureḥ pāpatvavācoyuktirayukteti bhāvaḥ | atra śanerapāpatvanirṇaye tadvāre vratācaraṇarūpassadācāraḥ pramāṇatayopanyastaḥ | ‘ācāro nāma śiṣṭānāmabhimato dayādākṣiṇyādiyuko vṛttiviśeṣaḥ' iti mādhavīye || ātmatuṣṭipramāṇaṃ yathā bhaktiḥ prapattirathavā bhavadāptessādhane smṛte tadapi | prapadana eva viśeṣātparitoṣo'smādṛśāṃ vṛṣādrimaṇe || 2092 || atra bhaktyā paramayā vā'pi prapattyā vā mahāmune | prāpyo'haṃ nānyadhā prāpyo mama kaiṃkaryalipsubhiḥ || iti vikalpitayorbhaktiprapattyoḥ prapadana 'evāsmādṛśāṃ pravṛttāvātmatuṣṭirūpaṃ pramāṇamupanyastam || evaṃ pramāṇaṃ śrutiliṅgādikamapi mīmāṃsakoktaṃ pramāṇaṃ saṃbhavadihodāhāryam || tatra śrutiryathā nāmnaiva harirasi tvaṃ duritaṃ harase kimatra liṅgena | svakaraprakoṣṭhakaṅkaṇasamīkṣaṇe na khalu darpaṇāpekṣā || 2093 || atra śrīnivāsasya harirityabhidhānaśrutyā sakaladuritahāritvaṃ samarthitam | ‘śrutirnāma nirapekṣaravaḥ' ityāhustantravidaḥ || yathāvā dhatse nābhayamudrāmabhayaṃ brahmeti yacchruto'si hare | śrutyā parame tattve nirṇīte ko nu liṅgamādriyate || 2094 || he hare śrīnivāsa! tvaṃ abhayamudrāṃ ūrdhvāgrāṅgulikapāṇitalapradarśanarūpāmabhayasūcanīṃ mudrāṃ na dhatse na dhārayase | śrīnivāsasyāvākkṛtāgrāṅgulikakaratalapradarśanarūpavaradānasucakamudrāvahanena tādṛśābhayamudrāvahanābhāvāttathoktiḥ | yat yasmāt tvaṃ abhayaṃ brahmeti śruto'si ‘etadamṛtametadabhayametadbrahma' iti, ‘abhayaṃ vai brahma' iti ca śrutiprathito'si | avidyamānaṃ bhayaṃ yasmāditi pañcamībahuvrīhiḥ | tathāhi śrutyā abhidhānaśrutyaiva parame śreṣṭhe tattve arthayāthātmye nirṇīte sati liṅgaṃ tadanumāpakaṃ sāmarthyarūpaṃ konu ādriyate | śrutyaivārthanirdhāraṇe durbalaliṅgādaraṇaṃ na kriyata eveti bhāvaḥ | kiṃca 'nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ' ityādiśrutyā nārāyaṇasyaiva paratatvatve nirṇīte sati liṅgaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ konu nāmādriyate | śrutyarthayāthātmyavettā nārāyaṇādanyaṃ rudrādikaṃ paratattvatayā nādriyata ityarthospi pratīyate | atra śrīnivāsasya ‘abhayam' iti śrutyā abhayamudrādhāraṇarūpaliṅgānāvaśyakatvaṃ samarthitam || yathāvā śrutirāha śrīpatiriti māmābhyāṃ kimiti śaṅkhacakre prāk | ajahāḥ kimīhagirīndo śraute'rthe na khalu liṅgamādriyate || 2095 || he ahigirindo! śrutiḥ ‘hrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau' ityādiśrutiḥ māṃ śrīpatirityāha | ābhyāṃ śaṅkhacakrābhyāṃ mama kiṃ sādhyaṃ śrīpatitvasya śrutyaiva nirṇaye śaṅkhacakradhāraṇarūpaliṅgena kiṃ prayojanamiti prāk pūrvaṃ śaṅkhacakre ajahāḥ atyākṣīḥ kimityutprekṣā | tathāhi śrute nirapekṣaravasiddhe'rthe liṅgaṃ nādriyate tāntriktairiti śeṣaḥ | atrāpyudāhṛtaśrutyā śaṅkhacakradhāraṇānāvaśyakatā samarthitā | atrānyahetukaśśaṅkhacakratyāga uktahetukassaṃbhāvyate | atra kasyacidrājñaśśatruvijayāya bhagavān śrīnivāsaśśaṅkhacakre vyatārīditi paurāṇikī kathā'nusaṃhitā || liṅgaṃ yathā bhuvanopakārahetostava no bhagavan pravṛttirekā'pi | kintu svārthā manye nikhilaśarīratvameva tadvadati || 2096 || atra bhagavataśrīnivāsasya ‘yasya pṛthivī śarīram' ityādiśrutiprasiddhasarvopakārakasarvavastuśarīrakatvaliṅgena tatpravṛtteḥ svaprojanaikatatparatvaṃ samarthitam || nanu liṅgasya sāmarthyātmakasya śabdapramāṇabahirbhūtatayā śabdapramāṇaprastāve kathamudāharaṇamiti cenna, svatastasya pramāṇatāviraheṇa vedānumāpakatayaiva pramāṇatvācchabdapramāṇa evāntarbhāvitatvāt | evaṃ laukikaliṅgānāmapi laukikaśabdonnāyakatayā laukikaśabda evāntarbhāvaḥ | tādṛśaliṅgamapyevamevodāhāryam || vākyaṃ yathā aghaniṣkṛtiprakaraṇe prabalaṃ niścitya tāvakaṃ vākyam | janani vṛṇe śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prakaraṇato vākyameva hi balīyaḥ || 2097 || aghaniṣkṛtiprakaraṇe prāyaścittaprasaktau satyāṃ tāvakaṃ vākyaṃ ‘prāyaścittaprasaṅge tu sarvapāpasamudbhave | māmekāṃ devadevasya mahiṣīṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet || iti lakṣmītantroktaṃ tvadvākyaṃ prabalaṃ niścitya he janani śrīḥ! tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ vṛṇe | hi yasmāt prakaraṇataḥ ubhayākāṅkṣālakṣaṇāt vākyaṃ samabhivyāhāralakṣaṇaṃ vākyaṃ balīyaḥ prabalaṃ āhuḥ | tāntrikā iti śeṣaḥ | tathāca pāramarṣaṃ sūtram ‘śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāṃ samavāye pāradaurbalyamarthavi prakarṣāt' iti, ‘nirapekṣo ravaśśrutiḥ | sāmarthyaṃ liṅgam | samabhivyāhāro vākyam | ubhayākāṅkṣā prakaraṇam | deśasāmānyaṃ sthānam | yaugikaśśabdasamākhyā' iti saṃkṣepaḥ | atra prakaraṇavākyarūpaśabdapratipādyārthadvayaśleṣamūlābhedādhyavasāyottambhitena prakaraṇādbalīyasā vākyenoktārthasamarthanam || yathāvā nāmnaiva mādhave tvayyāttadarāriṇi kumāra eṣa iti | vākyaṃ kaśśraddadhyācchrutiliṅgābhyāṃ hi durbalaṃ vākyam || 2098 || he bhagavan! nāmnaiva mādhave ‘mādhavaṃ veṅkaṭagirau' iti bhagavacchāstrokeriti bhāvaḥ | anenābhidhānaśrutirdarśitā | ātte śrībhagavadrāmānujācāryātsvīkṛte darāriṇī śaṅkhacakre yena tasminniti liṅgam | tvayi eṣa kumāraḥ skanda iti keṣāṃcinmūrkhāṇāṃ vākyaṃ kaśśraddadhyāt | hi yasmāt śrutiliṅgābhyāṃ tadapekṣayā vākyaṃ durbalam | pūrvodāharaṇe prakaraṇādvākyasya prābalyaṃ prādarśi | atra tu śrutiliṅgāpekṣayā tasya daurbalyamiti viśeṣaḥ | anyattulyam || prakaraṇaṃ yathā yatrakvavā'stu tava guṇakathāprakaraṇaṃ tadeva sādhujanaiḥ | ādriyate na sthānaṃ paramapi tatprakaraṇāddhi hīnabalam || 2099 || he bhagavan! tava guṇakathāyāḥ prakaraṇaṃ prastāvaḥ yatrakvavā astu apraśaste'pi deśe astvityarthaḥ | tadeva tvadguṇakathāprakaraṇameva sādhujanaiḥ bhāgavataiḥ ādriyate paraṃ sthānaṃ paramaṃ padamapi nādriyate teṣāṃ bhagavatkathaikabhogyatvāditi bhāvaḥ | tat paraṃ sthānaṃ paratvena sūtroktaṃ deśasāmānyarūpasthānaṃ ca prakaraṇādapi prastāvādapi ubhayākāṅkṣārūpaprakaraṇādapi ca hīnabalaṃ durbalaṃ hi | pāradaurbalyasya sūtritatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra uktarītyāprakaraṇasthānaśabdavācyārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyadattahastena prakaraṇena vivakṣitārthasamarthanam || sthānaṃ yathā sthānena vyapadiṣṭā bhāti samākhyā'pi veṅkaṭeśa tava | yatkathitaṃ jaimininā sthānaṃ balavattaraṃ samākhyāyāḥ || 2100 || he veṅkaṭeśa! tava śrutiśataprathitavaibhasyeti bhāvaḥ | samākhyā'pi nāmāpi sthānena tvadāvāsabhūtaveṅkaṭādrilakṣaṇasthānena vyapadiṣṭā vyapadeśaṃ khyātiṃ prāptā "vasiṣṭhavyapadeśinaḥ' itivat veṅkaṭādrirūpasthānapuraskāreṇaiva hi tava veṅkaṭeśa ityabhidheti bhāvaḥ | yat yasmāt jaimininā samākhyāyāḥ yaugikaśabdarūpasamākhyāyāḥ nāmnaśca tadapekṣayetyarthaḥ | sthānaṃ deśasāmānyarūpaṃ āvāsabhūtaṃ ca sthānameva balavaditi kathitaṃ paradaurbalyasūtreṇa | tasmāt tava samākhyā'pi sthānena vyapadiṣṭā bhātīti yojanā | atra samākhyāsthānaśabdapratipādyārthadvayaśleṣamūlābhedātiśayaikīkṛtena sthānena bhagavatsamākhyāyā vyapadeśyatvaṃ samarthitam || samākhyā yathā vedhāssa kṛttivāsāssāntā vṛddhaśravāśca viśvātman | nāntastvamatra mānaṃ bhavati hi yuṣmatsamākhyaiva || 2101 || he viśvātman! idaṃ atraiva udāhariṣyamāṇavacanasthaviśvātmaśabdapratyabhijñāpakam | sa ityetat vedhaḥprabhṛtiṣu sarveṣvapyanuṣañjanīyam | saḥ lokasraṣṭṛtayā prakhyātaḥ vedhāḥ caturmukhaḥ, saḥ jagatsaṃhartṛtvena prasiddhaḥ kṛttivāsāḥ pinākī, saḥ amarādhīśatvena prathitaḥ vṛddhaśravāḥ indraśca sāntāḥ antena saha vartanta iti tathoktāḥ | vinaśvarā ityarthaḥ | pakṣe uktāssarve'pi śabdāssakārāntā ityarthaḥ | saḥ ‘ajaro'mṛtaḥ | vijaro vimṛtyuḥ | satyaṃ jñānamanantam' iti śrutiśatakhyāpitaḥ tvaṃ nāntaḥ anantaḥ naśabdapūrvako bahuvrīhiḥ | nitya ityarthaḥ | pakṣe viśvātmanniti śabdo nakārānta ityarthaḥ | atra mānaṃ pramāṇaṃ yuṣmākaṃ te ca tvaṃ ca yūyaṃ teṣāṃ ‘tyadādīnāṃ mithassahoktau yatparaṃ tacchiṣyate' iti paraikaśeṣaḥ | samākhyā nāmaiva | atra brahmādiṣu pralīnaṣu naṣṭe loke carācare | ābhūtasaṃplave prāpte pralīne prakṛtau mahān | ekastiṣṭhati viśvātmā sa tu nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || iti śrīmanmahābhāratavacanaṃ, brahmā śambhustathā'rkaśca candramāśca śatakratuḥ | etadādyāstathaivānye yuktā vaiṣṇavatejasā || jagatkāryāvasāneṣu viyujyante svatejasā | vitejasaśca te sarve pañcatvamupayānti ca || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottaravacanaṃ cārthataḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | atra vivakṣite'rthe samakhyāyāḥ pramāṇatā || yathāvā natanivahena krīto nitarāṃ cakrī samiddhayā bhaktyā | cakrīti samākhyaiva krītatvamamuṣya vadati suspaṣṭam || 2102 || cakrīti samākhyā nāmaiva amuṣya bhagavataḥ krītatvaṃ krayaṇakarmatvaṃ, pakṣe krītyākārakavarṇena itatvaṃ yuktatvam | atrāpi svavivakṣite krītatvarūpe'rthe śabdārthatādātmyamūlakaśleṣamahimnā samākhyaiva pramāṇatāṃ gamitā | atra ‘bhaktikrīto janārdanaḥ' iti pramaṇārtho'nusaṃdheyaḥ || yathāvā tvatpadavidhuto raviriha khe'ṭeṣvagresaro bhavan bhagavan | vyagro'pyabhavannūnaṃ samākhyayaivāvagamyate'rtho'sau || 2103 || he bhagavan! raviḥ bhānuḥ raviśabdaśca | tvatpadena tava caraṇaruceti yāvat vidhutaḥ ataeva kheṭeṣu garhyeṣu ‘kheṭagarhyāṇakāssamāḥ' ityamaraḥ | gaganacāriṣu graheṣviti tattvam | agresaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ anyatra agre ādau saraḥ śabdārthatādātmyabalena rephaviśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | bhavan san vyagro'pi vyākulopi abhavat | viḥ vivarṇaḥ agre prānte yasya sa tathābhūtaśca "agraṃ purastādupari parimāṇe palasya ca | ālambane samūhe ca prānte ca syānnapuṃsakam | adhike ca pradhāne ca prathame cābhidheyavat" iti medinī | abhavat | nūnamiti sambhāvanāyām | atra tasya samākhyayaivāyamarthaḥ avagamyate | uktarītyā samākhyayā tādṛśārthalābhāditi bhāvaḥ | atrāpi svavikṣite'rthe samākhyaiva śleṣamahimnā pramāṇīkṛtā || yathāvā vidhuriha vibho bhavanmukhavipratipanno dhutastatassakhyamagāt | asya samākhyaiva vadatyamumarthaṃ kiṃnvihānyamīmāṃsanataḥ || 2104 || he vibho svāmin! iha vidhuḥ induḥ bhavanmukhena bhavanmukhe vā vipratipannaḥ vipratipattiṃ gataḥ virodhaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ | ata eva tataḥ sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ tena mukhenetyarthaḥ | dhutaḥ tiraskṛta iti yāvat | tata ityetat madhyamaṇinyāyenobhayānvayi | tataḥ tena saha sakhyaṃ sauhārdaṃ agāt utkṛṣṭenāvadhīritasya nikṛṣṭasya kuśalamaterjhaḍiti tadāśrayaṇamevocitamiti bhāvaḥ | amumarthaṃ uktamarthaṃ asya vidhoḥ samākhyaiva vadati prakāśayati | iha asminviṣaye anyamīmāṃsanataḥ kiṃ vicārāntaramanāvaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ | samākhyāpakṣe tu vidhuḥ vidhuśabdaḥ vibho abhavat iti chedaḥ | mukhe prathamabhāge vipratipannaḥ vi ityākārakākṣareṇāśritaḥ abhavat āsīt | tataḥ anantaraṃ dhutaḥ sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | dhuvarṇena sakhyaṃ sāhityamiti yāvat | agāt prāpat | vidhuśabda evaṃniṣpanna ityarthaḥ | anyatpūrvavat || yathāvā ādau svārāddhaśśrīdhara madhye trāsito'pi sutrāmā | mānugṛhīto'nte'bhūdasya samākhyaiva tamimamāhārtham || 2105 || he śrīdhara! sutrāmā indraḥ sutrāmeti śabdaśca | ādau durvāsaśśāpopaplavātpūrvaṃ svaḥ svargaḥ rāddhaṃ siddhaṃ yasya saḥ svā rāddhaḥ svaḥ svarge rāddhaḥ saṃsiddha iti vā | sarvaiśvaryaparipūrṇa ityarthaḥ ‘ro ri' iti rephalope ‘ḍhralope' iti pūrvasyāṇo dīrghaḥ | śabdapakṣe tu ādau su iti varṇaṃ ārāddhaṃ yena saḥ svārāddhaḥ | madhye durvāsaśśāpalakṣmīkaṭākṣalābhayorantarālasamaye trāsitaḥ vairocaniprabhṛtibhiḥ padabhraṃśanādinā bhīṣito'pi | anyatra madhye su mā iti varṇadvayāntare trāsitaḥ trā iti varṇasamudayaḥ āsitaḥ upaveśitaḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ca iti varṇasamūhena sitaḥ baddhaḥ saṃbaddha iti vā | apiratra samuccaye | trāsitaścetyarthaḥ | ante paryavasāne mānugṛhītaḥ lakṣmīkaṭākṣaviṣayīkṛta ityarthaḥ | anyatra ante caramabhāge mānugṛhītaḥ mā iti varṇena ghaṭita iti yāvat | abhūt | tamimamarthaṃ asya sutrāmṇaḥ samākhyaiva āha sutrāmeti samākhyayaiva vedite'sminnarthe paurāṇikoktiparyantānudhāvanaṃ nāpekṣitamiti bhāvaḥ | atra upapādite svābhimate'rthe samākhyāyāḥ pramāṇatā || yathāvā māpamumāpatirantarbibharti tadadhīnasatta evāyam | yadi durgraho'yamartho vimṛśyatāṃ sādhu tatsamākhyaiva || 2106 || umāpatiḥ śivaḥ māpaṃ śrīnāthaṃ antarbibharti antarātmatayā dadhāti | mamāntarātmā tava ca yecānye dehisaṃjñitāḥ | viṣṇurātmā bhagavato bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ || ityādipramāṇāditi bhāvaḥ | ata eva ayaṃ umāpatiḥ tadadhīnasatta eva tadāyattasvarūpasthitipravṛttibheda ityarthaḥ | ayamarthaḥ antaryāmibrāhmaṇārthāvisaṃvādipradarśitapramāṇasaṃpratipanno'rthaḥ durgraho yadi alpaprajñairdurvijñānaścet sādhu samyak tatsamākhyaiva umāpatisamākhyaiva vimṛśyatāṃ vimarśe ayamarthassphuṭībhaviṣyatyalpajñānāmapīti bhāvaḥ | samākhyāpakṣe tu umāpatiḥ umāpatiśabdaḥ antaḥ ādyantākṣarayormadhye māpaṃ māśca paśca anayossamāhāraḥ māpaṃ evaṃrūpaṃ varṇasamudayaṃ bibharti | ataeva ayaṃ umāpatiśabdaḥ tadadhīnasattaḥ māpavarṇāyattasvasthitiḥ uktamāpavarṇābhāve umāpatiśabdasattāyā durghaṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra svavivakṣite umāpaterbhagavadantarātmakatve umāpatisamākhyāyāḥ pramāṇīkaraṇam || yathāvā sati bhavati sarvabhogye kāmuka itarāmiṣasya yo bhagavan | amukassa kāka eva syādetadvakti tatsamākhyaiva || 2107 || he bhagavan! sarvabhogye sarvaissarvaprakāreṇa bhogye bhavati satyapi yaḥ itarāmiṣasya bhogyavastvantarasya 'āmiṣaṃ puṃnapuṃsakam | bhogyavastuni saṃbhoge'pyutkoce palale'pica' iti medinī | anyamāṃsasyetyapyupaskāryam | kāmukaḥ kāmayitā | ‘na loka' ityādikṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīniṣedhasya ‘kameraniṣedhaḥ' iti paryudastatvāt kāmukaśabdayoge itarāmiṣaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhyeva | saḥ amukaḥ so'sau kāmukaḥ | adaśśabdasamānārthako'yamavyutpanno'mukaśabdaḥ | 'amukagotrasyāmukaśarmaṇaḥ | jñātassvareṇāmukaḥ' ityādiprayogadarśanāt | na tu sākacko'daśśabdaḥ | tathā satyasuka iti syāt | kāka eva vāyasa eva syāt | āmiṣagṛdhnutvāttattulya eveti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe kāmukaśabdo mukāravighaṭitaḥ kāka eva kākaśabda eva syāt | atra svavivakṣitārthanirdhāraṇāya cyāvittaikavarṇakāmukasamākhyāyāḥ pramāṇatayopanyāsa ityacyāvitavarṇasamākhyodāharaṇebhyaḥ pūrvebhyo vicchittiviśeṣaśālīdam || yathāvā pratikūlabhāvabhāktve nūnaṃ haṃsīti bhāsi siṃhatvam | īdṛksiṃhetyetatpadameva hi mānamatra paryāptam || 2108 || he siṃha he nṛsiṃha! tvaṃ pratikūlabhāvabhāktve tvadviṣaye prātikūlyakṛttve nūnaṃ haṃsīti bhāsi prātikūlyabhājaṃ janaṃ saṃharasīti mama pratibhāsītyarthaḥ | pakṣe he siṃheti siṃhaśabdasyaiva saṃbodhanam | pratikūlabhāvabhāktve prātilomyaprāptau haṃsīti bhāsi haṃsītyānupūrvyā prakāśase ityarthaḥ | atra uktārthe īdṛk prātilomyabhāktve haṃsīti niṣpadyamānaṃ siṃhetyetatpadameva mānaṃ pramāṇaṃ paryāptam | kimanyapramāṇānveṣaṇeneti bhāvaḥ | atra uktārthe uktarūpaṃ siṃheti saṃbuddhyantasamākhyāpadaṃ pramāṇatayopanyastamiti pūrvasmādvicchittiviśeṣaśālīdam || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre śabdapramāṇasaraḥ pañcadaśottaraśatatamaḥ <6> athārthāpattisaraḥ anyathā'nupapattyā yatkiṃcidarthasya kalpyate | arthāntaraṃ tāṃ kathayantyarthāpattiṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ || kiṃcidarthānyadhānupapattyā arthāntarakalpanamarthāpattirnāmālaṃkāraḥ || yathā nandakiśorakaradarucibṛndaṃ nitarāmacūcuratkundam | upapadyatāmaparathā vipinabhavasyāpi dāntatā'sya katham || 2109 || kundasya vikāraḥ puṣpaṃ kundaṃ ‘puṣpamūleṣu bahulam' iti bahulagrahaṇādvaikārikāṇo luk | ‘dvihīnaṃ prasave sarvam' iti klībatā | idaṃ kartṛ mādhyakusumamityarthaḥ | nandakiśorakaradarucibṛndaṃ karma acūcurat acorayat | aparadhā evaṃ cauryābhāve vipinabhavasya āraṇyasyāpi asya kundasya dāntatā dantasaṃbandhitā kathamupapadyatāṃ na kathaṃcidapyupapadyata ityarthaḥ | kundaśabdasya davarṇāntatvāddāntatvamiti stusthitiḥ | atra kundasya dantatānyadhā'nupapattyā bhagavaddantarucibṛndacauryanirṇayanibandhanādarthāpattiḥ || yathāvā tvatpadagatividveṣṭā'śucaṃ tataḥ prāpya janani śuṇḍālaḥ | caṇḍālo'bhūnmanye mātaṅgatvaṃ kathaṃnvitarathā'sya || 2110 || he janani! śuṇḍālaḥ gajaḥ tvatpadagatividveṣṭā tvaccaraṇagamanadveṣī tava padaṃ sthānaṃ paramavyoma tasya gatiḥ prāptiḥ tasyāḥ vidveṣṭeti ca | ataeva tataḥ vidveṣāt śucaṃ śokaṃ prāpya | pakṣe aśu caṃ iti chedaḥ | aśu śuvarṇarahitaṃ yathāsyāttathā caṃ 'na girā girā' iti nyāyena tatraiva śuvarṇasthāne cakāraṃ prāpya caṇḍālo'bhūt | ‘yastu nārāyaṇaṃ dveṣṭi taṃ vidyādantyaretasam' itivat lakṣmīpadagatividveṣasya phalamidamiti bhāvaḥ | śuṇḍāla śabdaḥ śukārāpanayanapūrvakaṃ tatraiva cakāranyasanena caṇḍāla iti niṣpanna ityarthaḥ | itarathā uktarītyā caṇḍālatvāprāptau asya śuṇḍālasya mātaṅgatvaṃ kathaṃ nu mātaṅgaśabdābhilapanīyatvaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ | ‘mātaṅgaśśvapace gaje' iti medinī | atra gajasya mātaṅgatvavyavahārānyathānupapattyā caṇḍālatvaṃ śleṣamahimnā kalpyate || yathāvā harimukharuciparibhūto vidhuriti manye'nyathā vivarṇamukhaḥ | atipāṇḍurukpratipadaṃ kṣayamapi jāḍyaṃ kuto'yamupayāyāt || 2111 || vidhuḥ induḥ hareḥ bhagavataḥ mukhena paribhūta iti manye | anyathā evaṃ paribhavābhāve ayaṃ vidhuḥ atipāṇḍuruk atimātrapāṇḍurogavān ‘strī rugrujā' ityamaraḥ | ataeva vivarṇamukhaḥ nistejaskavadanaḥ | pakṣe ativiśadadīptiḥ ‘syuḥ prabhā rugruciḥ' ityamaraḥ | vi iti varṇo mukhe agrabhāge yasya sa tathokta ityarthaḥ | kṣayaṃ jāḍyaṃ rājayakṣmākhyarogamapi | pakṣe kṣayaṃ kalāpacayaṃ ‘kṣayo rogāntare veśmakalpāntāpacayeṣu ca' iti medinī | jāḍyaṃ śaityamapītyarthaḥ | kutaḥ upayāyāt | atra vidhorvivarṇamukhatvādyanyadhānupapattyā harimukhaparibhūtatvaṃ kalpyate | śleṣottambhitatā prāgvat || yathāvā tava saukumāryabhūmnā navanītaṃ janani kharvitaunnatyam | ādyantanatamitarathā kuto vanīgarbhagaṃ tadetatsyāt || 2112 || he janani! navanītaṃ tava saukumāryabhūmnā kharvitaunnatyaṃ saṃkucitasaukumāryocchrayaṃ itarathā tadetat navanītaṃ ādyantāvabhivyāpya ādyantaṃ nataṃ sarvadā bhugnaṃ sadityarthaḥ | kuto hetoḥ vanyāḥ vanasya garbhaṃ madhyapradeśaṃ gacchatīti vanīgarbhagaṃ syāt | tvatsaukumāryakartṛkasvasaukumāryakharvīkaraṇavirahe uktarītyā kuto vanīgarbhaṃ praviśediti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe navanītamiti padaṃ ādyantayoḥ natau nakāratakārau yasya tattathoktaṃ vanī iti varṇau garbhagau yasya tattathoktaṃ syāt | navanītaśabdasvarūpasyaivaṃvidhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra navanītasyādyantabhugnatvavanīgarbhagatvānyathānupapattyā śrīsaukumāryātiśayakharvīkṛtaunnatyatā saṃbhāvitā || yathāvā manye taṭitastvacchrījihīrṣavaśśrīstvayā''hatā gāḍham | kathamitarathā tvavākkṛtaśiraso'pi na tāntatāṃ samatyākṣuḥ || 2113 || he śrīḥ! taṭitaḥ tvacchrījihīrṣavaḥ tvallakṣmīharaṇecchavassatyaḥ ataeva tvayā gāḍhaṃ āhatāḥ abhihatāḥ itharathā tu evamāghātābhāve tu avākkṛtaśiraso'pīti lokoktiḥ | ativelaprayāsabhājo'pīti yāvat | tāntatāṃ glānatāṃ na samatyākṣuḥ | taṭita iti śabdasya pratilomye'pi yathāpuramavasthānena tavarṇāntatvāprahāṇāttathoktiḥ| arthagatabahutvasya śabde āropaḥ | atrāvākkṛtaśirastve'pi tāntatvāprahāṇānyathānupapattyā taṭitāṃ lakṣmīgāḍhaprahṛtatvaṃ kalpyate || yathāvā makarandenāmba tvadvacanarasasteyameva na kṛtaṃ cet | sūnāvasthānātsyādasya kimudvāsanāvāptiḥ || asya makarandasya sūnāyāṃ hiṃsāsthāne | sūne kusume iti tu tattvaṃ avasthānāt sthiteḥ ‘sūnaṃ prasavapuṣpayoḥ | sūnā putryāṃ vadhasthāne galaśuṇḍikayoḥ striyām' iti medinī | udvāsanaṃ pramathanaṃ tasyāvāptiḥ ‘udvāsanapramathanaprathanojjāsanāni ca' iti vadhaparyāyeṣvamaraḥ | utpūrvakāt ‘vasa snehacchedāpaharaṇeṣu' iti caurādikāddhātorlyuṭ | utkṛṣṭā vāsanā parimalaḥ tasyāḥ avāptiriti tu tattvam | atra makarandasya upapāditaśleṣasaṃpāditasūnāvasthānodvāsanāvāptyanyathānupapattyā jagajjananīvacanarasacoratvaṃ kalpyate || yathāvā tvadvacanadhṛtaṃ gavyaṃ no yadi tadidaṃ puro'gamārūḍham | madhye'tibhaye'vāpte śrīmanvyādhigatamantataḥ kasmāt || 2115 || he bhagavan! gavyaṃ gopayaḥ tvadvacanena dhutaṃ tiraskṛtameva no yadi tadidaṃ gavyaṃ puraḥ ādau agaṃ adriṃ ārūḍhaṃ sat kartari ktaḥ | loke pratipakṣanirdhūtānāṃ giridurgapraveśassuprasiddha iti bhāvaḥ | madhye giripradeśagamanāvasarāntare atibhaye pratyanīkabhūtatvadvacanasmaraṇenātyantikatrāse avāpte sati antataḥ paryavasāne vyādhigataṃ 'dvitīyā śrita' ityādinā samāsaḥ prāptarogaṃ cetyarthaḥ | atimātrabhayasaṃbhrāntānāṃ vyādherapi saṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ | kasmādbhavet tvadvacanadhutatvādeva gavyasyedṛgavasthāvāptiriti bhāvaḥ | arthāntaraṃ tu śabdaparam | asmin pakṣe puraḥ | gaṃ | atibhaye | avāpteḥ | iti chedaḥ | prāthamikārthe avāpte iti saptamyantatayā chede paratrasthitaśrīśabdaśakārasya ‘anaci ca' iti vaikalpikaṃ dvitvam | he atibha atitejasvin śrīman! gavyaṃ gavyamiti padaṃ puraḥ agre gaṃ gavarṇaṃ ārūḍhaṃ prāptaṃ tasya mukhe gavarṇasya śrūyamāṇatvāt | ye ‘gopayasoryat' iti sūtreṇa vihite vaikārike yādau pratyaye pare madhye gakārayakārayorantarāle avāpteḥ avasya ‘vānto yi pratyaye' iti sūtravihitasya okārasthānikāvādeśasya āpteḥ prāpterhetoḥ antataḥ ānte vyādhigataṃ vyetyākārakavarṇasamudāyaṃ prāptaṃ bhavet | gośabdāduktarītyā yatpratyaye avādeśe ca satyeva gavyaśabdasya vyavarṇāntatvaṃ sidhyet nānyatheti bhāvaḥ | atrāpi gavyasya puro'gārūḍhatvādyanyathānupapattyā śabdārthatādātmyamūlakaśleṣāvalambinyā bhagavadvacanasvādimavijitatvaṃ kalpyate | vicchittyantaraṃ tu spaṣṭameva || yathāvā svakareṇa tava bhujaśrīspardhī dantavalo mukhe'bhihataḥ | manye'nyathā kathamabhūddviradatvaṃ dvirasanādrināthasya || 2116 || abhūddviradatvamityatra viradatvamiti chedaḥ | viradanyaṃ vibhraṃśita dantatvam | dviradatvamiti parihāraḥ || yathāvā gāḍhaṃ prahṛtasya mukhe tvattejaspardhino'nalasya hare | radanāssphuliṅgadambhājjagaluḥ kathamanyathaiṣa haviradanaḥ || 2117 || eṣaḥ ha viradanaḥ iti chedaḥ | hetyavyayaṃ prasiddhau ‘ha saṃbuddhau prasiddhau ca' iti ratnamālā | pakṣe haviradana iti samastaṃ padam| hutāśana ityarthaḥ | anayorudāharaṇayorapi viradatvāviradanatvānyathānupapatyā śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyasaṃpāditayā dantāvalānalayormukhe'bhihatatvasya kalpanam || yathāvā vasudevasuto bhagavāṃtsūto'jani pāradaśca yuktamidam | kathamitarathā raso vai sa iti śrutivacanamarthavattvamiyāt || 2118 || bhagavān vasudevasutaḥ sūtaḥ pāradaśca ajanīti yuktam | vastutastu sūtaḥ arjunasya sārathiḥ | janipārada iti samastaṃ padam | janeḥ janmanaḥ pāraṃ dadātīti pāradaḥ janmaparaṃparāpārabhūtaniśśreyasaprada ityarthaḥ || janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ | tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so'rjuna || iti gānāt | anena saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ viṣayākrāntacetasām | viṣṇupotaṃ vinā nānyatkiṃcidasti parāyaṇam || durgaṃ saṃsārakāntāramapāramabhidhāvatām | ekaḥ kṛṣṇanamaskāro muktitīrasya deśikaḥ || ityādikaṃ smāryate | itarathā evaṃ sūtatvapāradatvābhāve ‘raso vai saḥ' iti śrutivacanaṃ kathamarthavatsyāt tasya rasatvādeva sūtatvapāradatve yukte iti bhāvaḥ | ‘rasassūtaśca pāradaḥ' iti trayāṇāmapi śabdānāṃ tulyārthakatvānuśāsanāt | rasaḥ ānandamaya iti vastusthitiḥ | atra bhagavato rasatvānyathānupapattyā sūtatvapāradatve kalpyete | yathāvā añjanamañjanagiripatimañjulasuṣamāṃ jahāra manye'ham | sudṛśāmidamakṣigataṃ dadṛśe kathamanyathā tadidam || 2119 || sudṛśāṃ viduṣāṃ yoṣitāṃ ca akṣigataṃ dveṣyaṃ cakṣurviṣayaṃ ca 'dveṣye tvakṣigataḥ' ityamaraḥ | atrāñjanasya sudṛgakṣigatatvānyathānupapattyā bhagavādvigrahasuṣamāharaṇadoṣavattvakalpanam || yathāvā svaśarīrato'harattava dhammillaruciṃ ghanāghano manye | kathamanyathā'sya kamale jagadantasthāvarāpakīrtijaniḥ || 2120 || he kamale! ghanāghanaḥ svaśarīrataḥ nijavapuṣā tava dhammillaruciṃ aharat amuṣṇāt iti manye | anyathā asya ghanāghanasya jagadantaḥ lokamadhye apagatā kīrtiḥ yasyāssā apakīrtiḥ sā cāsau janiśca sthāvara ityapakīrtijaniḥ sthāvaratvenāpraśastaṃ janmetyarthaḥ | kathaṃ bhavet | uktavidhaśārīrakarmadoṣavaśādeṣa sthāvarajanmalābha iti bhāvaḥ || śarīrajaiḥ karmadoṣairyāti sthāvaratāṃ naraḥ | vācikaiḥ pakṣimṛgatāṃ mānasairantyajātitām || iti manusmaraṇāt | pakṣe asya saṃbandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī | asmāt ghanāghanādityarthaḥ | varāpakīrtijaniḥ | apāṃ samūhaḥ āpaṃ varaṃ ca tat āpaṃ ca varāpaṃ | kīrtiḥ kardamaḥ | tayoḥ janiḥ utpattiḥ jagadantasthā jaganmadhyasthitā | ghanāghanādeva hi jagati salilapaṅkasaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ | atra ghanāghanasya jagadantasthāvarāpakīrtijanmalābhānyathānupapattyā lakṣmīdhammillarucicauryarūpakāyikadoṣakalpanam | śleṣottambhitatvaṃ tu pūrvavadeva || yathāvā tāvakanakhāni gobhistārakanikaro vyadūduṣa nmanye | kathamaparathā sadākhyo'pyeṣa hi vaihāyasīṃ gatiṃ vindet || 2121 || he janani! tārakāṇāṃ uḍnāṃ āpadādikṛchrāduttārakāṇāmiti ca gamyate | nikaraḥ tāvakanakhāni gobhiḥ vāgbhiḥ kiraṇaiśca vyadūduṣat dūṣayati smeti manye | aparathā eṣa tārakanikaraḥ sadākhyaḥ sādhurityākhyāvānapi sadityākhyā nāma yasya sa iti vastusthitiḥ ‘bhaṃ nakṣatraṃ tārakaṃ sat' ityanuśāsanāt | vaihāyasīṃ pakṣisaṃbandhinīṃ gatiṃ karmaphalaṃ kathaṃ vindet 'vācikaiḥ pakṣimṛgatām' ityanantarapūrvodāharaṇadarśitapramāṇena vācikakarmadoṣaphalatayā pratipāditā vaihāyasī gatiḥ kathaṃ satvena pratītasyāpi saṃbhavediti bhāvaḥ | vaihāyasīṃ antarikṣabhavāṃ gatiṃ gamanamiti tu tattvam | ‘vihāyaśśakune puṃsi gagane puṃnapuṃsakam' iti medinī | atra tārakanikarasya vaihāyasagatiprāptyanyathānupapattyā lakṣmīcaraṇanakhakarmakavākkaraṇakadūṣayitṛtvaṃ saṃbhāvyate || yathāvā amaladvijastava smitavasuhārī mānase'bhavannūnam | kathamanyathā plavaissaha vasedasāvantyajatvamāsīdan || 2122 || amaladvijaḥ haṃsaḥ nirmalo vipraścetyapi gamyate | mānase manasi tava smitasya vasūni dhanāni haratīti smitavasuhārī abhavat nūnam | anyatra smitasya vasuḥ raśmiḥ sa iva hārī manoharaḥ smitavadviśada ityarthaḥ | mānase tannāmni sarasi abhavat sattāmalabhateti yojanā | haṃsānāṃ mānasanivāsitvāditi bhāvaḥ | anyathā evaṃ mānasakarmadoṣavirahe antyajatvamā sadin ‘mānasairantyajātitām' iti prāgudāhṛtavacanapratipāditamānasakarmadoṣaphalabhūtamantyajātitvaṃ prāpnuvan san
