antimajakāravattāmiti tu tattvam | plavaiḥ caṇḍālaiḥ kāraṇḍavākhyavihagaiśca kathaṃ saha vaset | ‘caṇḍālaplavamātaṅgadivākīrtijanaṃgamāḥ, madguḥ kāraṇḍavaḥ plavaḥ' iti cāmaraḥ | ‘haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇām' ityādau sarvatra haṃsasya kāraṇḍavasahacāritvaṃ hi varṇyate ‘plavassyātplavane mele bheke'vau śvapace paśau, ityupakramya kāraṇḍavākhyavihage' iti medinī ca | evaṃcopadarśitodāharaṇatrayeṇa karaṇatrayanirvartitakarmadoṣaphalāni krameṇa darśitāni | atrāmaladvijasyāntyajatvaprāptyanyathānupapattyā mānasikalakṣmīsmitavasucauryarūpadoṣavattā kalpitā || yathāvā agrakarāhitamiha tava kaṭakaṃ karkaṭakatāṃ gataṃ manye'ham | kathamanyathā'sya kamale siṃhamukhatvaṃ śucidyutipadatvaṃ vā || 2123 || he amba! tava agraścāsau karaśca agrakaraḥ karāgramityarthaḥ 'hastāgrāgrahastādayo guṇaguṇinorbhedābhedāt' ityavayavāvayavinorabhedaḥ | tasmin āhitaṃ nyastaṃ kaṭakaṃ valayaṃ karkaṭakatāṃ karkaṭakarāśitāṃ gataṃ manye ‘syātkulīraḥ karkaṭakaḥ' ityamaraḥ | ‘syātkarkaṭaḥ karkaṭakaśca karkī' iti karkaṭarāśināmaparyāyeṣu vidyāmādhavaḥ | pakṣe agre mukhabhāge kar iti varṇasamudayena āhitaḥ kar āhito yasminniti vā | kaṭakaśabdaḥ karkaṭakatāṃ prapadyata ityarthaḥ | anyathā karkaṭakatvāyoge asya kaṭakasya kathaṃ siṃhamukhatvaṃ siṃharāśeḥ pūrvagaṇyatvaṃ syāt siṃharāśeḥ karkaṭakarāśyanantarabhāvitvāditi bhāvaḥ | siṃhasya mukhamiva mukhaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ tattvamiti vastusthitiḥ | siṃhamukhākāravattvaṃ kaṭakasya prasiddham, yat siṃhalalāṭakaṭakamiti vyavahriyate janaiḥ | śucidyuteḥ sitakiraṇasya padaṃ sthānaṃ tattvaṃ vā kathaṃ bhavet karkaṭakatvādeva candrasya kṣetramāsīditi bhāvaḥ | ‘karkaṭasya niśākaraḥ' iti karkaṭasya tatkṣetratokteḥ | vastutastu śuceḥ śuddhāyāḥ dyuteḥ kānteḥ padaṃ sthānaṃ ādhāra ityarthaḥ | tathātvaṃ, yadvā śucidyuteḥ agnitulyadīpteḥ padaṃ atyujjvalamityarthaḥ | atra kaṭakasya siṃhamukhatvādyanyathānupapattyā karkaṭakatvaṃ kalpyate | yathāvā tvannakhasaṃgharṣīndustaiśśastrāśastri mardito manye | ahigirināthetarathā vahati sa mṛdulāñchitāṃ kuto mūrtim || 2124 || saḥ induḥ mṛdulāṃ mṛdvīṃ chitāṃ chinnāṃ ca mūrtiṃ kuto vahati | śastrāśastrimarditatvādeva hi mūrtermṛdutvaṃ chinnatvaṃ ceti bhāvaḥ | mṛduścāsau lāñchitā ca mṛdulāñchitā tāmiti tattvam | mṛdvī kalaṅkitā cetyarthaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat | atra mṛdulāñchitāṃ mūrtiṃ kuto vahatītyuktārthānyathānupapattyā candramaso bhagavannakhasaṃgharṣamūlakaśastrāśastrimarditatvaṃ kalpyate || yathāvā nanu deva puṣpavantau saspardhau tvatpratāpakīrtibhyām | prahṛtau mukhe'nyathā tāvadantatāṃ tāntatāṃ ca kathametām || 2125 || puṣpavantau suryācandramasau | adantatāṃ avidyamānadantatvaṃ tāntatāṃ klāntatvaṃ ca | pakṣe akārāntatvaṃ takārāntatvaṃ ca ‘eka yoktyā puṣpavantau' ityamaraḥ | aitām agacchatām | ayamadantastānto'pyasti ‘puṣṭihrāsau kumudasuhṛdaḥ puṣpavantoparāge' iti, ‘vilocane vibhoryasya vikhyāte puṣpavattayā' ityubhayadhā'pi prayogadarśanāt | atra sarvatra śleṣojjvīvitatvaṃ tulyam || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre arthāpattisaraḥ ṣoḍaśottaraśatatamaḥ <7> athānupalabdhisaraḥ yadyogyānupalabdhessyādabhāvasyāvadhāraṇam | kṛtino'nupalabdhiṃ tāṃ ramyāṃ viduralaṃkṛtim || yogyānupalabdhijanyamabhāvāvadhāraṇamanupalabdhirnāmālaṃkāraḥ | ramyatvaṃ tu sarvālaṃkārānugatameva || yathāvā doṣalavo'pi yadi syāttvayi sudṛśāṃ tadupalabdhireva syāt | kalyāṇaguṇaikanidhe kalaṅka upalabhyate hi sakalendau || 2126 || atra bhagavato yadi doṣalavo'pi syāt tadā sudṛśāṃ 'śrutismṛtī tu viprāṇāṃ cakṣuṣī dve vinirmite' ityuktaśrutismṛtirūpacakṣuṣmatāṃ tadupalabdhissyādeveti tatsānathayā anupalabdhyā doṣagandhānavakāśanirdhāraṇādanupalabdhirnāmālaṃkāraḥ | kalyāṇaguṇaikanidhe iti saṃbodhanaṃ doṣātyantābhāvābhiprāyagarbham | sakalendau saṃpūrṇe candramasītyarthaḥ | kalaṅka upalabhyate | sattvādeva tadupalabdhiḥ | yadi na syāttarhi nopalabhyetaiveti vyatirekadṛṣṭāntaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre anupalabdhisarassaptadaśottaraśatatamaḥ <8> atha saṃbhavasaraḥ saṃbhavo'dhikasadbhāvānnyūnasthityavadhāraṇam | śate pañcāśannyāyenādhikasadbhāve nyūnasadbhāvāvadhāraṇaṃ saṃbhavaḥ || yathā kati kati vā tava karuṇā vyatikarato nāpnuvañ śriyaṃ nityām | tenaiva mamāpi śrījāne sā saṃbhavenna kiṃ brūyāḥ || 2127 || tenaiva karuṇāvyatirekeṇaiva | sā nityaśrīḥ || yathāvā kṛṣṇaghana varṣati tvayi bhuvanābhyudayāya divyatamamamṛtam | kathamiva na saṃbhaviṣyati cātakavṛttermamāpi tallābhaḥ || 2128 || udāharaṇadvaye'pi adhikasadbhāvānnyūnasadbhāvāvadhāraṇarūpasaṃbhavapramāṇaṃ pradarśitam | yathāvā sphuratāṃ bhavajaladhau ciramurutāntānāṃ haṭhāttava smaratām | paratārāptau satyāṃ paritāpaṃ tyaja bhavettavāpyeṣā || 2129 || atra jñānato'jñānato vā'pi vāsudevasya kīrtanāt | tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti toyasthaṃ lavaṇaṃ yathā || sakṛt smṛto'pi govindo nṛṇāṃ varṣaśataiścitam | pāparāśiṃ dahatyāśu tūlarāśimivānalaḥ || avaśenāpi yannāmni kīrtite sarvapātakaiḥ | pumānvimucyate sadyassiṃhatrastairmṛgairiva || harirharati pāpāni duṣṭacittairapi smṛtaḥ | yadṛcchayā'pi saṃspṛṣṭo dahatyeva hutāśanaḥ || ityādyuktaprakriyayā śrīhariṃ haṭhāt smaratāmapi saṃsārasāgaraparatīrāptau saṃbhavantyāṃ tavāpyeṣā bhaviteti saṃbhavapramāṇapradarśanam | paratāretyatra ‘dikchabdebhyastīrasya tārabhāvo vā vācyaḥ' iti tīraśabdasya tārādeśaḥ || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre saṃbhavasaro'ṣṭādaśottaraśatatamaḥ <9> athaitihyasaraḥ yatretihocurityādyamanirdiṣṭapravaktṛkam | pāraṃparyaṃ pravādasya tatraitihyamalaṃkṛtiḥ || anirdiṣṭapravaktṛkaṃ itihocurityādipravādapāraṃparyamaitihyam || yathā sasyadaśāyāmanamañ śākhī bhūtvā namettaruḥ kimiti | laukikagādhāṃ smaratā buddhimatā''bālyato harissevyaḥ || 2130 || atra sasyadaśāyāmityādilaukikagādhāṃ smaratā buddhimatā ‘kaumāra ācaretprājño dharmān bhāgavatāniha' ityuktarītyā ā bālyādeva harissevanīya ityarthaḥ | atra laukikagādhāmityanenānirdiṣṭapravaktṛkapravādapāraṃparyarūpatā darśitā || yathāvā tāvatkarma na me sttāttava śaure yāvatā smṛtirnaśyet | tāvatkimarthamañjanamakṣi vinaśyeddhi yāvatetyāhuḥ || 2131 || atrāpi tāvatkimarthamañjanamityākārakalaukikagādhāyāḥ pratibimbabhūtāyāḥ āhurityanenānirdiṣṭapravaktṛkapravādapāraṃparyaṃ darśitamiti draṣṭavyam || yadyapyete aṣṭau pramāṇālaṃkārāḥ dīkṣitebhyaḥ prācīnairna kṛtavivekāḥ | tathā'pyanumānālaṃkārasya sarvairapi lakṣitatvātpratyakṣādipramāṇālaṃkārā api lakṣitaprāyā eva | na hi pratyakṣādīnāmapi pramāṇatāyāmanumānato'sti viśeṣaḥ | na vā vicchittisadasadbhāvakṛtaṃ vailakṣaṇyam | ato'numānālaṃkārakathanaṃ prācāmitarapramaṇālaṃkāropalakṣaṇamityāśayena dīkṣitaiḥ kuvalayānande sarvāṇyapi tāni vivicya pradarśitānītyasmābhirapi tāni pradarśitāni || ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre aitihyasara ekonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ <10> atha saṃsṛṣṭisaraḥ alaṃkṛtīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ yathāsaṃbhavamelane | laukikīnāmivaitāsāṃ cārutā'tiśayekṣaṇāt || narasiṃhaprakriyayā bhātyalaṃkāratā pṛthak | atastannirṇayaṃ prācāṃ matenātrābhidadhmahe || nanūktānāmalaṃkārāṇāmanekeṣāmekatrāvasthāne kiṃ tattadalaṃkārataiva ? utāho narasiṃhanyāyena samavāyakṛtamalaṃkāratvam ? iti cet atra kecid nālaṃkārāntaraṃ yuktamabhyupagantuṃ, prātisvikatattadalaṃkāratātirekeṇa saṃjñāntarasya vicchittiviśeṣasya cābhāvādityāhuḥ | anye tu narasiṃhanyāyenālaṃkārāntarameva | na ca saṃjñāntaravicchittiviśeṣayorabhāvaḥ, asiddheḥ | saṃsṛṣṭisaṃkarasaṃjñayorlaukikālaṃkārāṇāṃ kanakamuktāpravālaharinīlamarakatādīnāmanyonyavilakṣaṇaśobhādhāyakānāṃ melanakṛtaśobhātiśayavadihāpi melane vicchittiviśeṣasadbhāvasya ca sahṛdayahṛdayaikasākṣikatvāt | ato narasiṃhākāreṇa melanamalaṃkārāntarameveti | tadetanmatamavalambyoktaṃ ‘bhātyalaṃkāratā pṛthak' iti || tilataṇḍulasaṃsargarītyā yatretaretaram | saṃsṛjyerannalaṃkārāssā saṃsṛṣṭiritīryate || tilataṇḍulanyāyena sphuṭāvagamyabhedālaṃkāramelane saṃsṛṣṭirityarthaḥ || śabdālaṃkārayorarthālaṃkṛtyośca parasparam | ubhayorapi saṃsṛṣṭiriti sā trividhā matā || tatrādyā yathā kalikaluṣaśabalitamatikṣitipatisevātivāhitāyuraham | adhunā tava madhunāśana vidhunāni klamabharaṃ caritamadhunā || 2132 || atra śabdālaṃkārayorvakṣyamāṇayoranuprāsayamakayoḥ pūrvottarārdhagatayoranyonyanirapekṣayossaṃsṛṣṭiḥ || dvitīyā yathā vṛṣabhūmibhṛdvataṃsendīvaramindīvarāptajaitramukham | śrīvāsanāmadheyaṃ tajjagatāṃ bhāgadheyamavyānnaḥ || atra paraṃparitarūpakopamākaitavāpahnutīnāmitaretaranirapekṣāṇāmarthālaṃkārāṇāṃ saṃsṛṣṭiḥ || tṛtīyā yathā pannaganagapāvanavanarājīrājī tamālasālaśrīḥ | pāpāturamārtaṃ māṃ pāpātu ramāttamānasassa pumān || pannaganagasya pāvanāni yāni vanāni teṣāṃ rājyāṃ śreṇyāṃ rājata iti tathoktaḥ | tamālasālasya śrīriva śrīḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ramayā śriyā āttaṃ vaśīkṛtaṃ mānasaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ sa pumān paramapuruṣaḥ pāpaiḥ āturaṃ māṃ pāpātu bhṛśaṃ pātu | yaṅluk | atra chekānuprāsavṛttyanuprāsayamakānāṃ śabdālaṃkārāṇāṃ upamāparyāyoktayorarthālaṃkārayośca saṃsṛṣṭiḥ || yathāvā śaraṇaṃ tameva ramayā bhajāmahe hemajābhayā''śliṣṭam | tvāṃ vipadi mahatyāmapi vadema vā vāmadeva śaraṇamiti || 2135 || hemajā svarṇajanyā ābhā prabhā yasyāstathoktayā hiraṇyavarṇayetyarthaḥ | ramayā āśliṣṭaṃ tameva śrīmantaṃ nārāyaṇameva śaraṇaṃ bhajāmahe prapadyāmahe | he vāmadeva virūpākṣa! tvāṃ mahatyāṃ vipadyapi śaraṇamiti vadema vā | na vademaivetyarthaḥ | śaraṇamityukterapi saṃbhāvanā na kāryā | kimuta śaraṇavaraṇakatheti bhāvaḥ ‘mahatyāpadi saṃprāpte smartavyo bhagavān hariḥ' ityuktarītyā taṃ śriyaḥpatimeva bhajāmo na tu bhavantaṃprati rakṣeti vacanamapi vā vadāmaḥ | ‘nāhamutsṛjya govindamanyamārādhayāmi bhoḥ' ityambarīṣavrataniṣṇātā vayamiti bhāvaḥ | ramayā''śliṣṭamityanena bhaga vatassarasatvaṃ vāmadevetyanena tadvyatireki vakratvaṃ ca sūcyate | atra pūrvārdhottarārdhayoḥ akṣarapañcakānulomyaprātilomyalakṣaṇaśabdālaṅkārau parisaṅkhyayā arthālaṅkāreṇa saṃsṛṣṭau || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre saṃsṛṣṭisaro viṃśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ <11> atha saṃkarasaraḥ yatrānyonyamalaṃkārāḥ kṣīranīranayādamī | saṃkīryeran saṃkaro'yamiti kāvyavido viduḥ || kṣīranīranyāyenāsphuṭabhedālaṃkāramelane saṃkara ityarthaḥ || so'yamaṅgāṅgibhāvena samapradhānyatastathā | saṃdehena tathā caikavācakānupraveśataḥ || caturthā saṃkaraḥ proktaśśrīmadappayadīkṣitaiḥ | evaṃ nṛsiṃhākṛtayaḥ pañcālaṃkṛtayo matāḥ || evaṃ saṃsṛṣṭiprabhṛtayaḥ pañcālaṃkṛtayo narasiṃhākārā ityarthaḥ || apradhānālaṃkriyayā pradhānālaṃkriyā yadi | ūjjīvyeta tadā'ṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkara iṣyate || yathā vadanasuṣamāsudhāmbudhinimagnakusumaśarakarikiśoreṇa | śuṇḍāgramivonnamitaṃ mṛgamadatilakaṃ vibhātyahinagendoḥ || 2136 || yathāvā mamaiva prapannānandastutau vadanarucihradaviharannayanamahāmīnarājaniṣṭhyūtam | nāsāvivaravilagnaṃ nūnaṃ dhyāyāmi mauktikaṃ devyāḥ || 2137 || atrodāharaṇadvaye'pi vadanasuṣamāsudhāmbudhītyādivadanarucihradetyādi ca paraṃparitarūpakamutprekṣayoraṅgaṃ, tadujjīvakatvāt rūpakābhāve cedṛśotprekṣānunmeṣāt | ato'nayoraṅgāṅgibhāvalakṣaṇassaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā avivekapaṭalamalinaṃ suvivekāñjanaśalākayā nayanam | nonmīlayati jano yo janmāndho bhavati konu tatto'nyaḥ || 2138 || avivekānāṃ ajñānānāṃ paṭalameva paṭalaṃ nayanendriyācchādakarogaviśeṣaḥ tena malinam nayanam | suvivekaḥ tattvatrayayāthātmyavivecanam | spaṣṭamanyat | atrāvivekapaṭaletyādirūpakeṇa janmāndhatānirdhāraṇasya samarthitatvātkāvyaliṅgamityanayoraṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā barhamayo yadunandana śirasi vataṃsastvayā navo vihitaḥ | vrajataruṇīhariṇīnāṃ prasabhaṃ grahaṇe vitaṃsatāmaiṣīt || 2139 || navaḥ navyaḥ ramyo vā vataṃsaḥ uttaṃsaḥ vihitaḥ nyastaḥ | vitaṃsatāṃ mṛgabandhanopakaraṇatām | pakṣe vataṃsa iti śabdaḥ navaḥ vakārarahitaḥ | naśabdapūrvako bahuvrīhiḥ | vihitaḥ viḥ vikāraḥ hitaḥ vakārasthāna eva nihitaḥ yasya sa tathoktassan vitaṃsatāṃ vitaṃsaśabdatāṃ aiṣīdityarthaḥ | atra vrajataruṇīhariṇīnāmiti rūpakaṃ vitaṃsatāmiti padārthavṛttinidarśanāyā aṅgam || yathāvā tvayyātmaśikhāntasthe vidyudivāntasthanīlajaladā'stu | antasthanīlatoyadavidyudasi tvaṃ kathaṃ nu paramātman || 2140 || he paramātman! anena ‘tasyāśśikhāyā madhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ' iti śrutaparamātmaśabdaḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | ātmaśikhā ‘tasya madhye vahniśikhā' ityuktā pratyagātmarūpā jvālā ‘vahniśikhā vahnaśśikhā ātmajvālā' ityupaniṣadbhāṣyam | tvayi nīlatoyadaśyāmaladivyavigrahe iti bhāvaḥ | antasthe sati ‘tasyāśśikhāyāḥ' ityuktarītyā antarvidyamāne antasthaḥ nīlajaladaḥ yasyāssā tathoktā vidyudivāstu ‘nīlatoyadamadhyasthā vidyullekheva bhāsvarā' iti śruteḥ "nīlatoyadaśyāmalabhagavadvigrahāśrayatvānmadhyasthanīlatoyadavidyunnibhetatyarthaḥ | madhyastheti nīlatoyadaviśeṣaṇasya pūrvanipātābhāvaśchāndasaḥ" ityupaniṣadbhāṣyakārairabhāṃṣi | abhūtopameyam | tvaṃ antasthanīlatoyadavidyut kathaṃ nu asi | ātmaśikhāmadhye nīlatoyadanibhasya bhavato'vasthānātsā antasthanīlatoyadavidyudiva prakāśatāṃ nāma tava tathā prakāśaḥ kāraṇābhāvādvismayāvaha iti bhāvaḥ | vastutastu antasthaḥ nīlatoyadaśabdaḥ yasya saḥ vidyut vidyucchabdaḥ vidyuditi varṇamadhye nolatoyadaśabdaniveśe vinīlato yadadyut iti niṣpadyate śabdaḥ tadvācya iti yāvat | vinīlajalada iva dyotata iti tathokta iti parihāraḥ | atra pūrvārdhodīritā upamā uttarārdhodīritavibhāvānāyā aṅgaṃ śleṣopaskṛtam || yathāvā bhavato'mbujākṣa bhavatā bhavanti ye tāritā na jātvāpi te | vindanti viparyāsātprakṛtivikāraṃ punastadapi tantāḥ || 2141 || he ambujākṣa! ye janāḥ bhavatā bhavataḥ saṃsārāt tāritāḥ mocitā ityarthaḥ | te janāḥ jātvapi kadā'pi viparyāsāt vaiparītyāt punarāvṛtterhetoriti yāvat | prakṛtivikāraṃ prākṛtalokaṃ na vindanti ‘eṣa devapatho brahmapatha etena pratipadyamānā imaṃ mānavamāvartaṃ nāvartante' ityādiśravaṇāt ‘māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate' iti smaraṇāt ‘anāvṛttiśśabdāt' iti sūtrācceti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe tāritā iti śabdaḥ jātvapi viparyāsāt prātilomyāt prakṛteḥ tāritā iti prakṛtyaṃśasya vikāraṃ anyadhābhāvaṃ na vindati | yathāpūrvamevāvasthānāditi bhāvaḥ | tathā'pi evaṃ prakṛtisambandhāttāritatve'pi punaḥ pūrvavaditi bhāvaḥ tāntāḥ aśanāyāpipāsādiprayuktaglāniśālina iti virodhaḥ | tāritā iti śabdo vaiparītye'pi pūrvavattāritā ityeva niṣpattestakārānta eveti parihāraḥ | atra śleṣopaskṛtaṃ kāvyaliṅgaṃ tathāvidhasya punarapi tāntā iti pūrvāvasthānuvṛttirūpapūrvarūpasyāṅgam || yathāvā tvattejovijigīṣustena parāsto'kṣamaḥ pratī kāre | viṣamaśnanmagno'bdhāvaurvo'cyuta bāḍabasya gatiriyatī || 2142 || he acyuta! aurvaḥ baḍabāmukhāgniḥ viṣamaśnan kṣvelaṃ jalaṃ ca piban | bāḍabasya brāhmaṇasya aurvāgneśca gatiḥ sthitiḥ iyatī etāvatī yatsvāvadhīrayiturvairaniryātanākṣamatayā viṣāśanenābdhau patanamiti | pakṣe yajjalaśoṣaṇena jaladhau nivāsa iti | śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭam | atra śleṣāvalīḍhayorviṣamārthāntaranyāsayoraṅgāṅgibhāvaḥ || yathāvā adhigatakṛśānubhāvo mahānubhāvaṃ mahastulayituṃ te | nūnamaparyāpto'gnirbhagavannanalaṃ tato vadantyenam || 2143 || adhigataḥ prāptaḥ kṛśaḥ anubhāvaḥ prabhāvaḥ yena kṛśānubhāvaḥ kṛśānutvaṃ ca yena sa tathoktaḥ agniḥ mahānubhāvaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ ‘anubhāvaḥ prabhāve ca' ityamaraḥ | prabhāvaḥ pratāpaḥ te dhāma tejaḥ pratāpamityarthaḥ | tulayituṃ aparyāptaḥ nūnaṃ | tataḥ enaṃ agniṃ analaṃ aparyāptaṃ asamarthamiti yāvat | analaśabdābhilaṣanīyamiti tattvam | vadanti | atra kṛśānubhāvaśabdapratipādyārthadvayaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasānāṅgakaṃ tulanā'paryāptatvasamarthanarūpakāvyaliṅgamanalamiti nirukteraṅgamiti viśeṣaḥ || kecattu evaṃrūpassaṃkaro na kevalamarthālaṃkārayoḥ kiṃtu śabdālaṃkārayorapyastītyuktvā yamakānulomapratilomayośśabdālaṃkāra yossaṃkaramāhuḥ | tadedamudāharaṇam deve nānāvede prathite nityaṃ sthitā natānavitum | devenānā'vedevaiṣā māmapi ramā kṣamājaladhiḥ || nānāvede nānāvidhaśrutau, jātyekavacanam | pratithe prasiddhe sarveśvaratvena sarvevedapratipādye ityarthaḥ | deve bhagavati śrīnivāse natān śaraṇāgatān avituṃ trātuṃ nityaṃ sthitā kṣaṇamapyetadavasthānavirahe vinatajanāparādhadarśanajanitakrodhoṣmalatayā naitadrakṣaṇābhimukhyaṃ bhagavān bhajeteti bhāvaḥ | devenānā ānayati prāṇayatītyānā pacādyac devānāṃ ināḥ prabhavaḥ indrādayo lokapālāḥ teṣāṃ ānā prāṇayitrī kṣamājaladhiḥ mādṛśāparādhamarṣaṇanipuṇeti yāvat | eṣāṃ ramā māmapi anavaratabahuvidhāparādhaparaṃparākaraṇadhurīṇamapīti bhāvaḥ | avedeva rakṣedeveti saṃbhavoktiḥ || yathāvā sā'vatu vṛṣagiribhūṣā sārasanābhā nadīnabhānā sarasā | tadbhūṣā sā'pica yā sārasanābhā nadīnabhānāsarasā || 2145 || sārasanābhā padmanābhā 'ac pratyaṃnvava' ityatra ajiti yogavibhāgādac | pṛṣodarāditvādvā akārāntatvaṃ nirvoḍhavyam | nadīnabhānā nadīnāṃ inaḥ prabhuḥ udanvān tasya bhānamiva bhānaṃ prakāśo yasyāssā jalanidhiśyāmalamūrtirityarthaḥ | sarasā sānurāgā sānandā vā bhūsahitā vā | sā vṛṣagiribhūṣā śrīnivāsa iti yāvat | avatu iti pūrvārdhārthaḥ | tadbhūṣā tasya śrīnivāsasyāpi bhūṣā ābharaṇaprāyā sā'pica śrīrapīti bhāvaḥ | ava tvityetadatrāpyanuṣajyate | sārasanābhā sārasanena kāñcīdāmnā ābhātīti tathoktā yā śrīḥ nadīnabhāḥ dīnā svalpā bhāḥ dīptiḥ yasyāssā tathoktā na bhavati | sarasā na bhavatītyasarasā ca na bhavati sarasaiva bhavatītyuttarārdhasyārthaḥ || atrādye padye prathamatṛtīyayoḥ dvitīye dvitīyaturīyayoścaraṇayośca yamakānulomapratilomayośśabdālaṃkārayoḥ parasparāpekṣatvenāṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkaraḥ | sarvasvakārastu ‘īdṛśasthale śabdālaṃkārayoranyonyamupakāryopakārakabhāvābhāvenāṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkaro na yuktaḥ | kiṃtu śabdālaṃkāradvayasaṃsṛṣṭireva | yadvā atra śabdālaṃkāradvayamekavācakānupraviṣṭam' ityabhāṇīt | kāvyadarpaṇakārastu 'dvayośśabdālaṃkārayoḥ parasparāpekṣayā vaicitryātiśayādhāyakatvātsaṃkara evedṛśasthale na tu saṃsṛṣṭiḥ, aṅgāṅgibhāvābhāve'pi mitho vaicitryātiśayahetutvasyākṣatatvāt | aṅgāṅgibhāve'pi mitho vaicitryātiśayahetutvasyaiva pārthakyena prayojakatvāt' ityavādīt || anyālaṃkāragarbhaivonnahyate kā'pyalaṃkṛtiḥ | anyayā tulyakālaṃ cetsamaprādhānyasaṃkaraḥ || yathā śirasā svaṃ lālayatāṃ prathayantaṃ nityameva sāmrājyam | phaṇibhūbhṛtaḥ kirīṭaṃ kāñcanalakṣmīṃ dadhānamīḍīya || 2146 || svaṃ ātmānaṃ śirasā lālayatāṃ dadhānānāṃ namaskurvatāṃ ca nityameva śāśvatameva sāmrājyaṃ ‘yeneṣṭaṃ rājasūyena maṇḍalasye śvaraśca yaḥ | śāsti yaścājñayā rājñassa samrāṭ' ityuktalakṣaṇaṃ samrāṭtvaṃ, anyatra ‘sa svarāḍbhavati' ityuktaṃ muktaiśvaryaṃ prathayantaṃ prakhyāpayantaṃ īdṛśakīrīṭadhāraṇavirahe samrāṭtvaprasiddherayogāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe vipulayantaṃ asaṃkucitaṃ vitanvantamityarthaḥ | kāñcanalakṣmīṃ suvarṇasya samṛddhiṃ śobhāṃ vā pakṣe kāñcana anirvacanīyavaibhavāṃ lakṣmīṃ bhagavatīṃ śriyaṃ dadhānaṃ phaṇibhūbhṛt śeṣādrireva bhūbhṛt rājā tasya kirīṭaṃ kirīṭatvenādhyavasitaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ īḍīya stuyām | 'īḍa stutau' liṅuttamaikavacanam | atra śirasā svaṃ lālayatāmityādiśleṣamūlātiśayoktyā aṅgabhūtayā unnahyamānaiva bhagavati śrīnivāse kirīṭatvādhyavasānarūparūpakātiśayoktiḥ phaṇibhūbhṛti mahārājavyavahārāropaśliṣṭarūpakagarbhaivonnahyate, uktaśleṣamūlātiśayokterubhayopakārakatvāt | ata uktarūpakātiśayoktirūpakayorekaḥ kālaḥ parasparāpekṣayā saundaryonmeṣaścobhayostulya iti vinigamanāvirahātsamaprādhānyam || yathāvā hanta sarāgālāpā tvatpāṇisparśavivaśitā muralī | atimadhuraṃ tvadadhararasamanitarasulabhaṃ kilāpibati śaure || 2147 || he śaure! muralī vaṃśanālī tvatpāṇisparśena ekatra rāgālāpārthena anyatra parirambhādyarthena vivaśitā paravaśīkṛtā ekatra tadāyattatayā anyatra stambhapralayādisāttvikabhāvodayena, sarāgaḥ sānurāgaḥ ālāpaḥ mithobhāṣaṇaṃ yasyāssā tathoktā | anyatra rāgāṇāṃ śaṃkarābharaṇādīnāṃ gāndharvavedoktānāṃ rāgāṇāṃ ālāpena saha vartata iti tathoktā | anitarasulabhaṃ atimadhuraṃ ca tvadadhararasaṃ āpibati kila hantetyetādṛśabhāgyalābhaparicintanajanite harṣe | atra sarāgālāpetyādiśleṣabhittikābhedātiśayoktyā aṅgabhūtayā paripoṣyamāṇaiva muralyāḥ bhagavadadhararasāsvādotprekṣā muralyāṃ nāyikāvyavahārasamāroparūpasamāsoktigarbhaiva paripoṣyate, sarāgādiśabdaśleṣasyobhayojjīvakatvāt | tasmādupapāditotprekṣāsamāsoktyoraikakālikatvātsamāsoktigarbhatāṃ vinā adhararasāsvādanotprekṣāyā niravalambanatvāccātrāpi samaprādhānyam || yathāvā mugdhā'tilalitalolā snigdhā śrīnāthahṛdayaparirabdhā | galadaṃśukā'navaratollāsaṃ kila yāti hārayaṣṭiriyam || 2148 || mugdhā ramyā udayadyauvanā ca atilalitaṃ yathātathā lolā cañcalā | anyatra atyantaṃ laliteṣu vilāsaviśeṣeṣu lolā āsaktā snigdhā thālathalyavatī snehavatī ca | iyaṃ hārayaṣṭiḥ strīliṅgānnāyiketi ca pratīyate | śrīnāthahṛdayena parirabdhā satī galantaḥ prasṛmarāḥ aṃśavo yasyāssā galadaṃśukā 'śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap | anyatra ataeva galat sraṃsamānaṃ aṃśukaṃ vasanaṃ yasyāssā tathoktā | anavarataṃ satataṃ ullāsaṃ prakāśaṃ, itaratra navarate abhinavasaṃbhoge ullāsaṃ kutūhalaṃ yāti kiletyutprekṣā || atra mugdhetyādiśleṣamūlābhedādhyavasāyātiśayoktyā aṅgatāmāpannayā uttabhyamānaiva galadaṃśuketyādiśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyamūlātiśayoktyavalambinī śrīnivāsorassthalaparirambhahetu kanavaratollāsaprāptirūpotprekṣā hārayaṣṭyāṃ nāyikāvyavahārasamāroparūpasamāsoktigarbhaivottabhyate | anayośca śleṣottambhitatvataulyādaikakālikatvādanyonyāpekṣacārutātiśayatvācca pūrvavatsamapradhānatā || yathāvā kalyāṇaguṇāmuktaḥ payodharāgresarātiśāyiśrīḥ | trayyāstaralo maṇiriva jīyāddevo vṛṣācalanikāyyaḥ || 2149 || kalyāṇaiḥ maṅgalarūpaiḥ guṇaiḥ sauśīlyādibhiḥ amuktaḥ nityayuktaḥ | āmukta iti vā saṃbaddha ityarthaḥ | pakṣe kalyāṇaguṇaiḥ suvarṇatantubhiḥ āmuktaḥ baddhaḥ yadvā kalyāṇaguṇaḥ ā samantāt muktāḥ mauktikāni yasyetyāmuktaḥ | viśeṣaṇobhayapadakarmadhārayaḥ | ‘kalyāṇaṃ maṅgale svarge' iti ratnamālā | payodharāgresaraḥ ghanāghanaśreṣṭhaḥ taṃ atiśete ativartata ityatiśāyinī śrīḥ divyavigrahaśobhā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | itaratra payodharāgre iti vyastam | stanayoruparisareṣu hāreṣu atiśayitaśobha ityarthaḥ | trayyāḥ śruteḥ taralaḥ hāramadhyagamaṇiriva sthitaḥ | anyatsugamam | atra kalyāṇaguṇādiśabdaśleṣātiśayoktyujjīvyamānaiva bhagavati taralamaṇitvotprekṣā trayyāṃ nāyikāvyavahārasamāroparūpasamāsoktimantarbhāvyaivojjīvyate | śleṣottambhitatvādikamubhayostulyameveti samaprādhānyam || yathāvā devarṣipitṝṇebhyo vinatānnūnaṃ mumocayiṣasi hare | uddhārabharaṃ vahase vṛddhiṃ vitarankuto'nyathā'mīṣām || 2150 || he hare! idaṃ iha vivakṣitārthopaskārakam | devarṣipitṝṇāṃ ṛṇebhyaḥ pitṝṇetyatra ‘akassavarṇe' iti savarṇadīrghaḥ | vinatān śaraṇāgatān mumocayiṣasi nūnaṃ mocayitumicchasīti sambhāvaye | anyadhā amīṣāṃ vinatānāṃ saṃbandhinīṃ etatpradeyāmiti yāvat | vṛddhiṃ uttamarṇena mūlātiriktaṃ grāhyaṃ dravyaṃ vṛddhiḥ | tāṃ | pakṣe vṛddhiṃ abhyudayaṃ muktaiśvaryarūpāṃ samṛddhiṃ vā ‘vṛddhistu vardhane yoge'pyaṣṭavargauṣadhāntare | kālāntare cābhyudaye samṛddhāvapi yoṣiti' iti medinī | vitaran niyamena pratipādayan | bhagavatpakṣe 'lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' iti śatā, heturiha phalaṃ | vitarītumityarthaḥ | uddhārasya ṛṇasya bharaṃ atiśayaṃ ‘syādṛṇaṃ paryudañcanam | uddhāraḥ' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe ‘teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarāt' ityuktarītyā saṃsṛtisindhoruddhṛtibhāraṃ vahase | atra vṛddhidānapūrvakoddhārabhāravahanānyathānupapattyā bhagavataḥ ṛṇavimocanecchā kalpyate | devarṣibhūtātmanṛṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ na kiṃkaro nāyamṛṇī ca rājan | sarvātmanā yaśśaraṇaṃ śaraṇyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ lokaguruṃ prapannaḥ || iti ślokārtho'trānusaṃhitaḥ | atra vṛddhyuddhāraśabdaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyamūlātiśayoktyā unnahyamānaiva uktārthāpattiḥ bhagavati pratibhūvyavahārāropalakṣaṇasamāsoktisahakṛtaivonnahyate | uktaśleṣopakṛtatvaparasparāpekṣacārutonmīlanaikakālikatvānyanayostulyānīti samaprādhānyam || aikakālikatābhāve'pyalaṃkāradvayaṃ yadi| ekenonnahyate so'pi samaprādhānyasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā tvatkīrtisumasamudayaṃ grathnātīva trayī tvadīyaguṇaiḥ | gṛhṇantastaṃ sudhiyaḥ prasādhayante diśāṃ dhruvaṃ kabarīḥ || 2151 || atrotprekṣayoḥ kālabhede'pi samaprādhānyaṃ, itaretaranirapekṣavākyadvitayapratipāditatvāt | taṃ gṛhṇanta iti kīrtikusumasamudayarūparūpakamātropajīvanena pūrvotprekṣānapekṣaṇāt | nacaivaṃ 'limpatīva tamo'ṅgāni varṣatīvāñjanaṃ nabhaḥ' itivadutprekṣādvitayasya saṃsṛṣṭireveyamiti vācyaṃ, laukikasiddhagrathanaprasādhanapaurvāparyacchāyānukāreṇotprekṣādvayapaurvāparyeṇa saundaryotkarṣasamunmīlanatassaṃsṛṣṭivaiṣamyāt | tasmāddarśādivadekaphalasādhanatayā samapradhānamidamutprekṣādvayam | ayaṃ ca saṃkaro dīkṣitopajñameva | "prāñcastu asmin samaprādhānyasaṃkare prāthamiko'ṅgāṅgibhāvena, dvitīyassaṃsṛṣṭyā ca gatārtha ityāśayena imaṃ bhedaṃ na menire" iti rasikarañjanīkāraḥ | tadvistarastatraiva draṣṭavyaḥ || sādhakaṃ bādhakaṃ vā'pi yatrānyatarasaṃgrahe | pramāṇaṃ naiva dṛśyeta syātsa sandehasaṃkaraḥ || yatra viruddhayoralaṃkārayorekatra sphūrtau tayoranyatarasya parigrahe sādhakaṃ bādhakaṃ vā pramāṇaṃ na dṛśyeta tatrāniścayātsaṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || yathā tvadvaradānāvicyutamāṅgalyāṃ sarvamaṅgalāṃ śaure | kātyāyanīṃ vadantaḥ kośakṛto hanta kośakṛta eva || tvadvaradānena avicyutaṃ māṅgalyaṃ yasyāstāṃ tathoktāṃ nityasaumaṅgalyaśālinīmityarthaḥ | bāṇāsurāhave bhagavatā mahādeve parābhūte bhītayā bhavānyā'bhyarthitena tenaiva bhagavatā nityasaumaṅgalyalakṣaṇavaro'syai vyatārīti padmapurāṇakathā'trānusaṃhitā | ataeva sarvamaṅgalāṃ sarvaprakāramāṅgalyaśālinītvena tannāmābhilapanīyāṃ devīṃ bhavānīṃ kātyāyanīṃ 'kātyāyanītyumā | yā cārdhavṛddhā kāṣāyavasanā gatabhartṛkā | kātyāyanyardhavṛddhā yā kāṣāyavasanā'dhavā' ityabhihitābhidhānāṃ vadantaḥ kośakṛtaḥ ratnamālānāmaliṅgānuśāsanādigranthakṛtaḥ kośakṛta eva | hantetīdṛśajugupsitanāmakathanacintanaprayukte khede | atra kośakṛtāṃ kośakṛttvavidhānamanupayuktibādhitaṃ sattadavivecakatāṃ garbhīkarotīti vidhyalaṃkāro vā | kośakṛtaḥ kośakṛta eva kośakārakrimaya eva na tu vivekaśālino grandhakṛta ityāropapūrvaka ādyo'pahnavo vetyubhayoranyataranirdhāraṇe sādhakasya vā bādhakasya vā pramāṇasyādarśanādanayossaṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā mukharucijalanidhiviharannayanajhaṣadvaṃdvajātapotadhiyam | unmīlayaduragācalavilāsimṛganābhitilakamavyānnaḥ || 2153 || atra dhiyamiti materbhrāntirūpatvavivakṣāyāṃ bhrāntimadalaṃkāre viśrāntiḥ, saṃbhāvanātvavivakṣāyāṃ utprekṣāyāmityanadhyavasāyādanayossaṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā mādhavavidūrasatvā ghanāgamollāsitāssujāti bhavāḥ | api sumanasaścyavante vṛthaiva katicana mahāphalāgrahaṇāt || 2154 || mādhavasya vidūrasattvāḥ dūrasthitayaḥ ghanānāṃ mahatāṃ janānāṃ āgamena prāptyā ghanaiḥ āgamaiḥ śāstrairvā ullāsitāḥ sujātibhavāḥ satkulaprasūtāḥ sumanaso manīṣiṇo'pi katicana mahāphalasya niśśreyasarūpasya uttamaphalasya agrahaṇāt vṛdhaiva cyavante bhraśyanti | anyatra mādhavasya vasantasya vidūre sattvaṃ sthitiḥ yāsāṃ tāḥ ghanāgamena prāvṛṣā ullāsitāḥ vikāsitāḥ śobhanāśca tāḥ jātayaḥ mālatīlatāḥ tāsu bhavāḥ katicana sumanaso'pi puṣpatāṃ prāptā api mahataḥ phalasya agrahaṇāt vṛthaiva cyavante | jātīkusumānāṃ vasantasamaye anunmeṣāt prāvṛṣi vikāsāt phalavattvavirahāt vṛthaiva cyavanaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | atrāprastutajātīkusumapraśaṃsā prastuteṣu uktavidheṣu vidvatsu paryavasyatītyaprastutapraśaṃsā vā, prastutavidvadvṛttāntenāprastutamālatīkusumavyavahārasphūrtiriti samāsoktirvā, prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣo vetyanadhyavasāyādeṣāṃ saṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā tvaccaraṇasamaṃ kisalayamāsevyādhaśśirāścirādbastaḥ | kāntasstabakassyādyadi kamale tvaccaraṇapūjanārhassyāt || 2155 || he kamale! bastaḥ chāgaḥ cirāt bahukālaṃ adhaśśirāḥ bhaktyā namraśīrṣassan bastasya nisargatastathātvāditi hārdam | āsevya saṃpūjya bhakṣayitveti tu tattvam | kāntaḥ sundaraḥ stabakaḥ kusumagucchaścet tvaccaraṇakisalayāsvādanaphalabhūtastabakajanmatāṃ yāyāccedityabhiprāyaḥ | tadā tvaccaraṇapūjānārhassyāt | stabakajanmanā vinā tadarhatā na syāditi bhāvaḥ | bastaḥ bastaśabdaḥ adhaśśirāḥ viparītassan staba iti niṣpannaḥ tataḥ yadākadācit kāntaścet kavarṇāntassyādyadi stabakaśabdo bhaviteti vastusthitiḥ | atra bastaḥ stabakassyāccettvaccaraṇārcanārhassyāditi saṃbhāvanā vā | idaṃ na kadā'pi sidhyatīti mithyādhyavasitirveti kavisaṃrambhasya nirṇetumaśakyatvādanayossaṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā arpayasi sma yadā tvaṃ kārpaṇyaṃ mādhava prapitsorme | manye sarvādhikyāttadaiva kāruṇyamantare vyatanoḥ || 2156 || he mādhava! prapitsoḥ tvatprapadanamicchataḥ me kārpaṇyaṃ aṅgasāmaggrasaṃpatteraśakteścāpi karmaṇām | adhikārasya cāsiddherdeśakālaguṇakṣayāt || upāyā naiva siddhyanti hyapāyā bahulāstathā | iti yā garvahānistu dainyaṃ kārpaṇyamucyate || iti lakṣitaṃ prapadanāṅgaṃ yadā arpayasi sma kārpaṇyopalakṣitamaṅgajātamadadāḥ tadaiva antare manasi sarvādhikyāt sarvātiśāyitayā kāruṇyaṃ mayi kṛpāṃ vyatanoriti manye | anyadhā mamedṛśīmaṅgasampattiṃ nārpayereveti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe yadā kārpaṇyamiti padaṃ arpayasi rpavarṇarahitaṃ karoṣi sma tadā saḥ rvādhikyamiti chedaḥ | saḥ tvamiti yojanā evaṃvidhastvaṃ antare madhye rvādhikyāt ruvarṇādhikyāt kāruṇyaṃ vyatanoriti manye | kārpaṇyaśabdasya rpavarṇotsāraṇena madhye tatraiva ruvarṇanyāsena ca kāruṇyamiti niṣpādanā diti bhāvaḥ | atra kārpaṇyānyadhānupapattyā bhagavataḥ kāruṇyavidhānaṃ kalpitamityārthāpattirvā | ayaṃ bhagavānmayi sarvādhikyena kṛpāvān mama prapadanāṅgajātārpayitṛtvādityanumānaṃ veti saṃdehaḥ || yathāvā sudṛgiti garvāt yo'paramāha tvatto'pi kāraṇaṃ jagatām | āhustameva sudṛśaśśaure'parakāraṇaṃ kimāścaryam || 2357 || he śaure! yaḥ pumān sudṛk sudhīriti cakṣuṣmāniti ca garvāt tvatto'pi aparaṃ anyaṃ jagatāṃ kāraṇaṃ āha bravīti sudṛśaḥ vipaścitaḥ cakṣuṣmantaśca tameva tvatto'nyajjagatkāraṇamastīti vadantaṃ pumāṃsameva aparakāraṇaṃ aparaṃ tvadanyatkāraṇaṃ yasya taṃ tathoktaṃ aparaṃ avaraṃ aśreṣṭhaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasya tathoktamiti vā āhuḥ | kimāścaryamiti lokoktiḥ | yastvatto'pyaparaṃ kāraṇamastīti bravīti tasyāparakāraṇatvamanāścaryāvahaṃ kintu yuktameveti bhāvaḥ | ataeva samālaṃkāraḥ | yadvā taṃ aparakāraṇavādinameva aparaṃ ca tat kāraṇaṃ ceti karmadhārayaḥ taṃ aparakāraṇaṃ āhuḥ | kimetadāścaryaṃ atyāścaryamiti bhāvaḥ | ataeva virodhābhāsaḥ | taṃ pumāṃsameva aparakāraṇaṃ apagato raḥ rephaḥ yasmāttaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāṇaṃ āhuriti vastusthitiḥ | ‘eko ha vai nārāyaṇa āsīt, sarvabhūtasthamekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ, kāraṇarūpamakāraparaṃ brahmom' ityādiśrutiśatakaṇṭharavapratipāditabhagavatkāraṇatvaviruddhārthābhidhāyī kāṇa eva na tu cakṣuṣmāniti sudṛśo vadanti | ‘śrutismṛtī tu viprāṇāṃ cakṣuṣī dve vinirmite | ekena hīnaḥ kāṇassyāt' ityādyukteriti bhāvaḥ | atra samavirodhābhāsayorekatraiva kavisaṃraṃbhāviśrāntestayossadehasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā dātraṃ manye totraṃ vetraṃ vā'ricchidā tvayā vidhṛtam | kuruvīrarathakuṭumbin dātovetastu bheda eteṣām || 2158 || he kuruvīrarathakuṭumbin arjunasārathe bhagavan! tvayā vidhṛtaṃ tadrathyāśvacodanāya pāṇau kṛtaṃ totraṃ todanaṃ ‘prājanaṃ todanaṃ totram' ityamaraḥ | vetraṃ vā dātraṃ ripuvaṃśalavanasādhanaṃ lavitraṃ ‘dātraṃ lavitram' ityamaraḥ | manye saṃbhāvaye | eteṣāṃ dātratotralavitrāṇāṃ bhedaḥ dātaḥ chinna iti ‘do avakhaṇḍane' karmaṇi ktaḥ | ‘ādecaḥ' ityātvam | ‘kṛttaṃ dātaṃ ditaṃ chitaṃ vṛkṇam' ityamaraḥ | avetaḥ avagataḥ avapūrvakādiṇaḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ | eteṣāṃ ripukulabhedanarūpadharmavattāyāssāmyāt bhedabhāvojñāta evetyarthaḥ | tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe | ‘tuḥ syādbhede'vadhāraṇe' ityamaraḥ | yadvā dātraṃ manye lavitrameveti nirdhārayāmītyarthaḥ | anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavadeva | tattvaṃ tu eteṣāṃ dātrādīnāṃ dātovetaḥ krameṇa dāvarṇa tovarṇa vevarṇaireva bheda ityarthaḥ | sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | athavā totraṃ vetraṃ vā dātraṃ dātratulyaṃ manye jāne | eteṣāṃ bhedastu dātovetaḥ uktavarṇaireva na tu sarvātmanā | śabdārthatādātmyaṃ na vismartavyam | atra totravetrayordātratādātmyasaṃbhāvanābhisaṃdhau utprekṣā, dātratvanirdhāraṇasyottaravākyārthasamarthitatvābhisaṃdhau kāvyaliṅgam, dātratotravetrāṇāṃ tulyānāṃ svavācakaśabdagatayatkiṃcidvarṇamātrabheda ityabhiprāye vyatirekaḥ, bhagavatkare dhṛtaṃ vastu dātrameva na tu totraṃ vetraṃ vetyabhisaṃdhau tvapahnutirityeteṣāmekatraiva kavisaṃrambhasya niyantrayitumaśakyatvātsaṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā tava bhaktairatiśucibhirnāmnā śuciravamato'nalo nūnam | ahaha viṣāśanamupayan jīvanabhaṅgāddhiśāntatāṃ yātaḥ || 2159 || atiśucibhiḥ yo'rthe śucirhi sa śucirna mṛdvāriśuciśśuciḥ | kṣetrajñasyeśvarajñānādviśuddhiḥ paramā matā || ityuktaprakāreṇa sarvaprakāraśuddhiśālibhiḥ tvadbhaktaiḥ bahubhiriti bhāvaḥ | nāmnā śuciḥ nāmamātreṇaiva śuciriti vyavahāryaḥ na tu tadvacchucitamaḥ eka iti bhāvaḥ | analaḥ avamato nūnam | ahaheti khede adbhute vā | viṣāśanaṃ viṣopalakṣitamannaṃ upayan aśnanniti yāvat | jīvanabhaṅgāt jīvitabhraṃśāt śāntatāṃ viniṣṭatāṃ yātaḥ | hītyavadhāraṇe hetau vā || vastusthitistu ahetyavyayaṃ ahahetyetadanatiriktārthakam | haviṣā ājyādinā aśanaṃ abhede tṛtīyā, hāvirabhinnamaśanaṃ upayan jīvanabhaṅgāt jalataraṅgāt śāntatāṃ nirvāṇatāṃ yāta iti | atrānalakartṛkaviṣāśanāderupapāditaśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyanirvyūḍhasya bhagavadbhaktāvamatatvaṃ na heturityahetostasya hetutvena saṃbhāvanāyāṃ cedabhisaṃdhiḥ tadā utprekṣāyāṃ paryavasānaṃ, uktaviṣāśanādyanyathānupapattyā tasyāvamatatvakalpanecet arthāpattau, viṣāśanādihetunā avamatatvasādhane cettātparyaṃ tadā anumānālaṃkāre iti kavisaṃrambhasya nānāmukhaprasṛtatayā amīṣāṃ saṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā sumahāneko'hāryaḥ kṣobhaṃ gamito'pi naiti vikṛtilavam | gāmbhīryaṃ śrīdhāmnaḥ sthirāśayasyāsya ko gaditumīṣṭām || 2160 || sumahān giripakṣe ativiśālaḥ bhagavatpakṣe atipūjyaḥ mahyate pūjyate iti mahān iti vyutpatteḥ | ekaḥ ahāryaḥ giriḥ | pakṣe itarairasaṃhāryaḥ | brahmāṇamindraṃ rudraṃ ca yamaṃ varuṇameva ca | prasahya harate yasmāttasmāddhariritīryate || iti bhagavata eva sarvasaṃhartṛtvokteḥ | kṣobhaṃ gamito'pi puṣpaphalaśilādārvādivastulipsubhirjanaiḥ svasvābhīṣṭaprepsubhirarthibhiśca kṣobhito'pi vikṛtilavaṃ vikāraleśamapi naiti | sthirāyāḥ bhuvaḥ āśayasya ādhārasya jalāśaya itivat bhūdharasyeti yāvat yadvā sthirāḥ āśayāḥ panasāḥ yasmin tasya 'āśayaḥ syādabhiprāye panasādhārayorapi' iti medinī | pakṣe sthirahṛdayasyetyarthaḥ | śaraṇāgatasaṃgrahe doṣapradarśakairantaraṅgairapyakampanīyahṛdayasyeti bhāvaḥ | tathācāha mitrabhāvena saṃprāptaṃ na tyajeyaṃ kathaṃcana' iti | śrīdhāmnaḥ saraladrumāṇāṃ bilvānāṃ vā āśrayasya 'śrīrveṣaracanāśobhāsaṃpatsaralaśākhiṣu | vāṇīlakṣmīlavaṅgeṣu viṣe bitve'pi' iti ratnamālā | ‘śrīrveṣaracanāśobhābhāratīsaraladrume | lakṣmyāṃ trivargasaṃpattividyopakaraṇeṣu ca' iti medinī ca | pakṣe śrīnivāsasyetyarthaḥ | asya girerbhagavataśca gāmbhīryaṃ duṣpraveśatvaṃ akṣobhyatvaṃ vā | bhagavatpakṣe bhaktānugrahavadānyatvāderāmūlato duravagāhatvaṃ āśritāparādheṣu pratigrahītṛnikarṣādiṣu ca sato'pi svajñānasya gopanena durgrahatvaṃ vā | tadabhiprāyeṇa hi sarvajñasyāpyavijñātṛtvoktiḥ | gadituṃ varṇayituṃ ka iṣṭāṃ śaknuyāt || atrāprastutasya kasyacinmahāgireḥ praśaṃsā praśaṃsanīyatvena prastute tatsarūpe bhagavati śrīnivāse paryavasyatītyabhisandhau aprastutapraśaṃsā, prastutavṛṣādrivṛttānte varṇyamāne viśeṣaṇasāmyādaprastutamahārājavṛttāṃtasya vā tathāvidhadugdhapayonidhervā vṛttāntasya pratītessamāsoktirvā | asmin prakāre vṛṣagiripakṣe sumahān śobhinairmahairutsavaiḥ anitītyan aniteḥ kvip | maharājapakṣe śobhanaṃ mahat rājyaṃ yasya tathābhūtaḥ 'vartamāne pṛṣat' ityādinā śatṛvadbhāvātideśādugittvānnum | ‘mahatī vallakībhede rājye syāttu napuṃsakam' iti medinī | ‘mahadrājyaṃ ca' ityamaraśca | payodhipakṣe atimahān ativipulaḥ kṣobhaṃ gamito'pi vṛṣagiripakṣe bhagavaddarśanalipsubhirjanairārohaṇacaraṇaghaṭṭanādibhissammardito'pītyarthaḥ | mahārājapakṣe vairijanādhikṣepādibhiḥ kadarthito'pītyarthaḥ | payodhipakṣe amṛtādyarthibhissurairmathanena viloḍito'pītyarthaḥ | vikṛtilavamapi naiti | sthirāśayasya ādye sthirāṇāṃ sālaparṇīvṛkṣāṇāṃ āśayasya ādhārasya 'sthirā bhūsālaparṇyornāśanau mokṣabalādriṣu' iti medinī | dvitīye sthirā bhūḥ śaye kare yasya tasya svāyattadharaṇīkasyetyarthaḥ | tṛtīye sthirāyāḥ bhūmeḥ ā samantāt śeta iti śayaḥ tasya pacādyac | mekhalāvadbhuvaṃ veṣṭitavata ityarthaḥ | śrīdhāmnaḥ ādyapakṣe śrīpadatvācchriyo vāsācchabdaśaktyā ca yogataḥ | rūḍhyā śrīśaila ityevaṃ nāma cāsya girerabhūt || iti vārohoktarītyā lakṣmīnivāsasthānabhūtasyetyarthaḥ |dvitīye trivargasaṃpattyāśrayasyetyarthaḥ | tṛtīye śrījanmaniketanasyetya rthaḥ | gāmbhīryaṃ duṣpraveśyatvaṃ durādharṣatvaṃ nimnatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ | anyatpūrvavat | yadvā prastutaśailavṛttānte varṇyamāne prastutaśrīnivāsavṛttāntasyaiva dyotanāt prastutāṅkuraḥ | athavā vācyasyaiva bhagavadrūpārthasya bhaṅgyantareṇa varṇanātparyāyoktam | āhosvit ekohārya ityatra ekaḥ hā aryaḥ ārya iti vā chedena viśeṣyasyāpi śliṣṭatayā aryasya āryasya vā aprakṛtasya ahāryasya śeṣādreḥ prakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | upapāditeṣveteṣvekatraiva kavisaṃrambhasyāvasthāpayitumaśakyatayā eteṣāṃ saṃdehasaṃkaraḥ | aryaḥ svāmī eko'dhipatirityarthaḥ 'aryassvāmivaiśyayoḥ' iti nipātanāt ‘ṛ gatau' ityasmāddhātoryat | āryaḥ prāpyaḥ ācārya ityarthaḥ uktādeva dhātoḥ 'ṛhalorṇyat' iti ṇyat | idaṃ ‘aryassvāmi' ityuktasūtrasya pratyudāharaṇam | hetyavyayaṃ gāṃbhīryacintanaprayuktavismaye | 'vismaye ca jugupsāyāṃ ha, iti śeṣaḥ | aryapakṣe svāmipakṣe ukta evārtho'nusaṃdheyaḥ | āryapakṣe tu kṣobhaṃ gamito'pi 'imā rāmāssarathāssatūryāḥ' ityuktadiśā kṣodiṣṭhaphalaprardaśanādibhiritaraiḥ pralobhite'pi vikṛtilavamapi tadāsaṅgakṛtacittavikāraleśamapi naiti | ‘tavaiva vāhāstava nṛttagīte' ityādivattatsarvaṃ pratyākhyāya 'varastu me varaṇīyassaeva' ityuktarītyā askhalitacittavṛttireva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | śrīdhāmnaḥ vidyānidheḥ sthirāśayasya sthire mokṣe āśayaḥ abhiprāyaḥ yasya tasya śrīsthiraśabdayoḥ kośastu prāgukta eva | asya ahāryasya aryasya āryasya ca gāmbhīryaṃ gadituṃ ka iṣṭāmityarthaḥ || yathāvā marakatamaṇireko'yaṃ sphuratitarāṃ sakalalokavibhavakṛte | bhāgyagarīyāṃso'muṃ bhogyatamaṃ prāpnuvanti naivānye || 2161 || atra bhagavāneva marakatamaṇitayā'dhyavasīyata iti rūpakātiśayoktiḥ, āhosvit ayamiti viṣayaṃ bhagavantaṃ nirdiśya tasminmarakatamaṇitvāropādrūpakaṃ, athavā bhagavato marakatamaṇitvena saṃbhāvanādvastūtprekṣā gamyā, uta aprastutamarakatavṛttāntena prastutaśrīnivāsavṛttāntapratīteraprastutapraśaṃsā, kiṃvā marakatamaṇitvenādhyavasitasya śrīnivāsasya sakalalokavibhavakṛte sphuratīti lokasiddhagārutmatāpekṣayā viśeṣasya gamyamānatvādvyatirekaḥ, āho śrīnivāsasyaiva bhaṅgyantareṇa varṇanātparyāyoktamiti bhūyasāmalaṃkārāṇāṃ saṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā tvadapāṅgapratyūṣe vidalitaduritaughasaṃtamasadoṣe | uragagirinātha visarati parito vikasati madantaraṅgābjam || 2162 || atra tvadapāṅga pratyūṣa iva, aghayūdhaṃ saṃtamasamiva antaraṅgaṃ abjamivetyupamāyā vā, tvadapāṅgaṃ eva pratyūṣaḥ | aghayūdhameva saṃtamasaṃ antaraṅgamevābjamiti rūpakasya vā sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvenāniścayātsaṃdehena saṃkaraḥ | sādhakabādhakapramāṇe nyāyadoṣarūpe | yatra nyāyadoṣalakṣaṇasādhakabādhakapramāṇayoranyatarasyāvatāraḥ tatraikatarasya niścayānna saṃdehaḥ | nyāyaśca kvacidupamāyāssādhakaḥ | rūpakasya tu na sādhako nāpyatyantapratikūlaḥ | kvacittu rūpakasya sādhakaḥ | upamāyāstu na sādhako nāpyantyantapratikūla eva, doṣo'pi kvacidupamāyā bādhakaḥ rūpakasya tu taṭasthaḥ | kvacittu rūpakasya bādhakaḥ upamāyāstaṭasthaḥ | evamalaṃkārāntarayorapi nyāyadoṣāvūhanīyau || tatropamāyāssādhako rūpakaṃprati taṭastho nyāyo yathā śriyamasmākaṃ tanu tāmityāśrayatāṃ ya adadhīta nu tām | gamayanvipadaṃ tanutāṃ padakamalamamuṣya saṃpadaṃ tanutām || 2163 || asmākaṃ tāṃ śriyaṃ muktisaṃpadaṃ tanu kuru iti āśrayatāṃ janānāṃ yaḥ śrīnivāsaḥ vipadaṃ bhavamayīṃ āpadaṃ tanutāṃ kṛśatāṃ gamayan san tāṃ tatprārthitāṃ śriyaṃ ādadhīta nu kurvīta ca | nu ityetadavyayaṃ pūrvoktavipattanūkaraṇasamuccaye | ‘pratyuktāvupamāne ca viṣādotprekṣayorapi | nu pādapūraṇe jñeyo jijñāsāyāṃ samuccaye' iti śeṣaḥ | amuṣya bhagavataḥ padakamalaṃ saṃpadaṃ sarvaprakārāṃ śriyaṃ tanutāṃ kurutām | atra saṃpadaṃ tanutāmiti mukhyatayā pratipādyamānasarvaprakāraśrīpradānarūpārthaḥ bhagavatpada evānukūlyamaśnuta iti padaṃ kamalamivetyupamāyāssādhakaḥ | padameva kamalamiti rūpakasya tu nāñjasyena,kamale vivakṣitasaṃpatpradānasya mukhyatayā'savagateḥ | nanu tarhi rūpakabādhikaiva kiṃ na syādupameti śaṅkyaṃ, kamale'pi saurabhādirūpamukhyasaṃpatpradānasaṃbhavāt | ato na rūpakabādhakatvaṃ, kiṃtu taṭasthataiva || rūpakasādhaka upamāṃprati taṭastho yathā sādhugatipratirodhakamādhunvānā'khilaṃ tamaḥprasaram | mādhavamukhāmṛtāṃśorādhattāṃ nayanasaṃmadaṃ jyotsnā || 2164 || sādhu yathāsyāttathā gateḥ saṃcaraṇasya anyatra sanmārgagamanasya arcirādigatervā pratirodhakam | anyatsugamam | atra mukha mevāmṛtāṃśuriti rūpake jyotsnāpadaṃ sādhakapramāṇaṃ mukhyatayā'vagamyamāno jyotsnāpadārthaḥ amṛtāṃśorevānukūlyamaśnuta iti mukhāmṛtāṃśoriti rūpakasādhakaḥ | mukhaṃ amṛtāṃśurivetyupamāyāstu nāñjasyena sādhakaḥ, mukhe mukhyatayā jotsnāpadārthasya candrikārūpasyānavagamāt | na ca tarhi rūpakamupamābādhakameva kiṃ na syāditi vācyaṃ, yathā amṛtāṃśāvanukūlaḥ na tathā mukhe | kiṃtūpacāreṇānukūlyasya kathaṃcitsaṃbhavānnopamāpratikūlatā | kiṃtu tāṭasthyameveti dhyeyam || upamābādhakādrūpakaparigraho yathā śaraduditaśiśirakiraṇasphuraṇajuṣā viśadayan vṛṣādrimaṇiḥ | kamalākṣo nassvāntaṃ kaṭākṣasudhayā vilimpati niśāntam || 2165 || naḥ asmākaṃ svāntaṃ niśāntaṃ bhavanamiti vyastarūpakam | viśadayanniti hetvarthe śatā | heturiha phalam | śaraduditetyādi kaṭākṣasudhayetyasya viśeṣaṇam | atra kaṭākṣassudhevetyupamāyāṃ uktavyastarūpakameva na bādhākaṃ, kiṃtu śaraduditetyādisāmānyadharmaprayogo'pi bādhaka eva | na tu taṭasthaḥ ‘upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ' ityādinā tadaprayoga eva samāsavidhānāditi prāñcaḥ | vayaṃ tu kvacitsāmānyadharmaprayogo'pi nopamābādhaka iti brūmaḥ || yathā svavaśānucaraṃ ruciraṃ sapadmakaṃ devakuñjaraṃ sukaram | nāgāgamasavihāraṃ yogādvindeya dhīragambhīram || svā svakīyā yā vaśā kariṇī ‘vaśā vandhyā'sutā yoṣā strīgavīkariṇīṣu ca | triṣvāyatte klibamāyāttatve cecchāprabhutva yoḥ' iti medinī | tasyāḥ anucaraṃ sahāyam | pakṣe svavaśenaiva svecchayaiva anucaraḥ | ‘yatra kāmagamo vaśī' ityuktarītyā sakala lokacārī svatantra ityarthaḥ | taṃ tathoktaṃ, padmakena bindujālakena saha vartata iti sapadmakaḥ tam | pakṣe padmayā śriyā saha vartamānaṃ, śaiṣike kapi 'āpo'nyatarasyām' iti vaikalpiko hṛsvaḥ | sukaraṃ śobhanaśuṇḍādaṇḍaṃ ramaṇīyapāṇiṃ ca | nāganāṃ gajānāṃ āgamena prāptyā savihāraṃ nāgāgāme phaṇiśaile savihāraṃ ca | dhīragambhīraṃ devakuñjaraṃ devaḥ kuñjara iveti vigrahaḥ devaśreṣṭhaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ yogāt yukteḥ sannāhādupāyādvā pakṣe dhyānāt vindeya 'yogassannahanopāyadhyānasaṃgatiyuktiṣu' ityamaraḥ || yathāvā ativṛddhimadāmodapradānato vivaśayansadālivarān | daivatanāgaḥ phāṇagirivanacārī sakalabhānvito jayatu || 2167 || atibṛddhimataḥ āmodasya ānandasya pakṣe atiśayitā vṛddhiryasya sa tathā yo madāmodaḥ tasya dānaparimalasya pradānataḥ sadālivarān satāṃ brahmavidāṃ āleḥ paṅkteḥ ye varāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ tān | pakṣe sadā alivarān bhramaraśreṣṭhān vivaśayan, sakalā saṃpūrṇā bhā dīptiḥ ‘tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti' ityādyuktā tayā anvitaḥ | pakṣe saḥ kalabhaiḥ triṃśadvarṣagajaviśeṣaiḥ anvitaḥ daivatanāgaḥ devaśreṣṭhaḥ bhagavān jayatu |‘syuruttarapade vyāghrapuṅgavarṣabhakuñjarāḥ | siṃhaśārdūlanāgādyāḥ puṃsi śreṣṭhārthagocarāḥ' ityamaraḥ | atra padyadvaye'pi devakuñjaraṃ daivatanāga ityatra upamitasamāsāśrayeṇa sāmānyadharmaprayogo nopamābādhakaḥ | 'bṛndārakakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam' iti sāmānyadharma prayoge'pi samāsavidhānāt vyāghrāderākṛtigaṇatvādeva siddhe sāmānyaprayogārthatvādasya vacanasya | tasmādiha upamārūpakayossaṃdeha eva yuktaḥ || rūpakabādhakādupamāparigraho yathā namadamaramakuṭapaṭalīghaṭitamaṇīkiraṇapuñjapiñjaritam | bhavyaṃ tanoti jagatāṃ divyaṃ phaṇiśelanāthapadapadmam || 2168 || atra namadamaretyādi viśeṣaṇaṃ padme kathaṃcidapyasaṃbhavīti padameva padmamiti rūpakasya bādhakaṃ na tu taṭastham || evaṃ vṛṣabhūbhṛti vibudhānāmāvāse pārijāta iva lasati | jagadāmodavidhātrī jayati śrīmañjarī muraṃ dviṣati || 2169 || vibudhānāṃ viduṣāṃ devānāṃ vā āvāse nivāsabhūte vṛṣabhūbhṛti śeṣādrau | pakṣe vṛṣā indraḥ bhūbhṛt rājā yasya tasmiṃstathokte | vibudhānāmāvāse tridaśālaye pārijāta iva lasati prakāśamāne muraṃ dviṣati śrīnivāse ‘dviṣaśśaturvā' iti dvitīyā | jagatāṃ āmodasya ānandasya parimalasya ca vidhātrī | śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāssamāsaḥ | śrīḥ lakṣīreva mañjarī vallarī jayati | atra śrīmañjarītyatra rūpakamevābhyupetyaṃ, jagadāmodavidhātrīti sāmānyadharmopādānāttasya copamābādhakatvāt | na ca pārijāta ivetyupamopakramānānurūpyamiti vācyam, satyapi bādhake upakrama evānuroddhavya itīdaṃ na vedānuśāsanam, nāpi dharmānuśāsanaṃ na vā rājaśāsanam | yatra tu na bādhakaṃ, yathā atreva padye tṛtīyacaraṇe jagadamodavidhātari' iti kṛte prakāmaṃ bhavatu tatropakramānurodhādupamitasamāsa eva || evaṃ vṛṣabhūbhṛti vibudhānāmāvāse śrīnivāsakalpatarau ! jagadāmodavidhātari jayati śrīmañjarī mahodāre || 2170 || iti pūrvodāhṛtapadyasyaiva prakārāntareṇa praṇayane śrīmañjarītyatra sāmānyadharmāprayoge'pi nopamāsamāso yuktaḥ | kiṃtu śrīnivāsapārijāta ityatra jagadāmodetyādisāmānyadharmaprayogabalādrūpakasamāse sthite tadanurodhasyaivocitatvāt | anyathā prathamamabhedapradhānatayā prakṛṣṭaṃ rūpakamavalambya paścādbhedābhedapradhānatayā tato'pakṛṣṭāyā upamāyā avalambane patatprakarṣadoṣo'pi syāt || yathāvā maṇivaraparirabdhāyā vakṣassthalyāḥ phaṇīndraśikharimaṇeḥ | mauktikamālā vilasati lalitā svedodabindumāleva || 2171 || atra svedodabindumālevetyutprekṣā na tūpamā, tathā sati maṇivaraparirabdhāyā iti vakṣassthalīviśeṣaṇasya nairarthikyāpātāt | mauktikamālāyāssvedabindumālopamāyā uktaviśeṣaṇanairapekṣyeṇaiva siddheḥ | ato maṇivaretyādi vakṣassthalīviśeṣaṇamupamābādhakam || abhinnapadabodhyāssyurnānālaṃkṛtayo yadi | tadaikavācakānupraveśasaṃkara iṣyate || arthayośśabdayośśabdārthayorvā'pyekavācake | anupraveśatasso'yaṃ trividhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || abhinnapadabodhyanānālaṃkāratvamekavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ | tatra ca arthālaṃkārayośśabdālaṃkārayorvā ekasmin vācake anupraveśena traividhyam | arthālaṃkārayoreva ekavācakānupraveśa iti dīkṣitāḥ | śabdālaṃkārayorapi sa iti sarvasvakāraḥ | śabdārthālaṃkārayoreveti kāvyaprakāśakāraḥ || tatrādyo yathā tvaditaradaivatabhajanādyadi vindetāmṛtaṃ jano jātu | udamanthādapi śaure nūnaṃ vindeta sa khalu navanītam || 2172 || udakasya manthaḥ 'manthaudana' ityādinā udakaśabdasya vaikalpika udādeśaḥ | atra pratipādyamāno'rthastulyavākyārthaikyāropalakṣaṇanidarśanārūpaḥ | kiñcittarkaṇamanyattarkaṇasādhanamityuktasaṃbhāvanarūpaścetyanayorarthālaṃkārayorekānupūrvībodhitatvādekavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā surapuṅgave samastastatpuruṣe bhajati gauravaṃ svānte | dhatte suśabdatāmatha yo'nevaṃsyātkathaṃ nu sa suśabdaḥ || 2173 || surapuṅgave devasārvabhaume | tatpuruṣe ityatra taditi bhinnaṃ padaṃ gauravaviśeṣaṇam | puruṣe śrīmati nārāyaṇe samastaḥ sarvo'pi lokaḥ svānte manasi tat anirvacanīyaṃ gauravaṃ bhaktimiti yāvat | bhajati atha suśabdatāṃ śobhanaśśabdaḥ kīrtiryasya saḥ tasya bhāvaṃ 'śabdo'kṣarayaśogītavyomavākyadhvaniṣvapi' iti ratnamālā || divaṃ spṛśati bhūmiṃ ca śabdaḥ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ | yāvatsuśabdo bhavati tāvatsvarge mahīyate || iti bhārataprayogaśca | bhagavati gauravabhāguttamakīrtimān bhavatītyarthaḥ| yaḥ pumān anevaṃsyāt bhagavati gauravaṃ na tanuyāt saḥ kathaṃnu suśabdaḥ sukīrtiḥ bhavet | bhagavadabhaktasya kathaṃ sukīrtilābhassyādityarthaḥ | anyatra tatpuruṣe tatpuruṣasamāsavivakṣāyāmiti yāvat | surapuṃgave surapuṃgavaśabde gauḥ avaṃ iti chedaḥ | samastaḥ samāsaṃ prāptaḥ gauḥ gośabdaḥ svānte svasya caramāvayavabhūte okāre avaṃ avādeśaṃ bhajati | ‘gorataddhita luki' iti go'ntatatpuruṣāṭṭaci caramāvayavasya okārasya 'eco'yavāyāvaḥ' ityavādeśo bhavatītyarthaḥ | atha evamavādeśānantarameva suśabdatāṃ sādhuśabdatvaṃ dhatte | tatpuruṣe gośabdasya kṛtasamāsāntasyaiva sādhutvāt | yaḥ tatpuruṣe samastaḥ gośabdaḥ uttarapadabhūtaḥ anevaṃsyāt samāsāntaṭajabhāvena avādeśaṃ na prāpnuyāt saḥ kathaṃ suśabdaḥ sādhuśabdassyāt | uktasamāsāntapratyayasya nityatayā tadabhāve tasya sādhutā kathaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | atra sauśabdyabhāktvasya bhagavadbhaktibhāktvarūpavākyārthahetukatvādekaṃ kāvyaliṅgam | aprastutabhaktajanasauśabdyabhāktvasvarūpakāryapraśaṃsayā tatkāraṇabhūtabhagavadbhaktirūpakāraṇasya śubhapradānotkarṣapratīterekā kāryanibandhanā'prastutapraśaṃsā | evamaprastutānevaṃvidhāsauśabdyabhāktvarūpakāryapraśaṃsayā tatkāraṇabhūtabhagavadagauravarūpakāraṇa syānarthadānotkarṣapratīteranyā cāprastutapraśaṃsā | prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣaścetyete'rthālaṃkārā ekavācakānupraviṣṭatayā saṃkīryante || yathāvā hariguṇamasṛṇā kṛtiriyamanādṛtā cetkhalaiḥ kimetasyāḥ | lāvaṇyaghanā lalanā januṣāndhairnnindyate yadi kimasyāḥ || 2174 || januṣāndha ityatra tṛtīyāyā aluk ‘puṃsā'nujo januṣāndha iti ca' iti nipātanāt | atra sarvaṃ padyaṃ dṛṣṭāntālaṃkārarūpam | pūrvottarārdhe pratyekamanyadoṣeṇānyadoṣānudayalakṣaṇāvajñālaṃkārarūpe | tena ekāvācakānupraveśasaṃkīrṇe || yathāvā bhagavan sa daivanihataprakṛtirdveṣṭā taveḍitaḥ kvanu vā | nityamudāttaprakṛtistavāñcitā neḍitaḥ kva vā dṛṣṭaḥ || 2175 || saḥ duṣkṛtātiśayasya durvacatvātsa iti nirdeśaḥ | tava dveṣṭā janaḥ daivena nihatā nāśitā prakṛtiḥ svābhāvikabhagavaccheṣatādyākāro yasya tathoktassan kvavā īḍitaḥ stutaḥ syāt sarvatra nindita eva syāditi bhāvaḥ | nityaṃ tava añcitā pūjayitā udāttaprakṛtiḥ ślāghyasvabhāvaḥ kvavā neḍitaḥ sarvatra sarvaisstuta eva syāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe dveṣṭā dveṣṭetyākārakaśśabdaḥ sadaiva nityameva nihatā anudāttā prakṛtiḥ tṛcprakṛtiḥ dviṣadhāturūpā yasya sa tathoktaḥ | dviṣadhātoranudātteṣu parigaṇitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ataeva kvavā iḍitaḥ iḍāgamena saṃbaddhaḥ ‘ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt' itīṇniṣe dhāditi bhāvaḥ | añcitā añcitetyākāraśśabdastu nityaṃ udāttaprakṛtiḥ udāttabhūtā añcadhāturūpā prakṛtiryasya sa tathā ataeva kvavā iḍito na iḍāgamaviśiṣṭo na syāt udāttatvāt 'ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ' itīḍāgamaṃ prāpta eva bhavediti bhāvaḥ | atra viśiṣṭo vākyārthassamāsoktirūpaḥ kāvyaliṅgarūpābhyāṃ vākyārthābhyāmekavācakānupraveśasaṃkīrṇaḥ || yathāvā śeṣagirīśvara bhavato vaśagau khagabhujagatallajau yasmāt | bhajato nityasamāsaṃ manye tadavigrahāvetau || 2176 || he śeṣagirīśvara śrīnivāsa ! pakṣe śeṣagiri vyākaraṇe īśvara samartheti kasyacidviduṣassaṃbodhanam | ‘svāmīśvara' ityādinā saptamī | praśastau khagabhujagau khagabhujagatallajau ‘praśaṃsāvacanaiśca' iti samāsaḥ | tārkṣyaśeṣāvityarthaḥ | pakṣe khagatallajaḥ bhujagatallaja ityetau śabdāvityarthaḥ | yasmāddhetoḥ nityasamāsaṃ āsa upaveśane' bhāve ghañ | samaścāsāvāsaśceti vigrahaḥ | tulyāvasthānaṃ sahāvasthitimityarthaḥ | pakṣe nityaṃ samastatāṃ bhajataḥ | kṛṣṇasarpavāpyaśvādivadete nityasamāsāḥ' iti ‘matallikā macarcikā' ityatra sudhākārādayaḥ | tat tasmāt etau khagatallajabhujagatallajaśabdau avigrahau vṛttyarthāvabodhakavākyavirahitau | yadvā asvapadavigrahau manye | anyathā nityasamāsaṃ na prāpnuta iti bhāvaḥ | ‘avigraho nityasamāsaḥ asvapadavigraho vā | vṛttyarthāvabodhakavākyaṃ vigrahaḥ' iti śābdikāḥ | atra śleṣānumānayorekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā nakṣatrapathollaṅghī navaghanarājyābhiṣekamabhigami taḥ | uttuṅgaśṛṅgasaṃgata ucitaṃ bhūbhṛdvaro'yamahiśailaḥ || 2177 || nakṣatrapathaṃ antarikṣaṃ ullaṅghata iti tathoktaḥ | anyatra kṣatradharmānativartītyarthaḥ | navayā ghanarājyā jaladaśreṇyā abhiṣekaṃ abhigamitaḥ | anyatra navaṃ pratyagraṃ ghanaṃ sāndraṃ yat rājyaṃ tasmin abhiṣekaṃ abhigamitaḥ | uttuṅgaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ śikharaiḥ sānubhirvā uttuṅgena śṛṅgeṇa prādhānyena prabhutvena vā saṃgataḥ saṃbanddhaḥ | ‘śṛṅgaṃ prabhutve śikhare cihne krīḍāmbuyantrake | viṣāṇotkarṣayoḥ' iti medinī | ‘śṛṅgaṃ prādhānyasānvośca' ityamaraśca | bhūbhṛdvaraḥ rājavareṇyaḥ giriśreṣṭhaśca | atra kāvyaliṅgasamālaṃkārayośśleṣānuprāṇitayorekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā svanayanajayibhirharidhṛtavaidūryairnirjito'tha mārjāraḥ | māro yadi jātu syāttadā'pi harinīlavigrahajitassyāt || 2178 || mārjāraḥ biḍālaḥ mārjāraśabdaśca svanayanajayibhiḥ nijalocanarucivijitvarairiti yāvat haridhṛtaiḥ bhagavatā bhūṣaṇatayā vidhṛtaiḥ vaidūryeḥ vālavāyajamaṇibhiḥ | vidūrātprabhavanti vaidūryāṇīti vigrahaḥ | ‘prabhavati' ityadhikāre ‘vidūrāññyaḥ' iti ñyaḥ | ‘vaidūryaṃ vālavāyajam' iti viśvaḥ | atra vidūraśabdo vālavāyasyādeśaḥ paryāyo vā tatropacarito vā | tena vālavāyādgirerasau prabhavati na vidūrānnagarāt tatra tu saṃskriyata ityākṣepaḥ pratyuktaḥ | yaduktaṃ vālavāyo vidūraṃ ca prakṛtyantarameva vā | na vai tatreti cedbrūyājjitvarīvadupācaret || iti | vaktavyāntaraṃ tu lakṣmīsahasrasaundaryastabakavyākhyāyāṃ 'vaidūryavīkṣābhayodgacchat' ityatra prapañcitamasmābhiḥ | nirjitaḥ parākṛtaḥ svanayanaruciparābhūtyā svayamapi parābhūta iti bhāvaḥ || śabdapakṣe nirjitaḥ atra ni ityupasarga idantaḥ na tu rephāntaḥ | nigataḥ rjā ityākārako varṇo yasya saḥ nirjāḥ | nirjāśabdāttatkarotīti ṇijantātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyasāmrājyānmārjāraśabdasya vaidūryanirjitatvamiti dhyeyam | atha yadi jātu mārassyāt vidveṣimārako'pi syāt vikrāntaśiromaṇirvairaniryātanapaṭurapi syāditi bhāvaḥ | kāmo'pi yadi syādityapyarthaḥ | mārjāraśabde rjāvarṇotsāraṇe māra iti sa niṣpadyeteti śabdapakṣe'rthaḥ | ‘jātuyadorliṅ, yadāyadyorupasaṃkhyānam' iti jātu yadiśabdayoge anavaklṛptau dyotyāyāṃ liṅ | anavaklṛptirasaṃbhāvanā | asaṃbhāvanīyamevaitaditi bhāvaḥ | tadā'pi harinīlaiḥ bhagavaddhṛtendranīlaiḥ vigrahe yuddhe jitassyāt | pūrvaṃ vaidūrtyairvijitasya rūpāntaraparigrahe'pīndranīlairjitatvaṃ syādityubhayadhā'pi haridhṛtaratnaparābhūtataiva saṃbhavediti bhāvaḥ | mārasya śyāmalatvena harinīlavigrahajitatvamiti bodhyam | bhagavaddivyamūrtijita iti tadarthaḥ | atra saṃbhāvanaviṣamayorekavācakānupraveśaḥ | śleṣottambhitatvaṃ ca pūrvavadeva || yathāvā cidacidvarāvubhāvapi bhavato jagatīśvarau na saṃdehaḥ | strīpuṃsarūpamātre bhinnau nanu divyadaṃpatī kiṃtu || 2179 || divyadaṃpatī lakṣmīnārāyaṇau ubhau dvāvapi yuvāmiti bhāvaḥ | cidacidvarau svabhāvānyadhābhāvasvarūpānyadhābhāvalakṣaṇavikāraviraheṇa cetanācetanāpekṣayā śreṣṭhau tadvilakṣaṇāviti yāvat | ata eva jagatyāḥ jagataḥ īśvarau | na saṃdehaḥ ubhayādhiṣṭhānatvādaiśvaryasya nātra saṃdegdhavyamiti bhāvaḥ | evamubhayostaulyamuktam | vailakṣaṇyamāha kiṃtu strīpuṃsarūpamātre strīpuruṣarūpamātre bhinnau nanu tāvanmātra eva bhidurau na tu jagadīśvaratve iti bhāvaḥ | atra tvaṃ yādṛśo'si kamalāmapi tādṛśīṃ te dārānvadanti yuvayorna tu bhedagandhaḥ | māyāvibhaktayuvatītanumekameva tvāṃ mātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ ca yuvānamāhuḥ || iti śrīviṣṇuvaibhavādhikārairuktamanusaṃdheyam | anyatra nanu divyadaṃpatī he lakṣmīnārāyaṇāviti saṃbodhanam | jagati loke īśvarau īśvaraśabdau cidacidvarau cit cakāretkaḥ acit cakāretkabhinnaḥ ṭakāretka iti yāvat | cidacitau varau varapratyayau yayostau 'īśa aiśvarye' ityasmāddhātoḥ 'stheśabhāse' ityādinā varacpratyayena ‘aśū vyāptau' iti dhātoḥ aśnoterāśukarmaṇi varaṭ ca' iti varaṭpratyayena ca niṣpannāviti bhāvaḥ | kiṃtu strīpuṃsarūpamātre strīliṅgapulliṅgarūpamātre bhinnau | strīliṅgatve varacā niṣpannasya īśvaraśabdasya ṭāpi īśvareti varaṭā niṣpannasya tu ‘ṭiḍhḍha' iti ṅīpi īśvarīti rūpam | pulliṅgatve tu ubhayathā'pīśvara ityeva rūpamiti tayorbheda iti bhāvaḥ | atra prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣavyatirekayorekavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā rājīva nanu ramākṣṇā nirākṛto jīvamātraśiṣṭo'si | jyāśliṣṭo'vāgrastvaṃ svalpaprāṇātmanassthitistviyatī || 2180 || nanu rājīva he matsya he hariṇeti vā | pakṣe he rājīveti śabdasyaiva saṃbodhanam | 'rājīvaṃ naline nā tu bhede hariṇamīnayoḥ' iti medinī | tvaṃ ramāyāḥ akṣṇā nirākṛtaḥ tiraskṛtaḥ matsyahariṇayorlalanānayanopamānatāyāḥ kavisamayasammatatvena nirākṛtatvoktiḥ | yathoktamalaṃkāraśekhare trayodaśamarīcyāṃ mṛgatannetrapāthojatatpatrajhaṣakhañjanaiḥ | netraṃ cakoratannetraketakālismarāśugaiḥ || iti sadṛśatvena kavibhirvarṇanīyamityarthaḥ | prayogaśca ‘sadṛśe vanavṛddhānāṃ kamalānāṃ tvadīkṣaṇe, iti | tatraiva pañcadaśamarīcyāṃ bhṛtakādyaiśca bhṛtyādyairnyakkārārthakriyāpadaiḥ | saṃdehatattadvākyādyaissādṛśyaṃ pratipādyate || iti ca saṃdehataḥ ‘kiminduḥ kiṃ padmaṃ' ityādyaiḥ tattadvākyādyaiḥ ‘tasya puṣṇāti saubhāgyaṃ tasya kāntiṃ vilumpati' ityādyaiḥ sādṛśyaṃ pratipādyata iti tadarthaḥ | śabdapakṣe nirākṛtaḥ nītyeṣa idanta upasargaḥ nivartitaḥ rā ityākārako varṇo yasya sa tathoktaḥ kṛtaḥ | rā ityasya strīpratyayāntatvābhāvānnopasarjanahṛsvaḥ | jīvamātraṃ prāṇadhāraṇamātraṃ śiṣṭaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | ‘jīvo'sudhāraṇam' ityamaraḥ | aprāpte vidhiniyamite samaye durmocatvātprāṇānāṃ taddhāraṇamātraṃ kurvanniti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe rāvarṇodvāsane rājīvaśabdo jīveti pariśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | ataeva avāgraḥ avanataḥ ‘avāgre'vanatānatam' ityamaraḥ | avāṅmukha iti yāvat | jyā bhūmiḥ śliṣṭā āliṅgitā yena sa tathoktaḥ asi | bhūmāvavāṅmukhatayā nipatitastata utthātumakṣama iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe jī ityākārakavarṇena āśliṣṭaḥ yukta ityarthaḥ vāgra iti chedaḥ | vetyākārakaṃ varṇaṃ agre yasya sa tathoktaḥ | jīveti varṇadvayamātrapariśiṣṭasya tādvidhyāditi bhāvaḥ | nirākṛto'yaṃ rājīvaḥ kutastatpratīkārakṣamo nābhūdityatrāha svalpeti svalpaprāṇaḥ alpaśaktiḥ ātmā deho yasya sa tathoktaḥ tasya | pakṣe rājīveti śabdo'lpaprāṇavarṇātmaka ityarthaḥ | tasya ‘vargāṇāṃ prathamatṛtīyapañcamāḥ prathamatṛtīyayamau yaralavāścālpaprāṇāḥ' ityukteḥ | sthitistu iyatī etāvatī alpaprāṇasya vairibhirnirākṛtatve'pi pratīkārākṣamatayā tūṣṇīṃ bhūmāvavāṅmukhatayā śayanamityetāvatyevāvasthitiriti bhāvaḥ | anyatra rājīvetyasyālpaprāṇātmakasya śabdasya sthitiretāvatītyarthaḥ | atrāprastutasya rājīvasya nirākaraṇādikāryavarṇanena tatkāraṇasya prastutasya ramānayanasya lokottarathālathalyacāñcalyādipratīteḥ kāryanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsā | mīnahariṇayoḥ rājīvaśabdasya cāprakṛtānāṃ śleṣaḥ | nirākṛtatvasya jīvamātrapariśiṣṭatāṃ prati tasyāśca jyāśliṣṭatādiṃ prati hetutvātkāvyaliṅgaṃ sāmānyena viśeṣasamarthanarūpārthāntaranyāsaścetyetāni ekavācakānupraviṣṭāni || yathāvā jetuṃ tvadvakṣojāvaribhāvātke vibhinnamapi nālam | āstāmba nārikelaṃ klībālpaprāṇamayagatistviyatī || 2181 || he amba ! nārikelaṃ nārikelaphalam | klībanirdeśo niṣpauruṣa tvadyotanāya | ‘dvihīnaṃ prasave sarvam' iti klībatā | aribhāvāt śatrubhāvāt ke śirasi vibhinnamapi vidīrṇaśīrṣamapīti lokoktiḥ | tvadvakṣojau jetuṃ nālaṃ asamarthaṃ āsta | vakṣojāviti pulliṅgadvivacananirdeśena tayorvīrapuruṣadvayatvaṃ pratīyate | ekena klībena dvau vīrapuruṣau jetumaśakyāviti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe nārikelamiti padaṃ aribhāvāt avidyamānarivarṇatvāt ke vibhinnamapi ke ityākārakavarṇo vibhinno yasmiṃstat | ke ityākārakavarṇabhraṃśaṃ prāpitamiti yāvat | apiśabdassamuccaye | nālaṃ nālamityavaśiṣṭavarṇadvayaṃ āstetyarthaḥ | klībasya ṣaṇḍasya alpaprāṇamayasya alpaśaktimataḥ gatiḥ sthitiḥ iyatī paraparābhavānarhataiveti bhāvaḥ | itaratra klībasya napuṃsakaliṅgasya alpaprāṇavarṇātmakasya sthitirityarthaḥ | atra viṣamārthāntaranyāsayorekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā nāke sthitimatkvacana vyañjanaparivṛttito'pyamuktārtham | śrīkucalakṣmīstenaṃ paripāke patati nārikelamadhaḥ || 2182 || śrīkucalakṣmīstenaṃ nārikelaṃ nāke svarge kvacana kasmiṃścidajñātapradeśe vyañjanaparivṛttiḥ svacihnavinimayena veṣāntareṇeti yāvat | sthitimadapi ‘vyañjanaṃ temane cihne śmaśruṇyavayave'kṣare' iti ratnamālā | amuktārthaṃ apāratyaktasvamuṣitārthakam | anena patanahetudoṣātiśaya uktaḥ | garhitārjitārthaparityāge tu "śāsanādvā vimokṣādvā stenassteyādvimucyate | yadgarhitenārjayanti japyena tapasaiva ca | tasyotsargeṇa śuddhyanti" ityuktarītyā doṣātiśayo na syāditi bhāvaḥ | ataeva paripāke svakṛtaduṣkarmapariṇāmasamaye adhaḥ patati adho gatiṃ vindatītyarthaḥ | pakṣe nārikelaṃ nārikelamiti padaṃ nākesthi mat nā ke iti varṇadvayāvikṛtisthitiśāli | kvacana avaśiṣṭākṣarayorityarthaḥ | vyañjanayoḥ haloḥ parivṛttitaḥ ri la ityakṣarastharephalakārayorvyatyayādapīti yāvat | na tu tanniṣṭhayorakārākārarūpasvarayorapītyarthaḥ | tayoryathāsthānameva sthitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | amuktārthaṃ aparityaktasvābhidheyamityarthaḥ | uktarītyā nārikelaśabdasya nālikeramiti rūpāntarābāptāvapi tulyārthakatāyā eva darśanāditi bhāvaḥ | atra nārikelādhaḥpatanasya śrīkucalakṣmīstenamityādipadārthaissamarthanātkāvyaliṅgaṃ aprastutanārikelādhaḥpatanakāryapraśaṃsāyā tatkāraṇībhūtaśrīkucasaundaryabhūmāvagate kāryanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsā caikavācakānupraveśena saṃkīryate || yathāvā ahigirivibhunā vihitaṃ pratyayamiha kaścidātiśāyanikam | prāpto'jādiślāghyaṃ jyādeśe jyeṣṭhatāṃ praśasya iyāt || 2183 || kaścit praśasyaḥ praśaṃsārhaḥ pumān bhāgyavāniti yāvat | pakṣe praśasyaśabdaḥ ātiśāyanikaṃ atiśāyanaprayojakaṃ prakarṣaprayojakamityarthaḥ | "prayojanam" ityanena ṭhak | iha prayojanaśabdena heturvivakṣitaḥ | prayojanaṃ phalaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca" iti vyākhyānāt | pakṣe atiśāyanārthaka ‘atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau' iti sūtreṇātiśayaviśiṣṭārthavṛttervihitamityarthaḥ | atipūrvakāccheterlyuṭ | atiśayanamevātiśāyanaṃ asmādeva nipātanāddīrghaḥ na tu sautraḥ | tena loke'pi dīrghassādhuḥ 'abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti | tena hrasvo'pi sādhuḥ' iti vyākhyātāraḥ | ataeva ajādibhiḥ brahmarudrādibhirapi ślāghyaṃ pakṣe ac ajrūpo ya ādiḥ prathamavarṇaḥ tena ślāghyaṃ iṣṭhanamiti yāvat | atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanorubhayorvidhānātkaḥ pratyayo'tra grāhya iti saṃdeho mā bhūditīdaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti dhyeyam | ahigirivibhunā śrīnavāsena | anyatra ahigiri pātañjalabhāṣye vibhunā tattvāvadhāraṇapaṭunā vihitaṃ pratyayaṃ smṛtisaṃtānarūpaṃ jñānaṃ ‘sa no devaśśubhayā smṛtyā saṃyunaktuṃ' iti śrutiḥ | ‘dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te, iti smṛteśceti bhāvaḥ | śabdapakṣe pratyayaṃ śābdikasaṃketitaṃ pratyayaṃ prāptassan | jyādeśe bhūpradeśe ‘kṣoṇī jyā kāśyapī kṣitiḥ' ityamaraḥ | jyeṣṭhatāṃ atiśayitapraśasyatāṃ iyāt prāpnuyāt | prathamamevānabhisaṃhitaphalakarmānuṣṭhānādiprāptanairmalyatayā praśasyaḥ pumān bhagavadanugrahalabdhasvacchatamapratyayatve atimātraṃ praśasyo bhavediti bhāvaḥ | śabdapakṣe praśasyaśabdaḥ atiśāyanikamiṣṭhanpratyayaṃ labdhvā jyādeśe ‘praśasyasya śraḥ | jya ca' ityanena jyetyādeśe jyeṣṭhatāṃ jyeṣṭha ityākārakaṃ rūpaṃ iyāt prāpnuyāt ityarthaḥ | atra praśaṃsanīyapuruṣasya prakṛtasya praśasyaśabdasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | jyeṣṭhatāvāpteḥ pūrvavākyārthahetukatvātkāvyaliṅgaṃ cetyetadubhayamekavācakānupraviṣṭam || yathāvā vidhimantaraṅgamapi te viloḍayatyeva nityamapavādaḥ | kimuta paramacyutākhilagīrvāṇapadānuśāsanavidhātuḥ || 2184 || he acyuta! akhilagīrvāṇapadānāṃ caturmukhādyakhilatridaśasthānānāṃ anuśāsanavidhātuḥ praśāsanavidhāyinaḥ ‘etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi sūryācandramasau vidhṛtau tiṣṭhataḥ' iti śruteḥ ‘śāstā viṣṇuraśeṣasya' ityukteśca | te tava apavādaḥ ājñā tvatkartṛkaṃ śāsanaṃ apavādaḥ nindeti vā | tvatkarmakaṃ nindanamityarthaḥ | apavādau tu nindājñe" ityamaraḥ | antaraṅgaṃ ātmajatayā atimātrapratyāsannaṃ ‘putro vai hṛdayam | ātmā vai putranāmāsi' ityādiśrutayo'trānusaṃdheyāḥ | vidhiṃ caturmukhamapi nityaṃ viloḍayati kampayati | etacchanānātivṛttau kiṃ bhaviṣyatīti mahato bhayādbrahmādayo'pi kampanta iti bhāvaḥ | ‘yadidaṃ kiṃca jagatsarvaṃ prāṇa ejati nissṛtam | mahadbhayaṃ vajramudyatam' ityādiśrutibhyaḥ | paraṃ anyaṃ maruttaraṇipāvakatridaśanāthakālādikaṃ kimuta viloḍayatīti kimu vaktavyamityarthaḥ | ātmajasyaiva śāsanānnindanādvā kampane anyeṣāṃ kā katheti bhāvaḥ | anyatra akhilānāṃ gīrvāṇapadānāṃ saṃskṛtaśabdānāmanuśāsanaṃ śikṣaṇaṃ tadvidhātuḥ ‘atha śabdānuśāsanam' iti pratijñāya mahābhāṣyaṃ vidhāturityarthaḥ | te tvatsaṃbandhī tvannirṇīta iti yāvat | apavādaḥ apavādaśāstraṃ nityaṃ antaraṅgamapi antaraṅgaṃ ca vidhiṃ śāstraṃ viloḍayati bādhate | paraṃ paraśāstraṃ kimuta bādhata iti kimu vaktavyamityarthaḥ | antaraṅgabādhakasyāpavādasya svabādhyabādhyabādhakatvaṃ kimāścaryamiti bhāvaḥ | yatparibhāṣyate paranityāntaraṅgāpavādānāmuttarottaraṃ balīyaḥ' iti | atra vedāntaśāstrīye'rthe śabdaśāstrīyavyavahārāropātsamāsoktiḥ kaimutyenārthasaṃsiddhirūpakāvyārthāpattiścetyubhayamekavācakānupraviṣṭam || yathāvā tvayi vinyastātmabharo nīlamaṇīmauliravaravarṇo'pi | tvatto vindatyuccaiśśriyaṃ śriyaḥkānta durlabhāmitaraiḥ || 2185 || he śriyaḥkānta! nīlamaṇīmauliḥ indranīlakirīṭaḥ avaravarṇo'pi tvatto nyūnaśyāmalimā'pi | pakṣe śūdro'pi ‘śūdrāścāvaravarṇāśca' ityamaraḥ | tvayi vinyastaḥ ātmanaḥ svasya bharaḥ bhāro yena sa tathoktaḥ tvayā mūrdhnā dhṛtatvāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe tvayyarpitātmarakṣābhara ityarthaḥ || ananyopāyaśaktasya prāpyecchoradhikāritā | prapattau sarvavarṇasya sātvikatvādiyoginaḥ | sā hi sarvatra sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradā || ityādibhiḥ prapattessarvādhikārikatvokteḥ | tvattaḥ uccaiḥ pūrvāpekṣayā'bhyarhitāṃ | pakṣe brahmādilokāpekṣayā'pyutkarṣaśālinīṃ itaraiḥ tvadavidhṛtābharaṇāntaraiḥ durlabhāṃ bhagavaddivyavigrahasuṣamānavalambitayā labdhumaśakyāṃ, anyatra prapannetarairdurāpāṃ ‘prapannādanyeṣāṃ na diśati mukundo nijapadam' ityādyukteriti bhāvaḥ | śriyaṃ śyāmalimarūpāṃ anyatra niśśreyasasaṃpadaṃ vindati || atra prastute bhagavaddhṛtendranīlamakuṭe varṇanīye viśeṣaṇasāmyabalādaprasutāvaravarṇaprapannavṛttāntaḥ pratīyata iti samāsoktiḥ | avaravarṇasyāpyuccaiśriyaḥ prāpteḥ tvayi vinyastātmabhara iti padārthahetukatvātkāvyaliṅgam | prāksiddhasya svanīlimno bhagavaddivyavigrahasaṃnidhivaśenotkarṣavarṇanādanuguṇālaṅkāraścetyetānyekavācakānupraveśena saṃkīryante || yathāvā na tyakṣyāmyacyutamiti śapathassatataṃ viśassughaṭitaścet | ayameva bhavati supatho vipatho'nyo yohi vighaṭitā bhavitā || 2186 || acyutaḥ āśritarakṣaṇavratacyutivirihī bhagavān | taṃ śrānivāsaṃ na tyakṣyāmyeveti sarvaṃ vākyaṃ sāvadhāraṇamiti nyāyāt | viśaḥ manujasya 'dvau viśau vaiśyamanujau' ityamaraḥ | śapathaḥ pratijñā sughaṭitaścet sudṛḍho yadi sa tvaṃ prahara vā mā vā mayi vrajaṃ puraṃdara | nāhamutsṛjya govindamanyamārādhayāmi bhoḥ || iti viṣṇudharme asbarīṣoktarītyā bhagavadaikāntyadraḍhīyān yadīti bhāvaḥ | ayameva supathaḥ śobhanamārgaḥ bhavati | anyaḥ asmāditaraḥ vipathaḥ vimārga eva | yaśśapathaḥ vighaṭitaḥ śithilo bhavitā aikāntyātpracyuto bhaviteti bhāvaḥ || eṣa niṣkaṇṭakaḥ panthā yatra saṃpūjyate hariḥ | kupathaṃ taṃ vijanīyādgovindarahitāgamam || ityādikamiha pratyabhijñāpyate | supathaḥ vipathaḥ ityubhayatrāpi na pathiśabdena samāsaḥ ‘na pūjanāt' iti samāsāntaniṣedhāt | ‘pathassaṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' iti klībatāprasaṃgāśca | kiṃtu ‘pathe gatau' ityasmātpacādyaci pathati vyāpnotīti vyutpāditaḥ pathaśabdo'sti | tena saha su vi ityanayossamāsaḥ | tathāca trikāṇḍaśeṣaḥ ‘vāṭaḥ pathaśca mārgassyāt' iti | tena prakṛte na kā'pyanupapattiḥ ‘vyadhvo vipathakāpathau' iti rabhasaścāha | anyatra śapathaḥ śapathaśabdaḥ viśaḥ vigataśakārassan sughaṭitaḥ su ityākārakavarṇena ghaṭitaścet ayameva śapathaśabda eva supathaśabdo bhavati | anyaḥ vipathaḥ yaḥ viśakārassan vighaṭitaḥ vi ityākārakavarṇena yuktassyāt | atra prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣaḥ supathatvavipathatvayoḥ pūrvottaravākyārthābhyāṃ samarthanātkāvyaliṅgadvayaṃ parisaṃkhyā caikavācakānupraveśena saṃkīryante || yathāvā arirīrito'trabhavatā''kāramatha prakriyādaśāvidhuraḥ | saṃvṛtametyāntasthāsvaravān bhūtvā'ntato visṛṣṭo'bhūt || 2187 || he bhagavan atra ariḥ vairī bhavatā īritaḥ kṣiptaḥ nirastassannityarthaḥ | 'viddhakṣipteritāssamāḥ' ityamaraḥ | ataeva atha anantaraṃ prakriyādaśayā rājyādhikārāvasthayā vidhuraḥ viśliṣṭaḥ ‘prakriyā tvadhikārassyāt | daśā'vasthā' iti cāmaraḥ | bhavannirastasya kathamiva rājyādhikārabhraṃśo na syāditi bhāvaḥ | saṃvṛtaṃ guptaṃ ākāraṃ ākṛtiṃ etya prāpya rājyādhikārabhraṃśaprayuktaḥ trapābhūmnā gūḍhaṃ kvāpi nilīna iti bhavaḥ | antaḥ tiṣṭhatītyantasthāḥ | sthādhātoḥ kvip| 'śaṃsthā' iti mahābhāṣyaprayogāt | yadvā vic | atra vaktavyaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmīsahasraratnaprakāśikāyāṃ ‘antasthoṣmoddhārāt' iti padyavivaraṇāvasare prapañcitamasmābhiḥ | īdṛśo yassvaro dhvaniḥ so'syāstītyantasthāsvaravān bhūtvā lajjābhayābhyāṃ nimagnadhvanirbhūtvetyarthaḥ | ‘svaro nāsāsamīraṇe | udāttādāvakārādau ṣaḍjādau ca dhvanau pumān' iti medinī | antataḥ visṛṣṭaḥ parityaktaḥ abhūt | niṣpaurupatayā vikrāntagoṣṭhīto bahiṣkṛto'bhūditi bhāvaḥ || anyatra atrabhavateti samastaṃ padam | atrabhavatā pūjyena viduṣeti yāvat | īritaḥ uktaḥ prakriyādaśayā saṃdhirūpaprakriyāvasthayā vidhuraḥ hīnaḥ ariḥ ariśabdaḥ aririti kevalāriśabdaprayogāvasare akārasya akārāntarasaṃdheradarśanāditi bhāvaḥ | asmin pakṣe bhavatākāramityatra bhavatā akāramiti chedaḥ | saṃvṛtaṃ saṃvṛtaprayatnavantaṃ akāraṃ hrasvākāraṃ ‘hrasvasyāvarṇasya prayoge saṃvṛtam' ityukteḥ prāpya prakriyādaśāyāṃ hrasvasyākārasya vivṛtaprayatnakatvena kevalāriśabdaprayoge prakriyādaśābhāvādakārasya saṃvṛtaprayatnakatvameveti bhāvaḥ | "etacca sūtrakāreṇa jñāpitam | tathāhi ‘a a' iti | vivṛtamanūdya saṃvṛto'nena vidhīyate | asya cāṣṭādhyāyīṃ saṃpūrṇāṃ pratyasiddhatvācchāstradṛṣṭyā vivṛtatvamastyeva | tathāca sūtraṃ ‘pūrvatrāsiddham' adhikāro'yaṃ, tena sapādasaptādhyāyīṃ prati tripādyasiddhā | tripādyāmapi pūrvaṃ prati paraṃ śāstramasiddham" iti | sarvamidaṃ kaumudīgranthe vyaktam | asmin pakṣe athetyetadatrānveti | atha akāroccāraṇānantaraṃ antasthāsvaravān antasthāḥ ādanto'yaṃ antasthābhiśca saṃyutam' iti pāṇinīyaśikṣādiprayogāt ariśabde antasthāsaṃjñito vārṇo rephaḥ | atha svaraḥ rephottaravartī ikāraḥ | ‘yaralavā antasthāḥ | acassvarāḥ' ityanuśāsanāt | tadvān bhūtvā antataḥ avasāne visṛṣṭaḥ visargavānabhūt ariśabdasya hṛsvākārarephekāravisargaghaṭatatvāttathoktiriti dhyeyam | atrāprakṛtasyāriśabdārthasya aprakṛtasyāriśabdasya ca śleṣaḥ | ādyakakṣyāyāṃ aprastutaparābhūtavairivṛttāntena prastutabhagavatparākramotkarṣaḥ pratīta iti kāryanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsā | bhagavannirastatayā prakriyādaśāvaidhuryasya tasya ca saṃvṛtākāratvādeśca samarthanātkāvyaliṅgamālā caikavācakānupraveśena sakīryante || yathāvā eko'yamanupasarjanabhāvādbhagavānamadhyamo'do'nyaḥ | api kaḥ parastadeṣa hi sarvādau gaṇyate budhavareṇyaiḥ || 2188 || ayaṃ bhagavān śrīnivāsaḥ eka eva anupasarjanabhāvāt upasarjanamapradhānaṃ ‘apradhānopasarjjane' ityamaraḥ | tadanyadanupasarjanaṃ tasya bhāvāt prādhānyādityarthaḥ | amadhyamaḥ ‘tasya lokapradhānasya jagannāthasya bhūpate' ityuktarītyā sakalalokapradhānatayā sarvottama ityabhiprāyaḥ | ado'nyaḥ amuṣmādbhagavata itaraḥ | paro'pi utkṛṣṭopi kaḥ ? naivetyarthaḥ | amuṣmādanyasya utkarṣasaṃbhāvanā'pi kā nāmeti bhāvaḥ | apiratra saṃbhāvanāyām | budhavareṇyaiḥ brahmaviduttamaiḥ sa eṣa hi ayaṃ bhagavāneva ‘hi hetāvavadhāraṇe' ityamaraḥ | sarvādau sarveṣāṃ brahmādīnāmapi ādau agre gaṇyate | jagajanmasthemapralayakāraṇatvena kīrtyate | anyatra ekādiśśabdāśśabdaparāḥ ekaḥ ayaṃ amadhyamaḥ madhyamavarṇavidhuraḥ bhagavān bhavānityarthaḥ | adaḥ anyaḥ apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ | kaḥ ekaḥ tat eṣo'pi śabdaḥ anupasarjanabhāvāt anyopasarjanatvābhāvāddhetoḥ budhavareṇyaiḥ vaiyākaraṇaiḥ sarvādau sarvādigaṇe gaṇyate | eka ityādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ gaṇyata ityanenānvayaḥ | ‘saṃjñopasarjanībhūtāstu na sarvādayaḥ mahāsaṃjñākaraṇena tadanuguṇānāmeva gaṇe saṃniveśāt' ityukteranupasarjanībhūtānāmeva sarvādīnāṃ tadgaṇe pāṭhāditi tathoktiḥ | ekedaṃbhavadado'nyakiṃparatadetacchabdāḥ krameṇātrapadye sarvādigaṇapaṭhitā evopanibaddhā iti dhyeyam | atra prakṛtāprakṛtagocaraśśleṣaḥ | prakṛtārthakakṣyāyāṃ bhagavatassarvādigaṇyatāyāḥ pūrvavākyārthena samarthanātkāvyaliṅgaṃ sarvādigaṇaprasiddhasahapāṭhānāmekādiśabdānāṃ nyasanādratnāvalī caikavācakānupraveśena saṃkīryante | prasiddhakramaviparyāse'pi ratnāvalī bhavatyeveti nirūpitamadhastāttadalaṃkāranirūpaṇāvasare || sarvādau nātha bhavānasmādasmiṃtsamullasati ja gati | paridṛśyatāmanīdṛkpara itarassama ito'sti ko nāma || 2189 || he nātha! bhavān sarvādau sarvasya jagataḥ ādau samullasati prakāśate | sarvajagatkāraṇabhūta ityarthaḥ | asmāt etasmāt tvattaḥ samullasatītyāvṛttyā yojanīyam | samullasati prādurbhāvaṃ prāpte ityarthaḥ | asmin jagati bhuvane anīdṛk anevaṃvidhaḥ tvamiva na jagatkāraṇamityarthaḥ | itaḥ asmāttvattaḥ paraḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ samastulyo vā itaraḥ konāma asti? paridṛśyatāṃ paryālocyatāmityarthaḥ | sarvajagakāraṇabhūtasya tava kāryabhūte asmin brahmādistambaparyante bhuvane īdṛśajagatkāraṇatāvidhuraḥ tvatkāryabhūtaḥ ko'nyastvatto'pyutkṛṣṭassamo vā syāditi bhāvaḥ | 'na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate' iti śruteḥ || anyatra he nātha! bhavān bhavacchabdaḥ sarvādau sarvādigaṇe asmāt avidyamānaḥ ṅasisthānikaḥ smādityādeśo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | asmin avidyamānaḥ ṅisthānikaḥ sminnityādeśo yasya sa tathoktaśca samullasati | bhavacchabdasya sarvanāmagaṇapaṭhitatve'pi halantatayā adantanimittakau 'ṅasiṅyoḥ smātsminau' iti vihitau smātsminnādeśau na bhavata iti bhāvaḥ | itaḥ asmin sarvanāmagaṇe sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | paraḥ paraśabdaḥ itaraḥ itaraśabdaḥ samaḥ samaśabdaḥ kaḥ kiṃśabdaśca | anīdṛśaḥ bhavacchabda iva smātsminnādeśavidhuro na bhavatītyarthaḥ | uktānāmeteṣāṃ sarvanāmagaṇapaṭhitānāṃ parādiśabdānāmajantatayā smātsminnādeśayoravaśyaṃbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | atra prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣaḥ varṇyasya bhagavata upamā'niṣpattivacanarūpapradīpabhedaścetyanayorekavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā tvaṃ sarvanāmavācyassarvādyantasthito yadasi viśvam | tvadadharaṃ itaro yo'cyuta nemamihatyaṃ bruve tathā kamapi || 2190 || he acyuta! tvaṃ sarvanāmavācyaḥ sarvairnāmabhiḥ brahmādināmabhiḥ vācyaḥ asi | tatra hetumāha yat yasmātkāraṇāt sarvasya jagataḥ ādāvante ca sthitaḥ | antasthita ityatra antemadhye'pi sthita iti ca yojanīyam | ata eva viśvaṃ asi | sarvajagaccharīrako'si | ‘yato vā imāni bhūtāni' ityādiśrutyuktaprakriyayā jagajjanmasthitipralayanidānatayā sarvaśarīrakatvāccharīravācināṃ śabdānāṃ śarīriparyantatayā brahmādisarvaśabdavācyo'sītyarthaḥ | ‘atha puruṣo ha vai nārāyaṇo'kāmayata prajāssṛjeyeti' ityupakramya ‘nārāyaṇātsamutpadyante nārāyaṇe pravartante nārāyaṇe pralīyante' ityantā ‘brahmā nārāyaṇaḥ śivaśca nārāyaṇaḥ' ityupakramya ‘nārāyaṇa evedaṃ sarvaṃm' ityantā ca śrutirarthato'nusaṃhitā evaṃ jagadbrahmaṇoḥ kāryakāraṇatvanibandhanasāmānādhikaraṇyapratipādikāḥ ‘tatsṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśat tadanupraviśya sacca tyaccābhavat' ityādayaḥ śrutayo'pīhānusandheyāḥ | yaḥ itaraḥ tvadadharaḥ tatto'pi nyūnaḥ | ihatyaṃ ihetyavyayāt ‘amehakvatasitrebhya eva' iti niyamitaḥ ‘avyayāttyap' iti tyap | tvatkāryabhūte'smin jagatyutpannaṃ imaṃ pūrvoktaṃ kamapi brahmāṇamapi tathā na bruve tvāmiva sarvakāraṇatayā sarvaśarīrakatayā ca sarvaśabdavācyaṃ santaṃ na vacmi | tasya sarvasyāpyanevaṃbhūtatvāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe viśvaṃ viśvaśabdaḥ tvat tvacchabdaḥ adharaḥ adharaśabdaḥ itaraḥ itaraśabdaḥ yaḥ yaccha bdaśca sarvanāmavācyaḥ sarvanāmasaṃjñakatvenokta ityarthaḥ | tatra hetumāha yat yasmāt sarvādigaṇasyānte madhye sthitaḥ 'sarvādīni sarvanāmāni' ityanuśāsanāditi bhāvaḥ | iha asmin sarvādigaṇe nemaṃ nemaśabdaṃ tyaṃ tyacchabdaṃ ca bruve paṭhāmi | tathā kamapi kiṃśabdamapi sarvādyantasthitaṃ bruve iti yojanā | kiṃśabdasya sarvādigaṇāvasāne paṭhitatvāt | samāsoktipratīpabhedayorekavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ || yathāvā ādau sarvaṃ vyadadhāttadanu ca tadbrahma viśvamavati samam | antassvaṃ paramavaraṃ cādadhadidamanyadantataḥ kiṃ syāt || 2191 || tadbrahma ādau agre sarvaṃ vyadadhāt asrākṣīt | tadanu sarjanātantaraṃ samaṃ mayā śriyā sahitaṃ tadbrahma viśvaṃ avati rakṣati || lakṣmyā saha hṛṣīkeśo devyā kāruṇyarūpayā | rakṣakassarvasiddhānte vedānteṣvapi gīyate || ityukteḥ | antataḥ pralayāvasare paraṃ brahmādikamutkṛṣṭaṃ avaraṃ taditaramapakṛṣṭaṃ ca idaṃ viśvaṃ antassvaṃ svasminnityarthaḥ ādadhat nyasyat anyat kiṃ syāt sarjanāvanakartṛ brahmavyatiriktaṃ saṃhartu vastu kimitaratsyāt | tasyaiva 'yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante' ityādiśrutibhirjagajjanmasthemapralayahetutāpratipādanāditi bhāvaḥ | atra "kasyodare haravirañcimukhaḥ prapañcaḥ ko rakṣatīmamajaniṣṭa ca kasya nābheḥ" ityādikamapi smartavyam || pakṣe tadbrahma ādau sarvādigaṇasyārambhe sarvaṃ sarvaśabdaṃ vyadadhāt vidhatte sma | tadanu sarvaśabdanyāsānantarameva viśvaṃ viśvaśabdaṃ ca avati rakṣati nyasyatīti bhāvaḥ | antaḥ viśva kiṃśabdayorantarāle samaṃ svaṃ paraṃ avaraṃ anyaśca samasvaparāvarānyaśabdān nātra kramavivakṣā | ādadhat nyadadhāt | dadhāteḥ parasmaipadino laṅ | antataḥ gaṇāvasāne kiṃ kiṃśabdaḥ syāt tena nyasto bhavet | sarvādigaṇe ādau sarvaviśvaśabdayoḥ antarāle samaparāvarānyaśabdānāmavasāne kiṃśabdasya ca darśanāditi bhāvaḥ | atra parabrahmāṇi prastute aprastutasya śābdikamunervṛttāntaḥ pratīyata iti samāsoktiḥ | śrutyuktasya sṛṣṭyādeḥ śabdanayasiddhasarvādigaṇaprakriyāyāśca krameṇa nyasanādratnāvalī ca śleṣasaṃkīrṇe ekavācakānupraviṣṭe iti draṣṭavyam || yathāvā bhavadubhayānyatarasya svarūpamiha sarvamukhagaṇe gaṇanīyam | bhavitā śrīsakha na tathā jātvapi caramālpakatipayānyatamasya || 2192 || he śrīsakha! idaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇārthopaskārakam | bhavadubhayānyatarasya śrīśca bhavāṃśca bhavantau ‘tyadādīni sarvairnityam' iti bhavacchabdaikaśeṣaḥ | bhavadrūpaṃ yadubhayaṃ mithunaṃ tadanyatarasya śriyāḥ bhavataśceti bhāvaḥ | svarūpaṃ sarvakāraṇatvasarvaśeṣitvādirūpaṃ iha loke sarveṣāṃ janānāṃ mukhagaṇe vadanasamūhe gaṇanīyaṃ sarvairapi sarvatra kaṇṭharaveṇa pratipādyamiti bhāvaḥ | carame arvāktanāḥ alpe nihīnāḥ ye katipayāḥ caturmukhādayo'pīti bhāvaḥ | teṣvanyatamasya yasyakasyāpīti bhāvaḥ | svarūpaṃ tathā sarvamukhagaṇagaṇanīyaṃ na bhavitā | sarveṣāmapyatathātvāditi bhāvaḥ || pakṣe bhavāṃśca ubhayaścānyataraśca eteṣāṃ samāhāraḥ tasya bhavadubhayānyatarasya | eteṣāṃ śabdānāṃ svarūpaṃ iha śabdaśāstre sarvamukhagaṇe sarvādigaṇe gaṇanīyaṃ, teṣāṃ tatra paṭhitatvāt | caramālpakatipayānyatamasya caramālpakatipayānyatamaśabdānāṃ pūrvavatsamāhāraḥ | svarūpaṃ tathā bhavadādiśabdavatsarvādigaṇapaṭhitaṃ jātvapi na bhavitā | teṣāṃ tatrāpaṭhitatayā ‘prathamacarama, iti sūtreṇa jasyeva teṣāṃ pṛthaksarvanāmatāvidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | atra prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣaparisaṃkhyāparikarāṅkurāṇāmekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā nanu sarvanāmatābhāgvyavasthito dakṣiṇassapūrvaśca | devottaro yathā'yaṃ paro'varo'pyavyavasthito na tathā || 2193 || pūrvaḥ sarvajagatkāraṇabhūtaḥ ‘sadeva somyedamagra āsīt | pūrvamevāhamihāsam | kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ pūrvam' ityādipramāṇāt | dakṣiṇaḥ ‘tadaikṣata bahu syām' ityādyuktaprakriyayā svasaṃkalpamātrānuguṇajagatsarjanādicāturyaśālī | mahodāra ityapyupaskāryam | vyavasthitaḥ ‘antaḥ praviṣṭaśśāstā janānāṃ sarvātmā' ityādyuktarītyā sarvajagatyantaḥ praviśya niyantā! antaraṅgairapi doṣadarśakairakṣubhitacittatayā sthirapratijña ityapyupaskāryam || dyauḥ patetpṛthivī śīryeddhimavān śakalībhavet | śuṣyettoyanidhiḥ kṛṣṇe na me moghaṃ vaco bhavet || iti tenaivoktatvāt | soyaṃ devottaraḥ devaśreṣṭho bhagavān yathā sarvanāmatābhāk sarvaśabdavācyo bhavati | avyavasthitaḥ jagatkāraṇatvāntaḥpraviśyaniyantṛtvādivyavasthāvidhura ityarthaḥ | cañcalacittatayā pratijñātārthanirvahaṇākṣama ityapyupaskāryam | avaraḥ bhagavadapekṣayā nyūnaḥ paraḥ anyaḥ brahmarudrādirapi na tathā nanu | sarvajagatkāraṇatvādinibandhanāṃ sarvanāmavācyatāṃ na bhajate khalviti bhāvaḥ || pakṣe he deva! so'yaṃ buddhisthaḥ dakṣiṇaḥ dakṣiṇaśabdaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvaśabdaḥ uttaraḥ uttaraśabdaḥ paraḥ paraśabdaḥ avaraḥ ‘avaraśabdaśca vyavasthitaḥ vyavāsthāṃ prāptasssan vyavasthā ca ‘svābhidheyāpekṣāvadhiniyamaḥ' ityāhuḥ | yathā sarvanāmatābhāk sarvanāmasaṃjñāṃ prāptaḥ avyavasthitaḥ vyavasthāmaprāptaḥ pūrvoktaḥ dakṣiṇādiśabdaḥ na tathā sarvanāmasaṃjñābhāṅna bhavatītyarthaḥ | ‘pūrvaparāvaradakṣiṇottarāparādharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām' iti vyavasthāyāmeva teṣāṃ sarvanāmatābhāktvasya vyavasthāhetukatvādatathātvasyāvyavasthitatāhetukatvācca kāvyaliṅgadvayaṃ prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣeṇaikavācakānupraviṣṭam || yathāvā svakareṇa tavāṅghriruciṃ jihīrṣurabhyetya purata eva tayā | nirvāsito'mba dhūto vāsarakara eṣa dhūsarakaro'bhūt || 2194 || he amba! eṣa vāsarakaraḥ bhānuḥ svakareṇa nijena hastena kiraṇena ca | tava aṅghriruciṃ caraṇaśriyaṃ na tu pāṇiśriyaṃ jihīrṣuḥ abhyetya abhimukhamāgatya abhyamitrīṇo bhūtveti bhāvaḥ | tayā rucyā striyeti bhāvaḥ | purata eva svāvāsādgṛhādeva nagarādeva vā ‘agāre nagare puram' ityamaraḥ | nirvāsitaḥ prasiddhaṃ hi mahāparādhināṃ niṣkāsanam | ataeva dhūtaḥ punarapi kīdṛśo daṇḍassyādveti kampitassan | yadvā purata eva dehādeva nirvāsitaḥ saṃhṛta ityarthaḥ | dhūtaḥ dehāntaraṃ prāpyāpi prāgbhavavāsa nayā kampita ityarthaḥ | ‘puraṃ napuṃsakaṃ gehe dehe' iti medinī | dhūsarāḥ īṣatpāṇḍavaḥ karāḥ yasya sa tathā abhūt atimātramandadyutirāsīditi bhāvaḥ | śvitripāṇirabhūditi ca gamyate || pakṣe vāsarakaraśabdaḥ purata eva agrabhāga eva vāsitaḥ vākāreṇa saṃbaddhaḥ sa na bhavatīti nirvāsitaḥ | niścala ityādāviva niśśabdo nañsamānārthakaḥ | avidyamānavākāra ityarthaḥ | dhūtaḥ vākārasthāna eva dhū iti varṇena ūtaḥ dhūsarakara iti nirapadyateti vastusthitiḥ | atra purata ityādiśleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyopajīvitaṃ vāsarakarasya dhūsarakaratvarūpāniṣṭāvāptilakṣaṇaviṣamam | aprastutavāsarakarakartṛkaśrīcaraṇarucicauryādikāryeṇa tatkāraṇībhūtāyāśśrīcaraṇaruceḥ ko'pyatiśayo dyotyata iti kāryanibandhanā'prastutapraśaṃsā ca kāvyaliṅgena saha ekavācakānupraviṣṭe || yathāvā tāvakagiryapavāhitamabjekṣaṇa pāpanāśanaṃ bata tīrtham | dramiḍā eva na kevalamabhidadhate pāvanāśanaṃ sarve'pi || 2195 || he abjekṣaṇa! tāvakagireḥ śeṣādreḥ apavāhitaṃ pravāhitaṃ pāvanāśanaṃ tannāmānaṃ tīrthaṃ dramiḍā eva dramiḍadeśajā eva kevalaṃ pāvanāśanaṃ tīrthamiti nābhidadhate | apitu sarve sarvadeśajā api janāḥ abhidadhate | batetyāścarye | dramiḍānāṃ anādipakārasya vakāratayoccāraṇasyāgastyavyākaraṇaśikṣitatayā pāvanāśanamityuktiryuktaiva | anyadeśajanyānāṃ tathoccāraṇamāścaryāvavahameveti bhāvaḥ | pavanāśanasya girirūpadharasya śeṣasya saṃba ndhi pāvanāśanamiti vā pavanāśanānāṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ saṃbandhīti vā pāvanaṃ aśanaṃ prāśanaṃ yasyeti vā virodhaḥ parihāryaḥ | ataeva niruktyalaṃkāraḥ | pakṣe tāvakagiri tvadīyavāci apavāhitaṃ apaṃ avidyamānapakāraṃ vāhitaṃ pakārasthāna eva vakāreṇa āhitaṃ pāpanāśanaśabdaṃ pāvanāśanamityabhidadhate sarvadeśyā apītyarthaḥ | atra tulyayogitāniruktyorekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā tvadanugṛhītaḥ puruṣo nigṛhītaśca tvayā bata murāre | sahamahiṣīko'dhivasatyaryamaśubhraṃ subhūriparyaṅkam || 2196 || he murāre! tvayā anugṛhītaḥ nigṛhītaśca pumān sahamahiṣīkassan āryamā bhānuriva śubhraṃ uddīpra 'śubhramuddīpraśuklayāḥ' ityamaraḥ | ‘śubhraṃ syādabhrake klībamuddīpraśuklayoḥ triṣu' iti medinī ca | subhūriparyaṅkaṃ śobhanasuvarṇamañcaṃ adhivasati kṛtābhiṣekābhirdevībhissaha mahīyāṃsaṃ vibhavamanubhavati mahārājo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ‘bhūrirnā vāsudeve ca hare ca parameṣṭhini | napuṃsakaṃ suvarṇe ca prājñe syādvācyaliṅgakaḥ' iti medinī | tvayā'nugṛhīta īdṛśo bhavatīti yuktam | nigṛhīto'pyevaṃvidho bhavatītyāścaryaṃ batenyanena sūcyate | parihārastu mahiṣībhissairibhībhissaha vartata iti tathoktassan | aryamaśubhraṃ ityatra aryaṃ aśubhramiti chedaḥ | aśubhraṃ kaluṣaṃ subhūri atimātrasphītaṃ aryaṃ ryavarṇavidhuraṃ paryaṅkaṃ paṅkamityarthaḥ | adhivasati mahiṣajanma vindatīti bhāvaḥ | atra tulyayogitāyāḥ śleṣojjīvitāyāḥ tathāvidhasamavibhāvanālaṃkārayoścaikavācakānupraveśalakṣaṇassakaraḥ || yathāvā tvatpadanateṣu yeṣāṃ gauravamābhāti garatayaiva sadā | vindante te mandā mukunda tadgauravaṃ padaṃ niyatam || 2197 || he mukunda! tvatpadanateṣu tvaccaraṇaśaraṇakṛtsu viṣaye gauravaṃ bahumatiḥ yeṣāṃ janānāṃ garatayaiva viṣatvenaiva ābhāti dveṣyaṃ bhavatīti yāvat | mandāḥ abhāgyāḥ
