te janāḥ rauravaṃ narakaviśeṣarūpaṃ tat durantaduritasantatiphalabhūtaduḥkhasahasrānubhāvakaṃ padaṃ sthānaṃ vindante | bhagavatpadanyastabharamahābhāgavatāvamantāro mahāntameva nirayaṃ prapadyanta iti nirgalito'rthaḥ | anyatra yeṣāṃ janānāṃ gauravamiti padaṃ garatayā gasya gakārasya ratayā rephavarṇatvena ābhāti te amandā iti chedaḥ kuśalā ityarthaḥ | te janāḥ tatpadaṃ gauravapadaṃ rauravamiti jānantīti yāvat | uktarītyā gauravaśabdasya rauravatvāvāpteriti bhāvaḥ | atra vākyārthahetukaṃ kāvyaliṅgaṃ prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣaḥ bhāgavatamahimaguṇena tadanādarajanyadoṣodayalakṣaṇa ullāsālaṃkāraścaikavācakānupraviṣṭāni || yathāvā bhagavan sadātana tvāṃ na tadāseti pratīpadṛgbrūtām | saṃbodhayāmahe taṃ puruṣaṃ tvādṛtya tena kā hāniḥ || 2198 || he bhagavan he sadātana! purāṇapuruṣetyarthaḥ | pratīpadṛk śāstrasiddhārthapratyanīkadarśī janaḥ tvāṃ sadātanamiti bhāvaḥ | na tadāseti tadā sṛṣṭeḥ prākkāle nāsa nāsīt iti brūtāṃ 'nāsadā sīnno sadāsīttadānīm' iti śrutiśakalamātrāpātapratīyamānārthaparituṣṭatayā sarvajñaṃmanyo'nṛjudhīrevaṃ brūtām, tatsvabhāvasthitireva tādṛśīti bhāvaḥ | āseti tiṅantapratirūpakamavyayam | pakṣe sadātaneti varṇānupūrvaviparītaṃ paśyato janasya natadāseti bhāsata iti pratīpadṛśastathoktirbhavatunāmetyarthaḥ | taṃ evaṃ viruddhārthadraṣṭāraṃ viparītānupūrvīdarśinaṃ ca puruṣaṃ tu ādṛtya saṃbodhayāmahe maivaṃ vādīriti sāntvayitvā samyakpaśyetyāvedayāmahe śāstrārtham || ajñānāya tu yo jñānaṃ dadyāddharmopadeśanam | kṛtsnāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ dadyāttena tulyaṃ na tatphalam || ityajñāya jñānadānasya mahāphalatvaśravaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | tena tādṛśapratīpavacanena kā hāniḥ ? evaṃ bodhito'pyayaṃ pratīpavāditāṃ na tyajaticettadvacanena tava na kā'pi hānirbhavet pratyuta tasyaiveti bhāvaḥ | yadvā taṃ sadātanatvena prasiddhaṃ ata eva puruṣaṃ 'pūrvamevāhamihāsamiti tatpuruṣasya puruṣatvam' iti nirvacanagocaraṃ kālāparicchinnamityarthaḥ | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ deśavastuparicchedarāhityasyāpi | tvā ādṛtyeti chedaḥ | tvā tvāṃ tena natadāsetyanena saṃbodhayāmahe | natāḥ praṇatāḥ dāsāḥ ‘dāsabhūtāssvatassarve hyātmānaḥ paramātmanaḥ' ityādyuktarītyā dāsabhūtāḥ brahmeśānādayaḥ yasyeti vigṛhya saṃbudhyantena tena padena āmantrayāmahe iti bhāvaḥ | tenetyāvartyate | tena pratīpavacanena kā hāniḥ tava na kā'pi hāniḥ pratyuta sarveśvaratvamevoktaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | atra pratīpadarśikathitavacanasyārthāntaraparikalpanalakṣaṇavakroktyalaṃkāreṇa tādṛśavacanarūpadoṣeṇa hānirūpadoṣānudayavarṇanātmakollāsālaṃkāra ekavācakānupraviṣṭatayā saṃkīrṇaḥ || yathāvā viparītadṛksanātana natanāsetyāha cedbravītu tvām | kassudṛganavadhikakṛponnasamācaṣṭe'cyutāvanāṭaṃ tvām || 2199 || he sanātana purāṇapuruṣa! viparītaddak yathāvasthitaviruddhagrāhī pumān tvāṃ sāmudrikoktamahāpuruṣalakṣaṇasarvasvaśālinamiti bhāvaḥ | natā nimnā nāsā yasya sa natanāsaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he natanāsa ityāhacet bravītu kāmaṃ brūtāṃ ko'sya niroddhā na hi viparītadṛśassudṛgbhiryathāvaduktamapyarthamupādadata iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe yavana iva pratilomavaṇadarśā sanātaneti śabdaṃ natanāseti brūtāmityarthaścamatkārātiśayāya | sudṛk samyagdraṣṭā kaḥ pumān he niravadhikakṛpa he acyuta! unnasaṃ 'śucismitaṃ komalagaṇḍamunnasam' ityuktarītyā unnatanāsikaṃ tvāṃ avanāṭaṃ natanāsikaṃ ācaṣṭe | na kaścidapi sudṛktathā brūyāditi bhāvaḥ | 'avātkuṭārācca' iti pūrvasūtrāt anuvṛttādavaśabdāt ‘nate nāsikāyāssaṃjñāyāṃ ṭīṭac nāṭac bhraṭacaḥ' iti nāṭacpratyayaḥ | nāsikāyā nataṃ avanāṭaṃ tadyogānnāsikā avanāṭā | puruṣo'vanāṭaḥ | ‘avaṭīṭo'vanāṭaścāvabhraṭo natanāsike' ityamaraḥ | yadvā nāsayati na sthāpayatīti nāsaḥ āsaṃrṇijantāt pacādyac naśabdena samāsaḥ | natānāṃ nāsaḥ natanāsaḥ praṇatajananiśśeṣayitetyarthaḥ | tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he natanāsa! iti bravītu anavadhikakṛpayā unnaḥ ārdraḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he anavadhikakṛponna! 'samunnamuttaṃ ca' ityamaraḥ | he acyuta tvāṃ evaṃ paramakāruṇikamiti bhāvaḥ | avanāṭayatītyavanāṭaḥ tathoktaṃ ‘naṭa avaskandane' curādiḥ | avaskandanaṃ hiṃsanaṃ tasmāt pacādyac | samācaṣṭe vadati paramakaruṇākaraṃ tvāṃ na ko'pi sudṛk hiṃsakaṃ bravītīti | bhāvaḥ | atra viparītadṛktvasya natanāsetyuktiṃ prati sudṛktvasyāvanāṭa ityanuktiṃ prati ca hetutvātkāvyaliṅgadvayam | viparītadṛggataduruktidoṣeṇa bhagavato'vanāṭatvarūpadoṣānudayalakṣaṇāvajñālaṃkāraścaikavācakānupraviṣṭe || yathāvā māyūraṃ śekharitaṃ nandakiśora tvayeti mādyattvāt | bhūtvā mukhe sakekaṃ keyūrībhūya bhūṣayati bāhum || 2200 || he nandakiśora! mayūrasyāvayavo māyūraṃ ‘avayave ca prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyaḥ' ityavayavarūpārthe vaikāriko'ṇ | mayūrapiñchamityarthaḥ | idaṃ kartṛ tvayā śekharitaṃ śekharavatkṛtaṃ alaṃkṛtamityarthaḥ | yadvā śekharaḥ kṛtaṃ śekharitaṃ parāṃ kāṣṭhāmutkarṣasya prāpitamityarthaḥ | avataṃsatayā dhṛtamiti tu tattvam | iti hetoḥ mādyattvāt mādyato bhāvaḥ mādyattvaṃ tasmāt mādyateśśatrāntādbhāve tvapratyayaḥ | mādyattvaṃ ca niṣkṛṣyamāṇaṃ madasaṃbandha eva ‘kṛttaddhitasamāseṣu saṃmbandhābhidhānaṃ tvatalau' iti śābdikokteḥ | harṣātirekaprayuktamadādityarthaḥ | māḥ mākāraḥ ādyo yasya tat mādyaṃ tasya bhāvaḥ mādyattvaṃ tasmāt takārasya ‘anaci ca' iti dvitvaṃ | māyūraśabdasya tathātvāditi bhāvaḥ | lyablope pañcamī | mākārādyattvaṃ vihāyetyarthaḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyam | mukhe vadane sakekaṃ kekayā mayūravāṇyā saha sartata iti sakekaṃ svāvayavibhūtamayūravat svayamapi madapāravaśyātkekāravaṃ vitanvadityatiśayoktiḥ | anyatra mukhe māvarṇavighaṭite ādibhāge sakekaṃ kevarṇena sahavartata iti tathoktamityarthaḥ | ‘śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap | bhūtvā keyūrībhūya aṅgadaṃ saṃpadyamānaṃ bhūtvā uktarītyā keyūrapadaṃ bhūtveti cārthaḥ | bāhuṃ tava bhujaṃ bhūṣayati | svaśekharīkaraṇapratyupacikīrṣayā bahumānayatīti bhāvaḥ | alaṃkarotīti vastusthitiḥ | keyūrasya mayūrapiñchatādātmyasaṃbhāvanayā tasya marakatamaṇimayatvaṃ dyotyate | atra bhagavanmayūrapiñchayoḥ parasparopakāravarṇanādanyonyālaṃkāraḥ utprekṣayā ekavācakānupraviṣṭaḥ || yathāvā mālūraṃ tatra kucayugajigīṣu tenāntarevagamitalayam | māyūraṃ bhūtvā'tha tvanmaulivilāsi nandasutalalane || 2201 || mālūraṃ bilvaphalaṃ mālūramiti padaṃ ca | tava kucayugajigīṣu sat ataeva tena kucayugena | antareva kenāpyavijñātameveti bhāvaḥ | gamitalayaṃ prāpitapralayaṃ sat atha anantaraṃ māyūraṃ mayūrabarhaṃ bhūtvā | pakṣe antaḥ madhyabhāga eva gamitaḥ utsāritaḥ laḥ lakāro yena tādṛśo yaḥ yakāraḥ yasya tattathābhūtaṃ mālūrapadaṃ madhyasthalakārotsāraṇena tatraiva yakāreṇa saṃgamitaṃ sat māyūramiti niṣpannamityarthaḥ | tyanmaulau vilāsi vilasanaśīlaṃ bhavati | vairaniryātanāya sākṣātpratipakṣabhūtāyāstava śiro'dhirohatīti bhāvaḥ | nandasutalalane iti saṃbodhanaṃ māyūrapiñchaṃ tasyeva tavā'pi śekharībhavatītyabhiprāyagarbham | tvanmauliḥ tava dhamilla iva vilāsīti tu tattvam | ‘mauliḥ kirīṭe dhamille cūḍāyāmanapuṃsakam' iti medinī | barhatvāvasthāṃ prāpya tvatkaba rīsāmyamabhajateti bhāvaḥ | atra viṣamapratyanīkaparikarāṅkurāṇāmekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā nirbhāsilatā tvattanudhutā'tha tatparibhavecchayā'vanitanaye | syādvā'laṅkāviṣṭā bhraṣṭā svārthādbhavettu nirbhāsikatā || 2202 || he avanitanaye janakanandini! idaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇārthānuguṇyāya | nirbhāsinī atiśayena bhāsanaśīlā ca sā latā ca nirbhāsilatā | tvattanvā tāvakamūrtyā dhutā tiraskṛteti yāvat | atha tasyāḥ tvattanvāḥ paribhavecchayā laṅkāviṣṭā syādvā tvatparābhavāya ekākṣyekakarṇādivadiyamapi laṅkāṃ praviśatu vā | tāvatā'pi nirbhāḥ vigatabhāḥ sikatā vālukā satī svārthāt svābhīpsitatvattanuparābhavarūpātprayojanādbraṣṭā bhavet | anavāptamanorathā prāptāniṣṭā ca bhavedityarthaḥ || pakṣe nirbhāsilatāśabdaḥ alaṃ avidyamānalakāraṃ yathāsyāttathā kāviṣṭā tatraiva praveśitakakarā satī nirbhāsikateti niṣpannā svārthāt svābhidheyāt prakāśamānalatātvarūpāt bhraṣṭā bhavet nirbhāsilatetyānupūrvyā yādṛśarthaḥ pratyāyyate nirbhāsikatetyānupūrvyāḥ tādṛśārthapratyāyanāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | atrāprastutapraśaṃsāviṣamau ekavācakānupraviṣṭau || yathāvā tvatpadanakharucimoṣaṇakṛtarucirapaśadatayā phaṇigirīndo | viśadamayūkho'pi paraṃ vimayūkho bhavati nātra saṃdehaḥ || 2203 || he phaṇigirīndo! viśadamayūkhaḥ svacchāṃśurapi tvatpadanakharuceḥ moṣaṇe caurye kṛtaruciḥ prarūḍhābhilāṣaḥ ataeva apaśadatayā jālmatayā ‘nihīno'paśado jālmaḥ' ityamaraḥ | paraṃ vimayūkhaḥ vigalitatejāḥ ‘mayūkhastviṭkarajvālāsu' ityamaraḥ | bhavati | pakṣe viśadamayūkhaśabdaḥ apaśadatayā apagatau śadau śakāradakārau yasya sa tathoktaḥ tasya bhāvastattā tayā vimayūkha iti niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ | atra virodhābhāsaviṣamātiśayoktīnāmekavācakānupraviṣṭatā || yathāvā bhāratarasā'khilā'cyuta bhāvatkaiḥ kvāpyavasthitairvimalā | pratilomavarṇabhāgapi ṛkṣai rātrīva sāratarabhaiva || 2204 || he acyuta! akhilā'pi bhāratarasā bhāratavarṣabhūmiḥ pratilomavarṇaṃ ‘brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyājjātaḥ' ityādyuktavidhaṃ saṃkīrṇavarṇaṃ bhajatīti tathoktā'pi tamaḥpracuratayā nīlavarṇabhāgapīti ca | kvāpyavasthitairapi ‘kvaciktvacinmahābhāga' ityuktarītyā kvaciktvacidavasthitairapītyarthaḥ | bhāvatkaiḥ bhavadīyaiḥ ṛkṣaiḥ nakṣatraiḥ rātrīva vimalā nirdoṣā svacchā ca satī sāratarā śreṣṭhatarā bhā dīptiḥ yasyāssā tathoktaiva bhavati | pakṣe akhilā samagravarṇā bhāratarasā bhārataraseti śabdavyaktiḥ pratilomavarṇabhāgapi pratikūlākṣarā satī sāratarabhetyeva niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ | atra pratilomavarṇabhāktvarūpapratibandhakasadbhāve'pi sāratarabhātvarūpakāryodayalakṣaṇavibhāvanāviśeṣasya upamāyāśca ekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā sakalajagadadhipatiṃ tvāṃ vṛṣagiripatiriti vadantu nāma janāḥ | viṣṇussa parvatānāmadhipatiriti kathamanādivāgbrūte || 2205 || janāḥ pāmarā ityarthaḥ | ‘jano loke maharlokātparaloke'pi pāmare' iti viśvaḥ | atra niraṅkuśanikhilajagadaiśvaryasya bhagavataśśrīnivāsasya yatkiñcitparicchinnaśailamātrādhīśvaratvaṃ śrutyā pratipāditamapyanupādeyameveti tatpratikṣepāya ‘viṣṇu parvatānāmadhipatiḥ' iti śruterupanyāsācchabdapramāṇālaṃkāraḥ pūrvottarārdhapratipādyasamaviṣamālaṃkārābhyāmekavācakānupraviṣṭaḥ || vipulabhavāmbhonidhiśuktirohitāścoddhṛtāstataḥ kāle | muktatvāddivyaguṇāssanmaṇayo'cyuta bhavanti te'grasarāḥ || 2206 || he acyuta! vipulaḥ yo bhavāmbhonidhiḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ tasya śukū tatsambandhinī śokaḥ idamupalakṣaṇamaśanāyāpipāsādyūrmīṇām | tayā tirohitāḥ ācchāditasvābhāvikasvasvarūpā iti yāvat | anyatra vipulaṃ yathā tathā bhavaḥ vidyamānaḥ yaḥ ambhonidhiḥ tasya yāḥ śuktayaḥ muktāsphoṭāḥ tāsu rohitāḥ svātivarṣajalabindubhiḥ prādurbhāvitā ityarthaḥ | caśabdo bhinnakramaḥ | tataḥ kālaṃ ‘vidhipariṇatibhedādvīkṣitastena kāle' ityuktaprakriyayā yādṛcchikādisukṛtaparipākāvasare | anyatra nadyāṃ tatra svātige'rke śuktisthā varṣabindavaḥ | ṣaḍbhirmāsairghanībhūtā jāyante śuddhamauktikāḥ || ityukte paripākasamaye nadyāṃ tāmraparṇyāṃ tatra sāgarasaṃgamapradeśe iti tadarthaḥ | uddhṛtāḥ dayānidhibhirācāryairupāyānuṣṭhānādinā ujjīvitāḥ itaratra śilpibhirudañcitā ityarthaḥ | idaṃ kṛtasuṣiratvasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | muktatvāt prakṛtibandhaviyuktatvāt | pakṣe mauktikatvāt muktāyāḥ bhāvaḥ muktatvaṃ 'tve ca' iti tvapratyaye pare āpo hrasvaḥ | divyāḥ guṇāḥ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ āvirbhūtāpahatapāpmatvādibrāhmaguṇāḥ ramaṇīyasuvarṇatantuprautāścetyarthaḥ | sanmaṇayaḥ brahmavicchreṣṭhāḥ ramaṇīyaratnāni ca te tava agrasarāḥ purovartinaḥ śreṣṭhahārāśca bhavanti | atra prakṛtāprakṛtayorvidvadratnayośśleṣaḥ | uktānāṃ vipulabhavāmbhonidhiśuktirohitatvādīnāmarthānāṃ kramikatvādratnāvalī caikavākyānupraviṣṭe || yathāvā rucimadatassaudāmani valgasyabhre ramāprabhābhihatā | patitā'dhaśśīrṣaṃ tvaṃ nimadāsau syā yadā tadā'vaiṣi || 2207 || sudāmnā adriṇā ekadik saudāmanī | taṭit ‘tenaikadik' iti prāgdīvyatīye ekadigityarthe aṇ ‘an' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ he saudāmani! śucimadataḥ mamaiva dyutirlokottareti garvāt abhre antarikṣe valgasīti lokoktiḥ | jaladhare sphurasīti tattvam | ramāprabhayā abhihatā ataeva adhaśīrṣaṃ patitā satī | asau evaṃ valgantī tvaṃ nimadā niśabdapūrvako'yaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ nivāta ityādivat | nirgalitarucimattvagarvetyarthaḥ | yadā syāḥ tadā avaiṣīti lokoktiḥ | udvalganaphalaṃ tadā jānāsi kimidānīṃ jānāsīti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe saudāmanīti saṃbuddhyantaśśabdaḥ vilomatve nimadāsau iti niṣpadyata ityarthaścamatkārāya | atra aprastutasaudāmanīgarvaśāntipraśaṃsayā tatkāraṇabhūtaramāprabhāyāstato'timātrojjvalattvaṃ pratīyata iti kāryanibandhanā aprastutapraśaṃsā | ramāprabhābhihatetyasyādhaśśīrṣapatanaṃ prati hetutvātkāvyaliṅgaṃ lokoktiśca ekavācakānupraveśena saṃkīryante || yathāvā devi tvadapāṅgajitastaṃ jetuṃ yadi śivatvameveyāt | tadapi na jetuṃ prabhavecchilīmukho'pi tu valīmukhatvamiyāt || 2208 || he devi! śilīmukhaḥ rolambaḥ kalambo vā ‘alibāṇau śilīmukhau' ityamaraḥ | tava apāṅgena locanāñcalena tvatsutenānaṅgenetyapi gamyate | ‘apāṅgatsvaṅgahīne syānnetrānte tilake'pica' iti | śivatvameva trilocanatvameva iyātprāpnuyādyadi tadapi tadā'pi jetuṃ na prabhavet | apitu valīmukhatvaṃ kapitvameva iyāt | śilīmukhaśabdaḥ śivatvaṃ śivarṇasya vakāratvaṃ śivarṇāpanayanena tatraiva vavarṇavattvameyādyadi valīmukha iti niṣpadyeteti vāstavārthaḥ | śabdārthatādātmyavaibhavaṃ na prasmartavyam | atra viṣamāprastutapraśaṃsayorekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā tāvakaguṇānuvādī tāmarasadalākṣa tadapavādī ca | bhavamayapārāvāre bhavitā sukhago mahāplavaścitram || 2209 || tapavādī tāvakaguṇānāṃ tadanuvādināṃ vā nindakaḥ bhavamaye sasārarūpe pārāvāre sukhagaḥ mahāplavo bhaviteti citram | tvadguṇānuvādī sukhagaḥ guṇānuvādajanitānandaśālī mahāplavaḥ bhavitā mahoḍupavaduttārako bhavitetyarthaḥ | tadapavādī tu bhavitā asukhaga iti chedaḥ | bhavamayapārāvāre mahān āplavaḥ āplavanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ nityanimagna ityarthaḥ | ataeva asukhagaḥ asukhaprāptā | yadvā mahān plavaḥ caṇḍālaḥ ‘caṇḍālaplavamātaṅgadivākīrtijanaṅgamāḥ' ityamaraḥ | bhagavadguṇanindanasya nedaṃ phalamalamiti bhāvaḥ | ataeva asukhagaḥ ukto'rthaḥ | yadvā mahān plavaḥ madgukāraṇḍavādivatkaścitplavanāmā śobhanaḥ khagaḥ sukhagaḥ sa na bhavatītyasusagaḥ aśobhanaḥ pakṣī bhavitā | atra rūpakakāvyaliṅgatulyayogitānāmekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā aravindaṃ ravimantardadhatāṃ bhavatāttatastathānandam | tadapi bhajatsadravitāṃ harinayanaṃ syāttavāmba na tu nayanam || 2210 || he amba! aravindaṃ padmaṃ antaḥ manasi raviṃ bhānuṃ dadhatāṃ dhattām | ‘dadha dhāraṇe' iti bhovādikāddhātorloṭ | tvannayanatāvāptyai upāstāmiti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ tasmādupāsanāt tathānandaṃ tathā ānando yasya tattathoktaṃ | tallābhaupayikaharṣaparipūrṇaṃ bhavatāt bhavatu | tadapi tathā'pi sat sādhu praśastaṃ vā yathātathā ravitāṃ bhānutā bhajat sevamānaṃ sat yathākratunayena ravimupāsīnasya tadbhāvabhāvitāyā avaśyaṃbhāvaḥ | harinayanaṃ etāvatā'pi prayāsena bhagavanna yanameva bhavet tasya bhānunayanatayā lokavedaviditatvāditi bhāvaḥ | na tu tava nayanam | saumyasundaramahodāradayātaraṅgitaṃ sakalatāpamocanaṃ bhavatyā locanaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe aravindaṃ aravindamitipadaṃ antaḥ svābhyantare raviṃ rephayuktavivarṇaṃ dadhatām | tasya padasya madhye uktavarṇayośśravaṇāt | tathā tadvat anandamiti chedaḥ | aśca ndaśca andau avidyamānau andau yasya tattathoktaṃ akārandakārābhyāṃ rahitaṃ bhavatāt | tadapi sadravitā santau vidyamānau ravīti varṇau yasya tattathoktaṃ tattāṃ bhajat anyavarṇayorapāye ravītivarṇayorevāvaśeṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | atra samaviṣamasaṃbhāvanādīnāmekavācakānupraviṣṭatā draṣṭavyā || yathāvā api harimaṇimukhamaṇayastvadrucisāmyepsavastayā'pāstāḥ | adharitaśiro'pi teṣvidamaraṃ maratakaṃ hare bhavetkatamam || 2211 || he hare! harimaṇiḥ indranīlamaṇireva mukhaṃ yeṣāṃ te maṇayaḥ mahānīlādyāḥ ‘indranīlamahānīlamaṇipravaravedikam' ityādau nīlaratnānāṃ bahuvidhatvaprasiddheḥ | ye maṇayaḥ pulliṅgena pumāṃso bahuvacanena bahava iti ca gamyate | tvadrucisāmyepsavaḥ ata eva tayā tvadrucyā striyā ekayaiveti bhāvaḥ | apāstāḥ ujjvalaśyāmalimānasta eva nirastā iti bhāvaḥ | teṣu madhye idaṃ maratakaṃ idamityanena indranīlādyapekṣayā mandatamanīlamiti dyotyate | araṃ atimātraṃ adharitaśiro'pīti lokoktiḥ katamaṃ bhavet ? indranīlādiṣvapīdaṃ kaḥ padārthaḥ teṣvapi gaṇayitumanarhaṃ klībaṃ ca kathaṃ nāma tvadrucisāmyasaubhāgyamiyāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe maratakaṃ adhaśśīrṣamapi araṃ repharahitaṃ sat katamamiti sidhyatītyarthāntaraṃ vicchittiviśeṣāya | viṣamakāvyārthāpattyaprastutapraśaṃsānāmekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā marakatakametvamaratāmavākchiro'pyastu tarhi katakaṃ sat | kājalameva vimalayedacyuta sanmānasaṃ na vapuriva te || 2212 || he acyuta! marakataṃ gārutmataṃ amaratāṃ devatvameva etu tvaddivyavigrahasāmyepsayā devatvameva labhatām | na kevalametāvadeva, avākchiro'pyastu adhaḥkṛtaśīrṣamapi bhavatviti lokoktiḥ | tarhi tathā'pi katakaṃ katakaphalameva syāt | devatve'pi svābhīṣṭānavāpteradhaśśīrṣaṃ taptvā'pi katakarūpameva bhavedityutkaṭāniṣṭaprāptirevoktā | tadā'pi katakarūpe'pi kājalaṃ īṣajjalameva prasādayet | tava vapuriva divyavigraha iva sanmānasaṃ satāṃ mana eva sanmānasaṃ atigabhīraṃ mānasasaraḥ na vimalayet yathā mānasamatigabhīramapi tava divyamaṅgalavigrahaḥ prasādayet na tathā marakatakamupadarśitarītyā mahatā yatnenāpi na prasādayet | kiṃtu atyalpakutsitajalameveti nirgalito'rthaḥ | anena marakatakasya sarvātmanā bhagavadvigrahasāmyadavīyastvamuktam | vastutastu marakatakamiti padaṃ amaratvaṃ makārarepharāhityaṃ prāpya katakamityavaśiṣṭaṃ viparyāse'pi katakatayaivāvasthitamityarthaḥ | atra pratīpaviṣamavyatirekāṇāmekavācakānupraveśo'nusaṃdheyaḥ || yathāvā janisaṃtatiḥ prayātā bahvī mugdhā gatā mudhābhā vam | tava kṛpayā'cyuta mā bhūnnijajanireṣā'pi vā pratīpagatiḥ || 2213 || he acyuta! bahvī janisaṃtatiḥ janmaparaṃparā mameti śeṣaḥ | mugdhā bhagavanmāyayā mohaṃ prāptā ataeva mudhābhāvaṃ anārādhitatvaccaraṇāravindatayā vyarthatvamiti bhāvaḥ | prayātā prāptā | eṣā nijajanirapi vā etanmama janma vā tava kṛpayā pratīpagatiḥ ‘anṛtena hi pratyūḍhāḥ' iti śrutyuktarītyā bhagavanmāyayā prātikūlyaṃ prāpitā mā bhūt aviditaparāvaratattvayāthātmyā ananuṣṭhitatvatprāptyupāyā mā vinaṅkṣīditi bhāvaḥ | atra vṛdhaiva bhavato yātā bhūyasī janmasaṃtatiḥ | tasyāmanyatamaṃ janma saṃciṃtya śaraṇaṃ ghraja || iti, saṃsāracakramāropya balibhiḥ karmarajjubhiḥ | kalenākṛṣyamāṇasya jaṅgamasthāvarātmanaḥ || aho me mahatī yātā bhūyasī janmasaṃtatiḥ | anārādhitagovindacaraṇāmbhoruhadvayā || anāsvāditasatkarmajñānabhaktisudhārasā | adṛṣṭānantasaṃsārasāgarottaraṇaplavā || ityādinā cokto'rtho'nusandheyaḥ | pakṣe mugdheti śabdavyaktiḥ agatāmudhābhāvamiti samastaṃ padam | agatayā avidyamānagakāratayā gakāre akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | g iti halmātralopenetyarthaḥ | mudhābhāvaṃ mudhāśabdatvaṃ prayāteti yojanā | kiṃca nijajaniriti śabdavyaktiḥ pratīpagatirmā bhūt prātilomyena paṭhitā'pi pūrvānupūrvyaivāvatiṣṭhata iti bhāvaḥ | ‘māṅi luṅ' ityasya sarvalakārāpavādatvāllaḍarthe luṅ | atra śāntarasasya mudhaiva janisaṃtatiḥ prayātetyanena sūcito nirvedassaṃcārī bhāvo'ṅgamiti preyo'laṃkāraḥ | pūrvārdhoditāyāḥ janisaṃtativṛdhābhavanacintāyā uttarārdhapratipāditanijajanipratīpatāniṣedhaprārthanaṃ prati hetutvātkāvyaliṅgaṃ caikavācakānupravaśesaṃkīrṇe || yathāvā ādau vyādhyuṣitamatho bahulabhraṣṭaṃ kuto'lamupari patet | yadi vijigīṣu bhujaṃ te vyālakulaṃ vyākulaṃ bhavennūnam || 2214 || he hare! ādau prathamameva vyādhiḥ uṣito yasmin vyādhigrastamityarthaḥ | atho anantaraṃ bahulaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ adhaḥpatitaṃ śaktivirahāditi bhāvaḥ | vyālakulaṃ bhujaṅgayūdhaṃ kartṛ na tveko vyālaḥ | te tava bhujaṃ vijigīṣu yadi kutaḥ kasmāddhetoḥ alaṃ samarthaṃ sat upari patet dvaṃdvayuddhārthamiti bhāvaḥ | kiṃtu vyākulaṃ bhavet jetumakṣamatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anyatra vyālakulaṃ vyālakulamiti padaṃ ādau vyā ityākārakavarṇaḥ adhyuṣito yasmin atho anantaraṃ bahu yathātathā labhraṣṭaṃ bhraṣṭalavarṇamityarthaḥ | atha kutaḥ kuvarṇāt upari anantaraṃ laṃ lakāraṃ patet gacchat yadi patatissakarmakaḥ | ‘dvitīyā śritātītapatita' iti samāsavidhānāt | ‘narakaṃ patitaḥ, divaṃ gaccha suvaḥ pata, pata bhūmimavākchirāḥ' ityādiprayogācca | vyākulaṃ bhavet vyālakulapadaṃ bhraṣṭaprathamalakāramātraṃ vyākulamiti niṣpadyetetyarthaḥ | asmin pakṣe tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe | kāvyaliṅgaviṣamayorekavācakānupraviṣṭatvamatra draṣṭavyam || yathāvā darasaṃyogaṃ prāpto janastvadīyo bhavatyamṛtadogdhā | yuktamidaṃ tvadvimukho'pīdṛgbhavatīti nātha citramidam || 2215 || he nātha! tvadīyo janaḥ darasaṃyogaṃ alpakālasaṃsargaṃ prāpto'pi amṛtadogdhā niśśreyasamārgopadeṣṭā bhavati | ahanyahani dharmasya yonissādhusamāgamaḥ | mohajālasya yonirhi mūḍhaireva samāgamaḥ || ityādikamihānusaṃdheyam | idaṃ yuktam | tvadvimukho'pi īdṛkdarasaṃyogaṃ prāpto'mṛtadogdhā bhavatīti citram | dakārarepharūpasaṃyogaṃ prāptaḥ amṛtadogdhā amṛtadogdheti vastusthitiḥ | samatulyayogitayorekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā tvaṃ nanu bhavasi vadānyassudhātiśiśiraḥ pṛdākuśailendo | viparītalakṣaṇādiha vadānyamanyaṃ tu dāvamiva manye || 2216 || he pṛdākuśailendo! tvaṃ nanu tvameva ‘praśnāvadhāraṇānujñānunayāmantraṇe nanu' ityamaraḥ | sudheva atiśiśiraḥ ativelakṛpāśītala ityarthaḥ | indupakṣe sudhayā atiśiśira iti | vadānyaḥ ‘priyavāgdānaśīlaśca vadānyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ' ‘ya ātmadā baladā' iti śrutātmaparyantasarvasvadātā tvadanyo mahāvadānyaḥ ka iti bhāvaḥ | yathācocyate śrīviṣṇudharme tasmāttvamapi viprendra nārāyaṇaparo bhava | tadanyaḥ ko mahodāraḥ prārthitaṃ dātumīśvaraḥ || iti | anyaṃ tvaditaraṃ vadānyaṃ vadānyaṃmanyaṃ tvitibhāvaḥ | viparītalakṣaṇāt sudhātiśiśiratvādilakṣaṇavipratīpāttāpakaratvādilakṣaṇāt dāvaṃ vanahutāśanamiva manye | durupasarpaṃ dūratastyājyaṃ ca jānāmīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā anyaṃ viparītalakṣaṇāt virodhilakṣaṇātaḥ sā ca jahatsvārthalakṣaṇaiva | yayā svābhidheyaviparītārtho lakṣyate | yathā ‘upakṛtaṃ bahunāma' ityādau vadānyaṃ avadānyamityarthaḥ | dāvaṃ manye ukta evārthaḥ | pakṣe anyaṃ nyavarṇaśūnyaṃ vadānyaṃ vadānyaśabdaṃ viparītaṃ vilomaṃ yathāsyāttathā lakṣaṇāt vīkṣaṇāt dāvaṃ manye dāvaśabdaṃ jāne | vadānyaśabdo nyavarṇavidhuro vadā ityavaśiṣṭaḥ vilomatayā paṭhito dāva iti niṣpadyate | asmin pakṣe ivaśabdo vākyālaṃkāre | atra bhagavattaditarayorvadānyatve prāpte bhagavatyeva tanniyamanātparisaṃkhyā tayorevendutvadāvatulyatvarūpavailakṣaṇyasadbhāvādvyatirekaśca upamābhyāmekavācakānupraviṣṭau || yathāvā salalitatamavalaripumaṇiphalakāsu narā viśālaśālāsu | kuruvindadīparucirāsvaravindākṣa tvadīkṣitā bhānti || 2217 || atra pratipādyamāno'rthassamṛddhimadvastuvarṇanātmakatayā udāttālaṃkārarūpaḥ | asaṃbandhe saṃbandhakathanātmakatayā atiśayoktirūpaśca | na ca sarvatra udattasyāsaṃvandhe saṃbandhakathanarūpatvaṃ nirṇīta miti na viviktālaṃkāradvayasamāveśostīti vācyam, divyalokasthitasaṃpatsamṛddhivarṇanādiṣvatiśayoktyasaṃspṛṣṭasya udāttasya śauryaudāryadāridryādiviṣayakātiśayoktivarṇaneṣūdāttāsaṃsṛṣṭāyā atiśayokteścānyonyaviviktatvena viśramāt | tayoścehārthavaśaprāptasamāveśayornāṅgāṅgibhāvalakṣaṇassaṃkaraḥ, ekenānyasyānutthiteḥ | svātantryapāratantryaviśeṣāvagateśca | nāpi samaprādhānyaṃ, yaiśśabdairiha samṛddhimadvastu pratipādyate taireva tasyaiva vastuno'saṃbandhe sabandharūpasya pratipādyamānatayā vibhinnapratipādakaśabdavyavasthitārthabhedābhāvāt | nāpi saṃdehasaṃkaraḥ, ekālaṃkārakoṭyāṃ tadanyālaṃkārakoṭipratikṣepābhāvāt | tasmādihodāttātiśayoktyorekavācakānupraveśalakṣaṇassaṃkaraḥ | evamuktasamṛddherbhagavatkaṭākṣitatāhetukatvātkavyaliṅgaṃ coktasaṃkaraikavācakānupraviṣṭamiti vicchittiviśeṣaśca || atra samaprādhānyābhāvavarṇanaṃ ca kuvalayānandakṛtāmanurodhena | rasikarañjanīkārastu ‘idaṃ cintyaṃ | samaprādhānyasaṃkaramabhyupagacchato bhinnaśabdavyavasthitārthabhedassamaprādhānyaprayojakaḥ| āgneyādāvutpattividhibhedasattve'pi ‘saptadaśa prājāpatyānpaśūnālabhate' ityādau vidhibhedābhāve'pi samaprādhānyavyavasthiteḥ | tadvadatrāpi pratipādakaśabdabhedābhāve'pi prādhānyasaṃbhavāt | ito'pi na samaprādhānyasaṃkarasaṃbhavaḥ, ekavācakānupraveśasaṃkarasya nirviṣayatāpatteḥ | tatrānupraviṣṭayoralaṃkārayorekajātīyacamatkāraprayojakatayā samaprādhānyasyaivopapatteḥ' ityabhāṇīdityalam || dvitīyaśśabdārthayorekavācakānupraveśasaṃkarassamaprādhānyanirūpaṇāvasara evodāhṛtaḥ | tṛtīyaśśabdārthayorekavācakānupraveśasaṃkaro yathā śabdārthayorekavācakānupraveśasaṃkaro yathā nanu bhajati pratyaya iha tānto'pi jahāti naiva bata satvam | ttvadabhaktibhṛtyasatvaṃ svayametya dadāti tasya tantattvam || 2218 || he bhagavan! iha loke bhajati tvāṃ sevamāne puṃsi pratyayaḥ jñānaṃ ‘pratyayo'dhīnaviśvāsadhīrandhrācārahetuṣu | khyātau sanādau śapathe' iti ratnamālā | tānto'pi kadācidādhyātmikāditāparūpakāraṇavaśāt svayaṃ glāno'pi sattvaṃ sattvaguṇaṃ prāśastyaṃ vā naiva jahāti | tvadbhaktasya jñānaṃ glānidaśāyāmapi sattvaguṇasamṛddhiṃ praśastatāṃ vā na visṛjatītyarthaḥ | atra jñānaśabdena tatprāptiheturjñānaṃ ca karma coktaṃ mahāmune | āgamotthaṃ vivekācca dvidhā jñānaṃ tathocyate | śabdabrahmāgamamayaṃ paraṃ brahma vivekajam || ityuktaṃ ghrahmaviṣayakaparokṣāparokṣarūpobhayavidhajñānaṃ vivakṣitam | bhagavadabhaktajñānasya vyatirekamāha tvaditi | tvadabhaktibhṛti tvayi bhaktimabibhrāṇe jane tu pratyaya itīhāpyanuṣajyate | pratyayo jñānaṃ svayaṃ ātmanā asattvaṃ sattvaguṇābhāvaṃ apraśastatvaṃ vā etya prāpya tasya abhaktibhṛta tāntatvaṃ glāniṃ dadāti | tvadabhaktaniṣṭhaṃ sāmānyaśāstrādijñānaṃ tvadbhaktividhuratayā svayaṃ sattvaguṇānādhāyakaṃ apraśastaṃ vā saṃpadyamānaṃ svāśrayameva niśśreyasarūpaparamapuruṣārthālābhena glapayatīti bhāvaḥ | anyatra bhajati tvadabhaktibhṛtītyetadubhayamapi śabdaparam | bhajati bhajatītyākārake śabde pratyayaḥ śatṛpratyayaḥ tāntaḥ takārāntaḥ bhavati | apiśabdo bhinnakramassamu ccaye | sattvaṃ satsaṃjñāvattvamapi naiva vijahāti | ‘tau sat' iti śatṛśānacossatsaṃjñāvidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | tvadabhaktibhṛti tvadabhaktibhṛcchabde pratyaya ityasyātrāpyanuṣaṅgaḥ | pratyayaḥ kkippratyayaḥ svayaṃ asattvaṃ satsaṃjñābhāvaṃ śaturiva kkipassatsaṃjñāyā avidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā asattvaṃ avidyamānatvaṃ etya kvipassarvasyāpi 'laśakvataddhite | upadeśe'janunāsika it | halantyam' iti kakārekārapakāraṇāmitsaṃjñāyāṃ 'tasya lopaḥ' ityanena vakārasya 'verapṛktasya' ityanena ca lopavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | tasya tvadabhaktibhṛcchabdasya tāntatvaṃ takārāntatvaṃ dadāti | kvipaḥ pitkṛttvāt | ‘hṛsvasya piti kṛti tuk' iti bhṛ ityasya tugāgame takārāntatvaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | kvibnimittakatvāttugāgamasya tāntatāyāstaddattatvoktiḥ | atra prakṛtāprakṛtayorjñānapratyayayośśleṣaḥ | prakṛtārthakakṣyāyāṃ jñānasya glānatārūpakāraṇasattve'pi sattvaparityāgarūpakāryānudayasya varṇanādviśeṣoktiḥ pūrvārdhe | uttarārdhe tu sāmānyajñānasya bhagavadbhaktyabharaṇarūpakāraṇānuguṇāsattvaprāptyādikāryavarṇanātsamālaṃkāraḥ || mahāvākyārthastu bhagavadbhaktābhaktagatapratyayayorvailakṣaṇyavarṇanātmakavyatirekarūpaḥ | aprakṛtārthakakṣyāyāṃ tu śatṛpratyayasya tāntatvasattvaprāptyoḥ kvippratyayasyāsattvaprāptitāntatāpradānayoścānurūpayorvarṇanātsamālaṃkāradvayaṃ cetyete'rthālaṃkārāḥ takārapaunaruktyalakṣaṇavṛttyanuprāsaścetyeteṣāmekasminneva vācake'nupraveśa ityekavācakavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ || na ca śabdālaṃkārasya padāvācyatayā ekasmin vācake vācyatayā'nupraveśābhāvātkathaṃ tasyaikavācakānupraveśa iti vācyaṃ, ekavācakāśritatvamātrasyaiva tatraikavācakānupraveśaśabdārthatvāt | na caivamarthālaṃkārasya vācakavṛttitāvirahatkathamekavācakānupraveśaviṣayateti vācyam, tasyāpi vācyatāsaṃbandhena taḍupapatterityāhuḥ || yathāvā bhavati khalu satpadavidāmiha sadgatirādare kriyāyoge | atha satkriyā samastā'pyasadgatiranādare kriyāyoge || 2219 || satpadavidāṃ saditi yatpadaṃ vastu brahmarūpaṃ vastvityarthaḥ | 'oṃ tatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhassmṛtaḥ' ityukteḥ | ‘padaṃ vyavasitatrāṇasthānalakṣmāṅghrivastuṣu' ityamaraḥ | yadvā brahmasvarūpamityarthaḥ | 'tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam' ityatra ‘padyata iti padaṃ svarūpam' iti vyākhyānāt | tat vidantīti tathoktāḥ | teṣāṃ kartari ṣaṣṭhī | parabrahmopāsakānāmityarthaḥ | vedanopāsanadhyānādiśabdānāmaikārthyasya ‘āvṛttirasakṛdupadeśāt' ityādau bhāṣye sthāpitatvāt kriyāyoge karmayoge anabhisaṃhitaphalakarmānuṣṭhāne ādare sati sadgatiḥ śarīrāvasāne arcirādimārgagamanaṃ bhavati khalu | khaluśśāstrīyaprasiddhau || vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca yastadvedobhayam saha | avidyayā mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā vidyayā'mṛtamaśnute || ‘tametaṃ vedānuvavanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣānta'| iyāja so'pi subahūnyajñān jñānavyapāśrayaḥ | brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāya tartuṃ mṛtyumavidyayā || 'ye ceme'raṇye śraddhāṃ tapa ityupāsate te'rciṣamevābhisaṃpadyante' ityādipramāṇānurodhena brahmavidāmapi vidyāsahakāritvenā śramānuguṇakarmānuṣṭhānādarasyāvaśyaṃbhāvāttasya sadgatisādhanatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atha arcirādimārgaprāptyavyavahitameva samastāsarvāpi sakriyā arcirādyātivāhikakriyamāṇassaṃmānaḥ bhavatītyanuṣajyate | vaiparītye'niṣṭamāha asadgatirityādinā | kriyāyoge uktavidhakarmānuṣṭhāne anādare sati asadgatirbhavati | brahmavidāmapyāśramakarmalope dūṣitāntaḥkaraṇatayā vidyotpatterevāsaṃbhavādasadgatirbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā sataḥ parabrahmaṇaśśrīnivāsasya pade caraṇau vindanti prāpnuvantīti tathoktānāṃ vindateḥ kvip | prapannānāmityarthaḥ | saṃbandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī | kriyāyoge kaiṃkaryalābhe ādare sati sadgatiḥ janānāmiti śeṣaḥ | anādare asadgatireva bhavati | bhagavatprapannajanaviṣayakakaiṃkaryādaratadabhāvābhyāṃ bhagavadanugrahalābhatadabhāvau bhavata iti bhāvaḥ | atra siddhirbhavati vā neti saṃśayo'cyutasevinām | na saṃśayo'sti tadbhaktaparicaryāratātmanām || anādṛtasutaṃ gehī puruṣaṃ nābhinandati | tathā'narcitatadbhaktaṃ bhagavānnābhinandati || ityādikamanusandheyam || anyatra sat praśastaṃ yat padaṃ śabdaśāstraṃ tadvidāṃ vyākaraṇavetṝṇāmityarthaḥ | ādare ādararūpārthe vivakṣite kriyāyoge kriyāśabdasaṃbandhe sat gatiḥ iti chedaḥ | sat sadityākārakamavyayaṃ gatiḥ gatisaṃjñakaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | atha samastā sadityanena samāsaṃ prāptā | kriyeti viśeṣyakaṭākṣeṇa strītvam | kriyā satkriyā bhavati satkriyeti niṣpadyate | anādare anādararūpārthe vivakṣite kriyāśabdayoge | asat gatiriti chedaḥ | asat asa dityākārakamavyayaṃ gatiḥ gatisaṃjñakaṃ bhavati | atha samastā asatkriyā bhavatītyapyupaskāryaṃ | ‘gatiśca' ityanuvartamāne ‘ādarānādarayossadasatī' ityādarānādararūpārthayorvivakṣitayossadasatoravyayayorgatisaṃjñāyāṃ ‘kugatiprādayaḥ' iti gate ssamāsavidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | atra prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣaḥ | prakṛtārthakakṣyāyāṃ pūrvottarārdhagataṃ samālaṃkāradvayaṃ cetyarthālaṃkārayoryamakasya śabdālaṃkārasya caikavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā yo vardhiṣṇusso'yaṃ śrayate vṛṣaśailamāptaśaityāgam | yo'vardhiṣṇusso'yaṃ śrayate vṛṣaśailamāptaśaityāgam || 2220 || yaḥ vardhiṣṇuḥ so'yaṃ āptaṃ śaityaṃ yaiste agāḥ vṛkṣāḥ yasmiṃstaṃ vṛṣaśailaṃ śrayate | dvitīyārdhe yaḥ avardhiṣṇuḥso'yaṃ prāptaḥ śaityāgaḥ śai ityākārakavarṇasya tyāgo yena saḥ vṛṣaśailaṃ vṛṣalamityarthaḥ | 'vṛṣalāśca jaghanyajāḥ' ityamaraḥ | atra samasyārthālaṃkārasya arthāvṛttirūyayamakalakṣaṇaśabdālaṃkārasya caikavācakānupraviṣṭatā || yathāvā yo bhaktastava madhye nākasthitimān satāṃ sa maulirbhāyāt | yo'bhaktastava madhye nā kasthitimān satāṃ sa maulirbhāyāt || 2221 || he bhagavan! yaḥ tava bhaktaḥ madhye nākasya madhyenākaṃ sthitimān tridive vasannityarthaḥ | satāṃ tatra vidyamānānāṃ daivarṣiprabhṛtīnāṃ mauliḥ kirīṭa iva bhāyāt | indratvena prakāśetetyarthaḥ | yaḥ tava abhaktaḥ so'pi tadvadeva bhāyādityāścaryam | parihārastu madhye nā kasthitimān iti chedaḥ | saḥ nā pumān 'puruṣāḥ pūruṣā naraḥ' ityamaraḥ | madhye antarāle kasthitimān kavarṇasthitimān mauliḥ maukalirityarthaḥ | śabdārthayostādātmyam | kāka iva satāṃ bhāyāt | bhagavadabhakto brahmavidāṃ kākatulyatayā dūratatsyājyo bhavediti bhāvaḥ | yadvā saḥ tava bhaktaḥ madhyenākaṃ ākāśamadhye 'ākāśe tridive nākaḥ' ityamaraḥ | parame vyomni vā | sthitimān ‘divi nakṣatrabhūtastvam' ityuktarītyā tvatkṛpayā prāptajyotirmayaśarīra iti bhāvaḥ | satāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ muktānāṃ vā maulirbhāyāt teṣāṃ madhye dedīpyamāno bhaveditibhāvaḥ | tvadabhaktastu maukaliḥ kāka iva nistejaskaḥ prākṛteṣvapi nihīnatayā'vasthitaḥ bhāyāt pratibhāyādityarthaḥ | ‘maukaliḥ pikavardhanaḥ' iti kākaparyāyeṣvamaraḥ | "mūkalo yamaḥ tasyāpatyaṃ maukaliḥ 'mūkalaḥ pretabhartā syānmūkalaḥ kānanecaraḥ' iti śabdārṇave" itei ṭīkāsarvasvakārādayaḥ | atra bhagavadbhaktatvatadabhaktatvayorviśeṣaṇagatyā maulitvamaukalitve prati hetutvātkāvyaliṅgadvayaṃ rūpakasaṃkīrṇaṃ arthāvṛttirūpakayamakena sahaikavācakānupraviṣṭam || yathāvā asakau pīno bhūtyopacitaḥ pītāmbaraṃ śrito yassyāt | asakaupīno bhūtyopacito haridambaraṃ śrito'pi syāt || 2222 || yaḥ pītāmbaraṃ śrīnivāsaṃ anena sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhiḥ sūcitā| śritaḥ syāt asakau asau janaḥ | adaśśabdasya ‘avyayasarvā nāmnāmakac prākṭeḥ' ityakaci 'adasa au sulopaśca' ityadasa aukāro'ntādeśassaupare sulopaśca | tadassassau' iti dasya saḥ | bhūtyā vastrābharaṇānnapānādisaṃpadā upacitaḥ samṛddhaḥ ataeva pīnaḥ puṣṭāṅgaḥ syādityetadatrāpi saṃbadhyate | haridambaraṃ haritavarṇavasanaṃ digambaraṃ śivamiti vāstavārthaḥ | ‘harit klībaṃ tṛṇe nāśve varṇe triṣu diśi striyām' iti ratnamālā | śrito'pi janaḥ bhūtyā upacitaḥ pīnassyādityāścaryam | vastutastu bhūtyā bhasmanā upacitaḥ digdhaḥ kaupīnena saha vartata iti sakaupīnaḥ sa na bhavatī tyasakaupīnaḥ syāt | yathākratunayena digambaramupāsīno digambara eva syāt tatsārūpyaṃ bhajediti bhāvaḥ | ‘bhūtirmātaṅgaśṛṅgāre janmasaṃpattibhasmasu | digdhavṛddhāvupacitau' iti ca ratnamālā | ‘bhūtirbhasmani saṃpattau, bhavedupacitaṃ digdhe samṛddhe vācyaliṅgakaḥ' iti medinī ca | atra śabdārthālaṃkārayoryamakasamālaṃkārayorekavācakānupraveśaḥ || yathāvā prākṛtadaivatabhajanānmanye prāpsyasyare nareśvaratām | mugdha tathaiva yatethā manye prāpsyasyarenareśvaratām || 2223 || idaṃ sakalaphalapradaṃ bhagavantaṃ śrīnivāsamupekṣya prākṛtadaivatopāsanenādhirājyaṃ prepsuṃ kaṃcinmugdhaṃ prati kasyacitprauḍhamateḥ parihāsavacanam | are mugdha! tvaṃ prākṛtadaivatānāṃ bhagavadatiriktadaivatānāṃ bhajanāt upāsanāt nareśvaratāṃ sārvabhaumatāṃ prāpsyasi manye prāpsyāmīti manyasa ityarthaḥ | 'ehi manye odanaṃ bhokṣyase' ityādāviva parihāsadyotanāyāyaṃ puruṣavyatyayaḥ | tathāca sūtram 'prahāse ca manyopapade manyateruttama ekavacca' iti | "manyadhā turupapadaṃ yasya tasmin dhātau prakṛtibhūte madhyamassyāt | manyatestūttamassyātsa caikārthavācakassyāt" iti tadarthaḥ | tathaiva yatethāḥ | are mugdha ! punassaṃbodhanaṃ parihāsātiśayaṃ dyotayati | nareśvaratāṃ prāpsyasi lapsyase iti manye ahaṃ jānāmītyarthaḥ | hārdo'bhiprāyastu arenareśvaratāmiti samastaṃ padam | areḥ revarṇavidhurā yā nareśvaratā naśvaratetyarthaḥ | tāṃ prāpsyasi bhagavatyaudāsīnyena durdevatā yadi bhajethāḥ tarhi kva nareśvaratā labhyeta | kiṃtu naśvarataiveti bhāvaḥ | atra arenareśvaratāmiti śleṣaḥ samālaṃkāraviśeṣasyāṅgaṃ, ayaṃ ca saṃkaraḥ yamakenaikavācakānupraviṣṭaḥ || yathāvā grasto jarādibhistvāṃ vimāyamenaṃ nameyamāvirbhaktiḥ | punarapi tava dhāmni pare virājamānaṃ na mā jarā viśatu hare || 2224 || he hare! jarādibhiḥ ādiśabdena garbhajanmādikaṃ gṛhyate | grastaḥ ahaṃ vibhraṃśitā māyā yena saḥ vimāyaḥ taṃ niśśeṣaprakṛtibandhavinivartakamityarthaḥ | māyāśabdaḥ prakṛtivācī | ‘māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyāt' iti śruteḥ | enaṃ tvāṃ āvirbhaktiḥ prādurbhūtabhaktissan nameyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajeyam | evamupāyaṃ prārthya phalaṃ prārthayate | pare tava dhāmni virājamānaṃ akarmavaśyatayā prakāśamānaṃ 'sa svarāḍbhavati' iti śrutirihānusaṃhitā | mā māṃ jarā jaropalakṣitagarbhajanmādikaṃ punarapi na viśatu | tvayyātmanikṣepāvadhikameva hi prakṛtibandhamūlakaṃ garbhajanmajarāmaraṇādiparivartanamiti bhāvaḥ | atra pūrvārdhavākyārthahetukaḥ uttarārdhavākyārtha iti kāvya liṅgaṃ dvitīyaturīyapādagatavarṇapañcakānulomapratilomacitrarūpaśabdālaṃkāraikavācakānupraviṣṭamiti dhyeyam || yathāvā śrīspṛhayālu dayālu grahayālu janasya caraṇapatayāloḥ | śraddhāluratandrālurbhadrānidrālu tadbhaje brahma || 2225 || śraddhāluḥ atandrāluḥ ahaṃ bhadrānidrālu jaganmaṅgalavidhānajāgarūkamityarthaḥ | atra śrīspṛhayālutvasya dayālutvaṃ prati tasya ca caraṇapatayālugrahayālutāṃ prati ca hetutvātkāvyaliṅgaṃ mālārūpaṃ tacca bhajanaṃ prati heturiti kāvyaliṅgāntaraṃ ca vṛttyanuprāsena sahaikavācakānupraviṣṭam | ‘spṛhigṛhipatidayinidrātandrāśraddhābhya āluc' iti sūtrodāharaṇāni sarvāṇyapyupekṣitakramāṇi ratnāvalīviśeṣarītyā nibaddhānīti vicchittiviśeṣo'nusaṃdheyaḥ || yathāvā phaṇigirimaṇiramaṇi bhavatphaṇitipraṇayo vyatāni yadanena | phāṇitamabhāṇi tadayaṃ khaṇḍavikāro na kāraṇāntarataḥ || 2226 || he phaṇigirimaṇiramaṇi! yat yasmāt anena khaṇḍavikāreṇa bhavatyāḥ phaṇitau vāci praṇayaḥ viśvāsaḥ sakhyamiti yāvat | vyatāni vyaraci | tat tasmāt ayaṃ khaṇḍavikāraḥ khaṇḍaśarkarāviśeṣaḥ phāṇitaśabdena vyavāhriyata | na tu kāraṇāntarataḥ | phaṇityā idaṃ phaṇitaṃ phaṇitipraṇayavattvāttatsaṃbandhītyagadyatetyarthaḥ | phaṇitiśabdāt ‘tasyedam' ityaṇi 'yasyeti ca' itīkāralope ādi vṛddhau phāṇitamiti rūpaṃ phāṇyate dravībhāvaṃ prāpyate ityādivyutpattibhistu phāṇitamiti nābhāṇītyarthaḥ | atra phaṇigirimaṇīti rūpakātiśayoktiḥ phāṇitamityabhāṇīti niruktiḥ na kāraṇāntarata ityapahnavaścāprastutapraśaṃsayā saṃkīrṇāḥ vṛttyanuprāsena sahaikavācakānupraviṣṭāḥ || uktānāṃ pañcānāmapi narasiṃhākārāṇāmalaṃkārāṇāṃ kvacidekapadye melane cārutātiśayaḥ | yathā svābhā tarūpalālyā surucirakuruvindabṛndapaṭukaṭakā | harimaṇinā phaṇināyakagiridharaṇī lasati kalitatilakā nu || 2227 || tarūpalālyā tarūṇāmupalānāṃ ca ālyā paṅktyā svābhā śobhanaprakāśā | anyatra svābhātarūpalālyeti samastaṃ prathamaikavacanāntaṃ padam | suṣṭhu ābhātaṃ prakāśamānaṃ yadrūpaṃ āropyāvedhyavikṣepyapārihāryairabhūṣitamū | yadbhūṣitamivābhāti tadrūpamiti kathyate || iti lakṣitaśśobhāviśeṣaḥ | tena lālyā lālanīyā | surucirāṇi kuruvindānāṃ mustānāṃ padmarāgāṇāṃ ca bṛndāni yasmiṃstattathokta paṭu ajarjharaṃ kaṭakaṃ sānubhāgo valayaśca yasyāssā | 'kuruvindāḥ padmarāgahiṃgulādarśamustakāḥ' iti ratnamālā | 'kaṭakaṃ valaye sānau rājadhānīnitambayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | phaṇināyakagiridharaṇī harireva harimaṇiḥ indranīlaḥ harireva maṇiriti vā | tena kalitatilakā nu racitatilakeva vilasati pratyuktāvupamāne ca viṣādotprekṣayorapi | nu pādapūraṇe jñeyo jijñāsāyāṃ samuccaye || iti śeṣaḥ | atra svābhātarūpalālyetyādiśleṣasya tanmūlakātiśayokteścāṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkaraḥ | tayā connahyamānā harimaṇitilakitatvotprekṣā phaṇināyakagiridharaṇyāṃ nāyikāvyavahārasamāroparūpasamāsoktigarbhaivonnahyata ityutprekṣāsamāsoktyoruktaśleṣamūlakātiśayoktyuttambhitatvataulyātparasparāpekṣasaundaryātiśayatvaikakālikatvayorapi sadbhāvātsamaprādhānyam | etāvatyeva kavisaṃrambhe ayaṃ saṃkaraḥ | kalitatilakā nu ityupamāyāṃ cetsaṃrambhaḥ tadā phaṇināyakagiridharaṇyāḥ nāyakaupamyaṃsya gamyamānatayā ekadeśavivartyupamālaṃkāraḥ | sa śleṣamūlātiśayoktyā aṅgena saṃkīryamāṇa ityanayossaṃdehasaṃkaraḥ | harimaṇinetyatra harireva harimaṇiḥ harirmaṇirivetyubhayathā'pi samāsasaṃbhavādrūpakopamayoranyo'pi saṃdehasaṃkaraḥ | surucirakuruvindabṛndapaṭukaṭaketyatra śleṣamūlātiśayokteranuprāsasya caikavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ | evaṃ kalitatilaketyatra utprekṣānuprāsayośca harimaṇineti saṃdehasaṃkarasya pūrvottarārdhagatānuprāsayośca saṃsṛṣṭiriti pañcāpyalaṃkārā atra militā iti sudhībhirvibhāvanīyam | ayaṃ ca pañcānāmalaṃkārāṇāmekatra melanaprakāraḥ lakṣmīsahasraratnaprakāśikāhaṃsasaṃdeśarasāsvādinyośca keṣucitpadyeṣvasmābhiḥ prakāśitaḥ || kvacitsaṃkarāṇāmapi saṃkarādvicchittiviśeṣaḥ | yathā ajirācitaharimaṇighṛṇimasṛṇānvajrāṃścyutāngṛhe dhaninām | uñchanti jāmbavadhiyā yadbālāssā ramākaṭākṣaśrīḥ || 2228 || dhanināṃ śrīmatāṃ gṛhe jātyabhiprāyakamekavacanam | cyutān anādarādgalitān ajireṣu aṅgaṇeṣu ācitāḥ bhūmīsamatalatayā ātatāḥ ye harimaṇayaḥ phalakākārā iti bhāvaḥ | teṣāṃ ghṛṇibhiḥ kiraṇaiḥ masṛṇān snigdhān śyāmalāniti yāvat | vajrān hīramaṇīn bālāḥ krīḍanto māṇavakāḥ jambvā vikārāḥ jāmbavāni jambūphalānīti dhiyā bhrāntyā 'jambvā vā' iti vaikāriko'ṇ | 'phale jambvā jambū strī jambu jāmbavam' ityamaraḥ | uñchanti ekaikaśa ādadate iti yat sā vidheyakaṭākṣaśrīśabdakaṭākṣeṇa strīliṅgatā | ramāyāḥ śrīnivāsadivyamahiṣyāḥ kaṭākṣaśrīḥ kaṭākṣalakṣmīreva | atra tāvat śrīmatāṃ saṃpattisamṛddhivarṇanamudāttālaṃkāraḥ | tanmūlako harimaṇighṛṇimasṛṇānityatra tadguṇālaṃkāraḥ, tatraiva vakṣyamāṇabhrānyupapādakapadārthahetukakāvyaliṅgālaṃkāraśceti tayorekavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ | tanmūlako jāmbavadhiyetyatra bhrāntimadalaṃkāraḥ | tābhyāṃ codāttālaṃkārassundaratāṃ lambhita iti tayośca tasya cāṅgāṅgibhāvena saṃkaraḥ | evaṃ śrīmadbhavanasamṛddherhetumato ramākaṭākṣaśriyo hetoścābhedavarṇanaṃ hetvalaṃkāraḥ | sa ca ramākaṭakṣāśriyo niravadhikotkarṣaparyavasāyī | etāvanmātre cetsaṃrambhaḥ kaveḥ tadā upapāditodāttālaṃkāropaskṛte hetvalaṃkāre viśramaḥ | varṇanīyāyā ramāyāḥ kaṭākṣalakṣmīḥ kīdṛśīti praśnottaratayā niravadhikaiśvaryaviśrāṇanarūpāprastutakāryamukhena tadīyakaṭākṣalakṣmīprakarṣapraśaṃsāyāṃ cetsaṃrambhaḥ tadā kāryanibandhanāprastutapraśaṃsālaṃkāre viśramaḥ | kāryasyāpi varṇanīyatayā'bhisaṃdhau tu prastutāṅkure viśrāntiḥ | atra viśeṣānadhyavasāyātsaṃdehasaṃkaraḥ | kiṃca śrīmadbhavanavaibhavavarṇanasyāsaṃbandhe saṃbandhakathanarūpatayā atiśayokterudāttālaṃkāreṇa sahaikavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ | niravadhikaudāryotkarṣaparyavasāyino hetvalaṃkārasyādbhutātathyaudāryavarṇanātmikayā'tyuktyā sahaikavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ | tanmūlakasyāprastuta praśaṃsālaṃkārasya prastutāṅkurālaṃkārasya vā śrīmatsampatsamṛddhivarṇanātmakodāttālaṃkāreṇa sahaikavācakānupraveśasaṃkaraḥ | vācakaśabdasya pratipādakamātraparatayā vyañjakasādhāraṇyasya dīkṣitairevoktatvāt | tathācodāttātiśayoktyoḥ hetvatyuktyoḥ vyaṅgyodāttāprastutapraśaṃsāprastutāṅkurānyatarayorityeteṣāṃ trayāṇāmekavācakānupraveśasaṃkarāṇāṃ samaprādhānyasaṃkaraḥ | na hyeteṣāmanyonyamitaratrāṅgatvamasti | nanu saṃpatsamṛddhivarṇanātmakasyodāttasyāsaṃbandhe saṃbandhavarṇanarūpātiśayokteścaikavācakānupraveśasya hetvalaṃkārasaundaryādhāyakatvenetarāṅgatāyāṃ jāgarūkāyāṃ kathaṃ trayāṇāṃ samaprādhānyasaṃkara iti vācyaṃ, udāttālaṅkārasyaiva saṃpatsamṛddhivarṇanātmanā hetvalaṃkāracārutādhāyakatayā aṅgatā | na tatrātiśayoktisaṃkarasyāpyupayoga iti trayāṇāṃ samaprādhānyasyocitatvāt | evamatra śloke caturṇāmapi saṃkarāṇāṃ yathāyogyaṃ saṃkaraḥ | tathāhiudāttatadguṇayoraṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkarasya bhrāntimadudāttayoraṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkarasya cāṅgāṅgibhāvena saṃkaraḥ | tathā bhrāntimadudāttayoraṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkarasya udāttāṅgakahetvalaṃkārādisaṃdehasaṃkarasya cāṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃkara iti kuśāgrīyamatibhiranusaṃdheyam | evaṃjātīyakāssakarāḥ prāgupadarśiteṣvarthālaṃkārodāharaṇeṣu upadarśayiṣyamāṇeṣu śabdālaṃkārodāharaṇeṣu ca saṃbhavanto manīṣibhiralaṃkāraśāstraniṣṇātaissvayamevāhyenta iti vistarabhayādviśramyate | granthānte śrīriti nirdeśo'tyantamaṅgalārtha iti sarvaṃ samañjasam || ityalaṅkāramaṇihāre saṅkarālaṅkārasara ekaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ <12> atha śabdālaṃkārasaraḥ ityarthālaṃkṛtayo yathāmati nirūpitāḥ | nirūpyante'tha diṅmātraṃ śabdālaṃkṛtayaḥ kramāt || yadyapi prakāśakārādibhirabhyarhitaśabdagatvenābhyarhitā iti śabdālaṃkārā arthālaṃkārebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ nirūpitāḥ | kāvyānuśāsanakārastu "alaṃkārāḥ khalu dvividhāḥ śabdālaṃkārā arthālaṃkārāśca, tatratāvadarthamadhikṛtya śabdaḥ pravartate, ataḥ prathamamarthālaṃkārā evodāhriyante" ityāha | ataeva daṇḍiprabhṛtibhiḥ arthālaṃkārāḥ prakarṣātiśayādādau śabdālaṃkārāstu jaghanyatayā'nantaraṃ ca nirūpitāḥ | ataevāsmābhiḥ kāvyānuśāsanakṛdādimatāvalambanenārthālaṃkāranirūpaṇānantarameva śabdālaṃkārā nirūpyante || varṇānuprāsaḥ sāmyaṃ vyañjanamātrasya varṇānuprāsa īritaḥ || svaravaisādṛśye'pi vyañjanānāṃ sādṛśyaṃ yat sa varṇānuprāsaḥ | vyañjanasāmyaṃ yamake'pyastīti tadvāraṇāya mātrapadam | tena svaravyañjanasādṛśya eva yamakatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvānna tatrātivyāptiḥ | svaravyañjanasāmyarūpalāṭānuprāsāvyāptivāraṇāya varṇapadaṃ lakṣye viśeṣitam | tathāca lāṭānuprāsasya padānuprāsatayā varṇānuprāsatāvirahādalakṣyatvena na tatrāvyāptirdoṣāyetyāhuḥ | rasādyanugataḥ prakṛṣṭo nyāso'nuprāsaḥ | taduktam ‘prakṛṣṭo varṇavinyāso rasādyanugato hi yaḥ | so'nuprāsaḥ' iti || dvidhā bhavedayaṃ chekavṛttyanuprāsabhedataḥ || ayaṃ varṇānuprāsaśca chekānuprāso vṛttyanuprāsaśceti dvividhaḥ | chekāḥ vidagdhāḥ tadabhimato'nuprāsaśchekānuprāsaḥ | vṛttirnāma niya tavarṇagato rasaviṣayo vyāpāraḥ racanāviśeṣa iti yāvat | tadāśrito'nuprāsa ityāhuḥ || chekānuprāsaḥ chekānuprāsamāhuryatsāmyaṃ vyañjanayossakṛt || yadvyañjanayossakṛtsāmyaṃ taṃ chekānuprāsamāhuḥ || yathāvā santatamantaḥkaraṇaṃ divyaṃ bhavyaṃ bhujaṅgagirisaṅgi | dhāma śyāmamameyaṃ vindatu kandarpadarpahararūpam || atra pūrvārdhe nakāratakārayoḥ ṅakāragakārayoḥ vakārayakārayoḥ uttarārdhe nakāradakārayoḥ rephapakārayośca sakṛtsāmyam | idaṃ ca tato'ruṇaparispandamandīkṛtavapuśśaśī | dadhre kāmaparikṣāmakāminīgaṇḍapāṇḍutām || iticchekānuprāsasyodāharaṇadānena vyavadhānasahiṣṇuvyañjanadvayasakṛtsāmyasya chekānuprāsatāmabhyupagacchatāṃ prakāśakārādīnāṃ matena | vidyānāthādīnāṃ mate tu idaṃ lakṣaṇam dvayordvayorvyañjanayoryugmayoryā nirantarā | āvṛttiḥ kriyate so'yaṃ chekānuprāsa īryate || dvayodvayorvyañjanayorvyañjanāntarāvyavadhānenāvṛttiśchekānuprāsa ityarthaḥ | tenājvarṇavyavadhāne'pi na doṣaḥ || yathāvā devādeva śreyo rāmārāmasvavakṣaso jyāyaḥ | dhyeyo hi yo'hibhūmīdharadharaṇībālikālikābharaṇam || atra pādacatuṣṭaye'pi vyañjanayugmānāmavyavadhānenāvṛtteśchekānuprāsaḥ || vṛttyanuprāsaḥ ullaṅghya saṃkhyāniyamaṃ paunaruktyaṃ bhavedyadi | ekadvitryādivarṇānāṃ vṛttyanuprāsamūcire || atraikasya vyañjanasya sakṛdāvṛttau vaicitryavirahātsāmarthyādasakṛdāvṛttirlabhyate | dvayostu sakṛdeva | anyathā chekānuprāso bhavet | vyavadhāne tvasakṛdāvṛttāvapi na virodhaḥ | tryādīnāṃ sakṛdasakṛdvā vyavadhānenāvyavadhānena vā āvṛttirdraṣṭavyā | vṛttiśabdena vaidarbhyādayo vivakṣitāḥ | tadupalakṣito'nuprāso vṛttyanuprāsaityāhuḥ || yathā muraghātukamaratakavaravisṛmararucinicayamecakībhūtā | ālasati nīlacelakanicolitevāhibhūbhṛto bhūmiḥ || 2231 || phaṇidharaṇīdhararamaṇī ramaṇīyamaṇīlalantikālatikā | unmīlati kā'pi mahāmahimamahī devatā mude jagatām || 2232 || komalakamalajarucimadahararucimadudāralocane deve | mudiramadarabhasanirjayarabhasi nijāṅge'stu mama mano lagnam || 2233 || dvitīye padye mahāmahimnāṃ mahī bhūmiḥ ādhārabhūtetyarthaḥ | kā'pi devateti yojanā | tṛtīye madarabhaso madavegaḥ tasya nirjaye rabhasi ullāsavadityarthaḥ | ‘rabhaso vegaharṣayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | atra padyatraye yathāyogaṃ ekadvitryādivarṇānāmāvṛttervṛttyanuprāsaḥ | atra pūrvatra ca svarasādṛśyamānuṣaṅgikam | svaravyañjanasādṛśyasya yamakaprayojakatvaṃ vakṣyate || atha lāṭānuprāsaḥ tātparyamātrabhinnā yā śabdārthapunaruktatā | so'yaṃ śābdaḥ kāvyavidbhirlāṭānuprāsa īryate || evaṃ varṇagatamanuprāsaṃ pratipādya varṇasamudāyarūpaśabdagatamanuprāsaṃ nirūpayati tātparyamātreti | tātparyamātrabhinnaṃ śabdārthayoḥ paunaruktyaṃ yat so'yaṃ śabdo varṇasamūhaḥ tatsaṃbandhī śābdo lāṭajanapriyatvāllāṭānuprāsa iti kāvyavidbhirīryate | atra śabda, paunaruktyamātraṃ yamake'pyastīti tadvāraṇāyārthapadam | yamake cārthabhedānna tatpaunaruktyam | śabdārthapaunaruktyamātraṃ kathitapadatvādirūpadoṣasādhāraṇamityatastātparyamātrabhinneti viśeṣaṇamiti dhyeyam | vākyāvṛttau padāvṛttau nāmāvṛttau ca tattridhā || saḥ lāṭānuprāsaḥ vākyapaunaruktye subantatiṅantapadapaunaruktye nāmnaḥ prātipadikasya paunaruktye ca trividho bhavati | tatrādyo yathā tvaṃ cetprasīdasi hare varṇāśramadharmacaryayā kiṃ naḥ | yadi na prasīdasi tvaṃ varṇāśramadharmacaryayā kiṃ naḥ || 2234 || atra prathamārdhe varṇāśramadharmacaryāyāḥ bhagavatprasādarūpaphalaniṣpattau satyāmanādaraḥ, dvitīyārdhe tādṛśaphalaniṣpattyabhāve anādara iti tātparyabhedena vākyāvṛtterlāṭānuprāsaḥ || yathāvā viṣamamṛtaṃ tasya bhavedyasya mano bhavati mādhave'skhalitam | viṣamamṛtaṃ tasya bhavedyasya manobhavati mādhave skhalitam || 2235 || nṛtyati hṛdi yasya hariḥ kaliḥ kṛtaṃ tasya bhavati hanta yugam | śaurirna yasya cetasi kaliḥ kṛtaṃ tasya bhavati hanta yugam || 2236 || atrādye padye yasya śranivāse cittamaskhalitaṃ tasya viṣamapyamṛtaṃ bhavet prahlādasyeva | yasya cittaṃ skhalitaṃ tasya amṛtamapi viṣaṃ bhavediti | dvitīye śrīnivāsadhyānabaddhādarasya kaliyugamapi kṛtayugaṃ tadanyasya kṛtayugamapi kaliyugamiti tātparyabhedena vākyāvṛtterlāṭānuprāsaḥ || kaliḥ kṛtayugaṃ tasya kṛtaṃ tasya kaliryugam | hṛdaye yasya govindo yasya cetasi nācyutaḥ || iti pramāṇamatra pratyabhijñāpyate | yadyapyatra padyadvaye'pi pūrvārdhayorviṣakalyoruddeśyatvātprāthamyaṃ amṛtakṛtayugaryorvidheyatvājjaghanyatvaṃ ca yuktam | uttarārdhe tu uddeśyavidheyavyutkramanirdeśarūpāvimṛṣṭavidheyāṃśarūpo doṣaḥ | tathā'pi tadasphuraṇadaśāyāṃ pratītisthaganavirahāt īdṛśamapi prakāśakārādibhiḥ prācīnairudāhṛtamityasmābhirapyudāhṛtam || dvitīyo yathā teṣāṃ cakṣuścakṣusteṣāṃ janmaiva janma manujānām | ye nidhyāyantyaniśaṃ ye'nudhyāyanti phaṇidhareśaṃ tam || 2237 || atra dvitīyacakṣurjanmaśabdayorutkarṣalakṣaṇastātparyabhedaḥ | nanu ‘indurinduriva śrīmān' ityādāvananvayālaṃkāre'pi śabdārthapaunaruktyasaṃbhavāllāṭānuprāsatvameva kiṃ na syāditi cetsatyaṃ, yadyapyananvaye arthapaunaruktyamātraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tathā'pi nirdeśapratinirdeśayoraikarūpyavirahe paryāyaprakramadoṣaprasaṃgādānuṣaṅgikaṃ śabdapaunaruktyam | atra tūbhayapaunaruktyamapyāvaśyakameveti viṣayabhedānna ko'pi virodhaḥ | taduktaṃ ananvaye ca śabdaikyamaucityādānuṣaṅgikam | asmiṃstu lāṭānuprāse sākṣādeva prayojakam || iti, ityāhuḥ | nanvevamapyanenaiva lāṭānuprāsena siddhasyaiva cakṣurādestātparyabhedena cakṣuṣṭvādividhānādvidhyalaṃkāro mā'sviti cenna | 'rāmasya gātramasi' ityādau śabdārthapaunaruktyābhāvasthale vidhyalaṃkārasyāvaśyakatvādatrāpyarthavaśātsamāveśe anayorekavācakānupraveśasaṃkarasyaiva vaktuṃ yuktatvāt || yathāvā taddaivataṃ hi daivatamahigiriśikhare'sti yanmahodāram | manujassa eva manujassakṛdapi vā yena tatsmṛtiṃ nītam || 2238 || samāsaikye taddhitāyāṃ syātsamāsāsamāsayoḥ | nāmāvṛttau punastredhā lāṭānuprāsa īritaḥ || ekasmin samāse bhinne vā samāse samāsāsamāsayorvā nāmnaḥ prātipadikasya cāvṛttau lāṭānuprāsaḥ punastrividho niṣpadyate || yathā amṛtāmṛtakaraśiśirā śiśirāvanidharadhṛtirdayāsīmā | sīmā purātanagirāṃ sā māṃ paradevatā'vatādaniśam || 2239 || dayāviṣaye asīmā avidyamānasīmā ativeladayormiletyarthaḥ | dayāyāssīmā avadhiriti vā | amṛtāmṛtetyatra amṛteti prātipadikasyaikasmin samāse śiśiretyasya bhinne samāse dayā sīmāsīmetyatra samāsāsamāsayoścāvṛttiḥ || pañcaprakāra evaṃ ca lāṭānuprāsa īritaḥ || vākyāvṛttāvekaḥ padāvṛttāvanyaḥ ekasmin samāse nāmāvṛttāvitaraḥ bhinne samāse nāmāvṛttau paraḥ | samāsāsamāsayornāmāvṛttāvapara iti pañcavidho lāṭānuprāsa uktaḥ sitakarakararuciravibhā vibhākarākāradharaṇidharakīrtiḥ | pauruṣakamalā kamalā sā'pi tavaivāsti nānyasya || ityādyudāharatāṃ kāvyaprakāśakārādīnāmanurodhena || atredaṃ cintyaṃ dvayorapi karaśabdayorvācya eva viśrāntatayā'nyaparatvavirahānnasti tātparyabhedaḥ, tasyaiva tajjīvātutvāt | ato'nuprāsamātratvamevāsya | na ca kevalakarādipadānāṃ svārthaviśrāntāvapi samāse upasarjanībhūtānāṃ svārthatyāgena parārthavṛttestātparyāntaraparatvamastyeveti vācyam, lakṣaṇāsāmagrīvirahāt | atrāpyanyapadārthapradhānatvātkaraśabdasya guṇībhāva eva na tu mukhyārthabādhaḥ, svārtha eva viśrānteḥ | na hi guṇībhāvamukhyārthabādhayorekatvaṃ sato hi mukhyārthasya kiṃcidapekṣya guṇībhāvaḥ | bādhastu svasminnevāviśrāntirityanayormahān bhedaḥ | nāpyatra lakṣaṇāyāṃ kiṃcitprayojanamityetatpaunaktyamātram | etena ‘atrābjapatranayane nayane nimīlya' ityatra lāṭānuprāsaṃ vadan sarvasvakāro'pi pratyuktaḥ | abjapatraśabdasyāpyapaunaruktyena tasya durghaṭatvāditi vadanti || <13> atha yamakam anarthakā vā bhinnārthāssārthakānarthakāśca vā | kramādāvartitā varṇā yadi tadyamakaṃ bhavet || yathā sarasā sarasā sakalāvipulā vipulā phaṇīndrabhūmibhṛtaḥ | śaurermodaṃ janayati nayati nṛṇāṃ duritamavirataṃ viratim || 2240 || atra sarasāsarasāsakaletyatra rasāsetyādīnāmanarthakānāṃ vā vipulāvipuletyatrārthasaṃbhavena bhinnārthakānāṃ vā janayati nayatītyatra kvacitsārthakānāṃ kvacidarthavidhurāṇāṃ vā varṇānāṃ kramādyatpaunaruktyaṃ tadyamakam | atra sarasāsarasāsakaletyatrāvartyamānānāṃ rasāsetivarṇānāmarthābhāvena bhinnārthakatvasya sārthakānarthakatvasya cābhāvadavyāptiḥ, ata uktamanarthakā veti | vipulāvipuletyatrāvartyamānānāṃ vipuleti varṇānāmanarthakatvasya sārthakānarthakatvasya vā abhāvādavyāptirityata uktaṃ bhinnārthakā veti | janayati nayatītyatra dvitīyanayatiśabdasya sārthakatvānnānarthakatvaṃ nāpi bhinnārthakatvaṃ, prathamanayatiśabdasyānarthakatvāt | atastatrāvyāptirityata uktaṃ sārthakānarthakāśca veti | kapiḥ pika ityadau bhinnārthakānāṃ varṇānāmāvṛtteryamakatvaprasaṅga ityata uktaṃ kramāditi | yena krameṇa prathamaṃ paṭhitāḥ tenaiva krameṇāvartitā ityarthānna tatrātivyāptiḥ | varṇā iti bahuvacanamavivakṣitam | tena vijayībhava bhavavandita ditaditijanijātajātabhītiviśeṣa | śeṣabhuja bhujagabhūdharadharaṇīramaṇīmaṇiyamāna murāre || 2241 || ityatra na yamakatvakṣatiḥ | ditijanīnāṃ daityānāṃ jātaṃ samūhaḥ tasmājjāto yo bhītiviśeṣaḥ saḥ ditaḥ chinnaḥ yena saḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ ‘ditaṃ chitaṃ vṛkṇam' ityamaraḥ | na caivaṃ lakṣaṇānanugama iti vācyaṃ, uktavidhātritayānyatamavidhāvadvarṇāvṛttiryamakamityeke | ekārthatvabhinnaśabdāvṛttiryamakam | ekārthakatvabhedaśca nirarthakeṣu bhinnārthakeṣu sārthakānarthakeṣu varṇeṣvaviśiṣṭamiti nānanugama ityanye || ślokārdhapādatadbhāgavṛttyā syāttaccaturvidham || tat yamakaṃ ślokāvṛttau ardhāvṛttau pādāvṛttau pādabhāgāvṛttau ca bhavat prathamaṃ caturvidhaṃ bhavati || tatra ślokāvṛttiryathā uttuṅgamadhyavanikāmandārollāsisuvipulakroḍa m | tamacalamahimādhāraṃ sadyo govindamādadhatamiṣṭam || 2242 || uttuṅgamadhyavani kāmandārollasisuvipulakroḍam | tamacalamahimādhāraṃ sadyogo'vindamādadhatamiṣṭam || uttuṅgamadhyavanikāmandārollāsisuvipulakroḍaṃ taṃ acalaṃ ahiṃ ādhāraṃ sadyaḥ govindaṃ ādadhataṃ iṣṭam | uttuṅgaṃ adhyavani kāmaṃ dārollāsisuvipulokroḍaṃ taṃ acalamahimādhāraṃ sadyogaḥ avindaṃ ādadhataṃ iṣṭam, iti padacchedaḥ | unnatāḥ tuṅgāḥ punnāgataravaḥ yasyāṃ tasyāṃ uttuṅgāyāṃ 'punnāge puruṣastuṅga' ityamaraḥ | madhyavanikāyāṃ madhye'raṇyamityarthaḥ | ye mandārāḥ pārijātataravaḥ ‘pāribhadre nimbatarurmandāraḥ pārijātakaḥ' ityamaraḥ | teṣu ullāsī śobhanā vipulā bhūdevī yasya saḥ suvipulaḥ bhūdevyā śliṣṭa ityarthaḥ | īdṛśaḥ kroḍaḥ ādivarāho yasmiṃsta tathoktaṃ, ādivarāhasya bhagavataśśeṣādrāvāvirbhūtatvāt | ‘kroḍo bhūdāra ityapi' iti varāhaparyāyeṣvamaraḥ | taṃ suprasiddhaṃ ahiṃ acalamityanvayaḥ | śeṣādrimityarthaḥ | śeṣasyaivācalatvenāvatīrṇatāyāḥ purāṇaprasiddhatayā abhedena nirdeśaḥ | ādhāraṃ nivāsasthānaṃ adadhataṃ kurvāṇaṃ tatra nivasantamityarthaṃḥ | iṣṭaṃ niratiśayaprītiviṣayaṃ ‘priyo hi jñānino'tyarthaṃ' iti gānāt | ‘iṣu icchāyāṃ' karmaṇi ktaḥ | iṣṭaṃ sarvaiḥ pūjitamiti vā | yajateḥ ktaḥ iṣṭamāśaṃsite'pi syātpūjite preyasi triṣu | saptatantau pumān klībe saṃskāre kratukarmaṇi || iti medinī | uttuṅgaṃ sarvairguṇairatimātramunnataṃ | adhyavani bhūmau | vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ | adhyavani ahimacalamādhāramādadhatamityanvayaḥ | kāmaṃ paryāptaṃ yathāsyāttathā dāraiḥ saha dharmiṇyā lakṣmyā ullāsi prakāśamānaṃ suvipulaṃ ativiśālaṃ kroḍaṃ bhujāntaraṃ yasya taṃ lakṣmīsamāśliṣṭaviśālavakṣasamityarthaḥ | taṃ vedāntavedyajagatkāraṇatvādikalyāṇaguṇagaṇatayā prasiddhaṃ acalasya sthirasya mahimnaḥ māhātmyasya ādhāraṃ iṣṭaṃ āśritābhīpsitaṃ yajvabhiḥ kṛtaṃ yāgaṃ vā ādadhataṃ puṣṇantaṃ govindaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ ‘govindeti yadākrandat' ityuktarītyā bhagavatastannāmnā sauśīlyaparākāṣṭhādyotakenāhvāne prītyatiśayasya gamyamānatayā śeṣādrau prāyeṇa govindanāmna eva janaiḥ kīrtyamānatayā govindaśabdena nirdeśaḥ | san praśastaḥ yogo dhyānaṃ yasya sa tathoktassan sadyaḥ avindaṃ śaraṇamavṛṇavam | vindatelaṅuttamaikavacanam || ardhāvṛttiryathā śubhadāmo'darabhāsurajaya māpāhisthirādharāmodin | śubha dāmodara bhāsura jaya mā pāhi sthirādharāmodīn || 2244 || śubhadāmaḥ adarabhāsurajaya māpa ahisthirādharāmodin śubha dāmodara bhāsura jaya māṃ pāhi sthirādharāmodin, iti padacchedaḥ | adarabhāḥ analpatejasaḥ ye asurāḥ jayatīti jayaḥ pacādyac | teṣāṃ jayaḥ analpavikramadaiteyajetetyarthaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ adarabhāsurajaya ! ahisthirādharaḥ śeṣādriḥ tasmin āmodin ānandin, śubha ‘maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam' ityuktarītyā maṅgalarūpa | dāmodara bhāsura svaprakāśasvarūpa | sthirāyāḥ bhūdevyāḥ adhareṇa adhararasena āmodin | yadvā sthirādhara dharaṇidhara ‘dharaṇidharācyuta śaṅkhacakrapāṇe, ‘dharaṇidhara me śikṣaya manaḥ' ityā dikamiha smartavyam | ataeva āmodin atinirhāriparimalaśālin | bhūdevyāssvābhāvikagandhavattvena nityatadyogāditi bhāvaḥ ‘vimardotthe parimalo gandhe janamanohare | āmodasso'tinirhārī' ityamaraḥ | yadvā ‘sarvagandhassarvarasaḥ' iti śravaṇātsarvadivyagandhetyarthaḥ | māpa śrīpate! śubhā dāmā vaijayantī yasya sa tathoktaḥ tvaṃ jaya | jidhātorloṇmadhyamaikavacanam | ‘na puṃsi dāma saṃdānam' ityamaraḥ | dāmaśabdasya strīliṅgasya ‘manaḥ' iti ṅībniṣedhe 'ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' iti ḍāp | tato bahuvrīhiḥ | bhā māṃ pāhi pālaya || yathāvā vadanābhibhāvitābjaṃ paramañjanavedagiriśirasyuditam | vada nābhibhāvitābjaṃ paramaṃ jana vedagiri śirasyuditam || 2245 || vadanābhibhāvitābjaṃ paraṃ añjanavedagiriśirasi uditaṃ vada nābhibhāvitābjaṃ paramaṃ jana vedagiri śirasi uditaṃ iti cchedaḥ | vadanena abhibhāvitaḥ abhibhavaṃ tiraskāraṃ prāpitaḥ abjaḥ candro yena tam | tiraskāre bhagavataḥ prayojakakartṛtvaṃ, vadanasya prayojyakartṛtvam | añjanavedagiriśirasi añjanaścāsau vedaśca añjanavedaḥ añjanākhyo vedākhyaśca yo giriḥ tasya śirasi śikhare uditaṃ āvirbhūtam | nābhibhāvitābjaṃ nābhau bhāvitaṃ utpāditaṃ abjaṃ padmaṃ yena tam, 'ajasya nābhāvadhyekamarpitaṃ yasminnidaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhiśritam' iti śruteḥ | vedagiri śrutirūpāyāṃ vāci śirasi ante vedānte ityarthaḥ | uditaṃ udīritaṃ | vadeḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ | 'taṃ tvaupaniṣadam' iti śruteḥ | he jana ! paraṃ atiśayitaṃ yathāsyāttathā paramaṃ atyuttamaṃ vada brūhi | añjanagirāvāvirbhūtaṃ bhagavantaṃ vidhātṛjaninidānabhūtanābhikamalatayā akhilajagatkāraṇaṃ paraṃ brahmeti vadeti janān pratyāvedanam || yathāvā prapadanatastava nānye'vākalayante mudaṃ nanūpāyāḥ | prapadananastavanānyevākalayante mudaṃ na nūpāyāḥ || 2246 || prapadanataḥ tava na anye avākalayante mudaṃ nanu upāyāḥ prapadanataḥ stavanāni eva akalayaṃ te mudaṃ na nu upāyāḥ, iti padacchedaḥ | nanvityāmantreṇa | nanu bhagavan ! prapadanataḥ śaraṇavaraṇāt ādyāditvātsārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | anye itare upāyāḥ yajñadānatapo'naśanādisādhanāni tava mudaṃ prītiṃ nāvākalayante nāvākalpayante | avāṅpūrvakātkalayaterlaṭ | te tava prapade pādāgre 'pādāgraṃ prapadam' ityamaraḥ | nataḥ śaraṇāgatassan stavanānyeva stutīreva akalayaṃ aracayam | kalayaterlaṅuttamaikavacanam | mudaṃ prītiṃ, tena stavaneneti bhāvaḥ | nuśabdaḥ pṛcchāyām | ‘nu pṛcchāyāṃ vikalpe ca' ityamaraḥ | nopāyāḥ tu nopāgacchaḥ kim ? upāṅpūrvakādupapūrvakādvā yāterlaṅmadhyamaḥ | upāgata eveti nirdhārayāmi | stavapriya iti hi tava nāmeti bhāvaḥ | dvitīyārdhe prapadanataḥ stavanānītyatra ‘kharpare śari vā visargalopo vaktavyaḥ' iti visargalopaḥ | akalayante ityatra ‘vā padāntasya iti vaikalpiko'nusvārasya parasavarṇaḥ | atra iti vāgbhiḥ praśastābhirayonirviṣṇurīḍitaḥ | vāgyajñenārcito devaḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ || ityādipramāṇānyanusaṃdheyāni | ime ślokāvṛttyardhāvṛttiyamake mahāyamakaṃ samudgakamiti nāmabhyāṃ rudraṭādibhirvyavāhriyetām | yathocyate 'ardhaṃ punarāvṛttaṃ janayati yamakaṃ samudgakaṃ nāma | ślokastu mahāyamakam' iti || yathāvā lakṣmīścakāsti bhavato navatoyadasārabhāsitādavitaḥ | lakṣmīśca kā'sti bhavato'navato yadasārabhāsitādavitaḥ || 2247 || lakṣmīḥ cakāsti bhavataḥ navatoyadasārabhāsitāt avitaḥ, iti pūrvārdhe | uttarārdhe tu lakṣmīḥ ca kā asti bhavataḥ anavataḥ yat asārabhāsitāt avitaḥ iti cchedaḥ | he avitaḥ avateḥ rakṣaṇārthakātṛc | he rakṣaka! 'na hi pālanasāmarthyamṛte sarveśvaraṃ harim' | ityukteḥ | navatoyadāḥ prāvṛṣeṇyavāridāḥ teṣu sāraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ tasya bhā prabheva asitāt śyāmalāt | yadvā navatoyadasya sārabhā śreṣṭhadīptiḥ seva asitaḥ tasmāt | tasyā apyasitāditi vā | bhavataḥ tvattaḥ lakṣmīḥ cakāsti | nīlatoyadamadhyasthavidyudiva prāptaparabhāgatayā bhāsata iti bhāvaḥ | yadvā bhavatassakāśāt lakṣmīḥ saṃpat janānāmiti śeṣaḥ | cakāsti tvatta eva jagatāṃ samṛddhilābha iti bhāvaḥ | anavataḥ āpatsu arakṣakāt saṃhartṛtayā aprīṇayataśca bhavataḥ śarvāt lakṣścī śrīrapi saṃpaditi vārtā'pīti bhāvaḥ | kā asti janānāṃ tasmātkā'pi saṃpanna sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ | kuta ityata āha yaditi | yat yasmātkaraṇāt ayamityadhyāhāraḥ, asāraṃ nissāraṃ aśreṣṭhaṃ vā bhasitameva bhāsitaṃ vāyasarākṣasādivat svārthiko'ṇ | tasmāt avitaḥ prītaḥ tṛpto vā bhavati | avateḥ prītyarthakāttṛptyarthakādvā kartari ktaḥ | rakṣaṇāsamarthāt bhasmamātrasamṛddhimattayā tṛptādasmāllakṣmīlābhassarvarakṣakācchrīnivāsādbhagavata iva janānāṃ kathaṃ niṣpadyeteti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā śrīśobhitassa dāsaṃ padaṃ śritaṃ bahukaro'tihīnamapi | śrīśo'bhitassadā saṃpadaṃ śritaṃ bahu karo'ti hīnamapi || 2248 || śrīśobhitaḥ saḥ dāsaṃ padaṃ śritaṃ bahukaraḥ atihīnaṃ api śrīśaḥ abhitaḥ sadā saṃpadaṃ śritaṃ bahu karoti hi inaṃ api iti padacchedaḥ | śriyā ṣāḍguṇyasaṃpadā śobhitaḥ | bahavaḥ karāḥ hastāḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | svasaṃpadanuguṇapuruṣārthacatuṣṭayadānaupayikapāṇicatuṣṭaya iti bhāvaḥ | saḥ sarveśvaratvena sakalopaniṣatprasiddhaḥ śrīśaḥ bhagavān śrīnivāsaḥ atihīnamapi atidurgatamapīti yāvat | apirvirodhe | padaṃ svacaraṇaṃ śritaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataṃ dāsaṃ śeṣabhūtaṃ cetanaṃ abhitaḥ samantataḥ sarvasmin deśe ityarthaḥ | sadā sarvasmin kāle bahu vipulaṃ yathāsyāttathā saṃpadaṃ sapattiṃ śriṃta prāptaṃ karoti | naitāvadeva kiṃtu ina mapi prabhumapi karoti | 'inassūrye prabhau' ityamaraḥ | atra apissamuccaye | hiḥ prasiddhau || yathāvā nijadhāmni devanetā paviyuktaśśrīrbhavatyanugrahataḥ | nijadhāmni devane tāpaviyuktaśrīrbhavatyanugrahataḥ || 2249 || nijadhāmni devanetā paviyukaḥ śrīḥ bhavatyanugrahataḥ | nijadhāmni devane tāpaviyuktaśrīḥ bhavati anugrahataḥ | iti chedaḥ | nijaṃ nityaṃ dhāma tejaḥ prabhāvo vā yasyāssā nijadhāmnī | tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ he nijadhāmni! ‘ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' iti vaikalpiko ṅīp | ‘svake nityaṃ nijaṃ triṣu' gṛhagehatviṭprabhāvā dhāmāni' iti cāmaraḥ | ‘nijaṃ svīye ca nitye ca' iti medinī ca | he śrīḥ bhavatyā anugrahaḥ bhavatyanugrahaḥ tasmāt sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ ‘sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ' iti bhāṣyakāreṣṭeḥ ‘ṭhakchasośca' iti vārtikārambheṇānityatājñāpanādbhavatīśabdasya na puṃvadbhāvaḥ | etacca haṃsasaṃdeśarasāsvādinyāṃ ‘bhavatībhāgadheyena jīvan' ityatra nipuṇataraṃ prapañcitamasmābhiḥ | devanetā indraḥ pavimuktaḥ vajrasahitaḥ ‘kuliśaṃ bhiduraṃ paviḥ' ityamaraḥ | etena śauryasthairyaṃ vyañjitam | ataeva anugrahataḥ ugraiḥ daityādibhiḥ krūraiḥ hataḥ hiṃsito na bhavatīti tathā | ataeva nijadhāmni svasthāne tridive devane krīḍane dyotane modane vā | tāpaviyuktaśrīḥ tāpaiḥ ādhyātmikādibhiḥ viyuktā śrīssaṃpat yasya sa tathoktaḥ bhavati | atra viṣṇupurāṇakathā'nusaṃdheyā | imānyardhāvṛttirūpayamakodāharaṇāni sarvāṇyapi vakṣyamāṇagomūtrikābandhodāharaṇāni bhaviṣyanti || atha pādāvṛttiyamakavibhāgaḥ āvṛttāvādyapādāderdvitīyādau bhidā nava || prathamapādasya dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthapādeṣu krameṇāvṛttau trayo bhedāḥ | yugapadāvṛttau tveka iti prathamapādāvṛttinibandhanāścatvāro bhedāḥ | tathā dvitīyapādasya tṛtīyacaturthayoḥ krameṇāvṛttau dvau bhedau' tṛtīyapādasya caturthapāde āvṛttāveka iti śuddhāḥ pādāvṛttinibandhanā bhedāssapta | tathā prathamasya dvitīye tṛtīyasya caturthe cāvṛttāvekaḥ | tathā prathamasya caturthe dvitīyasya caturthe dvitīyasya tṛtīye cāvṛttāvapara iti saṃkīrṇau dvau bhedau | āhatya pādāvṛttinibandhanā bhedā nava saṃpadyante | idamupalakṣaṇam | yathāhi prathamapādasya dvitīyādipādeṣu krameṇa yaugapadyena cāvṛttau catvāro bhedā uktāḥ | tathā prathamasya dvitīyatṛtīyayordvitīyacaturthayoḥ tṛtīyacaturthayoścāvṛttāvanye'pi trayo bhedassaṃbhavanti | tathā dvitīyasya tṛtīyacaturthayoḥ krameṇāvṛttau bhedadvayavat yugapadāvṛttāvaparo'pi bhedassaṃbhavatīti dhyeyam || atha pādabhāgāvṛttiyamakavibhāgaḥ dvidhā vibhāge pādānāṃ prathamādyādimā yadi | dvitīyādyādibhāgeṣu yamyante syurbhidā daśa || prathamādyantimā bhāgā dvitīyādyantimāṃśagāḥ | bhaveyuścettadā'pi syurevameva bhidā daśa || evaṃ dvidhā vibhāge tu bhedānāṃ viṃśatirbhavet | tridhā pādavibhāge tu triṃśadityūhyatāṃ kramāt || pādānāṃ dvidhā vibhāge prathamapādādyabhāgasya dvitīyādipādādyabhāgeṣu krameṇa yugapaccāvṛttau catvāro bhedāḥ | dvitīyapādādyabhāgasya tṛtīyacaturthapādādyabhāgayoḥ krameṇāvṛttau dvau bhedau | prathamapādādyabhāgasya caturthapādādyabhāge cāvṛttāvekaḥ, tathā prathamapādādyabhāgasya caturthapādādyabhāge dvitīyapādādyabhāgasya tṛtīya pādādyabhāge cāvṛttāvaparo bhedaḥ | tathā ardhāvṛttinyāyena prathamapādādyabhāgasya tṛtīyapādādyabhāge dvitīyapādādyabhāgasya caturthapādādyabhāge cāvṛttāvanyo bheda ityādyā bhāgāvṛttinibandhanā daśa bhedāḥ || nanvardhāvṛttinyāyeneva ślokāvṛttinyāyenāpi tattadbhedāḥ kuto nocyanta iti cet vicchittiviśeṣābhāvena ślokāntare bhāgāvṛttinibandhanā bhedā noktā iti dhyeyam | evamevāntyabhāgāvṛttinibandhanāśca bhedā daśa | evaṃ pādānāṃ dvidhā vibhāge viṃśatirbhedāḥ tridhā vibhāge triṃśat | caturdhā vibhāge catvāriṃśadbhavanti bhedā ityādyūhyam | itthaṃ śuddhabhedā nirūpitāḥ || atha saṃkīrṇabhedaprakārāḥ evamantyādikādyāntamadhyādīnyādimadhyagam | antyamadhyaṃ ca madhyāntyameteṣāṃ ca samuccayāḥ || yadā prathamādipādagatāntyabhāgo dvitīyādipādādyabhāge yamyate tadā antya ādau yamyata ityanvarthatāśrayaṇādantyādikam | yadā prathamapādādyabhāgo dvitīyapādāntyabhāge yamyate tadā ādyo'ntye yamyata ityādyantakam | evaṃ prathamādipādamadhyabhāgasya dvitīyādipādādyabhāge yamane madhyādikam | pavamādyabhāgasya madhyabhāge yamane ādimadhyagam | evamantyabhāgasya madhyabhāge yamane antyamadhyagam | madhyabhāgasyāntyabhāge yamane madhyāntyakam | yadā eteṣāṃ samāveśastadaitatsamuccayāśca bhavantītyavadheyam | evamekapādagatabhāgānāṃ pādāntarabhāgāpekṣā bhedāḥ pradarśitāḥ | ekapādagatabhāgānāmanyonyāpekṣā bhedāḥ pradarśyante ekaikapāde niyatā niyatakramaśālinaḥ | yamyante cedādimadhyāntyabhāgāstadbhidāśśatam || yadā tvekaikasminneva pāde ādimadhyāntyabhāgānāṃ niyatakramatvena aniyatakramatvena ca yamanaṃ tadā śataṃ aneke bhedāssaṃbhavanti | ete yamakaprabhedāḥ kāvyalakṣmīkaṇṭhagaḍubhūtatayā na prapañcanārhā iti diṅmātramevodāhriyate || puruṣassamāhitamanā yassevetāhiśailamaulimaṇim | puruṣassa māhitamanāstasmai kiṃ kiṃ padaṃ na vidadhīta || 2250 || yaḥ puruṣaḥ manujaḥ samāhitamanāḥ praṇihitacittassan ahiśailamaulimaṇiṃ seveta tasmai puruṣāya saḥ 'sakalaphalaprado hi viṣṇuḥ' iti prasiddhaḥ māhitamanāḥ māyai śriyai hitaṃ priyaṃ karaṇaṃ mano yasya saḥ | anena puruṣakārasāṃnidhyaṃ tatprītyācaraṇaikatānatvaṃ coktam | puruṣaḥ bhagavān kiṃ kiṃ phalaṃ na vidadhīta ‘kimalabhyaṃ bhagavati prasanne śrīniketane' ityukteriti bhāvaḥ || ratnaparvatamāruhya yathā ratnaṃ naro mune | satvānurūpamādatte tathā kṛṣṇānmanorathān || ityādikamapyatrānusaṃdheyam || yathāvā nāśamito'bhavadamunā bhavatā mama tāvadakhiladuritaughaḥ | nāśamito bhavadamunā bhavitā phaṇiśailanīlajalada hare || 2251 || nāśaṃ itaḥ abhavat amunā iti prathamapāde | na aśamitaḥ bhavadamunāḥ iti tṛtīyapāde ca chedaḥ | he hare ! idamāśritaduritāpahārasāmarthyābhiprāyagarbham | amunā bhavatā ātmahavissamarpaṇoddeśyabhūtena tvayā, hetau tṛtīyā | mama akhiladuritaughānāṃ sarvapūrvāghavyūhānāṃ, idamupalakṣaṇaṃ prāmādikottarāghānāmapi | nāśaṃ vināśaṃ idamaśleṣasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | itaḥ prāptaḥ iṇaḥ kartari ktaḥ abhavat | uttarāghāśleṣasya siddhavatkārābhisaṃdhinā bhūtanirdeśaḥ | bhavassaṃsāra eva damunāḥ āgniḥ saptārcirdamunāḥ' ityamaraḥ | bhavatetyetadatrāpyanuṣajyate | aśamitaḥ na bhavitā anirvāpito na bhaviṣyati | bhūdhātorbhaviṣyati luṭ | phaṇiśailanīlajaladeti viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavāgninirvāpaṇadhurīṇatābhiprāyakam | bhavatā mama pūrvottarāghavināśāśleṣayornirvartitayoḥ punassaṃsāratāpaḥ kadā'pi na bhaviṣyatyeveti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā bhavitā satkṛttyādṛtiracyuta na tvatpadāśritānāṃ yaḥ | bhavitāsatkṛttyādṛtireva sa eṣo'tra ko nu saṃśetām || 2252 || he acyuta ! yaḥ pumān tvatpadāśritānāṃ bhāgavatānāṃ satkṛtau satkāre bahumānane ādṛtiḥ ādaraṇaṃ yasya sa tathokto na bhavitā sa eṣa janaḥ asatkṛtyādṛtireva asat apraśastaṃ yatkṛtyaṃ tasmin ādṛtirasya tathokta eva bhavitā | yadvā bhavitāsatkṛtyādṛtiriti tṛtīyacaraṇe samastaṃ padam | bhavitayā saṃsāritayā satāṃ brahmavidāṃ kṛtye ācāre ādṛtiḥ yasya sa na bhavatītyasatkṛtyādṛtirerava | athavā asatyāṃ apraśastāyāṃ kṛtyāyāṃ devatāyāṃ 'kṛtyā kriyādevatayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | ādṛtiryasya tathokta eva bhavitā | bhāgavatārādhanavimukhānāmīdṛśī gatiriti bhāvaḥ | athavā asatkṛttyāḥ asatī sparśādyanarhā yā kṛttiḥ śvādicarma 'ajinaṃ carma kṛttiḥ strī' ityamaraḥ | tasyāḥ dṛtiḥ bhastrā bhavitā bhāgavatasatkārādaravidhuraḥ pumān carmabhastrikāprāya eva na tu cetana iti bhāvaḥ | atra padyatraye'pyādyapādasya tṛtīyapāde āvṛttiḥ || yathāvā kriyate yadbhuvanāvanamīśā no nanu vṛṣācaleśena | prabhavedetadracayitumīśā no nanu vṛṣā ca leśena || 2253 || īśā naḥ nanu vṛṣācaleśena | īśānaḥ na nu vṛṣā ca leśena iti chedaḥ | vṛṣācaleśena śeṣādrināthena naḥ asmākaṃ īśā 'īśā vāsyamidag sarvam' ityatreva īṭbdo'yaṃ tṛtīyaikavacanāntaḥ | svāminetyarthaḥ | yat bhuvanāvanaṃ jagatpālanaṃ kiyate etat bhuvanāvanaṃ racayituṃ īśānaḥ śarvaḥ vṛṣā ca nu vāsavo'pi vā ‘nu pṛcchāyāṃ vikalpe ca' ityamaraḥ | leśena leśato'pi na prabhavennanu | nanuravadhāraṇe | ‘praśnāvadhāraṇānujñānunayāmantraṇe nanu' ityamaraḥ | na hi pālanasāmarthyamṛte sarveśvaraṃ harim | sthitau sthitaṃ mahāprājña bhavatyanyasya kasyacit || ityuktaṃ pālanasāmarthyaṃ ‘na sanna cāsacchiva eva kevalaḥ' ‘indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate' iti kāraṇatvaśaṅkāspadatvena śrutayośśivaśatamakhayorna saṃbhavediti bhāvaḥ || yathāvā bhūṣṇussyādyo manujo bhavati sa dāmodarahitatāśreyān | yo manujo'bhūṣṇussa ca bhavati sadāmodarahitatāśreyān || 2254 || yaḥ manujaḥ bhūṣṇuḥ vardhiṣṇuḥ syāt saḥ dāmodarāya hitaḥ dāmodarahitaḥ ‘hitayoge ca' iti caturthī | ‘caturthī tadartha' ityādinā samāsaḥ | tasya bhāvaḥ dāmodarahitatā tayā śreyān praśasyataraḥ bhavati | yo manujaḥ abhūṣṇuḥ sa ca saṃścāsāvāmodaśca sadāmodaḥ praśastānandaḥ tena rahitatayā vidhuratayā aśreyān avidyamānaṃ śreyo yasya tathābhūtaḥ bhavati | ‘īyasaśca' iti bahuvrīherna kap || yathāvā tvayi yo'cyutābhidadhyādantaryāmīti śabdamātramapi | tāṃ śriyameti sa na viśedantaryāmīti śabdamātramapi || 2255 || he acyuta ! tvayi viṣaye antaryāmī antarniyanteti śabdamātramapi yaḥ abhidadhyāt | mā sma tadarthaṃ jñāsīditi bhāvaḥ | saḥ pumān tāṃ śriyaṃ saṃpadaṃ eti prāpnoti | yāṃ śriyaṃ ītiśabdamātramapi viplavaśabdamātramapi antaḥ na viśet kimuta tadarthaḥ | tvayi antaryāmīti śabdamātraṃ prayuñjāno'pi nirātaṅkāṃ śriyamaihikīmāmuṣmikīṃ vā prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | ‘ītirḍimbapravāsayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | ḍimbo viplavaḥ ‘ḍimbe ḍamaraviplavau' īti tenaivānuśiṣṭatvāt || yathāvā yaḥ phaṇiśailaniveśe śrīśe'vadhirahitavardhane nipuṇaḥ | sa bhavati vasudhādhīśaśśrīśevadhirahitavardhane'nipuṇaḥ || 2256 || śrīśe avadhirahitavardhane nipuṇaḥ śrīśevadhiḥ ahitavardhane'nipuṇaḥ iti padacchedaḥ | yaḥ pumān avadhirahitaṃ anantaṃ vardhanaṃ vṛndviḥ yasya tathokte svarūpeṇa guṇaiśca niratiśayabṛhati parasmin brahmaṇīti yāvat | yadvā anavacchinnābhivṛddhau trivikramāvatāre tathā pravṛddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | avadhirahitaṃ yathāsyāttathā vardhane vardhiṣṇāviti vā | ‘vardhanaṃ vṛddhivardhiṣṇucchede' iti medinī | ‘syādvarddhiṣṇustu vardhanaḥ' ityamaraśca | phaṇiśailaniveśe śrīśe śrīnivāse nipuṇaḥ mātari nipuṇa ityādāviva tatpūjanaikatāna ityarthaḥ | ‘sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ' ityarcāyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ nipuṇaśabdayoge saptamī | saḥ pumān śriyaḥ saṃpadaḥ śevadhiḥ nidhiḥ 'nidhirnā śevadhiḥ' ityamaraḥ | ahitānāṃ vairiṇāṃ vardhane chedane viṣaye nipuṇaḥ kuśalaḥ vasudhādhīśaḥ rājā bhavati | atra ‘kriyate yadbhuvanāvanam' ityādipadyacatuṣṭaye'pi dvitīyapādasya turīyapāde āvṛttiḥ | atra prathamasya pādasya tṛtīye pāde āvṛttau saṃdaṃśo nāma yamakam | dvitīyasya caturthe āvṛttau saṃdaṣṭakaṃ nāma yamakamiti rudraṭaḥ | tathāca tadīyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ paryāyeṇānyeṣāmāvṛttānāṃ sahādipādena | mukhasaṃdaṃśāvṛtayaḥ krameṇa yamakāni jāyante || ādipādena dvitīyapādāvṛttau mukhaṃ nāma yamakam | tena tṛtīyapādāvṛttau saṃdaṃśonāma yamakam | tena turīyapādāvṛttāvāvṛtirnāma yamakamiti tadarthaḥ | pratyekaṃ paścimayorāvṛttyā pādayordvitīyena | yamake saṃjāyete garbhassaṃdaṣṭakaṃ ceti || iti || paścimayoḥ tṛtīyaturīyapādayoḥ dvitīyenāvṛttau garbhasaṃdaṣṭakanāmanī yamake bhavata iti tadarthaḥ | prathamatṛtīyapādābhyāṃ dvitīyaturīyapādayorāvṛttirihāryāvṛtteṣu na ghaṭata iti nodāhārṣma pratijñābhaṅgabhayāt || atha pādabhāgāvṛttiyamakabhedā diṅmātramudāhriyante vanamālīyata nīpāvanamālī yogināṃ ca yatra girau | vanamālī ya ihāste'vanamālīḍhābdhijādharaṃ tamaye || 2257 || yatra girau śeṣācale nīpāvanaṃ nīpānāṃ kadambānāṃ bandhūkānāṃ nīlāśokānāṃ vā kadambabandhūkānīlāśokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vā taruviśeṣāṇāṃ avanaṃ rakṣakaṃ 'puṃvākyeṣvanekārthatvamadoṣāya' ityasakṛdavocāma | ‘nīpaḥ kadambe bandhūke nīlāśokadrume'pi ca' iti viśvaḥ | vanaṃ vipinaṃ ālīyata āślikṣat sthitamityarthaḥ | yogināṃ munīnāṃ ālī paṅktiśca ālīyateti yojanā | iha asmingirau vanamālī āpādalambinīṃ mālāṃ vanamālāṃ vidurbudhāḥ | pañcavarṇā tu yā mālā vaijayantī gadābhṛtaḥ || ityādyuktalakṣaṇavaijayantyākhyamālālaṃkṛtaḥ yaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ āste | avanaṃ nirupādhikasarvarakṣakaṃ ālīḍhābdhijādharaṃ āsvāditaramādharaṃ taṃ śrīnivāsaṃ aye śaraṇaṃ prapadye | taṃ avanaṃ aye iti vā yojanā | rakṣakatvena vṛṇomītyarthaḥ | iha prathamapādabhāgasya vanamālīti catu rakṣarātmakasya dvitīyādipādatrayabhāgeṣvāvṛttiḥ | prathamatṛtīyayoḥ pañcānāṃ varṇānāmāvṛttirapyastīti viśeṣaśca || mama tāvadiyaṃ sutarāmamatā duritāliracyutātyamitā | mamatāṃ vahatā bhavatā bhavatāpahṛtā kṣamāpadaṃ gamitā || 2258 || he acyuta! tāvaditi sākalye | sutarāṃ amatā anabhyupagatā atyamitā mama tvāṃ prapannasyeti bhāvaḥ | duritālistāvat sarvāghatatirityarthaḥ | mamatāṃ madīyo'yamiti vātsalyamityarthaḥ | vahatā bhavatāpahṛtā saṃsārasaṃjvaranirāsakeneti svāparādhakṣamādakṣatābhiprāyakam | bhavatā kṣamāpadaṃ kṣamāgocaratāṃ gamitā nītetyarthaḥ | anena 'nyāsena kṣapayannanabhyupagataprārabdhakhaṇḍaṃ ca naḥ' ityukto'rthassaṃgṛhītaḥ | atra prathamapādādimabhāgasya mamatetyakṣaratrayātmakasya dvitīyatṛtīyapādādibhāgamātre āvṛttiḥ | na tu turīyapādādibhāge | atra yamakāntaramapyavadheyam || stāvakamahiśikhariśaśiṃstāvakacaritasya dhanyamiha manye | bhāvukamakhilaṃ subhagaṃbhāvukamenaṃ yato nayasi manujam || 2259 || he ahiśikhariśaśin ! tāvakacaritasya stāvakaṃ stotāraṃ janaṃ dhanyaṃ manye | yato hetoḥ subhagaṃbhāvukaṃ enaṃ manujaṃ akhilaṃ bhāvukaṃ kuśalaṃ 'bhāvukaṃ bhavikaṃ bhavyaṃ' ityamaraḥ | nayasi | tasmādamuṃ dhanyaṃ manye iti yojanā | atrādyapādādyabhāgasya dvitīyapādādibhāge tṛtīyādyapādasya turīyapādādibhāge cāvṛttiḥ || yairna kṛtā kvacidapi vā satkṛttyāssyuḥ prasevikāśśaure | śvāsānvitāsta ete'satkṛttyāssyuḥ prasevikā nūnam || 2260 || yairjanaiḥ kvacidapi vā satkṛtiḥ ādaraḥ tayā satkṛtyā | ‘anaci ca' iti takārasya dvitvaṃ yamakāvirodhāyeti dhyeyam | prasevikāḥ prakṛṣṭāssevāḥ 'dhātvarthanirdeśe ṇvul vaktavyaḥ' iti sevateḥ ṇvul | dhātvarthaśca sevanam | na kṛtāḥ ta ete janā śvāsānvitāḥ śvasantyaḥ asatkṛttyāḥ asatī svarśādyanarhā yā kṛttiḥ śvagardabhādicarma tasyāḥ prasevikāḥ bhastrikā eva nūnam | ‘bhastrā carmaprasevikā' ityamaraḥ | bhagavatsevanavidhurāḥ śvāsamātravaḥ ccarmabhastrikāprāyā eva | atra 'taravaḥ kiṃ na jīvanti bhastrāḥ kiṃ na śvasanti ca' ityādibhāgavataślokārtho'nusaṃdheyaḥ | atra dvitīyaturīyayorādyabhāgāvṛttiḥ || yastava kathāsudhāyāṃ yaduvaṃśamaṇe mahādṛtirna ssyāt | samyakkṛte vimarśe sa naro nūnaṃ mahādṛtirnassyāt || 2261 || he yaduvaṃśamaṇe ! yaḥ naraḥ tava kathāsudhāyāṃ mahādṛtiḥ mahatī ādṛtiryasya tathoktaḥ | na syāt na bhavet saḥ naraḥ samyak vimarśe kṛte nassyādityatra naḥ syāt iti chedaḥ | naḥ asmākaṃ sa naraḥ mahādṛtiḥ mahatī bhastrikaiva syāt tattulyo bhavet | asmaddṛṣṭyā sa carmabhastrikāprāya eva syāt na tu cetana iti bhāvaḥ | atra dvitīyaturīyapādayorantyabhāgāvṛttiḥ ‘dṛtiścarmapuṭe matsye' iti medinī | ‘dṛteḥ pādādivodakam' iti prayogaśca || jagatāṃ sa bhavānīśaḥ phaṇadharagirinātha na tu bhavānīśaḥ | brahmā'pi bhavānīśastadahaṃ tava kiṃkaro bhavānīśaḥ || 2262 || he phaṇadharagirinātha! bhavāneva jagatāṃ īśaḥ svāmī | bhavānīśastu rudrastu na neśa ityarthaḥ | brahmā'pi neśaḥ | kuta ityata āha bhavānīśa iti | bhavena saṃsāreṇa anīśaḥ asvatantraḥ saṃsārabandhavivaśa ityarthaḥ | ‘anīśayā śocati muhyamānaḥ' iti śruteḥ | tat tasmāt rudrādīnāṃ saṃsāraparatantratvāt ahaṃ bhavabandhānmumukṣuriti bhāvaḥ | īśaḥ īṭchabdadaṣṣaṣṭhyanto'yam | nirupādhikatayā sarveśvarasyetyarthaḥ ‘juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśaṃ, jñājñau dvāvajāvīśanīśau' ityādiśrutibhyaḥ | tava ‘teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarāt' ityuktarītyā bhavasāgarādvinatānuddharatastaveti bhāvaḥ | kiṃkaraḥ bhavāni bhaveyam | loḍutamaikavacanam | mumukṣurahaṃ ‘baddhassvayaṃ kimu vimocayitā batānyam' iti nyāyena svayameva saṃsṛtibandhamomuhyamānānumānāthādīnanādṛtya nikhilasaṃsṛtipāśabandhanirdhūnanaparamādbhutaśaktestavaiva dāsyamabhyupeyāmiti bhāvaḥ | atra ‘ā brahmastambaparyantā' ityādipramāṇānyapyanusadheyāni | atra prathamapādāntyabhāgo bhavānīśa iti varṇacatuṣṭayātmako dvitīyādipādatrayāntyabhāgeṣvāvartitaḥ || yathāvā svadhayaiva bhṛśamanantaṃ pralayadaśāyāṃ vaṣācaleśamanantam | ya upāste śamanantaṃ na vīkṣate bata sa vindate śamanantam || 2263 || pralayadaśāyāṃ svadhayā lakṣmyā saha | evaśabdo bhinnakrama uttaratrānveti | ‘svadhā tvaṃ lokabhāvanī' iti purāṇokteḥ svadhāśabdo lakṣmīvācī | mahābhārate ca śrīvāsavasaṃvāde ‘ahaṃ svāhā svadhā caiva' iti śriyā svayamevoktatvācca | bhṛśaṃ anantaṃ prāṇantaṃ ‘ānīdavātagg svadhayā tadekam' iti śruteḥ | mahābhārate ca kṛtvā matsthāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | ekākī vidyayā sārdhaṃ vihariṣye dvijottama || iti vidyāśabdo lakṣmīparaḥ | ‘ātmavidyā ca devi tvam' ityādyukteḥ | yadvā ‘teneyaṃ sa ca dharmātmā muhūrtamapi jīvati' ityuktarītyā svadhayā ānīditi premapāratantrye tātparyam | yadvā svasmin dhīyata iti vyutpattyā svadhāśabdassvasattāviṣayakaḥ | svakīyaṃ viśvadhāraṇasāmarthyameva vā svadhā | tathāca ‘śreṣṭhaśca' ityadhikaraṇe bhāṣyaṃ ‘ānīdavātam' iti tu na jaivaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāṇanamabhipretyocyate apitu parasya brahmaṇa ekasyaiva vidyamānatvamucyate' iti | 'atrānanyādhīnasattākatvamabhipretam' iti catuśślokībhāṣye ācāryāḥ | anena jagatkāraṇatvamuktam | ‘kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeya' iti tasyaivopāsyatvaśravaṇāt | anantaṃ trividhaparicchedavidhuraṃ vṛṣācaleśaṃ arcātmanā veṃkaṭādrāvavasthitaṃ paraṃ brahmaivetyarthaḥ | yaḥ pumān upāste saḥ taṃ atibhīṣaṇatayā durdarśaṃ duṣkṛtāṃ yātayitāraṃ prabhumiti bhāvaḥ | 'prabhurahamanyanṛṇāṃ na vaiṣṇavānām' iti hyucyate | śamanaṃ yamaṃ 'śamano yamarāḍyamaḥ' ityamaraḥ | na vīkṣate | sakṛnmanaḥ kṛṣṇapadāravindayorniveśitaṃ tadguṇarāgiyairiha | na te yamaṃ pāśabhṛtaśca tadbhaṭān svapne'pi paśyantyaghacīrṇaniṣkṛtāḥ || iti śrībhāgavatādyukteriti bhāvaḥ | athāpi taṃ śamanaṃ yamaṃ vindate prāpnotīti virodhaḥ | parihārastu śaṃ anantamiti chedena anantaṃ aparicchinnaṃ śaṃ sukhaṃ parabrahmānubhūtisukhamiti bhāvaḥ tasyaivānantatvāt | vindate prapnotīti | atrāpi prathamapādāntyabhāgasya pādāntareṣvāvṛttiḥ || yathāvā yā'ghaṃ tapasā'dhayati tvatkīrtisudhāṃ nṛṇāṃ tatissā dhayati | atha bhaktiṃ sādhayati tvayyacyuta tāṃ bhavāṃśca sādhayati || 2264 || he acyuta ! yā nṛṇāṃ tatiḥ tapasā kṛchracāndrāyaṇādinā aghaṃ pāpaṃ adhayati adhaḥkaroti tiraskarotītyarthaḥ | adhas iti sāntāvyayāt ṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve ṭilopaḥ | sa nṛṇāṃ tatiḥ tvattīrtisudhāṃ dhayati pibati | dheṭ pāne' kartari laṭ | tatphalamāha atheti | atha tvayi bhaktiṃ sādhayati niṣpādayati | bhavāṃśca evamupāsitastvamapi tāṃ nṛṇāṃ tatiṃ sādhayati bāḍhaṃkaroti sādhuṃ karotītyarthaḥ | bāḍhaśabdāt ṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve 'antikabāḍhayornedasādhau' iti sādhādeśaḥ | dvitīye sādhuśabdāt ṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve ṭilopa iti bhidā || yathāvā kariṇo varada hare te caraṇe mama duritamaghanuda harete | tadvyarthaṃ dahare te na dhyāte śrīpate yadaharete || 2265 || he hare ! ‘harirharati pāpāni' ityetadatra smartavyam | aghaṃ duḥkhaṃ vyasanaṃ vā nudati kṣipatītyaghanudaḥ | tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | te tava caraṇe mama duritaṃ harete | yadahaḥ yasminnahani atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā | dahare hṛdayapuṇḍarīke te pūrvokte ete tava caraṇe na dhyāte tadahaḥ vyarthaṃ nirarthakam | atra ‘yanmuhūrtaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāspi' iti vacanārthassmartavyaḥ || yathāvā sa bhavānyadi no dayate jantorjñānaṃ tadā'sya nodayate | karmāṇi na nodayate tattvāṃ dhyātuṃ ramāvinoda yate || 2266 || vinodayatīti vinodaḥ ramāyāḥ vinodaḥ ramāvinodaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | ramāyāḥ vinoda vinodaheto iti vā hetuhetumatoraikyam | he śrīnivāsetyarthaḥ | sa bhavān jantoḥ prāṇinaḥ no dayate yadi dayaterlaṭ ‘adhīgarthadaya' iti karmaṇaśśeṣatvavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī | tadā asya jantoḥ jñānaṃ niśśreyasaupayikamiti bhāvaḥ | nodayate nodeti | ayaterlaṭ | sa bhavān asyetyetaccānuṣajyate | asya jantoḥ karmāṇi pāparūpāṇi na nodayāte na nivartayate | nudaterṇijantāllaṭ | yadvā ayamityadhyāhāraḥ | ayaṃ jantuḥ karmāṇi na nodayate iti yojanā | pāpakarmaṇaḥ kṣayābhāve jñānānudayāditi bhāvaḥ | 'jñānamutpadyate puṃsāṃ kṣayātpāpasya karmaṇaḥ' iti hi smṛtiḥ | tat tasmāt uktāddhetoḥ tvāṃ dhyātuṃ yate yatna karomi | yataterlaḍuttamaikavacanam | pāpakṣayapūrvakajñānodayanidānatvādbhavatkṛpāyāstatsaṃpādanāya tvāmupāsituṃ yatnavānbhavāmīti nirgalito'rthaḥ || kṛtavidhinābhīkamalaṃ hṛdayāntarakṛtaniketanābhīkamalam | vrajalalanābhīkamalaṃkurutāṃ hṛdbrahma tadadhunā'bhīkamalam || 2267 || kṛtaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ vidhiḥ brahmā yena tathoktaṃ nābhīkamalaṃ yasya tat | hṛdayāntare vakṣo'ntarāle kutaniketanā racitamandirā abhīḥ avidyamānā bhīryasyāsseti pañcamībahuvrīhiḥ | āśritabhītihāriṇī | ṣaṣṭhībahuvrīhirvā | paripūrṇāparādheṣvāśritayūdheṣu kaluṣitamaterdaṇḍadharāllokeśvarādbharturapi tatparitrāṇe ‘kimevaṃ nirdoṣaḥ ka iha jagati' iti bodhayantī na bibhetīti bhāvaḥ | abhīḥ kamalā yasya tat tathoktam | ābhyāṃ paratvamuktam | vrajalalanānāṃ gopamahilānāṃ abhīkaṃ kāmukaṃ ‘kamraḥ kāmayitā'bhīkaḥ' ityamaraḥ ‘anukābhikābhīkaḥ kamite' tyabheḥ kamite' kamitetyarthe kanpratyayo nipātitaḥ | anena saulabhyamuktam | brahma uktavidhaṃ paraṃ brahma hṛt mama cittaṃ karma alaṃkurutāṃ pariṣkurutām | tat manaḥ kartṛ | adhunā alaṃ paryāptaṃ abhīkaṃ nirbhayaṃ bhavati bhagavati parasmin brahmaṇi hṛdayamadhivasati kuto mama bhayavārteti bhāvaḥ | ‘yadā hyevaiṣa etasminnadṛśye'nātmye'nirukte'nilayane'bhayaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vindate atha so'bhayaṃ gato bhavati' iti śruteḥ | atra prathamapādāntyabhāgagatasasvaravyañjanapañcakasya taditarapādāntyabhogaṣvāvṛttiriti
