viśeṣaḥ || śrayasi sadā sahitattvaṃ śriyā yadetatpurā sadāsa hi tattvam | ayasi sa dāsahitattvaṃ tvāmevaṃ veda yaḥ sadā sa hi tattvam || 2268 || he bhagavan! sadā śriyā sahitattvaṃ śrayasi | śriyā nityayogavāniti śrīmacchabdārtha uktaḥ | 'ānīdavātag svadhayā tadekam' ityuktaṃ tasyaiva jagatkāraṇatvamāha yaditi | etat paridṛśyamānaṃ cidacidātmakaṃ jagat purā sṛṣṭeḥ prāk āsa hi | tat tvam iti chedaḥ | hiravadhāraṇe | ayaṃ bhinnakramaḥ pūrvatra paratra cāpi saṃbadhyate | yat sakalopaniṣatprasiddhaṃ sat hi sadeva sacchabdābhilapanīyaṃ brahmaiva āsa | jagadidaṃ yatkāraṇakaṃ yadātmakamevāsīt | āseti tiṅantapratirūpakaṃ babhūvārthakamavyayam | yadvā āsa didīpe | dīptyarthakādasadhātorliṭ | tadbrahma tvameva | tvameva taditi vā yojanā | ‘sadeva somyedamagra āsīt' iti kāraṇavākyārthassmāritaḥ | evaṃca śriyaḥpatyureva jagatkāraṇatvaṃ nānyasyetyuktaṃ bhavati | saḥ īdṛśaḥ tvaṃ dāsebhyaḥ ‘dāsabhūtāssvatarssve hyātmānaḥ paramātmanaḥ' ityuktarītyā śeṣabhūtebhyaḥ hitattvaṃ siddhopāyatvaṃ ayasi prāpnoṣi | ‘iṭa kiṭa' ityatra praśliṣṭasya idhātorlaṭ | yaḥ pumān sadā tvāṃ evaṃ śriyaḥpatiṃ jagatkāraṇaṃ siddhopāyabhūtaṃ ca veda sa hi sa eva tattvaṃ ātmaparamātmayāthātmyaṃ vedeti yojanā | atrādyapādāntyabhāgagatānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ sasvaravyañjanānāṃ pādāntarāntyabhāgeṣvāvṛttiriti pūrvebhyo viśeṣaḥ | caturthacaraṇe yaḥ sadā ityatra ‘vā śari' iti pākṣiko visargasya visarga evaiṣṭavyaḥ | na tu ‘visarjanīyasya saḥ' iti sakāraḥ | asaṃyuktasakārayamakaprakramabhaṅgāpatteḥ || vitara śubhāṃ gāṅgeyaṃ tvāṃ gāyānīha vinatagāṅgeyam | lakṣmīsubhagāṅgeyaṃ pūtā'stu vṛthaiva mā sma gāṅgeyam || 2269 || śubhāṃ gāṃ vācaṃ vitara | geyaṃ gātuṃ yogyam | vinataḥ gāṅgeyo bhīṣmaḥ yasmiṃstaṃ tvāṃ gāyāni gāyeyaṃ loḍuttamaikavacanam | viṣṇorgānaṃ ca geyaṃ ca naṭanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | brahmanbrāhmaṇajātīnāṃ kartavyaṃ nityakarmavat || iti śaunakokteriti bhāvaḥ | he lakṣmīsubhagāṅgā śrīśobhanamūrte śrīnivāsetyarthaḥ | iyaṃ gauḥ vāk pūtā astu tvatsaṃkīrtanāditi bhāvaḥ | yathāhyucyate śaunakenaiva nṛtyatāṃ śrīpateragre karasaṃsphoṭanādibhiḥ | uḍuyinte śarīrasthā mahāpātakapakṣiṇaḥ || iti | atra saṃsphoṭanādibhirityādiśabdena gānasyapi grahaṇaṃ, pūrvaśloke tasyaiva prastutatvāt | vṛthā geyaṃ tvatkīrtanavidhuraṃ gānaṃ mā sma gāṃ na prāpnuyāmeva | harigītaṃ vinā nānyadbrāhmaṇena narottama ! bhāṣāgānaṃ na kartavyaṃ tasmātpāpaṃ tvayā kṛtam || iti bhavagadgītātiriktagānapratiṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ | atrādyapādāntyabhāgasyākṣaratrayātmakasya pādāntareṣvāvṛttiriti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā mahimānaṃ vedānte vacasāṃ tava viśrutasya vedānte | svamahaṃ vibhave'dānte karuṇaya mayi durabhibhavabhave'dānte || 2270 || vedānte viśrutasya tava mahimānaṃ vacasāṃ ante veda jānāmi 'yato vāco nivartante' iti śruteḥ | vibhave jagatprabhave sarvavyāpine te tubhyaṃ ahaṃ svaṃ ātmānaṃ tvadīyaṃ svameveti vā adāṃ adadāṃ tyayyātmasamarpaṇamakārṣamityarthaḥ | durabhibhavo bhavaḥ saṃsāro yasya tasmin tvaccaraṇaśaraṇavaraṇamantareṇa upāyāntarairdurapanaya saṃsāre ityarthaḥ | adānte ‘śānto dāntaḥ' ityuktadamadavīyasītisvakārpaṇyābhivyañjanam | mayi karuṇaya karuṇāṃ kuru | karuṇāśabdāt "tatkaroti' iti ṇic | adānte ityatra ‘vā padāntasya' iti parasavarṇaḥ | pūrvavadeva yamakam || kamalāsakha tava dāsye kṛtarucirātmānameva te dāsye | aviditavinataudāsye lagati manastvayi mamendulasadāsye 2271 || idaṃ bhagavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapitsoḥ kavervacanam | he kamalāsakha ! ayaṃ śrīmacchabdārthaḥ | anena ātmasamarpaṇoddeśyatvaṃ śrīviśiṣṭasyaiveti sūcitam | tava dāsye kaiṃkarye kṛtaruciḥ anena śaraṇāgatimantre uktarakhaṇḍagatacaturthyantaśabdārthassūcitaḥ | ātmānameva te tubhyaṃ dāsye ātmarakṣābharaṃ tvayi samarpayiṣyāmīti bhāvaḥ | anena ‘śaraṇaṃ prapadye' ityetadartha uktaḥ | atra hetumupapādayaty aviditeti | aviditaṃ vinateṣu audāsyaṃ udāsīnatā yena tasmin ataeva tvayi mama manaḥ lagati | indulasadāsye iti bhagavato viśeṣaṇamanugrahaprasannatāvyañjanāya | atra prathamapādāntimabhāgasya varṇadvayātmakasya caturṣvapi pādāntyabhāgeṣvāvṛttiriti viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā nikhilamihālaṃ karaṇaṃ niyamya yaḥ śrutivadhūmahālaṃkaraṇam | narasakhamāpaccharaṇaṃ na bhajeta kadā'pi sa bhavamāpaccharaṇam || 2272 || yaḥ pumān nikhilaṃ karaṇaṃ sarvāṇīndriyāṇītyarthaḥ | ala paṃrthāptaṃ yathātathā niyamya viṣayebhyaḥ pratyāhṛtya śrutireva vadhūḥ tasyāḥ mahābharaṇaṃ śiromaṇimityarthaḥ | narasakhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ rakṣitāramupāyaṃ vā āpat prāpnot | rakṣitṛtvena vā upāyatvena vā avṛṇodityarthaḥ | sa pumān kadā'pi āpadāṃ śaraṇaṃ nivāsabhūtaṃ sakalavipajjanmabhūmimityarthaḥ | bhavaṃ saṃsāraṃ na bhajeta | bhagavati nyastarakṣābharasya kva punassaṃsṛtisṛtyavatāra iti bhāvaḥ | bhagavantaṃ śaraṇamupeyivān bhavaṃ śarvaṃ āpaccharaṇaṃ kadā'pi na bhajeta āpatsu rakṣakatayā na seveteti ca pratīyate | atra pūrvārdhe uttarārdhe ca caramabhāge yamakam || atha madhyabhāgayamakam yathā raghujāya te namasstānna jāyate yanmudhā kadācidapi | jalajāyatekṣaṇa janavrajā yateranvidhātumidameva || 2273 || he jalajāyatekṣaṇa ! anena prapanneṣvatiprasannatvaṃ vyajyate | raghujāya śaraṇavaraṇadharmapravartanadhurīṇaraghuvaṃśajatvakathanenāsyāpi tādṛśavratadīkṣitatvaṃ dyotitam | ataeva 'sarvalokaśaraṇyāya rāghavāya' ityuktiḥ | te tubhyaṃ namaḥ ‘nivedayata māṃ kṣipram' ityuktamātmanivedanaṃ ‘namaskārātmakaṃ tasmai vidhāyātmanivedanam' iti hyucyate | stāt bhavatu | kiṃ tenatyatrāha yat namaskaraṇaṃ kadācidapi mudhā na jāyate nirarthakaṃ na saṃpadyate | phalegrahitāmeva bhajata iti bhāvaḥ | svānuṣṭhitamātmanivedanameva sarvairanuṣṭheyamiti 'pradiśatu bhagavānaśeṣapuṃsāṃ harirapajanmajarādikāṃ samṛddhim' iti nyāyenāśaste janetyādinā | janavrajāḥ pāmaraparīkṣakasādhāraṇyena sarve jananivahāḥ idameva bhagavate ātmanivedanameva vidhātuṃ yateran prārthanāyāṃ liṅ | yatantām | kimanyairvyabhicaritaprayojanairupāyaiḥ tathaphalamidamekameva sevantāṃ sarvādhikārikatvādasya ‘abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dadāmyetadvrataṃ mama' iti tenaiva pratijñātatvādapekṣitasakalaphaladānadhaureyatvācceti bhāvaḥ| atrādyapādamadhyabhāgagatāḥ jāyate iti trayo varṇā eva pādāntaramadhyabhāge yamyanta iti madhyayamakamidam || yathāvā sarasī visārasārasasaugandhikasārasārahitavṛttiḥ | bhāti ghanasārasārasuśātī sarasā rasāramaṇa te'drau || 2274 || rasāyāḥ bhūdevyāḥ ramaṇa vallabha ! ‘viṣṇupatnīṃ mahīṃ devīṃ mādhavīṃ mādhavapriyām' iti śrutyā tasyā bhagavatpriyātvasyoktatvādasyāpi tadvallabhatvamityabhiprāyeṇa tathā saṃbodhanam | he bhūvarāheti vā | te tava adrau śeṣācale ityarthaḥ | visārāḥ mīnāḥ sā rasāḥ puṣkarāhvakhagāḥ saugandhikāni kahlārāṇi sārasāni padmāni taiḥ arahitā vṛttiḥ sthitiḥ yasyāssā tadyuktetyarthaḥ | ghanasārasya karpūrasya sāraḥ sthirāṃśaḥ sa iva suśītā atiśiśirā sarasā rasena madhurarasena saha vartata iti tathoktā ca | sarasī svāmipuṣkariṇī bhāti | atra prathamapādamadhyabhāgasya sārasāretivarṇadvayayamakarūpasya dvitīyādipādamadhyabhāge yamanānmadhyayamakaviśeṣa iti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā śaraṇaraṇaśravaṇakṣaṇacaraṇaraṇatkaṭakamatijavādetya | nīraṇaraṇakitavicakitavāraṇa raṇadhurya deva bhava śaraṇam || 2275 || śaraṇeti raṇaḥ dhvaniḥ rakṣaketyākrandanamiti yāvat ‘raṇaḥ kvaṇe' iti, 'rave raṇaḥ' iti ca saṃkīrṇanānārthavargayoramaraḥ | 'raṇaḥ koṇe kvaṇe puṃsi samare puṃnapuṃsakam' iti medinī ca | tasya | śravaṇakṣaṇameva caraṇayoḥ raṇantau dhvanantau kaṭakau balayau yasminkarmaṇi tadyathāsyāttathā atijavāt etya grāhagrastagajendrasavidhamiti bhāvaḥ | raṇaraṇakaḥ uttarottarataraṅgitabhayavisaṃṣṭhulatvaṃ nirgamitaḥ raṇaraṇako yasya saḥ nīraṇaraṇakaḥ tathoktaḥ kṛtaḥ nīraṇaraṇakitaḥ nīraṇaraṇakaśabdāt ṇijantārtkamaṇi ktaḥ vicakitaḥ nakrākrāntatayā viśeṣataḥ pratihataḥ vāraṇaḥ gajendro yena tasya saṃbuddhiḥ nīraṇaraṇakitavicakitavāraṇa ! he raṇadhurya samaradhaureya he deva mama śaraṇaṃ bhava | gajendrasyeva mamāpi bhayacakitatāṃ nirdhūya paritrāṇaṃ vidadhyā iti bhāvaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadeva raṇaraṇeti madhyabhāgayamakaṃ pādacatuṣṭaye || śrīvāsādevāsāvāsādyā sakalasaṃpadakhilajanaiḥ | kā vā sā yā'vāsādayituṃ saṃpattato na śakyeta || 2276 || asau jagadānandasaṃdāyitayā dṛśyamānā akhilasaṃpat śrīvāsāt bhagavata eva sakāśāt sakalajanaiḥ āsādyā prāpyā | kā vā sā yā avāsādayitumiti chedaḥ | tataḥ tasmāt śrīnivāsāt yā saṃpat avāsādayituṃ avāptuṃ svārthiko ṇic yadvā tataḥ tena śrinivāsena āsādayituṃ śritānprāpayituṃ na śakyeta | sā tathāvidhā saṃpat kā vā na kāpi tādṛśī saṃpadastīti bhāvaḥ | atrādyapāde ekavarṇāntaravyavahitavāsārūpavarṇadvayāvṛttilakṣaṇamadhyabhāga eva tṛtīyapāde tathā''vartyata iti prāgudāhṛtāvyavahitavarṇadvayāvṛttirūpamadhyayamakādvicchittiviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā sa jayati bhujageśadharo japāvanaṃ sahajapāvanaṃ yatra | yatra nṛṇāṃ dānatapojapāvanaṃ divijapāvanaṃ bhavati || 2277 || dānatapojapānāṃ avanaṃ gamanaṃ prāptirityarthaḥ | avatergatyarthakādbhāve lyuṭ | divijānpātīti divijapaḥ deveśaḥ bhagavān tasya avanaṃ prīṇanaṃ bhavati | prīṇanārthakādavateḥ karaṇe lyuṭ | spaṣṭamanyat | atra dvitīyapāde varṇāntaravyavadhānenāvṛttasya japāvanamityakṣarasamudāyasya turīyapāde tathā''vṛttiriti viśeṣaḥ || atibahulasattamo jāyate'hibhūbhṛtpate mano yasya | bata bahulasattamojāyate hi bhūbhṛtsa tava dṛṣṭyā || 2278 || he ahibhūbhṛtpate! yasya puṃsaḥ manaḥ atibahulaṃ sat vidyamānaṃ tamaḥ yasya tathoktaṃ jāyate tvatkaṭākṣaprasarātpūrvamatimātratāmasaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | saḥ manujaḥ tava dṛṣṭyā 'yatsattvaṃ sa harirdevaḥ' iti sattvamayatayoktasya tava kaṭākṣeṇeti bhāvaḥ | bahulā sattā sādhutā praśastatā vā yasmiṃstattathoktaṃ yathātathā | yadvā bahvī lasato bhāvaḥ lasattā bhagavatsaṃśleṣaḥ yasmiṃstadyathātathā hi bhūbhṛditi chedaḥ | bhūbhṛt rājā san ojāyate | hiravadhāraṇe | sattvaguṇonmeṣeṇa dīpyate | 'tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvātprakāśakamanāmayam' iti sattvaguṇasya prakāśakatvaṃ hi gīyate | atra pūrvārdhamadhyabhāga uttarārdhamadhyabhāge āvartyate | vipulānāmāryāvṛttabhedo'yamiti ca viśeṣaḥ || saṃlaṅghya gaṇatrayamādimaṃ śakalayordvayorbhavati pādaḥ | yasyāstāṃ piṅgalanāgo vipulāmabhisamākhyāti || iti lakṣaṇāt || yadvaibhavaṃ na meyaṃ nameyamahiśailanāthamahilāṃ tām | sarvasya hi sunameyaṃ na me yamādbhīritaḥparaṃ bhavitā || 2279 || yasyāḥ vaibhavaṃ mahimā mātuṃ yogyaṃ meyaṃ na bhavati 'yasyāste mahimānamātmana iva tvadvallabho'pi prabhurnālaṃ mātumiyattayā niravadhim' ityuktarītyā bhagavatā'pyaparicchedyamityarthaḥ | tāṃ ahiśailanāthamahilāṃ nameyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajeyam | kathamevamajñatamastvaṃ tāṃ namerityatrāha hi yasmāt iyaṃ ajñātanigraheti bhāvaḥ | sarvasya ajñasya sarvajñasya vā jantoḥ sunamā sukhena namanīyā | pāmaraparīkṣakavibhāgakārpaṇyānādareṇa sarvaśaraṇyeti bhāvaḥ | ato'haṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajeyamiti yojanā | itaḥparaṃ taccharaṇāgateranantaraṃ me yamāt bhīḥ na bhavitā | ‘parihara madhusūdanaprapannānprabhurahamanyanṛṇāṃ na vaiṣṇavānām' ityādyukteriti bhāvaḥ | sā hi bhagavadavinābhūtā | atra pādacatuṣṭaye antyādyabhāgayoḥ nameyamiti varṇanāmaikarūpyeṇāvṛttiriti bhedaḥ || yathāvā loke samānanāmā samānanā mā śudhāṃśubimvena | juṣatāṃ samānanā mā samānanāmāmarādhinātho yām || 2280 || loke samānaṃ mānasahitaṃ pūjyamityarthaḥ tādṛśaṃ nāma yasyāssā asamānaṃ nāma yasyā iti vā | sudhāṃśubimbena samānanā tulyava danā samaṃ sarvaṃ jagat ānayati jīvayatīti samānanā kartari lyuḥ | 'samaṃ sarvam' ityamaraḥ | mā śrīḥ mā māṃ juṣatāṃ sevatām | mā juṣatāmiti padābhyāṃ ‘śrīrmā devī juṣatām' iti śrutikhaḍaḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | yāṃ amarādhināthaḥ indraḥ samānanāma samyak praṇatavān śaraṇaṃ gata ityarthaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadeva yamakam | pañcānāṃ varṇānāmāvṛttiriti pūrvasmādvailakṣaṇyam || na bhayānakāddraveyaṃ na kāddraveyaṃ yamaṃ samīkṣyāsmāt | no yadi sa vai nate yaḥ savainateyaḥ prabhurdadātyabhayam || 2281 || yamaṃ kādraveyaṃ yamarūpamāśīviṣamiti vyastarūpakam samīkṣya bhayānakāt asmāt na dvaveyamiti na kiṃtu draveyameva | nate śaraṇāgate viṣaye yaḥ prabhuḥ abhayaṃ dadāti savainateyaḥ vainateyasahitaḥ saḥ prabhuḥ bhagavān no vai yadi naiva cet na draveyamiti neti yojanā | atra prathamapādāntyabhāgaḥ pañcavarṇātmako dvitīyapādādibhāge āvartyate | evamuttarārdhe'pi vibhinnānupūrvakipañcavarṇāvṛttiriti pūrvebhyo viśeṣaḥ | evamagre'pi | savainateyaḥ ityatra 'vā śari' iti pākṣikaḥ visarjanīyasya visarjanīyaḥ yamakāvairūpyāyeṣṭavyaḥ || yathāvā nayase yamasālokyaṃ yamasālokyaṃ bhajeta sa hi jantuḥ | gamayasi yaṃ paramapadaṃ paramapadaṃ syātsa saṃsaraṇavipadaḥ || 2282 || yaṃ jantuṃ salokasya bhāvaḥ sālokyaṃ na sālokyaṃ asālokyaṃ āloko darśanaṃ kaṭākṣāviṣayatāmityarthaḥ nayase sa jantuḥ yamasālokyaṃ kṛtāntasalokatāṃ bhajeta | yaṃ paramapadaṃ divyaṃ sthānaṃ gamayasi saḥ saṃsaraṇavipadaḥ saṃsārāpadaḥ padaṃ sthānaṃ na padaṃ apadaṃ aviṣaya iti yāvat syāt saṃsṛtikleśānpunarnānubhavedityarthaḥ || yathāvā tvaṃ nanu bahulāghavato bahulāghavato'pi bata natāñ janani | śaure rakṣasi dayitā rakṣasi dayitā'si kimathavā''ścaryam || 2283 || nanu janani bahulāghavataḥ atilāghavena sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | atimātracittacāpaleneti bhāvaḥ | bahulaṃ adhikaṃ aghaṃ pāpameṣāmastīti bahulāghavato'pi natān śaraṇāgatān śaurerdayitā tvaṃ rakṣāsi | bata aghavatāmapi rakṣaṇamāścaryāvahamiti bhāvaḥ | svayameva samādhatte’thaveti | rakṣasi kākāsura eva vā rāvaṇa eva vadayitā dayamānā asi dayateḥ kartari ktaḥ dayā'syāssaṃjātā dayiteti vā tārakāditvāditac | idaṃ ca pādmarāmāyaṇayoḥ spaṣṭam | ataḥ aghavatāmapi vinatānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kimāścaryamiti bhāvaḥ | pūrvavadevedaṃ yamakaṃ, ṣaṇṇāmakṣarāṇāmāvṛttiḥ paraṃ viśeṣaḥ || yathāvā divyāssutarāmahatīssutarā mahatīssadā'khilāśśaktīḥ | bhṛśamavitathā dadhānaṃ tathā''dadhānaṃ śriyaṃ jayatu daivam || 2284 || divyāḥ āścaryāvahāḥ sutarāṃ atyantaṃ ahatīḥ kṣatirahitāḥ apratihatā ityarthaḥ | sutarāḥ kalyāṇatarāḥ mahatīḥ vipulāḥ pūjyā vā bhṛśaṃ avitathāḥ anāropitāḥ akhilāḥ śaktīḥ dadhānaṃ samastāśśaktayaścaitā nṛpa yatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ | tadviśvarūpavairūpyaṃ rūpamanyaddharermahat || ityetadihānusaṃdheyam | tathā śriyaṃ niśśreyasaiśvaryaparyantāṃ saṃpadaṃ ādadhānaṃ āśriteṣviti śeṣaḥ | daivaṃ paraṃ brahma jayatu | atrāpi pūrvavadeva yamakam | pūrvārdhe ṣaṇṇāṃ uttarārdhe pañcānāṃ varṇānāmāvṛttiriti tu vailakṣaṇyam | uttarārdhe tavargīyavarṇānāṃ kramādāvṛttiriti vicchittiviśeṣaśca draṣṭavyaḥ || yathāvā hṛdayaharaśrīvatse śrīvatse sarvahṛdyamādhurye | mādhurye gataviśayaṃ viśa yaṃ jānāsi śeṣiṇaṃ hṛdaya || hṛdayaharaḥ manohārī śrīvatsaḥ tannāmā lāñchanaviśeṣaḥ yasya tasmin | śrīḥ vatse vakṣasi yasya tasmin sarvahṛdyaṃ mādhuryaṃ premā yasya tasmin | ‘svādupriyau tu madhurau' ityamaraḥ | māyāḥ dhurye śrīvallabhe ityarthaḥ | he hṛdaya ! gataviśayaṃ nissaṃśayaṃ yathāsyāttathā mahāviśvāsapūrvakamiti yāvat | viśa praviśa | karmaṇo'dhikaṇatvavivakṣayā saptamī | yaṃ śrīvallabhaṃ śeṣiṇaṃ nirupādhikasarvaśeṣiṇaṃ jānāsi | tasmin viśeti yojanā | atrādyapādāntyabhāgāvasthitasya sasvaravyañjanatrayasya dvitīyapādādibhāge, evaṃ dvitīyapādāntyabhāgasthasya tṛtīyapādādibhāge, tadantyabhāgasthasya turīyapādādyabhāge, tadantyabhāgāvasthitasya hṛdayetyasya punarādyapādādau cābṛttiriti pūrvebhyo vaicitryaviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā mandāraissaṃpanne saṃpannetarnate'riśaṃkhaśaya | khaśayastuto viharase harasevye phaṇigīrau samandāraiḥ || nate praṇate saṃpannetaḥ saṃpatprāpaka he ariśaṃkhaśaya cakraśaṃkhapāṇe bhagavan ! mandāraiḥ pāribhadratarubhiḥ saṃpanne harasevye śivena sevanīye phaṇigirau khaśayaiḥ svargibhiḥ stutassan dāraissamaṃ viharase | samandārairityatra ‘vā padāntasya' iti parasavarṇaḥ | atrāpi pūvarpadyavadevāntyādiyamakaṃ draṣṭavyam | daṇḍī tu idaṃ saṃdaṣṭayamakamityāha | yathoktaṃ kāvyādarśa ‘saṃdaṣṭayamakasthānamantādī pādayordvayoḥ' iti || ālīḍhabhāratarasā nabhāratararasādhanā bhavajjanatā | vitamassabhāratarasā na bhāratarasā bhavasya khidyeta || 2287 || he bhagavan! ālīḍhā āśritā bhāratī bharatakhaṇḍasaṃbandhinī rasā bhūḥ yayāsā bharatakhaṇḍajanitetyarthaḥ | bharatakhaṇḍajanmanassarvapuruṣārthasaulabhyasya bhāgavatādyuktatvāttathoktiḥ | bhavajjanatā tvadīyājanasamūhaḥ | yadvā bhavajjanatā ālīḍhabhārataraseti yojanā | ālīḍhaḥ āsvāditaḥ bhāratasya śrīmanmahābhāratasya rasaḥ ātisvādutamassārabhūto'rthaḥ yayā sā adhigatacaramaślokasārabhūtaśaraṇavrajanarūpārtheti yāvat | ataeva nabhāratarasādhanā | bhārataraṃ atiguru sādhanaṃ bhaktirūpaṃ paramapuruṣārthasādhakopāyaḥ tat na vidyate yasyāssā tathoktā | naśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ | śaraṇavrajanalakṣaṇalaghūpāyalābhenānādṛtabhaktirūpagurutaropāyā satītyarthaḥ | svatantraprapadananiṣṭheti phalito'rthaḥ | ataeva vitamāśca sā sabhā ca vitamassabhā ‘ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt | prajāpatessabhāṃ veśma prapadye' ityādi śrutipratipāditamaprākṛtaṃ divyaṃ sthānaṃ ‘sabhā sāmājike goṣṭhyāṃ dyūtamandirayorapi' iti medinī | tasyāṃ rataṃ 'jakṣankrīḍanramamāṇaḥ' ityāmnātaṃ muktānubhāvyaṃ krīḍanaṃ | ramaterbhāve ktaḥ | tasmin rasaḥ anurāgaḥ yasyāssā tathoktā niśśreyasasāmrājyamanubhavantī satīti bhāvaḥ | bhavasya saṃsārasya bhāratarasā bhāravegena ‘raṃhastarasī tu rayassyadaḥ' ityamaraḥ | na khidyeta | īdṛśāmapunarāvṛtteśśravaṇāt smaraṇācceti bhāvaḥ | atra pūrvottarārdhayoḥ madhye ekarūpatayā nakāramātravyavadhānena bhāratarasetyakṣarapañcakāvṛtterantyādyayamakadvayaṃ saṃdaṣṭayamakaṃ ca | yamakasya ayamakarūpapārśvabhāgābhyāṃ saṃdaṃśeneva madhye daṣṭatvāditi bodhyam || dhanikabhavane hayānana dhanehayā na na padaṃ nanu nidadhyām | tvaddattamahā vibhavaṃ sumahāvibhavamapi kiṃ nu yāceya || 2288 || nanu hayānana he hayagrīva! dhanehayā vittaspṛhayā dhanikānāṃ satpātrāsātkṛtatayā ninditadhanaśālināṃ nindāyāṃ matvarthīyaṣṭhan | dhanaśabdādukta evārthe matvarthīye inipratyaye kutsāyāṃ kanvā | bhavane padaṃ caraṇaṃ na na nidadhyāṃ naiva nikṣipeyam | na neti vīpsāyāṃ dvirbhāvaḥ | atra bhaye pratijñāne vā dyotye vīpsā | yadāhuḥ pratijñāyāṃ praśaṃsāyāṃ pralāpe tarjane'pi ca | bhaye ca vismaye caiva paunaḥpunyamalaṃkṛtiḥ || iti | sāmānyadhanikagṛhapadanyasanavairasye'pi mahodāramahārājādiyācñāyāṃ ko doṣa ityata āha tvadityādinā | tvayā dattaṃ mahaḥ tejaḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ tvatkaṭākṣāvāptalokottaranityasāmrājyaprayuktadivyatejaśśālīti bhāvaḥ | ahaṃ sumahān mahāvadānyatvena sakalalokamānanīyaḥ yaḥ avibhavaḥ bhānusūnuḥ karṇaḥ tamapi vibhavaṃ arthaṃ yāceya kiṃnu tādṛśamapi nārthayeya kimanyaṃ vadānyaṃmanyamiti bhāvaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavadeva yamakaṃ, pūrvottarārdhayorvibhinnarūpatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ || bhagavannyāvannyāsaṃ vannyāvannyāṃ padorahīndragireḥ | sā'hantā hantā māṃ hantāhantāṃ bhajeya na punarapi || 2289 || he bhagavan! ahīndragireḥ vanyā vanasamūhaḥ tasyāḥ avanyāṃ padoḥ caraṇayoḥ yāvannyāsaṃ nnyāsarpayantemava sā svasvarūpabhraṃśayitrī ahaṃtā ahaṃkāraḥ māṃ hantā nāśayitā hanterluṭ | hanteti bhaviṣyanmahālābhacintanajanitaharṣe | ahaṃ tāṃ ahantāṃ punarapi śeṣaśailavanabhūpadanyāsottaramapi na bhajeya vindeya | bhajate ssaṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅ | atrādyatṛtīyapādayossasvaravyañjanadvayāvṛttilakṣaṇayamakarūpamadhya bhāgastādṛśayamakarūpa eva dvitīyaturīyayoḥ pādayorādyabhāge āvartyata iti madhyādyayamakaviśeṣaḥ saṃdaṃśayamakaṃ ca draṣṭavyam || jñānandeyaṃ bhavatā nandeyaṃ nanu mukunda yenāham | kiṃ nātheya kamapi vā nāthe yattvayi samarpitātmabharaḥ || 2290 || nanu mukunda muktibhūprada! bhavatā mahyamiti śeṣaḥ | jñānaṃ tvadviṣayakamiti bhāvaḥ | bhavataiva deyam yena jñānena ahaṃ nandeyaṃ tvatsāyujyānandaṃ prāpnuyāṃ 'dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te' iti gītatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anya evāmumarthaṃ prārthyatāmityatrāha kimiti | kaṃ vā tvadanyaṃ kamapi vā nātheya kiṃ yāceya kiṃ kiṃ nātheyeti vā | madabhīpsitajñānadānāpaṭumanyaṃ kiṃ vastu prārthayeya | apekṣitārthasya tasmādalabdheriti bhāvaḥ | kuta iyaṃ pratijñetyatrāha nāthe ityādi | yat yasmāt nāthe sarveśvare tvayi ahaṃ samarpitātmabharaḥ tvayi nyatsātmarakṣābharasyānyanāthanaṃ kathaṃ ghaṭeteti bhāvaḥ | yathoktaṃ tatpādabhaktijñānābhyāṃ phalamanyatkadācana | na yācetpuruṣo viṣṇuṃ yācanānnaśyati dhruvam || iti | atrādyapādamadhyabhāgasya dvitīyapādādyabhāge āvṛttiḥ | tṛtīyapādamadhyabhāgasya turīyapādādyabhāge iti madhyādiyamakaṃ saṃdaṃśayamakabhedaśca || sapramadagaṇḍakairahiśikharī sapramadagaṇḍakairlasati | ditasārasairibhairapi vipuloditasārasairibhairapica || 2291 || sapramadaiḥ sastrīkaiḥ saharṣairvā gaṇḍakaiḥ khaḍigmṛgaiḥ | ‘gaṇḍake khaḍgakhaḍgino' ityamaraḥ | sapramadāḥ prakṛṣṭadānodakasahitāḥ gaṇḍāḥ karaṭāḥ yaistaiḥ | sapramadagaṇḍakaiḥ ‘śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap | ditāni chinnāni sārasāni padmāni yaistaiḥ | padmavikṣobhibhirityarthaḥ | ‘ditaṃ chitam' ityamaraḥ | ibhaiḥ gajaiḥ| vipulaṃ yathātathā uditaḥ atimātrapravṛddhaḥ sāraḥ balaṃ yeṣāṃ taiḥ vipulaiḥ mahadbhiḥ uditasārairiti vā | sairibhaiḥ vanamahiṣaiḥ ahiśikharī lasati | atra prathamatṛtīyapādādibhāgayordvitīyaturīyapādayormadhyabhāge āvṛtterādimadhyayamekaṃ saṃdaṃśayamakabhedaśca || evamekapādagatabhāgānāṃ pādāntarabhāgāpekṣā yamakabhedā diṅmātreṇodāhṛtāḥ | atha ekapādagatabhāgānāmanyonyāpekṣā bhedā diṅmātramudāhriyante | yathā pāyādeṣā'pāyājjāyā śauressudhājaladhijāyā | chāyāyā acchāyā geyā''sthānī sudhībhiravigeyā || 2292 || yā acchāyāḥ chāyāyāḥ kānteḥ āsthānī sudhībhiḥ geyā avigeyā kenāpyanindyā eṣā sudhājaladhijā śaureḥ jāyā apāyāt pāyāditi yojanā || yathāvā kalyāṇāmbujakalyāyitā mṛgādhipanagādhipatidayitā | bhāvyā'maraiśśubhā'vyānmā tādṛśavaibhavā jaganmātā || 2293 || kalyāṇamevāmbujaṃ tasya kalyāyitā prabhātāyamānā ‘pratyūṣo'harmukhaṃ kalyam' ityamaraḥ | amaraiḥ bhāvyā dhyeyā śubhā kalyāṇī tādṛśavaibhavā avāṅmanasagocaraiśvaryā jaganmātā mṛgādhipanagādhipateḥ śeṣādrīśasya dayitā mā śrīḥ | avyāt iti yojanā || yathāvā bṛndārakāribṛndāskandeśānasya nataśivaskande | vinde padāravinde nandeṣṭasutasya saṃbhṛtānande || bṛndārakārīṇāṃ daityānāṃ bṛndasya āskande parābhave īśānasya paṭīyasaḥ | anyatsugamam || yathāvā vindemahi govinde kande'ridavasya bhuvanatarukande | mandetarāmamande kundeḍyarade ruciṃ hṛdi mukunde || 2295 || aridavasya kande jalade bhuvanataroḥ kande mūlabhūte ‘kandastu sūraṇe sasyamūle jaladhare'pica' iti medinī | amande paṭīyasi kundeḍyarade kundaślāghyadaśane mukunde viṣaye hṛdi ruciṃ abhiratiṃ vindemahīti yojanā || yathāvā dātā dhiyamavadātāṃ dātākhilasaṃśayāmasuradātā | pātā śriyamanipātāṃ pātā kamalādharasya māṃ pātā || 2296 || avadātāṃ śuddhāṃ ataeva dātaḥ chinnaḥ akhilasaṃśayaḥ yayā tāṃ ‘do avakhaṇḍane' iti dhātoḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ ‘kṛttaṃ dātam' ityamaraḥ | dhiyaṃ dātā 'dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ' iti gānāt | avadātāśabdo viśuddhavācī | dātetyasya tṛnnantayā tadyoge ‘na loka' ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaḥ | anena tṛnā bhagavato dhīdānatācchīlyaṃ dyotyate | tasya 'ā kvesttacchīla' ityādinā tācchīlye vidhānāt | asurāṇāṃ dātā chettā | dyatestṛc | śaiṣikaṣaṣṭhyāssamāsaḥ | śriyaṃ saṃpadaṃ anipātāṃ satīṃ pātā rakṣitā | kamalāyāḥ śriyaḥ adharasya pātā ramādhararasāsvādavidhātā bhagavān śrīnivāsa iti viśeṣaṇabalāllabhyate | māṃ pātā rakṣiṣyati | pādhātorluṭ | atra padyapaccake'pi pratipādamādimabhāgasyānte āvṛttiḥ antime tu ādyacaraṇādimabhāga eva tadantyabhāge dvitīyapādādyantayoścāvartyate | evaṃ tṛtīyapādādyabhāga eva tadantyabhāge turīyapādādyantayoścāvartyata iti viśeṣaḥ || atha saṃkīrṇayamakabhedā diṅmātramudāhriyante | yathā kravyādāṃ tanvantaṃ tanvantaṃ kratubhujaśca dhinvantam | rāmamabhivīkṣya samitau sa mitaujā rāvaṇo'pi śamitaujāḥ || 2297 || kravyādāṃ kravyādānāṃ tanūnāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ antaṃ vidadhānaṃ kratubhujaḥ devān idaṃ kravyātpratidvandvi dhinvantaṃ prīṇayantaṃ ca | rāmaṃ samitau saṃgare abhivīkṣya saḥ durādharṣatayā prasiddho rāvaṇo'pi mitaujāḥ mitaṃ ojaḥ prabhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ ataeva śamitaujāḥ śamitaṃ śāntiṃ prāpitaṃ ojaḥ dīptiḥ yasya tathoktaḥ abhavaditi śeṣaḥ ‘ojaḥ prabhāve dīptau ca' ityamaraḥ | atra tanvantamiti prathamapādāntyabhāgo dvitīyapādādibhāge samitāviti | tṛtīyapādāntyabhāgaścaturthapādādibhāge cāvartyate | tanvantamityasya mitaujā ityasya ca dvitīyaturīyapādayorāvṛttirapīti saṃkaraḥ || yathāvā taritā'smi bhavābdhimahaṃ taritā tvadapāṅgakena mātaritā | bhavitāṃ nanu kathamiva mama bhavitā niśśreyasaṃ hi saṃbhavitā || 2298 || ahaṃ bhavābdhiṃ taritāsmi tariṣyāmi 'tṝ plavanataraṇayoḥ' asmāddhātorluṭ | kathaṃ taritāsītyatrāha he mātaḥ ! tava ‘saṃsārārṇavatāriṇīm' iti prasiddhāyā iti bhāvaḥ | apāṅgakena kaṭākṣeṇa taritā nautvaṃ ‘sniyāṃ naustaraṇistariḥ' ityamaraḥ | itā praptā | tvatkaṭākṣe nautvamavalambamāne kathamahaṃ bhavābdhiṃ na tareyamiti bhāvaḥ | itaḥ paraṃ mama bhavitā saṃsāritā kathamiva bhavitā bhaviṣyati | bhavaterluṭ | kuto na bhavedityatra upanyaste'pi pūrvaṃ hetau dārḍhyāya hetvantaraṃ copanyasyati hi yataḥ niśśreyasaṃ muktiḥ saṃbhavitā saṃbhaviṣyatīti | atra yugmayoḥ pādayorādyabhāgasyāntyabhāge avṛttiritīdaṃ ekapādagatabhāgānyonyāpekṣaṃ yamakam | prathamatṛtīyapādādibhāgayordvitīyaturīyapādādibhāge āvṛttiriti pādāntarabhāgāpekṣayamakaṃ cātra saṃkīrṇam | evamuttaratrāpi draṣṭavyam || yathāvā madhunāśana śucamadhunā madhunā tvaddivyataracaritamadhunā | bhavatā śubhalābhavatā bhavatāpo me nirāsi hṛdi bhavatā || 2299 || śucaṃ adhunā iti chedaḥ | hṛdibhavatā hṛdayasthitena bhavateti yojanā || yadi tu na samudbhavedbhuvi hṛdayālu dayālu tatparaṃ brahma | jagati na samudbhavedbhavapatayālutayā luṭhan jano jātu || 2300 || tat hṛdayālu paraṃ brahma dayālu sat bhuvi asyāṃ bhūmau yadi tu na samudbhavet arcātmanā veṃkaṭācalādau nāvatareccet bhave saṃsāre patayālutayā patanena luṭhan upāvartamānaḥ ayaṃ janaḥ jagati samut mudā sahitaḥ na bhavet asmin bhuvane na kamapyānandaṃ vindediti bhāvaḥ | ‘ko hyevānyāt kaḥ prāṇyāt yadeṣa ākāśa ānando na syāt' iti śrutyarthacchāyā'trānusṛtā | atrādyapādamadhyasthānāṃ nasamudbhave iti sasvaravyañjanānāṃ tṛtīyapādamadhyabhāge āvṛttiḥ | dvitīyaturīyapādayormadhye dayālu dayālu tayālu tayālu iti yamakaviśeṣaśca || paribhavaharaṇaṃ śrayatoparibhavaharaṇaṃ ca bhagavataścaraṇam | nilayaṃ tu kadaryāṇāṃ nirayaṃ na bhajata janāḥ kadaryāṇām || 2301 || he janāḥ ! paribhavaharaṇaṃ ‘dhyeyaṃ sadā paribhavaghnamabhīṣṭado'ham' iti śrībhāgavatoktarītyā sarvaparibhavanivāraṇaṃ upari itaḥparaṃ bhavassaṃsārastasya haraṇaṃ ca bhagavataścaraṇaṃ śrayata | kadaryāṇāṃ ātmānaṃ dharmakṛtyaṃ ca putradārāṃśca pīḍayet | lobhādyaḥ pitarau bhrātṝn sa kadarya iti smṛtaḥ || ityuktalakṣaṇānāṃ kṛpaṇānāṃ kutsitāśca te aryāśca kadaryāḥ | teṣāṃ aryāḥ svāmino vaiśyā vā | ‘aryassvāmivaiśyoḥ' iti nipātanātsādhuḥ | ‘syādaryassvāmivaiśyayoḥ' ityamaraḥ ‘koḥ kattatpuruṣe'ci' iti kuśabdasya kadādeśaḥ | nilayameva nirayaṃ narakaṃ vyastarūpakaṃ na bhajata | dhanalipsayā kutsitānāṃ rājñāṃ viśāṃ dhanināṃ vā narakaprāyān gṛhānmā seviḍhvamiti bhāvaḥ || kalayāmi tāṃ sakalayā'mitāṃ sa kalayā mitāṃ sadā'haṃ yām | tarasā'dhunā'titarasādhunā'titarasā dhunāti sā'ghaṃ śrīḥ || 2302 || kalayāmi tāṃ sakalayā amitāṃ saḥ kalayā mitāṃ sadā ahaṃ yām tarasā adhunā atitarasādhunā atitarasā dhunāti sā aghaṃ śrīḥ || iti chedaḥ | tāṃ prasiddhāṃ sakalayā kalayā amitāṃ mitāṃ jñātāṃ sarvaśāstrāparicchedyamahimatayā jñātāmityarthaḥ | yāṃ śriyaṃ saḥ dāsabhūtaḥ ahaṃ sadā kalayāmi dhyāyāmi sā śrīḥ atitarasā atitaḥ sātatyena prāptaḥ rasaḥ kṛpārasaḥ yayā sā tathoktā satī | atitetyatra ‘ata sātatyagamane' ityasmāddhātoḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ | aviśrāntakāruṇyā satītyarthaḥ | atitaraścāsau sādhuśca atitarasādhuḥ tena mahāśreṣṭhenetyarthaḥ | atiśabdo vṛttiviṣaye dravyavacanaḥ tena ‘avyayaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe' iti adravyaprakarṣārthavihitasyāmo'tra na prasaktiḥ | tarasā vegena niravadhikavegenetyarthaḥ | adhunā adyaiva aghaṃ pāpmānaṃ dhunāti kampayati | uktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāṃ śriyaṃ dhyāyato mama sadya eva pūrvottarāghavināśāślaiṣau bhavata iti bhāvaḥ || daṇḍī tu prātilomyena pādādyāvṛttau pratilomayamakamityabhāṇat | tathāca tallakṣaṇam āvṛttiḥ prātilomyena pādārdhaślokagocarā | yamakapratilomatvātpratilomamiti smṛtam || iti | yatra pūrvapādasya pratilomāvṛttyā uttarapādaḥ, pūrvārdhasya pratilomāvṛttyā uttarārdhaṃ, ekasya ślokasya pratilomāvṛttyā ślokāntaraṃ ca niṣpadyate tatpratilomayamakamiti tadarthaḥ | ayamanulomapratilomacitrabheda ityanye | pādabhāgaprātilomye'pīdaṃ dṛśyate | atrā ryāvṛttaviśeṣaireva udāharaṇapradarśanasya pratiśrutatayā teṣāmasamagaṇapādatayā pādaprātilomyasya durghaṭatvena pādabhāgārdhaślokaprātilomyāvṛttiḥ pradarśyate || tatra pādabhāgaprātilomyāvṛttiryathā sarasāśaya yaśasā rasa iti vidito vitamasi sthito yassthāne | vanamālālī līlāmānava rāma tvayā'munā'vāptā'ho || 2303 || sarasaḥ āśayaḥ abhiprāyo yasya tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | he līlāmānava svecchāgṛhītamānuṣavigraha he rāma! yaḥ tvaṃ rasa iti ‘raso vai saḥ' iti śrutānandamayarūpa iti yaśasā viditassan vitamasi sthāne parame vyomni sthito'si | amunā īdṛśena tvayā vanamālānāṃ kānanacchaṭānāṃ ālī śreṇī prāptā aho aprākṛtadivyadhāmāvasthitasya prākṛtadaṇḍakāraṇyāvāptirāścaryāvaheti bhāvaḥ | atra prathamatṛtīyapādabhāgayossasvaravyañjanapañcakayoḥ prātilomyena yamakaviśeṣaḥ || garhyaṃ janayannayanaṃ prabhaviṣyati tiṣyavibhava eva hare | tava nāmnāmāmnānādaparā na narāpadapanaye'sti gatiḥ || 2304 || he hare ! garhyaṃ nindyaṃ ayanaṃ mārgaṃ janayan janānamārge pravartayannityarthaḥ | tiṣyasya kaleḥ ‘tiṣyaḥ puṣye kaliyuge' ityamaraḥ | vibhava eva prabhaviṣyati prabhutāṃ prapatsyata ityarthaḥ | nātra yuge yāgadānatapaḥprabhṛtyupāyānuṣṭhānāvakāśa iti bhāvaḥ | tarhi kathaṃ doṣanistāra ityata aha tava ‘harirharati pāpāni' iti prākhyātadi vyānāmna iti bhāvaḥ nāmnāṃ āmnānāt abhyāsāt aparā anyā narāṇāṃ mānavānāṃ vipadaḥ saṃsmṛtirūpāpadaḥ apanayane utsāraṇe gatiḥ upāyaḥ nāsti tvannāmasaṃkīrtanameva vipaduttaraṇopāya ityarthaḥ| yathokhyate kalerdoṣanidhe rājānnasti hyeko mahānguṇaḥ | kīrtanādeva kṛṣṇasya muktabandhaḥ paraṃ vrajet || iti | atrādyatṛtīyapādayorante varṇadvitayasya ekāntaritatayā parivartanam | dvitīyaturīyayostu avyavahitatayā varṇacatuṣṭayasyeti bodhyam || ardhasya prātilomyenāvṛttiryathā sā bhāyādanaghatarā kāntāśā'tīva janavarāmodā | dāmorā vanajavatī śāntākā''rātaghanadayā bhāsā || 2305 || sābhāyāt anaghatarā kāntāśā atīva janavarāmodā dāmorāḥ vanajavatī śāntākā ārātaghanadayā bhāsā | iti padacchedaḥ | anaghatarā apahatapāpmā kāntāśā kānte vallabhe bhagavati āśā abhilāṣo yasyāssā bhagavadviṣayakaniratiśayaprītiśālinīti bhāvaḥ | yadvā āśaḥ vyāptiḥ ‘aśū vyāptau' bhāve ghañ | kāntasya āśa iva āśo yasyāssā ‘tvayā ca viṣṇunā cāmba jagadvyāptaṃ carācaram' ityukteḥ | atīva atimātraṃ janavarāmodā janavarāṇāṃ naraśreṣṭhānāṃ āmodā āmodayitrī āṅpūrvakānmodayateḥ pacādyac | yadvā varaḥ āmodaḥ prītiryasyāssā janeṣu varāmodā niratiśayaprītirityarthaḥ | athavā varaiḥ tattadabhilaṣitairvaraiḥ āmodā āmodayitrī jānanāṃ varāmodā dāmorāḥ dāma kusumamālyaṃ urisa yasyāssā dāmorāḥ ataeva ‘mahāmālāvibhūṣaṇā' iti tannāma | 'uraḥprabhṛtibhyaḥ kap' iti kap na bhavati, samāsāntavidheranityatvāt | tathāca murāriprayogaḥ ‘āpūryamāṇorasam' iti | vanajavatī vanajaṃ abjaṃ asyā astīti tathoktā padminītyarthaḥ | 'padye sthitāṃ, padmapriye padmini padmahaste' ityādipramāṇāt | śāntaṃ akaṃ āśritānāṃ pāpaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā yayā sā śāntākā | ‘akaṃ pāpe ca duḥkhe ca' iti viśvaḥ | ārātaghanadayā ārātā āttā ‘rā ādāne' ityasmāddhātoḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ | ghanā sāndrā dayā yasyāssā | sā prasiddhā śrīrityarthaḥ | bhāsā prabhāvena ‘bhāḥ prabhāve ca dīptau ca' iti medinī | bhāyāt prakāśatām | sā bhāyādityatra mā bhāyāditi pāṭhe mā bhāyāt iti chedaḥ | turīyapādānte dayābhāsetyatra dayābhāmeti pāṭhe ārātaghanadayā bhāmeti vā ārātaghanadayābhā mā iti vā chedaḥ | ārātaghanadayā ukto'rthaḥ | dvitīyapakṣe tu ārāte ātte ghane dayā ca ābhā ca dayābhe yasyāssā mā idaṃ viśeṣyaṃ lakṣmīrityarthaḥ | mā māṃ prati bhāyāt prakāśatāṃ mayi saṃnidhattāmiti yāvat || ślokasya prātilomyaṃ yathā vaitāne bhuvi janitā mā tārārāmadamanayojyājñā | mānātigavibhavanadī dāsāvanasārasarasanayanābhā || 2306 || bhānāyanasarasarasā'navasādā''dīnavabhāvigatināmā | jñā jñā jyāyo namadamarā rātā mātā nijavibhunetā vai || 2307 || vaitāne bhuvi janitā mā tārārāmadamanayojyājñā mānātigavibhavanadī dāsāvanasārasarasanayanābhā bhānāyanasarasarasā anavasādā ādīnavabhavigatināmā jñā jyāyaḥ namadamarā rātā mātā nijavibhunā itā vai | iti padyadvayapadacchedaḥ | vaitāne vitānasaṃbandhini karmaṇīti yāvat | yajñiyabhūkarṣaṇāvasare iti bhāvaḥ | bhuvi bhūmau janitā mā śrīḥ idaṃ viśeṣyam | tārārāmadamanayojyājñā | tārāyāḥ rāmaḥ ramaṇaḥ vālītyarthaḥ | tasya damanaḥ daṇḍayitā bhagavān dāśarathiḥ tasmin yojyā yojanīyā ājñā śāsanaṃ yasyāssā tasya tadājñānuvartitāyāśśrīrāmāyaṇe prasiddhatvāt | mānātigavibhavanadī mānātigaḥ velātītaḥ yo vibhavaḥ vaibhavaḥ tasya nadī āśrayabhūteti yāvat | bhagavatyāṃ nadītvarūpaṇenārūpitamapi vibhavasya salilatvaṃ pratīyata ityekadeśavivartirūpakaviśeṣaḥ | ataeva 'mahāvibhavavāhinī' iti tannāmasahasre paṭhyate | dāsāvanasārasarasanayanābhā dāsānāṃ kiṃkarāṇāṃ avane rakṣaṇe viṣaye sārā śreṣṭhā sarasā sadayā nayanābhā locanaśrīḥ yasyāstathoktā | bhānāyanasarasarasā bhānasya prakāśasya bhāterbhāve lyuṭ | ayanaṃ mārgaḥ āśraya iti yāvat | tādṛśo yassaraḥ hāraḥ tena sarasā ramaṇīyeti yāvat | anavasādā avidyamānaḥ avasādaḥ kārśyaṃ yasyāssā | ādīnavabhavigatināmā ādīnavaḥ kleśaḥ ‘ādīnavāstravau kleśe' ityamaraḥ | ādīnavayuktānāṃ bhavināṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ gatiḥ gamyata iti gatiḥ karmaṇi ktin | prāpyaṃ nāma yasyāstathoktā tāpatrayadūṣitasaṃsārijanānusaṃdheyanāmadheyeti bhāvaḥ | jñā viduṣī sarvajñetyarthaḥ | ata eva 'sarvajñā kamalaprabhā' iti tannāmasu paṭhanti | jyāyaḥ idamuttaratrānveti | namadamarā namantaḥ amarāḥ yāṃ tathoktā | nijavibhunā svavallabhena bhagavatā itā yuktā jyāyaḥ śreyaḥ atipraśasyamai śvaryamityarthaḥ | praśasyaśabdādīyasuni tasya ‘jya ca' iti jyādeśaḥ | rātā dāsyati | ‘rā dāne' luṭ | vai iti prasiddhau | evaṃ yamakadigudāhṛtā || <14> atha punaruktavadābhāsaḥ punaruktavadābhāti yatrārtho na tu vastutaḥ | punaruktavadābhāsassa nāmākhyātagocaraḥ || yatrārthaḥ punaruktavadābhāti īṣadbhāti ananvitamiva āmukhe'vabhāsate | vastutaḥ paramārthatastu anvayavelāyāmanyadhaiva bhavati sa punaruktavadābhāso nāmālaṃkāraḥ | ayaṃ ca nāmāvalambī akhyātāvalambī ceti dvividhaḥ | arthālaṃkāratve'pyasya śabdapaunaruktyāvalambitayā śabdālaṅkāraprastāve lakṣaṇoktiḥ | tatra nāmāśratho yathā phaṇidharaṇibhṛdacalasthitighṛṇimanmitraprabhākaramudāram | maṇiratnaghanoraskaṃ praṇidadhyāṃ kimapi daivataṃ satatam || 2308 || phaṇidharaṇibhṛt bhujagarājaḥ sa cāsau acalo giriḥ tasmin sthitiḥ yasya tat ghṛṇimān bhānuḥ tasya mitraṃ tattulyā yā prabhā tasyāḥ ākaram | maṇiratnaṃ maṇiśreṣṭhaḥ ‘ratnaṃ svajātiśreṣṭhe'pi' ityamaraḥ | tena ghanoraskam | atra dharaṇibhṛdādīnāṃ acalādiparyāyapadaprayogeṇa āmukhe avabhāsamānasya paunaruktyasya uktaprakāreṇānvayāvasare anyadhāparyavasānātpunaruktavadābhāso'yaṃ nāmāśrayaḥ || ākhyātāśrayo yathā dīvyati bhāti virājati dinanāthasadṛkūprakāśa te kamalā | bhavatīṣṭe prabhavati nanu bhagavannahinagavasuṃdharābharaṇa || 2309 || dinanāthasadṛkprakāśa ahinagavasuṃdharābharaṇa nanu he bhagavan ! te tava kamalā te iti ‘lakṣmīpate te'ṅghriyugam' ityatreva vibhaktipratirūpakamavyayam | na tu yuṣmacchabdasya ‘te mayau' iti vihitaste ityādeśaḥ dinanāthasadṛkprakāśetyāmantritasya ‘āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' ityavidyamānavadbhāvena pādāditvāt tasya cādeśasya ‘padasya padāt' | anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau' ityapādādāveva vidhānāt te kamaletyanena ‘sadā tavaivocitayā tava śriyā' ityatreva 'viṣṇoḥ śrīranapāyinī' ityādiprasiddhaṃ nityavyavasthitapatipārārthyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyate | dīvyati krīḍāṃ vidadhāne bhāti prakāśamāne prabhavati prabhaviṣṇau iṣṭe priye bhavati tvayi virājati bhāsate | atra dīvyati bhāti virājati prakāśate ityeteṣāṃ īṣṭe prabhavatītyanayośca āmukhe ekārthakākhyātavadābhāsamānatayā paunaruktyasya upapāditarītyānvayasamaye'nyathā paryavasitatvenākhyātāśrayo'yaṃ punaruktavadābhāsa iti bodhyam | kāvyaprakāśakāramate tu śabdaikaniṣṭhaśśabdārthadvayasthaścetyasau dvidhā | sabhaṅgābhaṅgabhedena dvidhā śabdaikasaṃśrayaḥ || asau punaruktavadābhāsaḥ śabdamātrasamāśrayaḥ śabdārthobhayasamāśrayaśceti dvividhaḥ | tatrādyaśśabdamātrāśrayastu sabhaṅgaḥ abhaṅga iti dvividhaḥ | tatra sabhaṅgaḥ punaruktavadābhāsaśśabdaikagocaro yathā snehena hare tvayyava lipto'haṃkṛtamatiścirādabha vam | bahudhā mahitaṃ te'ja sthānaṃ me syātkathaṃ nu duṣprāpam || 2310 || he hare! ava rakṣa | tvayi viṣaye snehena premṇaina tailādirasadravyeṇa liptaḥ digdhaḥ cirāt bahoḥ kālāt abhavam | bahudhā mahitaṃ te ajeti chedaḥ | he aja! bhagavan bahudhā bahuprakāreṇa mahitaṃ pūjitaṃ te tava sthānaṃ paramaṃ vyoma kathaṃ nu duṣprāpam evaṃ tvayi saṃjātānurāgasya suprāpameva syādityarthaḥ | atrāvalito'haṃkṛta ityatra bahudhāmahitaṃ tejasthānamityatra ca avaliptāhaṃkṛtaśabdayoḥ dhāmatejaśśabdayoścaikārthatayā bhāsamānayoranayoruktarītyā padabhaṅgena bhinnārthayornibandhanātsabhaṅgaḥ punaruktavadābhāsaḥ || abhaṅgo yathā vākpatigurusaumyabudhaślāghyo'cyuta bhaumamaṅgalanidhānam | bhānusutamandatāvahaparamaudāryaścakāsti bhavadīyaḥ || 2311 || he acyuta! bhavadīyaḥ bhavadanugrahagocaro manujaḥ vākpatayaḥ vāvadūkāḥ guravaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ saumyaḥ araudrāśca ye budhāḥ vipaścitaḥ taiḥ ślāghyaḥ | bhūmeridaṃ bhaumaṃ yat maṅgalaṃ kalyāṇaṃ tasya nidhānaṃ ādhāraḥ | bhānusutasya karṇasya mandatāvahaṃ alpatvasaṃpādakaṃ tato'pyatiśayitamityarthaḥ | tādṛśaṃ paramaudāryaṃ yasya tathoktaḥ cakāsti | atra vākpatiguruśabdayoḥ saumyabudhaśabdayoḥ bhaumamaṅgalaśabdayoḥ bhānusutamandaśabdayośca bṛhaspatirauhiṇeyāṅgārakaśanaiścararūpaikārthatāvabhāsa uktarītyā abhaṅgapadāśraya iti dhyeyam || śabdārthobhayāśrayo yathā tapanīyasuvarṇāṅgāṃ ghanajaladasanābhirucirakacabandhām | lakṣmīṃ prabhāmudārāṃ mahatīṃ śrīvāsa vāsaya kule me || 2312 || tapanīyaṃ kāñcanamiva suvarṇaṃ śobhanavarṇaṃ aṅgaṃ yasyāstāṃ 'hiraṇyavarṇām' iti śruteḥ | ghanaḥ sāndraḥ yaḥ jaladaḥ tasya sanābhiḥ sagotraḥ tatsadṛśa iti yāvat | ruciraḥ kacabandho yasyāstāṃ udārāṃ vadānyāṃ ‘devajuṣṭāmudārām' iti śruteḥ | ‘udāro dātṛmahatoḥ' ityamaraḥ mahatīṃ pūjyāṃ mahyate pūjyata iti vyutpatteḥ | prabhāṃ prakṛṣṭā bhā dīptiryasyāstāṃ lakṣmīṃ he śrīnivāsa ! idaṃ tannivāsanaupayikatābhiprāyagarbham | me kule saṃtāne gṛhe ca vāsaya | anena 'śriyaṃ vāsaya me kule' iti śrutiḥ pratyabhijñāpyate | atra suvarṇaghanaprabhodārāśabdānāṃ paryāyāsahiṣṇutayā śabdāśrayatvam | tapanīyajaladalakṣmīmahatīśabdānāṃ gāṅgeyamudirakamalāpūjyādipadāntarasahiṣṇutayā'rthāśrayatvamityubhayāśritatvaṃ punaruktavadābhāsasyeti vijñeyam || athāpaśabdavadābhāsaḥ nivartate sādhubhāvajñānādyatrāpaśabdadhīḥ | apaśabdavadābhāsasso'laṃkāro nigadyate || yathā hariṇo yasya yaśobhirvyāpto lokaḥ payonidhīyati tam | śaraṇaṃ vrajeyamīśaṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ śaṃbhuvaṃ ramādhibhuvam || 2313 || yasya yaśobhiḥ vyāpto lokaḥ hariṇaḥ pāṇḍurassan payonidhīyati ātmānaṃ kṣīrābdhimivācarati | payonidhiśabdāt 'upamānādācāre' iti kyac | taṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ anitarakāraṇakaṃ śaṃbhuvaṃ sukhabhūmiṃ īśaṃ sarveśvaraṃ ramādhibhuvaṃ śrīvallabhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajeyamiti yojanā | atra hariṇa iti prathamāntasya yasyeti ṣaṣṭhyantapadasamabhivyāhārāt kariṇa itivat ṣaṣṭhyantatayā payonidhīyatītyatra paya iti cchedena nidhīyatīti nipūrvakāddhāñaḥ karmaṇi parasmaipaditayā vrajeyamityatra vraje ayamiti cchedena vrajaterātmanepaditayā śaṃbhuvamityatra samabhivyāhṛtasvayaṃbhuvamitivat uvaṅādeśavattayā cāpaśabdatvenāvabhāsādapaśabdavadābhāsatvam || yathāvā śrīnāthorthijanānāmabhīṣṭadānāya kalpati vṛṣādrau | pratyarthijanānāmapyaniṣṭadānāya kalpati nitāntam || 2314 || pūrvārdhe kalpati kalpatarurivācarati | uttarārdhe kalpati kalpaḥ pralaya ivācaratītyarthaḥ | ‘kalpastu pralaye nyāye śāstre brahmadine vidhau | suradrume vikalpe ca pratyayaścetsamārthatā' iti ratnamālā | atra kalpatīti klṛpadhātoḥ parasmaipadavadavabhāsādapaśabdābhāsatvaṃ, tasya nityamātmanepaditvāt || athāvyayābhāsaḥ padānāṃ suptiṅantānāmanyārthānāṃ nigumbhane | yathā'vyayavadābhāsaścitraṃ tannāma tadviduḥ || yathā sadvārenohantā bahudhābhūyassvadhāmavannāmā | doṣātītassudivā''samayāsamayāvanodyataḥ prāpi || sadvārenohantā dvārā saha vartata iti sadvāḥ' rephānto'yaṃ śabdaḥ | yat enaḥ aghaṃ ‘kaluṣaṃ vṛjinainogham' ityamaraḥ | avidyārāgadveṣādikāraṇakaṃ pāpamityarthaḥ | tasya hantā nirāsakaḥ | svopāsakasamūlapūrvottarāghanirākaraṇadhurīṇa ityarthaḥ | tatra hetumabhiprayannāha bahviti | bahu cetanācetanātmanā bahuprakāraṃ viśvaṃ dadhāti dhārayati puṣṇāti ceti bahudhāḥ | ādanto'yaṃ viśvapā itivat | bhūyaḥ atiśayena bahu svadhāma svābhāvikaḥ prabhāvaḥ | ‘gṛhadehatviṭprabhāvā dhāmāni' ityamaraḥ | tadasyāstīti tadvat nāma abhidhānaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | dhārakatvātpoṣakatvānmahāmahimanāmavattvāccāsya sakaladuritānāṃ samūlaghātaṃ hantṛtvamiti bhāvaḥ | ataeva doṣātītaḥ doṣān atītaḥ ‘dvitīyā śritātīta' ityādinā samāsaḥ apahatapāpmā ‘sa eṣa sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhya uditaḥ' ityādiśrutyarthotrānusaṃdheyaḥ | yadvā bhūyāṃsi svadhāmavanti tattaccharīravanti tattadrūpavanti vā nāmāni devamanuṣyādināmāni yasya bahudhā ityanenātmatvaṃ anena tu nāmarūpavyākaraṇapūrvakatattaccharīrapraveśaprayuktatattannāmarūpabhāktvaṃ ca darśitam | suṣṭha dīvyatīti sudivā | svābhāvi kajñānānandādikalyāṇaguṇavattayā prakāśamāna ityarthaḥ | tattaddevādiśarīrānupraviṣṭatve'pi tatkṛtatadīyadoṣāsaṃspṛṣṭatvamanena dyotitam | yatsūtritaṃ ‘saṃbhogaprāptiriti cenna vaiśeṣyāt' iti | mayā śriyā | atra ya ityadhyāhāryamuttaratra sa iti darśanāt | āsa didīpe | dīptyarthakādaserliṭ | svābhāvikaniravadhikadīptiyukta eva yo bhagavān hemneva maṇiśśriyā viśeṣato dīpyata iti bhāvaḥ | avane rakṣaṇe udyataḥ udyuktaḥ ‘na hi pālanasāmarthyamṛte sarveśvaraṃ harim | ityukteḥ | saḥ pūrvoktaguṇaśālī bhagavān mayā śeṣabhūteneti bhāvaḥ | prāpi prāpadyata prapūrvakādāpnoteḥ karmaṇi luṅi ciṇ || atra padye sat vā re no hanta ā bahuthā bhūyaḥ svadhā āma vat na amā doṣā ati itaḥ su divā samayāsamayā ava na ut yataḥ pra api ityavyayaparaṃparāyā ābhāsaḥ | samayāsamayeti dviruktāvyayasyābhāsa iti draṣṭavyam || atha tiṅantavadābhāsaḥ yatrābhāsastiṅantānāṃ syādarthāntaragaiḥ padaiḥ | tattiṅantavadābhāsacitraṃ citrajñasammatam || yathāvā bhavatāpahara jayāvaha pāpāni bhave davessya pariluṭhataḥ | premodadhe prabhavitā bhavato vātītaro na cetastaḥ || 2316 || bhavatāpasya haraḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | jayāvaha āśritotkarṣadāyin premā priyatvaṃ tasya udadhe niratiśayapriyetyarthaḥ| ‘priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamaham' iti hi tena gīyate | bhave saṃsāre eva dave vanānale kāntāre vā vyastarūpakaṃ pariluṭhataḥ mameti śeṣaḥ | pāpāni asya nirākuru | asyaterdaivādikālloṇmadhyamaikavacanam | kuto māmeva nirbadhnāsītyata āha prabhavitetyādi | bhavataḥ tvatto'pi itaraḥ anyaḥ prabhavitā pāpaharaṇakarmaṇi prabhuḥ samartha ityarthaḥ | mameti śeṣaḥ | cetastaḥ cittaṃ dvitīyāyāssārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | na vāti na gacchati | vātergatyarthakādādādikāllaṭ | tvatto'nyaḥ pāpanirvāpaṇadhurīṇaḥ maccittagocaratāṃ na yātītyarthaḥ | ‘harirharati pāpāni duṣṭacittairapi smṛtaḥ' ityādivacanāditi bhāvaḥ | atastvameva me pāpāni nirākurvityarthaḥ | atrānyārthakapadānupūrvyā tiṅantānāṃ padānāmābhāsanāttiṅantavadābhāsanāmedaṃ citramasmadupajñam || bhavata āpa hara jaya āvaha pāpāni bhavet aveḥ sya pariluṭhataḥ premaḥ dadhe prabhavitā bhavataḥ ava atītaraḥ ana ceta staḥ || iti chede ekonaviṃśatistiṅantapadānyābhāsante iti sāvadhānaṃ vibhāvanīyam || <15> atha svarasthānavyañjanādiniyamacitram svarasthānavyañjanānāṃ niyamo duṣkaro hi yaḥ | proktaścatuḥprabhṛtyeṣa darśyate sukaraḥ paraḥ || duṣkaracitreṣu madhye svarasthānavyañjanānāṃ svarāḥ akārādayaḥ acaḥ sthānāni 'akuhavisarjanīyānāṃ kaṇṭhaḥ' ityādyuktāni kaṇṭhādisthānāni | vyañjanāni halvarṇāḥ teṣāṃ niyamaḥ prāktanairyo duṣkaratayā proktaḥ eṣaḥ catuḥprabhṛti darśyate | catuḥprabhṛtītyanena catustridvyekarūpatayā catvāro bhedāḥ pradarśyanta ityuktaṃ bhavati | paraḥ anyastu pañcādiḥ sukaraḥ anatiprayāsasādhyatvāt | atastadudāharaṇaṃ yathāyathamūhyam || tatra prathamaṃ catussvaraniyamacitramudāhriyate | yathā kāmo moho lobho'pyatimātraṃ galati tava padadhyānāt | bhogo vā yogo vā mokṣo vā'bjākṣa tava kaṭākṣātsyāt || 2328 || atra akāra ākāra ikāra okāraśceti catvāra eva svarā nibaddhāḥ || yathāvā saubhāgyakairavaglauḥ padmāsthairyaprabhāvatārādyauḥ | anapāyabhavārṇavanauranaghā bhadrāya bhāsatāmavanau || 2329 || glauḥ candramāḥ | sthairyaṃ ca prabhāvāśca ta eva tārāḥ tārakāḥ tāsāṃ dyauḥ | padmā lakṣmīḥ | atra akāra ākāra aikāra aukāraścetyete catvāra eva svarā nibaddhāḥ || trisvaraniyamo yathā yā nāgādryāvāsā sā pāyānmāṃ sadā bhavāpāyāt | śrīḥ hrīdhīśrīkīrtīḥ prītīrdadhatī harantītīḥ || 2330 || nāgādryāvāsā śeṣādrinivāsā | hīḥ akārye lajjā | dhīḥ prajñā śrīḥ prabhā | kīrtiḥ yaśaḥ | prītiḥ āśriteṣu premā | tasyāḥ viṣayabhedādbahutvam | dadhatī puṣṇatī | ītīḥ upaplavān | 'ītirḍimbapravāsayoḥ' ityamaraḥ | harantī śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ bhavāpāyāt saṃsārarūpādapāyāt pāyāt iti yojanā | atra akāra ākāra īkāra ityete traya eva svarāḥ || yathāvā vinutassatataṃ munibhirmumukṣubhirnanu bubhukṣubhirapi tvam | tattadabhilaṣitamakhilaṃ vitarasi mucukundavarada muramathana || 2331 || atra akāra ikāra ukāra iti traya evaite svarā grathitāḥ || dvisvaraniyamo yathā vedevede vedye dhyeye'meye priye'kriye'kṣeye | geye'jeye deve deveśeḍye'kṣi me reme || 2332 || vedevede prativedaṃ vedye jñeye | dhyeye dhyātavye | ameye ‘yato vāco nivartante' ityādyuktarītyā vāgādyaparicchedye paricchedatritayāgocare vā | priye niratiśayaprītiviṣaye akriye ‘niṣkriyaṃ niṣkalam' ityādyuktarītyā akarmavaśye | kṣetuṃ yogyaḥ kṣeyaḥ sa na bhavatītyakṣeyaḥ tasmin idaṃ ‘kṣayyajayyau' ityasya pratyudāharaṇam | upalakṣaṇametansarvabhāvavikārāṇāṃ rāhityasya | geye gātuṃ yogye | jetuṃ yogyo jeyaḥ sa na bhavatītyajeyaḥ tasmin | idamapyudāhṛtasūtrapratyudāharaṇameva | deveśaiḥ brahmādibhiḥ īḍye stutye | deve bhagavati śrīnivāse me mama akṣi locanaṃ reme aramata tannidhyānaikatānamabhavaditi bhāvaḥ | atra reme iti liṭprayogassvasya pramodapāravaśyaprayuktapārokṣyaṃ sūcayati | atra ikāra ekāra ityetayordvayoreva svarayoryantraṇam || ekasvaraniyamacitraṃ yathā tvaccaraṇaśaraṇavaraṇakṣatasakalamalasya kamalanayana mama | bhavadavapathasaṃcaraṇaśramamapanaya varada paradarakṣapaṇa || 2333 || parebhyaḥ kāmādivairibhyaḥ yaḥ daraḥ bhayaṃ tasya kṣapaṇaḥ dhvaṃsakaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | atra hrasvākārasyaikasyaiva svarasya nibandhaḥ || atha sthānaniyamaḥ | tatra catussthānaniyamo yathā dṛṣṭiśrutibhūbhṛdvibhunutisṛtibhṛbhṛdbhuvi vibhīssudhīvṛttī | nītivinītidyutidhṛtivibhūtibhūmiśśrutismṛtisthitivit || 2334 || dṛṣṭiśrutiḥ cakṣuśśravāḥ sa cāsau bhūbhṛt śeṣagirirityarthaḥ | tasya vibhuḥ śrīnivāsaḥ tasya nutisṛtibhṛt stutisaraṇibhartā stotetyarthaḥ | īdṛśo janaḥ bhuvi dhīśca vṛttaṃ caritraṃ tacca dhīvṛtte śobhane ca te sudhīvṛtte ca te asya sta iti sudhīvṛttī matvarthīya iniḥ | śobhanabuddhiśśobhanācāraścetyarthaḥ | nītiḥ nayaḥ vinītirvinayaḥ dyutiḥ tejaḥ dhṛtiḥ dhairyaṃ vibhūtiraiśvaryaṃ tāsāṃ bhūmiḥ āśrayaḥ śrutirvedaḥ smṛtirdharmaśāstraṃ etayoḥ sthitiḥ maryādā tāṃ vettīti śrutismṛtisthitivit 'maryādā dhāraṇā sthitiḥ' ityamaraḥ | bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | atra kevalatālavyamūrdhanyadantyoṣṭhyaireva varṇairghaṭanā ‘ānunāsikyameṣāmadhiko guṇaḥ' iti bhāṣaṇātprakṛte nakārasya dantyatvamātravivakṣayā na sthānaniyamabhaṅga iti dhyeyam | idaṃ niṣkaṇṭhyavarṇācitramapi | kiṃcātra ikāra īkāra ukāra ūkāra ṛkāra ityete pañcaiva svarā nyabadhyanta | yadyapi pañcasvaraireva ghaṭanaṃ nātiprayāsasādhyamityanāścaryamityavocāma | tathāpi varṇasthānaniyame svaraniyamasyāpyānuṣaṅgikatve tadapyāścaryāvahameveti dhyeyam || sphīte munibhirdhyāte śrīsindhusute'dbhute dyusindhuyute | śeṣe śeṣiṇi śaile'bhyeṣi prītiṃ priyeṇoccaiḥ || 2335 || he munibhirdhyāte he śrīsindhusute he śeṣiṇi sphīte abhivṛddhe adbhute vicitre dyusindhuyute ākāśagaṅgānvite śeṣe śaile śeṣādrau priyeṇa śrīnivāsena saha uccaiḥ niratiśayāṃ prītiṃ mudaṃ abhyeṣīti yojanā | ayaṃ ślokaḥ niṣkaṇṭhyavarṇagrathitaḥ | niṣedhyaḥ kaṇṭhyaścātra kevalakaṇṭhyaḥ, tena kaṇṭhatālusthānakayoḥ ekāraikārayoḥ kaṇṭhoṣṭhasthānakasya okārasya sattve'pi na doṣaḥ || rakṣogaṇasukṣobhaṇadakṣolbaṇabāṇatūṇabāṇāsaḥ | svakṣo natapakṣonnatirakṣo'vatu māṃ ramānāthaḥ || śobhane akṣiṇī yasya saḥ svakṣaḥ ‘bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ' iti samāsāntaṣṭac | ‘na pūjanāt' iti niṣedhastu, bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ' ityataḥ prāgeva iti niyamitamākare | atra nistālavyaireva varṇairnnibandhaḥ, svarapañcakaniyamopyānuṣaṅgikaḥ || kiñcidacañcalavibhavaṃ kañcukināthācalāñcalodañci | tvañcāpalaṃ vimuñcatpañcāyudhamañca daivataṃ cetaḥ || 2337 atra kaṇṭhyatālavyadantyauṣṭhyavarṇānyeva nibaddhāni | idameva nirmūrdhanyamiti vyavahriyate || śikharaviśaṅkaṭaveṅkaṭagirikaṭakavihāri hārihāraruci | ayi kimapi vaibhavaṃ bhavabhavabhayabharaharaṇameva paricara gīḥ || 2338 || śikharaiḥ viśaṃkaṭaḥ viśālaḥ yo veṃkaṭagiriḥ tasya kaṭake viharatīti tathoktaṃ hāriṇī manoharā hāraruciḥ yasya tat | bhavabhava bhayabharaharaṇaṃ bhavāt bhavaḥ utpannaḥ yo bhayabharaḥ tasya haraṇaṃ hartṛ kimapi vaibhavameva vaibhavatvenādhyavasitaṃ paraṃ brahmaiva ayi gīḥ he vāṇi ! paricara tadguṇānevānuvarṇayetyarthaḥ | atra kaṇṭhyatālavyamūrdhanyauṣṭhyavarṇaireva nibandhaḥ | idameva nirdantyacitram | atra kevaladantyasyaiva niṣedhaḥ, tena dantoṣṭhasthānakavakārasadbhāve'pyadoṣa iti dhyeyam || yathāvā phaṇiśekharaśikhariśikhāmaragaṇaparibṛḍhamaṇīśamañjurucim | ramaṇīramaṇīyoraśśaraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ kamapyaye śaraṇam || 2339 || śaraṇaṃ rakṣitāraṃ ramaṇīramaṇīyaṃ uraśśaraṇaṃ hṛdayagṛhaṃ yasya taṃ kamapi pumāṃsaṃ śaraṇamaye upāyatve svīkaromītyarthaḥ || upāye gṛharakṣitrośśabdaśśaraṇamityayam | vartate sāṃprataṃ caiṣa upāyārthaikavācakaḥ || ityahirbudhnyasaṃhitokteḥ | idaṃ sarvadhā nirdantyam || mamaiva prapannānandastutau jagadīśahṛdayanilayā jagatāñjananī janārtiharaṇacaṇā | jalajadalāyatanayanā jalanidhitanayā jayānkalayatānnaḥ || 2340 || atra kaṇṭhyatālavyamūrdhanyadantyavarṇānāmeva nibandhaḥ | idameva niroṣṭhyamityucyate | atra akāra ākāra ikāra īkāra ṛkāraścetyete pañcaiva svarā nibaddhā iti vicchittiviśeṣaḥ || yathāvā kanakanagakaṭakataṭakanadagagahanaga gaganasadanasatatanata | jagadanaghajayada ghanadaya jaya gajadaradahanajalada narakahara || 2341 || kanakanagasya vṛṣādreḥ kaṭakastha taṭe kanatāṃ lasatāṃ agānāṃ tarūṇāṃ gahanaṃ kānanaṃ gacchatīti gahanagaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ gaganasadanaiḥ diviṣadbhiḥ satatanata | jagatāṃ anaghaṃ duḥkhāsaṃbhinnaṃ jayaṃ dadātīti jagadanaghajayadaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | gajadaradahanajalada gajasya daraḥ bhayameva dahanaḥ pāvakaḥ tasya jalada | narakahara narakāre jaya utkarṣaṃ prāpnuhi | atrāpi kaṇṭhyatālavyamūrdhanyavarṇā eva grathitāḥ | idaṃ niro'ṣṭhyamekasvaraṃ sarvalaghu ceti vicchittiviśeṣaḥ pūrvasmāt || śeṣācalabhūṣā śubhaveṣā bhāṣāpatistutisatoṣā | yoṣāhṛdayavibhūṣā śeṣāśeṣā''didevatā saiṣā || yoṣā lakṣmīḥ hṛdayavibhūṣā yasyāssā saiṣā ādidevatā | śeṣāḥ śeṣabhūtāḥ aśeṣāḥ sarve yasyāssā | atra śrīnivāsamuddiśya aśeṣaśeṣitvaṃ vidhīyate | idaṃ nirnāsikyavarṇaṃ citram || evaṃ catussthānavarṇaniyamo darśitaḥ | atha tristhānavarṇaniyama udāhriyate yathā kāntyānantyātkāntā śāntyā cātyantayā dayājaladhiḥ | kanakanaganāthadāyitā kanati kanatkāñcikāñcitā jagati || 2343 || kānteḥ ānantyāt atyantayā śāntyā ca kāntā manojñā dayājaladhiḥ kanantyā prakāśamānayā kanakakāñcikayā añcitā kanakanaganāthadayitā jagati jayatīti yojanā | idaṃ kaṇṭhyatālavyadantyavarṇaireva nibaddhamiti niroṣṭhyamūrdhanyacitram | atrāpi ‘dṛṣṭiśṛtibhūbhṛdvibhu' iti prāgudāhṛtaniṣkaṇṭhyacitrapadya iva nakāra īkārayordantyatālavyatvamātravivakṣayā na sthānaniyamabhaṅga iti dhyeyam | anyathā catussthānavarṇaniyamasyaivodāharaṇaṃ bhavet | atra akāra ākāra ikāra iti trisvaraniyamopyabhyuccīyate || yathāvā sakalehitadāya jayaśśakalitadaityāya sakalaśaśiyaśase | sajalajaladālilālitadīdhitaye stātkhagācaleśāya || 2344 || sakalaśaśiyaśase pūrṇacandrasadṛśakīrtaye | khagācaleśāya śrīnivāsāya jayaḥ stāt | iti yojanā | ‘jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa' itivadatra bhagavato jayāśāsanam | idaṃ tu śuddhatristhānavarṇaniyamodāharaṇaṃ nāsikyāsaṃvalitatvāditi pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ || dvisthānavarṇaniyamo yathā bhāmābhāmāpoho bhogābhogābhabāhubhāgaghahā | bhūbhāgamakhabhugagabhāṅmāmakapāpāpaho mahābhūmā || bhāmāyāḥ satyabhāmāyāḥ bhāmaḥ kopaḥ 'bhāma krodhe' ityasmādbhāve ghañ | 'bhāmaḥ krodhe ravau dīptau' iti medinī | saḥ apohyate apanīyate'neneti bhāmābhāmāpohaḥ| bhogasya ahikāyasya ābhogaḥ paripūrṇatevābhogo yasyāssā tathoktā ābhā yayostau bāhū bhajata iti bhogābhogābhabāhubhāk | bhūbhāgamakhabhugagabhāk | bhūbhāgaṃ bhūmipradeśaṃ makhabhugagaṃ svardrumaṃ bhājayati sevayatīti tathā | bhajaterṇyantāt kvip | kalpataruṃ bhuvaṃ nītavānityarthaḥ | yadvā ‘bhaja viśrāṇane' ityasmāccaurādikāt kvip | kalpataruṃ bhūlokāya viśrāṇitavānityarthaḥ | ataeva bhāmābhāmāpoha ityuktam | ataeva mahābhūmā vipulamahimā aghahā aghāsurahantā bhagavānyadunandanaḥ māmakapāpāpahaḥ madīyaduritaharaḥ bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | atra kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyavarṇaireva nibandhanamiti nistālavyamūrdhanyadantyacitramidam | atrāpi makāraṅakārayoḥ kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyamātratvaṃ pūrvavat akāra ākāra ukāra ūkāra ākāraśceti pañcaiva svarā iti svaraniyamo'pyabhyuccīyate || ekasthānavarṇaniyamo yathā kākāghahā'ṅkagāṅkaḥ khagāṅkagāgāgagāhakaḥ khagagaḥ | aṅkāgāṅkāṅkāṅkagakaṅkakakaṅkākahā khagāṅkāṅkaḥ || 2346 || kākāghahā kākasya aindrervāyasasya aghaṃ duḥkhaṃ hantīti tathoktaḥ | aṅkagāṅkaḥ aṅkaṃ śrīvatsākhyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ gacchatītyaṅkagaḥ aṅkaḥ kroḍaṃ yasya saḥ śrīvatsavakṣā ityarthaḥ | kośastvanantaramevodāhariṣyate | khagāṅkagāgāgagāhakaḥ khagāḥ dyusadaḥ aṅkagāḥ samīpagāḥ yasya saḥ atyunnata iti yāvat | tathoktaḥ agāgaḥ phaṇigiriḥ 'ago nagaśca bhujage nābhau bhūruhi bhūdhare' iti ratnamālā | 'agassyānnagavattarau | śaile sarīsṛpe bhānau' iti hemacandraśca | khagāṅkagaścāsāvagāgaśca khagaṅkagāgāgaḥ tasya gāhakaḥ unnatatamaṃ śeṣācalaṃ praviṣṭa ityarthaḥ | gāhaterṇvul | khagaṃ khagena vā gaccha tīti khagagaḥ tārkṣyavāhana ityarthaḥ | 'anyatrāpi dṛśyata iti vaktavyam' iti' vārtikāt gamerḍaḥ | yadvā khagaṃ bhānuṃ gacchatīti khagagaḥ savitṛmaṇḍalāntarvartītyarthaḥ 'ya eṣo'ntarāditye' ityādiśrutibhyaḥ | aṅkāgāṅkāṅkāṅkagakaṅkakakaṅkākahāṅkaṃ saṃkhyāṃ na gacchatītyaṅkāgaḥ asaṃkhyāka ityarthaḥ | yadvā aṅkaṃ kalaṅkaṃ na gacchatītyaṅkāgaḥ niṣkalaṅka ityarthaḥ | yo'ṅkaḥ citrayuddhaṃ tasya aṅkaḥ sthānaṃ tasya aṅkaṃ samīpaṃ gacchatītyaṅkāṅkagaḥ | yadvā aṅkaḥ aparādhaḥ taṃ na gacchatītyaṅkāgaḥ niraparādha ityarthaḥ | tathoktaścāsāvaṅkāṅkagaśceti viśeṣaṇobhayapadaḥ karmadhārayaḥ | tādṛśo yaḥ kaṅkakaḥ gṛdhraḥ jaṭāyurityarthaḥ | tasya kaṅkākahā kaṅkaḥ yamaḥ tatkṛtaṃ yat akaṃ duḥkhaṃ taddhantīti tathoktaḥ | hanteḥ kvip 'yā gatiryajñaśīlānām' ityādi vadatā bhagavatā tasya divyasthānapradānena yamaviṣayagamanaduḥkhasya galahastitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | akaṃ duḥkhāghayoraṅko bhūṣārūpakalakṣmasu | citrājau nāṭakādyaṃśe sthāne kroḍe'ntikāgasoḥ || iti hemacandraḥ | khagāṅkāṅkaḥ khaṃ paramavyoma gacchatīti khagaḥ yaḥ aṅkaḥ ‘divyaṃ sthānamajaraṃ cāprameyam' ityādyuktaḥ śrīvaikuṇṭhākhyasthānaviśeṣaḥ | tasya aṅkaḥ ābharaṇabhūta ityarthaḥ | atra bhagavāṃstārkṣyavāhanaḥ paramavyomanilayaśśrīvatsavakṣā eva rāmātmanā'vatīrya kākāsuravipadapanayano jaṭāyuniśśreyasaviśrāṇayitā ca bhūtvā'rcātmanā śeṣādrau nivasatīti nirgalito'bhiprāyaḥ | paramavyomanilayatvādinā paratvaṃ vibhavarūpāvasthānena saulabhyaṃ arcātmanā'vasthānena tasyaiva niratiśayatvaṃ ca vyañjitam | atra kaṇṭhyaireva svarairvyañjanaiśca padyaracanā | duṣkaramidaṃ citramityāhuḥ || atha varṇaniyamaḥ tatrāpañcavargīṇacitraṃ yathā, mamaiva prapannānandastutau sarasiruhālayavāsā yā sā śiśirāṃśuhārilavahāsā | varasārasaśāliśayā sarasā sā śrīrviśiśriye śirasā || 2347 || lavahāso mitahasanam | sā śrīḥ śirasā viśiśriye āśritā | atra kacaṭatapavargīyavarṇavaidhuryeṇa yakārādivarṇā eva nyabadhyanta | idamevāsparśavarṇacitram || yathāvā vāsavasavahara savaharavaravaśyāsuravarāsaśaurya hare | vallavavalayasahāya svayaṃ śriyā saha vihāraśīlāvyāḥ || 2348 || vāsavasavasya indrayāgasya hara | savaharavarasya śambhudattavarasya vaśyaḥ yaḥ asuravaraḥ bāṇāsuraḥ taṃ asyati nirasyatīti tathoktaṃ śauryaṃ yasya tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | vallavavalayasya gopolajālasya sahāya śriyā saha vihāraśīla hare ! svayaṃ matkṛtakiṃcitkāramanapekṣya avyāḥ rakṣa | idamapi pūrvavadapañcavargīyacitram || anantasthoṣmavarṇacitraṃ yathā kanakakanadanaghadhāmā ghanabhūmā kā'pi jagadadhipabhāmā | dattāṃ mama matimattāmatimattānāṃ padāntikaṃ mā gām || 2349 || ghanabhūmā sāndramahimā jagadadhipabhāmā sarveśvaradayitā śrīḥ mama matimattāṃ dattām | atimattānāṃ surāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ vā padāntikaṃ caraṇanikaṭaṃ sthānasavidhaṃ vā mā gām | yathā durdānteśvarammanyāntikaṃ na gaccheyaṃ tathā mama matimattāṃ saṃpādayatviti bhāvaḥ | atra kādimāvasānāssparśā eva varṇā nibaddhāḥ | na tu yādayo'ntasthāśśādaya ūṣmāṇaśceti vyañjananiyamaḥ | akāra ākāra ikāra iti traya eva nibaddhā iti svaraniyamo'pyanusaṃdheyaḥ || ekavargīyavarṇaniyamo yathā dhānādānādhīne dīnānāthādhidhūnananidāne | nānānandanidhāne nāthe'nadhunātane natiṃ nāthe || dhānānāṃ pṛthukataṇḍulānāṃ dānena adhīne āyatte kucelasyeti bhāvaḥ | dīnānāṃ anāthānāṃ śaraṇyāntaravirahiṇāṃ ādheḥ manovyathāyāḥ dhūnanasya nidāne ādikāraṇe | nānānandānāṃ śataguṇitottarakrameṇābhyasyamānānāmānandānāṃ nidhāne nidhau anadhunātane nāthe purāṇapuruṣe bhagavati natiṃ śaraṇāgatiṃ nāthe āśāse 'āśiṣi nāthaḥ' ityātmanepadam | atra tavargīyavarṇaireva nibandhaḥ || yathāvā nātho'nāthānāṃ no netā'nanto'dhunā dhunātu tathā | tāṃ dīnatāṃ tato no dhinotu dhīdānato natānetān || 2351 || nāthaḥ jagadīśvaraḥ anāthānāṃ rakṣakāntaravidhurāṇāṃ naḥ asmākaṃ netā anantaḥ bhagavān tāṃ anirvacanīyāṃ dīnatāṃ dainyaṃ adhunā sāṃpratameva tathā dhunātu apunarunmeṣamunmūlayatvityarthaḥ | tataḥ natān etān naḥ asmān dhīdānataḥ ‘dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ tam' ityuktabuddhiyogavitaraṇena dhinotu prīṇayatu | atrāpi kevalatavargīyavarṇaniyamaḥ || yathāvā bhābhāmba mamābābhā bhūbhūpāpābhibhūbhāme | pāpāmbupapībimbopamabhūme'bhīmabhābhūme || 2352 || bhuvi bhavati jāyata iti bhūbhūḥ yaḥ pāpaḥ pāpiṣṭhaḥ bhīputro narakaḥ | yadvā bhūbhuvaḥ bhuvi kṛtajanmānaḥ pāpāḥ pralamba bakacāṇūra kaṃsa śiśupālādayaḥ taṃ tānvā abhibhavatīti bhūbhūpāpābhibhūḥ bhagavānvāsudevaḥ | tasya bhāme lalane | pāpāmbūni ambatulyāni lokapāpāni teṣāṃ papībimbaṃ sūryamaṇḍalaṃ upamā yasya saḥ tādṛśo bhūmā mahimā yasyāssā tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ anena vallabhasādharmyaṃ sūcitam | ‘nityaṃ taddharmadharmiṇī' iti hyucyate | 'ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' iti ḍāp | pātīti papīḥ 'yāpoḥ kiddve ca' iti pāterīpratyayo dvitvaṃ ca | ‘papīssūryaḥ' iti śābdikāḥ | bhīmā durātmanāmatyugrā yā bhāḥ prabhāvaḥ ‘bhāḥ prabhāve ca dīptau ca' iti medinī | tasyāḥ bhūmiḥ ādhārabhūtā | tasyāssaṃbuddhiḥ ‘sītāyāstejasā dagdhāṃ | na tadagniśikhā kuryāt' ityādiprasiddharipujanabhayaṃkaradivyaprabhāvāśrayabhūtāmiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā abhīmeti chedaḥ | abhimā anugrā ‘śīto bhava hanūmataḥ | na kaścinnāparādhyati' ityādyuktarītyā āśritaviṣaye saumyā bhāḥ prabhāvaḥ tasyāḥ bhūmirityarthaḥ | he amba ! tvamiti śeṣaḥ | mama bhābhā bhasya nakṣatrasya ābhevābhā yasyāstathābhūtā satī abābhāḥ bhṛśamadīpyathā ityarthaḥ | bhāteryaṅlugantāllaṅ | atra pavargīyaireva varṇairnibandhaḥ || dvivyañjanaṃ yathā nāmānanāni nāmāmanāni māmāninīnanāmāni | nūnamanunnamanamanā namāmi nānānanānamanamenam || 2353 || nāmānanāni nāma āmanāni māmāninīnanāmāni nūnaṃ anunnamanamanāḥ namāmi nānā ananānamanaṃ enaṃ iti padacchedaḥ | avidyamānaṃ mānanaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni tathoktāni na bhavantīti nāmānanāni atimātramānanīyānītyarthaḥ | mā lakṣmīriti māninī tasyāḥ inaḥ svāmī śrīnivāsa ityarthaḥ | tasya nāmāni nūnaṃ niścayena āmanāni abhyasyāni | āṅpūrvakāt mnādhātoḥ ‘pāghrādhmā' ityādinā manādeśaḥ | loḍuttamaḥ | punaḥpunaśśrīnivāsanāmāni kīrtayeyamiti bhāvaḥ | unnamanamunnatiḥ anunnamanaṃ mano yasya saḥ anunnamanamanāḥ anuddhata ityarthaḥ | ataeva ‘mānaścittasamannatiḥ' ityamaraḥ | ananānamanaṃ ananaṃ prāṇayitṛ ujjīvakamityarthaḥ | īdṛśaṃ ānamanaṃ praṇāmo yasya tam | eko'pi kṛṣṇe sukṛtaḥ praṇāmo daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ | daśāśvamedhī punareti janma kṛṣṇapraṇāmī na punarbhavāya || ityādipramāṇāt enaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ nānā anekaṃ yathāsyāttathā namāmi | nūnaṃ nātra kiṃcidapi saṃśetavyamiti bhāvaḥ | idamanunāsikadvivyañjananibaddham || yathāvā nānāmaunīnānananāmāmananāmumāmanomānām | māmānamāmi nūnaṃ mānāmāmāmamānanāmemi || nānā aneke ye maunīnāḥ muniśreṣṭhāḥ teṣāṃ ananaṃ prāṇayitṛ nāmāmananaṃ nāmadheyānukīrtanābhyāsaḥ yasyāstāṃ | umāyāḥ gauryāḥ manasā mānyata iti mānā tāṃ ‘akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' iti karmaṇi ghañ | ‘saṃjñāyām' iti prāyikamityāhuḥ | ghañanto'pyayaṃ bhedyaliṅgaḥ, ‘karmādau tu ghañādyantamapi viśeṣyaliṅgam' iti liṅgānuśāsanāt | yadvā māno mānanaṃ bhāve ghañ umāmanomāno'syā astīti tathoktā tāṃ māṃ śriyaṃ ānamāmi śaraṇaṃ prapadye | amānanāṃ pūjāvidhurāṃ amāṃ alakṣmīṃ nūnaṃ mā nāma emi na prāpnomi | lakṣmīśaraṇavaraṇānantaramalakṣmīrnaśyatyeveti bhāvaḥ | 'tāṃ padmanemīṃ śaraṇamahaṃ prapadye'lakṣmīrme naśyatāṃ tvāṃ vṛṇe' iti śrutyartho'trānusaṃhitaḥ | idamapi pūrvavat dvivyañjanameva || yathāvā tāntiṃ tatāṃ natānāṃ tanutāṃ nata tanota tane tān | netā nā'tanutāta'notonnantūnnatāntata' nantaḥ || 2355 || tāntiṃ tatāṃ natānāṃ tanutāṃ netā tanotu tān etān netā naḥ atanutātaḥ anītīn nantṝn nitāntataḥ anantaḥ | iticchedaḥ | tatāṃ vistṛtāṃ natānāṃ tāntiṃ glāniṃ tanutāṃ kṛśatāṃ netā prāpayitā | nayatestṛn | ataeva na kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhī | atanoḥ pradyumnasya tātaḥ janakaḥ netā svāmī anantaḥ bhagavān nantṝn śaraṇāgatān tānetān naḥ ‘te vayaṃ bhavatā rakṣyāḥ' ityuktarītyā tvadīyānasmānityarthaḥ | anītīn ītiḥ pīḍā avidyamānā yeṣāṃ tān nivṛttāvidyāsaṃvalanabādhāniti yāvat | tanotu kurutām | atraikavargīyayoreva vyañjanayordvayorghaṭanādidaṃ dvivyañjanacitraṃ pūrvodāharaṇato vailakṣaṇyaśāli || yathāvā dhārādharadhārādharadharādharadharādharādhāraḥ | rādhādharadhārādhā dhīrodhidhuraṃdharo'rādhi || 2256 || dhārādharāṇāṃ jaladharāṇāṃ dhārāḥ jalāsārāḥ tāsāṃ dharaḥ anārataghanāghanavarṣadhārāstimitatayā śītala iti divyaprabandhaprathita iti bhāvaḥ | yaḥ dharādharaḥ śeṣaḥ sa cāsau dharādharo giriḥ sa evādhāro'dhikaraṇaṃ yasya saḥ uktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaśeṣādrinivāsītyarthaḥ | rādhāyāḥ adharasya adhararasasyeti yāvat yāḥ dhārāḥ tāḥ dhayati pibatīti rādhādharadhārādhāḥ ‘dheṭ pāne' asmāt kvip | dhīraḥ 'dhairyeṇa himavāniva' ityuktarītyā dhairyaśālī, dhīrodhināṃ viṣayebhyo niyantritamatīnāṃ yogināmityarthaḥ 'yogaścittavṛttinirodhaḥ' iti hi pātañjalaṃ sūtram | dhuraṃdharaḥ tadrakṣābharasvīkartetyarthaḥ | ‘yogo yogavidāṃ netā' iti hi tannāmasu paṭhyate | yadvā 'vyaktameṣa mahāyogī paramātmā sanātanaḥ' ityādyuktarītyā yogināmīśvara ityarthaḥ | arādhi apūji | asmābhiriti śeṣaḥ | rādheḥ karmaṇi luṅi ciṇ | atrāpi pūrvavadvyañjanadvayenaiva ghaṭanā, pūrvārdhe yamakaviśeṣo'pīti vailakṣaṇyam || yathāvā duraridaradāridaradoruro'rarodāradāra dāridrī | raudrāridurdarodaradaradāradurodarādarādāri || 2357 || duraridaradāridaradoḥ uro'rarodāradāra dāridrī raudrāridurdarodaradaradāradurodarādara adāri | iti chedaḥ | raudraḥ ugraḥ yaḥ ariḥ vairī hiraṇyakaśipuḥ tasya durdaraḥ darītuṃ dalayitumaśakyaḥ yaḥ udaradaraḥ jaṭharaśvabhraṃ 'daro'striyāṃ bhaye śvabhre' ityamaraḥ | tasya dāraḥ dāraṇameva durodaraḥ dyūtaṃ paṇo vā tasmin ādaro yasya saḥ tasmin adaraḥ nirbhayaḥ iti vā | yadvā raudrāridurdarodaradaradāre durodaraḥ dyūtakāraḥ sāhasika iti yāvat | tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | durodaro dyūtakāre paṇe dyūte durodaram' ityamaraḥ'| uraḥ vakṣaḥ araraṃ kavāṭamiva uro'raraṃ tasmin udārāḥ ‘śriyaṃ loke devajuṣṭāmudārām' iti śrutyuktaudāryāḥ dārāḥ yasya tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | kavāṭavistīrṇavakṣassthalaviharamāṇaśrīka ityarthaḥ | duṣṭāḥ arayaḥ śātravāḥ teṣāṃ daraṃ bhayaṃ datta iti duraridaradau aridarau cakraśaṅkhau yayoḥ tathoktau doṣau bāhū yasya tasya saṃbuddhiḥ 'bhujabāhū praveṣṭo doḥ' ityamaraḥ | he śaṅkhacakradhara ! bhagavannityarthaḥ | dāridrī dāridryaṃ brāhmaṇāderākṛtigaṇatvāt ṣyañi ṣittvāt ‘ṣidgaurādibhyaḥ' iti ṅīṣ | adāri | śrīnivāsaṃ tvāmāśrayato mama bhaktiviraktijñānasaṃpadādisarvavidhadurvidhatvaṃ vidīrṇamiti bhāvaḥ | adāri svayameva vyadīryateti vā | dṛṇātervidāraṇārthakātkarmaṇi karmakartari vā luṅi ciṇ || yathāvā gaganaganagānugānāṃ gānānuganāga go'nanānāgaḥ | nānānaganāgānananāganagenānino nu no nanu gāḥ || 2358 || gaganaganaga anugānāṃ gānānuganāga go'nana anāgaḥ nānānaganāgānananāganagena āninaḥ nu naḥ nanu gāḥ iti chedaḥ | anugānāṃ anucarāṇāṃ āśritānāmityarthaḥ | gaganaganaga kalpaśākhin gānānugāḥ svapravartitamuralīgānānusāriṇaḥ nāgāḥ phaṇinaḥ yasya tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | 'śiśurvetti paśurvetti vetti gānarasaṃ phaṇī' ityuktestathoktiḥ | gavāṃ dhenūnāṃ anana prāṇana | anāgaḥ apahatapāpman 'pāpāparādhayorāgaḥ' ityamaraḥ | nanviti sukumārāmantraṇe | nānā bahuvidhāḥ nagā taravaḥ nāgāḥ gajāśca teṣāṃ ananaḥ prāṇayitā yo nāganagaḥ śeṣādriḥ tasya ina svāmin śrīnivāsetyarthaḥ | naḥ asmākaṃ gāḥ stutirūpāḥ vācaḥ āninaḥ 'yo'ntaḥ praviśya mama vācamimāṃ prasuptāṃ saṃjīvayatyakhilaśaktidharassvadhāmnā' ityuktaprakriyayā prāṇayaḥ prāṇitavānityarthaḥ | aniterṇijantālluṅi caṅi madhyamapuruṣaikavacanam | nu ityavadhāraṇe | udāhṛtapadyatraye vibhinnavargīyavyañjanadvayaṃ nibaddhamiti viśeṣaḥ || ekavyañjanacitraṃ yathā nūnaṃ no nānenānenā nenena nonena | nānainonunnānāṃ nānainenānanī na no nanu nauḥ || 2359 || nūnaṃ no na anena anenāḥ nā inena nonena nānainonunnānāṃ nānā enena ananī na naḥ nanu nauḥ iti padacchedaḥ | na ūnaḥ nonaḥ tena nonena | sarvottamenetyarthaḥ | anena inena svāminā bhagavatā hetubhūtena nā kaścidapi pumān avidyamānaṃ enaḥ pāpaṃ yasya saḥ anenāḥ no iti na | kiṃtvanenā eva nūnamityuktārthasyātimātranirdhāraṇe | nānāvidhāni ca tāni enāṃsi pāpāni taiḥ nunnānāṃ kṣiptānāṃ naḥ asmākaṃ enena bhagavatā 'dvitīyā ṭaussvenaḥ' ityanvādeśe enādeśaḥ | nānā vinā ‘pṛthagvinā nānābhiḥ' iti tṛtīyā | ‘pṛthagvinā'ntareṇarte hiruṅnānā ca varjane' ityamaraḥ | ananī prāṇayitrī nauḥ uttaraṇasāmagrīti yāvat | na nanu naiva | nanuravadhāraṇe | yato'munā śrīnivāsena bhagavatā sarvo'pi janaḥ pāpmano mocyate tata enaṃ vinā nānāvidhaduritatiraskṛtānāmasmākaṃ bhavārṇavottārako'nyo naiveti bhāvaḥ | atraikenaiva nakāreṇa padyabandhaḥ || yathāvā līlālolelālīlālīlālīlalo'lilīlālāḥ| lolollolelālaṃlīlālālo lalāla lolālaḥ || 2360 || līlālolelālīlālīlālīlalaḥ līlāsu vilāseṣu lolā āsaktā yā ilā bhūḥ saiva ālī sakhī tāṃ lālayatīti līlālolelālīlālinī | sa cāsau ilānāṃ girāṃ ālī paṅktiḥ 'puṃvatkarmadhāraya' iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ | līlālolelālīlālīlālī | tayā lalatīti lalaḥ 'laḍa vilāse' pacādyac | līlāsaktabhūsakhīlālayitṛvāṇīśreṇīvilāsītyarthaḥ | alilīlālāḥ aleḥ bhramarasya līlā vilāsaḥ tacchāyeti yāvat | tāṃ lāti ādadātīti tathoktaḥ | 'tvannetrayugalaṃ dhatte līlāṃ nīlāmbujanmanoḥ' itivattatsadṛśadyutirityarthaḥ | ‘lā ādāne' ityasmāddhātoḥ kvip | lolollolelālaṃlīlālālaḥ lolāḥ cañcalāḥ ullolāḥ mahātaraṅgāḥ yasyāṃ sā lolollolā ca sā ilā ca lolollolelā | ilā jalaṃ bhūgovācastviḍā ilāḥ' ityamaraḥ | tasyāṃ pralayamahodadhijale iti yāvat | alaṃ līyata ityalaṃlīḥ ‘lī śleṣaṇe' daivādikādasmāt kvip | sā cāsau ilā bhūḥ vedavāṇī vā tasyāḥ lā ādānaṃ ‘laśśakre lā tu dāne syādgrahaṇe'pi nigadyate | lī śleṣaṇe ca capale' iti medinī | tasyāṃ alatītyalaḥ | payārpta ityarthaḥ | 'ala bhūṣaṇaparyāptivāraṇeṣu' iti dhātoḥ pacādyac | mahodadhinimagnāyā bhuvo vedavāco vā samuddhartetyarthaḥ | lalāla vilalāsa | ‘lala vilāse' ityasmālliṭ | lolālaḥ lolā lakṣmīḥ ‘lolassyādvācyaliṅgakaḥ | satṛṣṇe capale lolā jihvākamalayoḥ striyām' iti medinī ‘lolā tu rasanāśriyoḥ' iti hemaśca | tāṃ alati bhūṣayatītyalaḥ uktadhātoreva pacādyac | lolāyāḥ alaḥ lolālaḥ | yadvā lolāṃ lalatīti lolālaḥ karmaṇyaṇ | lolāyāṃ linātīti vā lolālaḥ ‘lī śleṣaṇe' asmāt krayyādikāt 'anyebhyopi dṛśyate' iti ḍaḥ | athavā linātīti lā lolā lā yasmin saḥ lolālaḥ sarvathā'pi śrīvallabha ityevārthaḥ | lalāletyanvayaḥ | atra lakāreṇaikenaiva padyabandha ityapañcavargīyavarṇamekākṣaracitramidam || saptasvaraniyamacitraṃ yathā māmāninīsamāgamanissamagarimā'ridārisārigadam | nigamāpasāridamadaṃ pāpāni mamā''sadāsadhani dhāma || 2361 || mā lakṣmīriti māninī vadhūḥ tasyāssamāgamena nissamaḥ asadṛśaḥ garimā gauravaṃ yasya tattathoktaṃ śrīvallabhatvādevāsyedṛśaṃ mahattvamiti bhāvaḥ | arīn dārayatītyaridāriṇī ariṇā cakreṇa saha vartata iti sāriḥ sā cāsau gadā kaumodakī yasya tattathoktam | nigamasya vedasya apasāriṇaḥ apahartāra madhukaiṭabhādayaḥ teṣāṃ damaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadātīti nigamāpasāridamadam | dhanamasyāstīti dhani dāsairdhani dāsadhani dakāradhakārayorubhayorapi grathanamiti dhyeyam || yathāvā mamaiva raṅgarājavilāse mā mādhā mama dhāmani padamāsa sadā gadāridadha sā sā | pāpā nigadapadaṃ parigada māṃ mā madarimāninīdāsa || 2362 || idaṃ padyaṃ bhagavantaṃ raṅgarājamākheṭakavihārotsavānantaramupāgatamanyavadhūsaṃgatamāśaṅkamānāyā lakṣmyā uktirūpaṃ vīṇayā'nūditam | tathāhi dadhātīti dadhaḥ | gadāriṇoḥ kaumodakīsudarśanayoḥ dadha gadācakradhārinnityarthaḥ | tasya saṃbuddhiḥ | mama dhāmani gṛhe padaṃ mā mādhāḥ mā sma nidadhāḥ roṣasaṃbhramānmā meti dviruktiḥ | āṅpūrvakāddhāño luṅi ‘na māṅyoge' ityaṭpratiṣedhaḥ | kuta īdṛśaḥ kopa ityatrāha āsetyādinā | sā sā pāpā mama sapatnīti bhāvaḥ | asahanāttannāmāgrahaṇam | nigadasya tvadvacasaḥ padaṃ pātraṃ āsa | tatsallāpa eva tava hṛdyaḥ | māṃ mā parigadamayā saha mā saṃbhāṣiṣṭhā iti bhāvaḥ | mā śabdo'yaṃ na tu māṅ | ato na luṅ | tvameva khalu mama preyasīti cāṭubhirayaṃ māmanuneṣyatītyāśaṅkya roṣātibhūmnā saṃbodhayati madarimāninīdāseti | matpratyarthilalanākiṃkaroti tadarthaḥ | atrāpi pūrvavat sarigamapadhanīti saptasvaravarṇā eva nibaddhāḥ || anantarapadyamidaṃ iti kupitayā śriyoktaṃ nirāsavacanaṃ kilānukurvāṇā | vīṇā svarasamudāyairatoṣayadraṅgarājamatiramyaiḥ || 2363 || apunaruktavyañjanacitram vyañjanānāṃ kakhādīnāṃ yatrāvṛttirna dṛśyate | citrametadvijānīyāttadanāvṛttavarṇakam || yathā atha ṛṣabhācalakūṭāpīḍe'tighṛṇājharībāḍhe | ojaḥkhacchāye śaṭha mana ihi go've sadā ṛddhe || atheti maṅgalārthakam | "maṅgalānantarārambhapraśnakārtsnyoṣvatho atha" ityamaraḥ | idamavyayaṃ cādau svarādau ca paṭhyate | tena maṅgalavācakasya sattvārthakatve'pyavyayatvaṃ sidhyati | ataeva śrīharṣaḥ udasya kumbhīratha śātakumbhajāḥ catuṣkacārutviṣi vedikodare | yathākulācāramathāvanīndrajāṃ purandhrivargassnapayāṃbabhūva tām || iti | atra hi atha snapayāṃbabhūvetyasya maṅgalasnapanaṃ cakāretyarthaḥ | nipātastu svarūpeṇaiva maṅgalo mṛdaṅgadhvanivat | na cātra śrīharṣapadye athetyasyānantaryamevārthaḥ kuto na syāditi vācyaṃ, athaśabdayordvayośśravaṇāt | vṛṣādriḥ tasya yat kūṭaṃ śikharaṃ tasya āpīḍe śekharabhūte bhagavatītyarthaḥ | idaṃ viśeṣyam | atiśayitā ca sā ghṛṇā ca atighṛṇā niratiśayakaruṇā | saiva jharī pravāhaḥ tena bāḍhe praśaste ‘bhṛśapraśastayorbāḍham' ityamaraḥ | go've avatītyavaḥ gavāṃ dhenūnāṃ vedavācāṃ vā goḥ bhuvaḥ divaśca vā avaḥ rakṣitā tasmin | sadā ṛddhe samṛddhimati | ojaḥkhacchāye ojasi tejasi viṣaye khaṃ vyoma chāyā pratimā yasya tathokte gaganatalaśyāmale ityarthaḥ ‘chāyā tvanātape kāntau pratibimbārkayoṣitoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | ‘chāyā paṅktau pratimāyām' iti hemacandraśca | śaṭha dhūrta he manaḥ ! ihi gaccha | hārimahākiraṇabhāramaṇi hāram | heyaguṇavisaradūraṃ geyaguṇaṃ cintaye saparivāram || 2366 || kundasumamandahāsaṃ kuvalayadalakomalāvayavabhāsam | kuṇḍalibhūdharavāsaṃ kalaye kamalāvilāsasavikāsam || 2367 || eṣu triṣu padyeṣvapi śabdānāṃ saṃskṛtaprākutabhāṣayostulyarūpateti samasaṃskṛtaprākṛtamidam || <16> atha padmādicitrāṇi padmādyākāramāpannā vaṇāścitramudāhṛtam || nanu kathamasya śabdālaṃkāratā, padmādyākāratāyā rekhoparekhāniṣṭhatvāditi cetsatyam | varṇānumāpakarekhāniṣṭhānāmevākārāṇāmanumeyaniṣṭhatvādhyavasāyādaupacārikīyaṃ śabdālaṃkāratāvācoyuktirityāhuḥ || tatra ṣoḍaśadalapadmam ekaṃ yadi bhavetsarvamekāntaritamakṣaram | tatpadmaṃ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ karṇikāśliṣṭavarṇakam || ekākārameva varṇamekavarṇāntaritaṃ yadi nibadhyate karṇikāyāṃ śliṣṭaṃ ekavarṇaṃ yasya tat ṣoḍaśadalapadmaṃ nāma citraṃ bhavet || yathā tārāgaurākārā śrī rāyo rāti rāddharāssmerā | sā rājārādhyā''rātsphārā'hīrādharākarādhārā || tārā tarakā seva gaurākṛtigauravarṇā | rāddhaḥ siddhaḥ rāḥ bhūvāksurāpsu syāt' ityamaraḥ | 'ākaro nivahotpattisthānaśreṣṭheṣu kathyate' iti medinī | sā prasiddhā śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ ārāt kṣipramiti yāvat | rāyaḥ dhanāni rāti dadāti ‘rā dāne' | ayameva dvicatuṣkabandho gomūtrikā ca bhavati | tallakṣaṇaṃ tu bahirantarmaṇḍalasthaṃ tāvatkoṣṭhavihāri yat | koṇāṣṭakayutaṃ tacca dvicatuṣkaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || tatrāyugmākṣaraiḥ śliṣṭā yadi yugmākṣaraistu vā | gomūtriketi vikhyātimidameva bhajettadā || iti | etaduktaṃ bhavati diṅmukhakoṇakaṃ vidiṅmukhakoṇakaṃ ca dve caturaracakre vyatikṛte vilikhya tasya bahirantaśca maṇḍalarekhāyugaṃ vilikhya tatpratyekamaṣṭakoṣṭhaghaṭitaṃ vidhāya bahirmaṇḍale pūrvārdhasyāśliṣṭākṣarāṇi antarmaṇḍale uttarārdhasyāśliṣṭākṣarāṇi vilikhyārdhadvayasya śliṣṭamakṣarāṣṭakaṃ maṇḍaladvayamadhyāṣṭakoṇeṣu vilikhet | evaṃca dvicatuṣkoṇaviśiṣṭatvāddvicatuṣkasaṃjñā'sya | iyaṃ yugmākṣaraśliṣṭānulomagomūtrikā | atra koṇasparśapūrvako maṇḍalasparśaḥ | evamayugmākṣaraśliṣṭatve'pi gomūtrikā bhaviṣyati | tatra koṇasparśo maṇḍalasparśapūrvaka iti viśeṣo bodhyaḥ || yathāvā vyālādrīlādolālīlālolācalācalābālā | śrīlā'velāmme lātīlāmālāṅkhilākhilāślīlā || 2369 || vyālādreḥ śeṣagireḥ ilāyāṃ dharāyāṃ dolālīlāyāṃ āṃdolanavihāre lolā āsaktā | acalā sthirahṛdayā acalābālā bhūsutā | idaṃ viśeṣyam | śrīlā śrīmatī | sidhmāditvānmatvarthīyo lac | lakṣmīvān lakṣmaṇaśśrīlaḥ' ityamaraḥ | khilāni dhvastāni akhilāni aślīlāni amaṅgalāni yayā sā | avelāṃ maryādātītāṃ ilāmālāṃ vāṇīsrajaṃ mālikāsadṛśīṃ vācamityarthaḥ | me lāti datte | iti yojanā || yathāvā dhāma vyomaśyāmaṅkāmaṅkṣemakramakṣamannāma1| premasthemaśrīmadbhūmakṣmāmaklamannamasyāma || 2370 || vyomeva śyāmaṃ nīlaṃ kāmaṃ paryāptaṃ yathā syāttathā | kṣemasya kuśalasya kramaḥ paripāṭiḥ tasya kṣamaṃ arhaṃ kṣemakaramiti yāvat | premṇaḥ sthemā sthairyaṃ tasya śrīḥ saṃpat tadasyāstīti premasthemaśrīmat | bhūmnaḥ vibhutvasya kṣmāṃ āvāsabhūmiṃ aklamaṃ śramarahitaṃ idamupalakṣaṇamakhilaheyaguṇadavīyastvasya | dhāma tejaḥ śrīnivāsamiti bhāvaḥ | namasyāma praṇamāma | nāmetyabhupagame vismaye smaraṇe vā | yadvā vyomaśyāmaṃ dhāma tejaḥ śrīnivāsaṃ aklamaṃ bhavaklamābhāvāya ‘niṣpratyūhamupāsmahe' ityādāviva arthābhāve'vyayībhāvaḥ ‘nāvyayībhāvādatomtvapañcamyāḥ' iti caturthyā am | kāmaṃ paryāptaṃ yathātathā namasyāma pūjayāmeti yojanā | ‘namovarivaścitraṅaḥ kyac' iti namaśśabdātpūjāyāṃ kyac | tadantāddhātoloḍuttamaikavacanam | ‘nāma kope'bhyupagame vismaye smaraṇe'pica' iti medinī | kṣemakramakṣamandhāmeti pāṭhe'pi na citrabhaṅgaḥ | tadā kṣemakramasya kṣamaṃ paryāptaṃ dhāma sthānaṃ kṣemaṃkarasthānabhūtamityarthaḥ | atra śyāmaṃ kāmamityādau sarvatrānusvārasya ‘vā padāntasya' iti parasavarṇo bodhyaḥ | anyathā vivakṣitacitrabhraṃśāpattiḥ | yadyapi ‘sabindukābindukayossavisargāvisargayoḥ' iti citrādāvabhedakalpanā'bhyupagatā kavibhiḥ | tathā'pi yāvadbuddhibalodayaṃ tādṛśakleśānāśrayaṇameva jyāya iti | dhyeyam | asminpadyadvaye'pi tārāgaureti prāgudāhṛtapadyavadeva padmādibandhā draṣṭavyāḥ || atha gāmūtrikā ekāntaraṃ tu varṇānāmekarūpatvamardhayoḥ | gomūtrikākhyaṃ citraṃ tadāhuścitravido budhāḥ || ardhayoḥ ślokasya yathākramaṃ pūrvottarārdhayoḥ ekāntaraṃ ekākṣaravyavahitaṃ yadekarūpatvaṃ abhinnākāratvaṃ tat gacchato gormūtrākārakatayā ghaṭitatve gomūtrikākhyaṃ citramiti citrakāvyavida āhuḥ | gomūtramiva gomūtrikā | 'ive pratikṛtau' iti kani ṭāpi ‘pratyayasthāt' iti itvam || yathā bhogīśvaraśailakṣitivilāsalolo dadātu naḥ kuśalam | yogīśvarajālastutikulāmalo'sau dadhātu no kuphalam || 2371 || bhogīśvaraśailakṣitau vilāse lolaḥ śrīnivāsa ityarthaḥ | naḥ kuśalaṃ dadātu yogīśvarajālasya stutikulaiḥ stotranivahaiḥ amalaḥ prasanna ityarthaḥ | asau śrīnivāsaḥ kuphalaṃ kutsitaphalaṃ no dadhātu na puṣṇātvityarthaḥ | iyaṃ yugmākṣaraśliṣṭagomūtrikā | uddhārakramastu ṣoḍaśadalapadmanirūpaṇāvasara eva pradarśitaḥ || idameva padyaṃ prāgupadarśitarītyā trivīdhikagomūtrikākāro'pi bhavati | evamuttaratrāpi || yathāvā phaṇiśailaśirodhāmā navajalajavilocanassadā'pāyāt | maṇiloladurodāmā bhavavalanavimocanassa māṃ pāyāt || 2372 || maṇinā taralaratnena lolat calat urodāma vakṣohāro yasya tathoktaḥ saḥ bhagavān māṃ sadā apāyāt pāyāditi yojanā | iyamapi yugmākṣaraśliṣṭagomūtrikaiva | atrāpi prāgupadarśitarītyā bandhalekhanaprakāraḥ || yathāvā mādhava dūre vacasāṃ caritaṃ tava pāpahāri dalitabhavam | māmava śaure'nucaraṃ calitaṃ bhavatāpato'rikalitabhayam || 2373 || bhavatāpataḥ saṃsāratāpena calitaṃ anavasthitacittaṃ aribhiḥ kāmādibhiḥ kalitaṃ bhayaṃ yasya taṃ ariṣaḍvargatrastamityarthaḥ | anucaraṃ tava kiṃkaraṃ "kuruṣva māmanucaram" ityetadanena jñāpyate | māṃ ava rakṣa | iyamayugmākṣaraśliṣṭagomūtrikā || uddhārastu yathāvā manasijasamānarūpe hṛdayaṃ lagatādaśeṣajagatīśe | mahasi lasamānacāpe sadaye laghu tādṛśe'rijayatīvre || 2374 || arijayaviṣaye tīvre tīkṣṇe manasijasamānarūpe ānayatītyānaṃ jagadujjīvayitṛ rūpaṃ manasijasamaṃ ānarūpaṃ yasya tasminniti vigrahaḥ | yadvā mānyata iti mānaṃ 'akartari ca kārake' iti karmaṇi ghañ tādṛśaṃ ca tat rūpaṃ ca tena saha vartata iti samānarūpaṃ | manasija iva samānarūpamiti vigrahaḥ tasmin kandarpatulyamānanīyarūpa ityarthaḥ | na tu samānaṃ rūpaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ | tathā sati 'jyotirjanapada' ityādinā samānaśabdasya sabhāvāpatteḥ | yadvā samānaśabdātpraśaṃsāyāṃ rūpappratyayaḥ praśastaṃ samānaṃ samānarūpamiti vigrahaḥ | manasijasya praśaste samāne ityarthaḥ | tattulyasaundarye iti bhāvaḥ | lasamānaṃ lasanaśīlaṃ cāpaṃ yasya tasmin | lasateścānaś | 'lasamānanavāṃśukaḥ iti māghaḥ | laghu kṣipraṃ hṛdayaṃ lagatāditi yojanā | idamapi padyaṃ ayugmākṣaraśliṣṭagomūtrikārūpam ||

|| upamā udbhūtā bhāti sāmyaśrīrubhayoryatra sopamā | vākyārthopaskārakaṃ yatsādṛśyaṃ cāru sopamā || pūrṇā luptetyalaṅkāratattvajñaissā dvidhoditā | upamānaṃ copameyaṃ dharmo vācakamityadaḥ || catuṣṭayamupāttaṃ cetsā hi pūrṇopamā matā | varṇyopamānayorddharmopamāvācakayorapi || ekadvitryanupādāne bhavelluptopamā'ṣṭadhā | vācakasyātra dharmasya dharmavācakayostathā || varṇyavācakayorlope tattalluptāḥ khalūpamāḥ | upamānasya lope tu talluptā pañcamī smṛtā || proktā ṣaṣṭhī vācakopamānalupteti kovidaiḥ | dharmopamānaluptā'nyā lope dharmopamānayoḥ || aṣṭamī dharmopamānavācakānāṃ vilopane ca tredhā te dve syātāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || yathevavādiśabdānāṃ sākṣātsādṛśyavācinām | upādāne bhavecchrautītyāhuśśāstravicakṣaṇāḥ || ye dharmivyavadhānena sādṛśyapratipādakāḥ | sadṛṅnibhādiśabdānāṃ caturvidhā || dharmavācakayorlope tathā dharmopamānayoḥ | varṇyavācakayostadvadvācakāvarṇyayorapi || triluptā tvekadhā dharmavācakāvarṇyalopataḥ | krameṇa dharmaluptādervibhāgo'tha pradarśyate ||
