taddvidhā'bhedatādrūpyāvasitaṃ viduḥ || ārope satyabhedasyābhedarūpakamucyate | tādrūpyarūpakaṃ tatsyāttādrūpyasya sa cedbhavet || taddvayaṃ ca tridhā''dhikyanyūnatvānubhayoktibhiḥ | pūrvāvasthāta āropyamāṇasyādhikyavarṇanam || varṇyāyāṃ cedavasthāyāmadhikābhedarūpakam | nyūnatā prāgavasthātaścennyūnābhedarūpakam || ādhikyanyūnatābhāve'nubhayābhedarūpakam | tādrūpyarūpake'pyevaṃ traividhyaṃ sadbhirūhyatām || prācāṃ mate vibhāgo'pi rūpakasya nirūpyate | tridhā sāṅgaṃ niraṅgaṃ ca paramparitamityadaḥ || samastavastuviṣayamekadeśavivarti ca | iti sāvayavaṃ cāpi dvividhaṃ tatra rūpakam || yatparasparasāpekṣaniṣpattīnāṃ nibadhyate | rūpakāṇāṃ tu saṃghāto bhavetsāvayavaṃ hi tat || nirūpaṇe'vayavino'vayavānāṃ ca śabdataḥ | samastavastuviṣayaṃ bhavetsāvayavaṃ hi tat || āropyamāṇaṃ śābdaṃ cetkvacidārthaṃ ca kutracit | ekadeśavivartyākhyamidaṃ sāvayavaṃ viduḥ || niraṅgaṃ tadviduryatsyādaṅgimātrasya rūpaṇam | taddvidhā kevalaṃ mālārūpaṃ ceti satāṃ matam || ekaṃ viṣayi yadyanyaviṣayyanvitamucyate | kāryakāraṇabhāvena syātparamparitaṃ tadā || śliṣṭāśliṣṭavibhedana tatparamparitaṃ dvidhā | kevalaṃ mālikā ceti taddvayaṃ dvividhaṃ bhavet || evamaṣṭavidhaṃ prācāṃ mate rūpakamiṣyate | pariṇāmaḥ viṣayī svātmanā yatra prakṛtānupayogataḥ | viṣayātmatvamabhyeti pariṇāmassa īritaḥ || ullekhaḥ grahītṛbhiranaikairyadekasyānekadhā grahaḥ | rucyādikāraṇavaśāt tamullekhaṃ pracakṣate || ekasya viṣayādīnāmanekatvanibandham | naikadhātvaṃ grahītraikye'pyullekhasso'pi saṃmataḥ || smṛtiḥ yā sādṛśyaparijñānodbuddhasaṃskāratassmṛtiḥ | prayojyā sā smṛtirnāmālaṅkṛtiḥ kathyate budhaiḥ || bhrāntiḥ camatkṛtimatī bhrāntiryasmin sādṛśyahetukā | anūditā syātsandarbhe tamāhurbhrāntimāniti || sandehaḥ sambhāvanāniścayānyatarabhinnā manoramā | sādṛśyahetukā buddhiḥsandehālaṅkṛtirmatā || apahnutiḥ āhāryābhedabuddheścenniṣedho'ṅgyaṅgameva vā || etāṃ sāmānyataḥ prāhurapahnutimalaṅkṛtim || anyāropaphalo yassyātprakṛte dharmanihnavaḥ | alaṅkṛtiriyaṃ śuddhāpahnutirnāma gadyate || sa evāpahnavo yuktipūrvaśceddhetvapahnutiḥ | paryastāpahnutiryatra kvacittaddharmanihnavaḥ || varṇanīye tadāropaphalako varṇyate yadi | bhrānternivāraṇe'nyasya śaṅkāyāṃ bhrāntyapahnutiḥ || anyasya śaṅkayā chekāpahṇutistathyanihnutau | chalacchadmanibhādyaiśca vapurātmādikaiḥ padaiḥ | nihnutiścedabhivyaṅgyā kaitavāpahnutirhi sā || utprekṣā yadanyadharmasaṃbandhādanyasyānyatvatarkaṇam | sotprekṣoktā tridhaiṣā syādvastuhetuphalātmanā || uktānuktāspadatvena vastūtprekṣā dvidhā matā | hetūtprekṣāphalotprekṣe siddhāsiddhāspadatvataḥ || atiśayoktiḥ nigīrya viṣayaṃ yatra viṣayyevādhyavasyate | rūpakātiśayoktiṃ tāmalaṅkāravido viduḥ || uktā sāpahnavā saiva yadyapahnutigarbhitā | bhedakātiśayoktiryatprastutasyānyatocyate || asaṃbandhe'pi saṃbandho varṇyotkṛṣṭyai yadīryate | saṃbandhātiśayoktiṃ tāmalaṅkāravido jaguḥ || yoge'pyayogo'saṃbandhātiśayoktirudīryate | hetukāryasahatve syātseyamakramapūrvikā || hetuprasaktimātreṇa kāryaṃ cedvinibadhyate | capalātiśayoktissā nipuṇairvinigadyate || hetoḥ kāryasya ca syāccetpaurvāparyaviparyayaḥ | atyantātiśayoktiṃ tāmāhuḥ kāvyavicakṣaṇāḥ || tulyayogitā varṇyānāmeva vā'nyeṣāmeva vā dharma ekakaḥ | anvito varṇyate yatra tatra syāttulyayogitā || hite'hite ca yadvṛttestaulyaṃ sā tvaparā matā | yadutkṛṣṭaguṇaissāmyavacanaṃ sā'parā matā || dīpakam taddīpakaṃ syādyadvarṇyāvarṇyayorekadharmatā || āvṛttidīpakam samastayorvyastayorvā''vṛttau padatadarthayoḥ | āvṛttidīpakaṃ prāhustrividhaṃ budhasattamāḥ || prativastūpamā sādṛśyāvasite vākyadvaye ceddharma ekakaḥ | dvirupātto bhavetsā tu prativastūpamocyate || dṛṣṭāntaḥ bimbatvapratibimbatvāpannadharmādikaṃ dvayoḥ | vākyārthayoścedaupamyamārthaṃ dṛṣṭānta īryate || nidarśanā upāttayorarthayoścedārthābhedaḥ prakīrtyate | aupamyaparyavasito bhavetseyaṃ nidarśanā || padārthapūrvā sā'nyā syādupamānopameyayoḥ | yatrānyataradharmasyānyatrāropaṇamucyate || sadasadbodhanaṃ syāccetkriyayā'nyā nidarśanā || vyatirekaḥ uktaḥ kaścidviśeṣaścedupadupamānopameyayoḥ | tamāhurvyatirekākhyamalaṃkāraṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ || upameyasyopamānādyadā guṇaviśeṣataḥ | utkarṣo varṇyate prāhurvyatirekaṃ tadā budhāḥ || sahoktiḥ guṇapradhānatābhājorarthayorubhayoryadā | varṇyassahārthasaṃbandhassahoktiṃ tāṃ tadā viduḥ || vinoktiḥ kiṃcidvinā prastutasya ramyatā'ramyatā'pi vā | nibadhyate yadi tadā sā vinoktiralaṃkṛtiḥ || samāsoktiḥ sāmyādbhedakamātrasya gamyamaprastutaṃ yadi | samāsoktimimāṃ prāhuḥ prāñco'laṃkāravedinaḥ || parikaraḥ sābhiprāye parikaro'laṃkārassyādviśeṣaṇe | parikarāṅkuraḥ viśeṣyaṃ yadi sākūtaṃ bhavetparikarāṅkuṃraḥ || śleṣaḥ varṇyāvarṇyobhayālambī śleṣo'nekārthasaṃśrayaḥ | ādyo'ṣṭadhā varṇapadaliṅgabhāṣāvibhaktibhiḥ || prakṛtipratyayābhyāṃ ca vacanaiśśleṣa īritaḥ | vibhaktyādivaśādyatra nānāvarṇaikarūpatā || śrūyate sa hi vidvadbhirvarṇaśleṣa itīryate | padaśleṣassa yaśśleṣaḥ padabhedanibandhanaḥ || liṅgaśleṣassa vijñeyo hṛsvadīrghasamāsataḥ | strīpuṃnapuṃsakānāṃ cecchabdānāṃ tulyarūpatā || bhāṣāśleṣastu bhinnārthanānābhāṣaikyato bhavet | supāṃ tiṅāṃ ca śleṣaścedvibhaktiśleṣa īritaḥ || aśliṣṭamatyayakṛtā prakṛtyoścetsarūpatā | sa eṣa prakṛtiśleṣo dvidhā suptiṅapekṣayā || prakṛtipratyayaughasyānekasya pratyayairyadi | śliṣṭaissarūpatā so'yaṃ pratyayaśleṣa ucyate || sa bhavedvacanaśleṣaśśliṣyanti vacanāni cet || aprastutapraśaṃsā syātprastutasya gamakaṃ yatrāprastutavarṇanam | aprastutapraśaṃsākhyā saiṣā'laṃkṛtirucyate || kārye hetau tathā vyāpye vyāpake prastute'nyagīḥ | same samasya cetyevaṃ saiṣā bhavati pañcadhā || prastutāṅkuraḥ prastutasya prastutena vyañjane prastutāṅkuraḥ || paryāyoktam paryāyoktaṃ tvanyabhaṅgyā kathitaṃ cedvivakṣitam | vyājena ramaṇīyena yadi svasya parasya vā || sādhyate'bhīpsitaṃ tacca paryāyoktaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || vyājastutiḥ stutyā'bhivyajyate nindā nindayā vā stutiryadi | tatra vyājastutiṃ nāma prājñāḥ prāhuralaṃkṛtim || stutyā nindā nindayā vā stutirbhinnaikagocarā | vyaṅgyā vibhinnaviṣayā stutyā vyājastutisstutiḥ || vyājanindā vyājanindā tu nindāyā nindayā vyaṅgyatā yadi || ākṣepaḥ sa ākṣepo bhavetsvoktiniṣedho yo vimarśataḥ | niṣedho yo bādhitassan viśeṣaṃ kaṃcidākṣipet || vakṣyamāṇoktaviṣayaṃ tamākṣepaṃ pare jaguḥ | niṣedhābhāsavadvidhyābhāso'pyākṣepa iṣyate || virodhaḥ sa virodho'virodhe'pi virodhābhāsatā yadi | jātyādīnāṃ svasvaparasaṃbandhāddaśadhā bhavet || vibhāvanā kāraṇavyatireke'pi kāryotpattirvibhāvanā | kāraṇānāmasāmagrye kāryajanma ca sā matā || tṛtīyā pratibandhe'pi kāryotpattirvibhāvanā | vibhāvanā caturthī syātkāryotpattirakāraṇāt || kāryotpattirviruddhāccetpañcamī sā vibhāvanā | kāraṇasyodbhavaḥ kāryādyadi ṣaṣṭhī vibhāvanā || viśeṣoktiḥ viśeṣoktiḥ puṣkale'pi hetau kāryaṃ na cedbhavet || asaṃbhavaḥ asaṃbhāvyatvakathanamarthāsiddherasaṃbhavaḥ || asaṃgatiḥ bhinnādhikaraṇatvaṃ yadviruddhaṃ hetukāryayoḥ | varṇyate tamalaṃkāraṃ prājñāḥ prāddurasaṃgatim || kāryamanyatra yattasya tatonyatra kriyāpi sā | kartumanyatpravṛttasya tadviruddhakriyā ca sā || viṣamam anānurūpyabhājoryaddhaṭanaṃ viṣamaṃ hi tat | vilakṣaṇasya kāryasyotpattiṃ ca viṣamaṃ viduḥ | iṣṭārthodyogato'niṣṭāvāptiśca viṣamaṃ matam || samam yatrānurūpaghaṭanaṃ varṇyate tatsamaṃ viduḥ | samaṃ tadapi kāryasya sārūpyaṃ kāraṇena yat || yatkiñcidiṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ ya udyogo vitanyate | aniṣṭena vinā tasya siddhiśca samamucyate || vicitram iṣṭaiṣiṇeṣṭasiddhyai tadviparītaṃ kriyeta cet | prayatnastāmimāṃ prāhurvicitrālaṃkṛtiṃ budhāḥ || adhikam ādheyādhikyakathanamādhārānmahato'dhikam | ādhārādhikyakathanamādheyādvipulācca tat || alpam ādhārasaukṣmyamādheyātsūkṣmādalpaṃ taducyate | sūkṣmādādhāratassaukṣmyamādheyasya ca tadbhavet || anyonyam viśeṣādhānamanyonyamanyonyālaṃkṛtiṃ viduḥ | viśeṣaḥ viśeṣassyādvinā''dhārādādheyaṃ varṇyate yadi || yatraikameva yugapadanekādhārasaṃśrayam | ādheyaṃ varṇyate sopi viśeṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || kiṃcitkāryārambhamātrādanyatkāryaṃ suduṣkaram | kṛtaṃ nibadhyate yatra viśeṣassopi saṃmataḥ || vyāghātaḥ tatkāryasādhanaṃ vastu tadviruddhasya sādhanam | kriyate cettadā khyāto vyāghāto'sāvalaṃkṛtiḥ || parābhimatakāryasya viruddhā kenacit kriyā | saukaryato nibaddhā cedvyāghātassopi kathyate || yadyuttarottarasya syātpūrvapūrvānubandhitā | artheṣu paṅktibaddheṣu vyatyayo vā'pi śṛṅkhalā || kāraṇamālā pūrvapūrvairvastubhissyāduttarottarakāraṇaiḥ | gumbhaḥ kāraṇamālaiṣā vaiparītye'pi ceṣyate || ekāvalī uttarasyottarasya syātpūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇam | viśeṣyaṃ vā yadā prāhurimāmekāvalīṃ tadā || mālādīpakam mālādīpakametatsyāddīpakaikāvalīyuteḥ | sāraḥ saivottarottarotkarṣe sāra ityucyate budhaiḥ | yathāsaṃkhyam uddeśakramato'rthānāṃ saṃbandho yatra kathyate | prāñcastatra yathāsaṃkhyamapare kramamūcire || paryāyaḥ ādheyasya kramādekasyānekādhārasaṃśrayaḥ | varṇyate yatra tatroktā paryāyo'yamalaṃkṛtiḥ || kramādādhāra ekasminnādheyānekatā'pi saḥ || parivṛttiḥ nimayaḥ parivṛttissyādarthānāṃ syātsamāsamaiḥ | parisaṃkhyā ekasyānekasaṃprāptau yadekatra niyantraṇam | parisaṃkhyeti tat prāhuralaṃkārādhvayāyinaḥ || vikalpaḥ vikalpaḥ pākṣikaprāptirvarṇyate cedviruddhayoḥ | samuccayaḥ yaugapadyātpadārthānāmanvayassyātsamuccayaḥ | kārakadīpakam kramikāṇāṃ kriyāṇāṃ cedekakārakagāminām | gumbhanaṃ kriyate tattu bhavetkārakadīpakam || samādhiḥ kāraṇāntarasānnidhyavaśātkāryasya kasyacit | saukaryaṃ varṇyate yatra samādhistatra gīyate || pratyanīkam balini pratipakṣe vā tatpakṣe vā tiraskṛtiḥ | tatpratidvandvisāhyaṃ vā pratyanīkamitīryate || kāvyārthāpattiḥ daṇḍāpūpikayā yatrārthāntarāpatanaṃ bhavet | kāvyārthāpattireṣā syādalaṃkāravidāṃ matā || arthena kenacittulyanyāyādarthāntarasya cet | āpattiḥ kathyate saiṣā kāvyārthāpattirucyate || kāvyaliṅgam yatsāmānyaviśeṣatvānālīḍhaṃ syātsamarthanam | samarthanīyasyārthasya kāvyaliṅgaṃ taducyate || arthāntaranyāsaḥ samarthanaṃ viśeṣasya sāmānyenāsya tena vā | āhurarthāntaranyāsaṃ sādharmyeṇetareṇa vā || vikasvaraḥ sāmānyena viśeṣasya kriyate yatsamarthanam | punastasya viśeṣeṇa sa vikasvara īryate || prauḍhoktiḥ yadutkarṣānimittasya tannimittatvakalpanam | prauḍhoktireṣā kathitā jayadevamukhairbudhaiḥ || sambhāvanā sambhāvanaṃ syādyadyevaṃ syādityūho'nyasiddhaye || mithyādhyavasitiḥ mithyārtho'nyaḥ kalpyate cetkiñcinmithyātvasiddhaye | mithyādhyavasitirnāma sālaṃkṛtirudāhṛtā || lalitam dharmiṇi prastute varṇyavṛttāntollekhanaṃ vinā | tatra tatpratibimbasya varṇanaṃ lalitaṃ matam || praharṣaṇam vinā yatnādabhīṣṭārthasiddhissyāccetpraharṣaṇam | abhīpsitārthādadhikalābhaścāpi praharṣaṇam || upāyasiddhaye yatne kriyamāṇe yadṛcchayā | sākṣātphalasya lābho'pi praharṣaṇamitīritam || viṣādanam yadabhīṣṭaviruddhārthalābhastatsyādviṣādanam | ullāsaḥ yadanyaguṇadoṣābhyāmanyasya guṇadoṣayoḥ | ādhānaṃ varṇyate prāhurullāsālaṃkṛtiṃ tu tām || avajñā na syātāṃ yadi te tābhyāṃ sā'vajñālaṃkṛtirbhavet | anujñā anujñā sā guṇautsukyāddoṣasyābhyarthanā yadi | tiraskṛtiḥ guṇasya doṣasaṃbandhāddoṣaścetsā tiraskṛtiḥ | leśaḥ guṇo doṣatayā doṣo guṇatvenāthavā yadi | varṇyate tamalaṃkāraṃ leśamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || mudrā prakṛtārthaparaiśśabdairmudrā sūcyārthasūcanam | ratnāvalī prasiddhasahapāṭhānāmarthānāṃ nyasanaṃ yadi | ratnāvalī sā vikhyātā sakramākramatābhidā || tadguṇaḥ svaguṇasya parityāgāttadbhaṇo'nyaguṇagrahaḥ | pūrvarūpam svaguṇasya punaḥ prāptiḥ pūrvarūpamitīryate || yattu syādvikṛte'pyarthe pūrvāvasthānuvartanam | pūrvarūpaṃ tamapyāhuralaṃkṛtiviśāradāḥ || atadguṇaḥ atadguṇaṃ saṅgatānyaguṇānaṅgīkṛtiṃ viduḥ | anuguṇaḥ svasajātīyaguṇavadanyasānnidhyato yadi | utkarṣaḥ pūrvasiddhasya guṇasyānuguṇaṃ hi tat || mīlitam na dṛśyate bheda eva sādṛśyādyadi mīlitam | vastutulyena liṅgena nijenāgantukena vā || pidhīyate vastunā cenmīlitaṃ tadudāhṛtam || sāmānyam na gṛhyate viśeṣaścetsāmyātsāmānyamīritam | guṇataulyavivakṣātaḥ parasya prastutena yat || aikātmyamucyate yogātsāmānyaṃ tadudīritam || unmīlitam sphūrtau samānaguṇayorbhedasyonmīlitaṃ viduḥ | viśeṣakam dvayorvaidharmyasaṃsphūrttau tulyayossyādviśeṣakaḥ | uttaram unnatipraśnamathavā nibaddhapraśnamuttarat | sākūtamucyate yatra tatrottaramudīritam || citrottaramalaṃkāraḥ prannābhinnottaraṃ bhavet | yaccottarāntarābhinnamuttaraṃ tadapīṣyate || citrapraśnaḥ praśnaḥ praśnāntarābhinno yadi vānyārthagarbhitaḥ | nibadhyate taṃ katiciccitrapraśnākhyamucire || sūkṣmam anyāśayajñasākūtaceṣṭitaṃ sūkṣmamīryate | pahitam paravṛttajñasākūtaceṣṭitaṃ pihitaṃ matam || vyājoktiḥ hetvantaroktyā vyājoktiryadākārasya gūhanam | gūḍhoktiḥ gūḍhoktiritaroddeśyamanyaṃ pratyucyate yadi || vivṛtoktiḥ vivṛtoktiśśleṣagūḍhaṃ vivṛtaṃ kavinā yadi | yuktiḥ yuktissyānmarmaṇo guptyai kriyayā paravañcanam || lokoktiḥ lokoktissyādasau lokapravādānukṛtiryadi | chekoktiḥ syāccellokoktiranyārthagarbhā chekoktiriṣyate || vakrektiḥ anyābhiprāyakānyoktamanyathā'nyena yojyate | śleṣeṇa yadi kākvā vā sā vakroktiritīryate || svabhāvoktiḥ jātyādisthasvabhāvoktissvabhāvoktiritīryate | bhāvikam varṇanādadbhutārthasya vastunī bhūtabhāvinī || pratyakṣe iva dṛśyete yatra tadbhāvikaṃ matam | udāttam tadudāttaṃ vastu yatra varṇyate susamṛddhimat | anyopalakṣakaṃ ślāghyacaritraṃ vā nibadhyate || atyuktiḥ adbhutātathyaśauryādivarṇanā'tyuktiriṣyate | niruktiḥ sā niruktiryogato yannāmno'rthāntarakalpanam || pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ pratītasya pratiṣedhasya varṇanam || vidhiḥ sā vidhyalakṛtayatra siddhameva vidhīyate || hetuḥ sākaṃ hetumatā heturuktaśceddheturīritaḥ | keciddhetumato hetoścaikyaṃ hetuṃ budhā jaguḥ || itthaṃ yathāmati prācāmarvācāṃ ca matānyalam | pravicārya śataṃ sāgramalaṅkārā nirūpitāḥ || rasabhāvatadābhāsabhāvaśantinibandhanāḥ | rasavatpreyaūrjasvisamāhitamiti śrutāḥ || aparāṅgavyaṅgyabhedā ye proktāḥ prāktanairbudhaiḥ | alaṃkāratvamāpannāścatvāraste'tisundarāḥ || bhāvasya codayassandhiśśabalatvamiti trayaḥ | evaṃ saptāpyalaṃkārā nirūpyante'pare'dhunā || rasavān rase rasāṅge bhāvāṅge'pyeṣvāhū rasavadbudhāḥ | preyaḥ yadi bhāvarasāṅgatvaṃ bhāvasya preya iṣyate || ūrjasvī bhāvāṅgatāṃ rasābhāso bhāvābhāso'thavā'śnute | yadā tadeyamūrjasvināmā'laṃkṛtirucyate || samāhitam samāhitaṃ bhāvaśānterbhāvāṅgatve tvalaṃkṛtiḥ | bhāvodayaḥ bhāvodayasya bhāvāṅgabhāve bhāvodayo mataḥ || bhāvasandhiḥ bhāvāṅgatve bhāvasandherbhāvasandhiralaṃkṛtiḥ | bhāvaśabalatā bhāvāṅge bhābaśābalye bhāvaśābalyamucyate || pratyakṣādipramāṇānāṃ syāccamatkāritā yadi | tadā pramāṇālaṅkārānaṣṭau prāhuḥ pare budhāḥ || pratyakṣam arthānāmindriyāṇāṃ ca sannikarṣeṇa yadbhavet | jñānaṃ tadāhuḥ pratyakṣaṃ cāru cettadalaṃkṛtiḥ || anumānam anumānaṃ liṅgajanyaliṅgijñānamudāhṛtam | upamānam saṃjñāyāssaṃjñinaścāpi saṃbandhapratyayo hi yaḥ | sādṛśyajñānakaraṇa upamānaṃ taducyate || śabdapramāṇam sa śabdo yattu śabdasya pramāṇatvena kīrtanam | śrutismṛtītihāsādirūpaḥ śabda itīryate || arthāpattiḥ anyathā'nupapattyā yatkiñcidarthasya kalpyate | arthāntaraṃ tāṃ kathayantyarthāpattiṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ || anupalabdhiḥ yadyogyānupalabdhessyādabhāvasyāvadhāraṇam | kṛtino'nupalabdhiṃ tāṃ ramyāṃ viduralaṃkṛtim || saṃbhavaḥ sambhavo'dhikasadbhāvānnyūnasthityavadhāraṇam | aitihyam yatretihocurityādyamanirdiṣṭapravaktṛkam | pāramparyaṃ pravādasya tatraitihyamalaṃkṛtiḥ || saṃsṛṣṭiḥ alaṃkṛtīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ yathāsaṃbhavamelane | laukikānāmivaitāsāṃ cārutāśiyekṣaṇāt || narasiṃhaprakriyayā bhātyalaṃkāratā pṛthak | atastannirṇayaṃ prācāṃ matenātrābhidadhmahe || tilataṇḍulasasaṃrgarītyā yatretaretaram | saṃsṛjyerannalaṃkārāssā saṃsṛṣṭiritīryate || śabdālaṃkārayorarthālaṃkṛtyośca parasparam | ubhayorapi saṃsṛṣṭiriti sā trividhā matā || saṅkaraḥ yatrānyonyamalaṃkārāḥ kṣīranīranayādamī | saṃkīryeran saṃkaro'yamiti kāvyavido viduḥ || so'yamaṅgāṅgibhāvena samaprādhānyatastathā | saṃdehena tathā caikavācakānupraveśataḥ || caturdhā saṅkaraḥ proktaśśrīmadappayadīkṣitaiḥ | evaṃ nṛsiṃhākṛtayaḥ pañcālaṃkṛtayo matāḥ || aṅgāṅgibhāvasaṅkaraḥ apradhānālaṃkriyayā pradhānālaṃkriyā yadi | ujjīvyeta tadā'ṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃṅkara iṣyate || samaprādhānyasaṃkaraḥ anyālaṃkāragarbhaivonnahyate kā'pyalaṃkṛtiḥ | anyayā tulyakālaṃ cetsamaprādhānyasaṅkaraḥ || aikakālikatābhāve'pyalaṃkāradvayaṃ yadi | ekenonnahyate sopi samaprādhānyasaṃkaraḥ || saṃdehasaṃkaraḥ sādhakaṃ bādhakaṃ vā'pi yatrānyatarasaṅgrahe | pramāṇaṃ naiva dṛśyeta syātsa saṃdehasaṃkaraḥ || ekavācakānupraveśasaṅkaraḥ abhinnapadabodhyāssyurnānālaṃkṛtayo yadi | tadaikavācakānupraveśasaṃkara iṣyate || arthayośśabdayośśabdārthayorvā'pyekavācake | anupraveśatasso'yaṃ trividhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || śabdālaṅkāraḥ itthamarthālaṃkṛtayo yathāmati nirūpitāḥ | nirūpyante'tha diṅmātraṃ śabdālaṃkṛtayaḥ kramāt || sāmyaṃ vyañjanamātrasya varṇānuprāsa īritaḥ | dvidhā bhavedayaṃ chekavṛttyanuprāsabhedataḥ || chekānuprāsaḥ chekānuprāsamāhuryatsāmyaṃ vyañjanayossakṛt | dvayordvayorvyañjanayoryugmayoryā nirantarā | āvṛttiḥ kriyate soyaṃ chekānuprāsa īryate || vṛttyanuprāsaḥ ullaṅghya saṅkhyāniyamaṃ paunaruktyaṃ bhavedyadi | ekadvitryādivarṇānāṃ vṛttyanuprāsamūcire || lāṭānuprāsaḥ tātparyamātrabhinnā yā śabdārthapunaruktatā | so'yaṃ śābdaḥ kāvyavidbhirlāṭānuprāsa īryate || vākyāvṛttau padavṛttau nāmāvṛttau ca tattridhā | samāsaikye taddhitāyāṃ syātsamāsāsamāsayoḥ || nāmāvṛttau punastredhā lāṭānuprāsa īritaḥ | pañcaprakāra evaṃ ca lāṭānuprāsa īritaḥ || yamakam anarthakā vā bhinnārthāssārthakānarthakāśca vā | kramādāvartitā varṇā yadi tadyamakaṃ bhavet || ślokārdhapādatadbhāgāvṛttyā syāttaccaturvidham | āvṛttāvādyapādāderdvitīyādau bhidā nava || dvidhā vibhāge pādānāṃ prathamādyādimā yadi | dvitīyādyādibhāgeṣu yamyante syurbhidā daśa || prathamādyantimā bhāgā dvitīyādyantimāṃśagāḥ | bhaveyuścettadā'pi syurevameva bhidā daśa || evaṃ dvidhā vibhāge tu bhedānāṃ viṃśatirbhavet | tridhā pādavibhāge tu triṃśadityūhyatāṃ kramāt || evamantyādikādyāntamadhyādīnyādimadhyagam | antyamadhyaṃ ca madhyāntyameteṣāṃ ca samuccayāḥ || ekaikapāde niyatā niyatakramaśālinaḥ | yamyante cedādimadhyāntabhāgāstadbhidāśśatam || punaruktavadābhāsaḥ punaruktavadābhāti yatrārtho na tu vastutaḥ | punaruktavadābhāsassa nāmākhyātagocaraḥ || śabdaikaniṣṭhaśśabdārthadvayasthaścetyasau dvidhā | sabhaṅgābhaṅgabhedena dvidhā śabdaikasaṃśrayaḥ || apaśabdavadābhāsaḥ nivartate sādhubhāvajñānādyatrāpaśabdadhīḥ | apaśabdavadābhāsassolaṃkāro nigadyate || avyayābhāsaḥ padānāṃ suptiṅantānāmanyārthānāṃ nigumbhane | yathā'vyayavadābhāsaścitraṃ tannāma tadviduḥ || tiṅantavadābhāsaḥ yatrābhāsastiṅantānāṃ syādarthāntaragaiḥ padaiḥ| tattiṅntavadābhāsacitraṃ citrajñasaṃmatam || gūḍhapādacitram anyapādagatā varṇā gūḍhāḥ pādāntareṣu cet | citraṃ tat gūḍhapādākhyaṃ caturthādyādigūhanāt || kriyāvañcanacitram kriyādikaṃ vidyamānamapi sandarbhakauśalāt | spaṣṭaṃ na dṛśyate cettatkriyādervañcanaṃ viduḥ || saptavibhaktivañcanacitram yatraikasyaiva śabdaśya guptāssapta vibhaktayaḥ | tatra saptavibhaktīnāṃ vañcanaṃ citramucyate || svarasthānavyañjanādiniyamacitram svarasthānavyañjanānāṃ niyamo duṣkaro hi yaḥ | proktaścatuḥprabhṛtyeṣa darśyate sukaraḥ paraḥ || apunaruktavyañjanacitram vyañjanānāṃ kakhādīnāṃ yatrāvṛttirna dṛśyate | citrametadvijānīyāttadanāvṛttavarṇakam || padmādicitrāṇi padmādyākāramāpannā varṇāścitramudāhṛtam || ṣoḍaśadalapadmam ekaṃ yadi bhavetsarvamekāntaritamakṣaram | tatpadmaṃ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ karṇikāśliṣṭavarṇakam || dvicatuṣkam bahirantarmaṇḍalasthaṃ tāvatkoṣṭhavihāri yat || koṇāṣṭakayutaṃ tacca dvicatuṣkaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || gomūtrikā tatrāyugmākṣaraiśśliṣṭā yadi yugmākṣaraistu vā | gomūtriketi vikhyātimidameva bhajettadā || ekāntaraṃ tu varṇānāmekarūpatvamardhayoḥ | gomūtrikākhyaṃ citraṃ tadāhuścitravido budhāḥ || gavākṣabandhaḥ uparyupari koṣṭhāni bhaveyurnava madhyataḥ | tiryakkoṣṭhānyapi tathā bhaveyurmadhyato nava || ubhayoranayoḥ pārśvadvaye koṣṭhānyanakramāt | sapta pañca tathā trīṇi niṣpadyeranyathā tathā || tulyapramāṇā vilikhettiryagūrdhvaṃ ca rekhikāḥ | madhyavīthīśiraḥkoṣṭhādārabhya vilikhedbudhaḥ || ekaṃ trīnpañca saptātha nava sapta ca pañca ca | trīnekaṃ ceti padyasya varṇāṃstiryaganukramāt || ūrdhvamadhyamavīdhīsthavarṇaiḥ pramilitaiḥ kramāt | svoddeśyakavikāvyādināmnāmuddhṛtiriṣyate || gavākṣo nāma bandho'yaṃ saralaḥ kavisammataḥ || samāptā alaṃkāramaṇihāralakṣaṇaślokāḥ
